model.name: Staffing Hr
model.description: Staffing and Human Resources is a workforce solutions industry providing temporary and permanent talent placement, recruitment process outsourcing, workforce management, and HR consulting services across all industries and skill levels.
model.core_business_processes: Talent Acquisition and Sourcing, Candidate Screening and Assessment, Job Order Management, Client Relationship Management, Temporary Placement and Assignment Management, Permanent Placement and Direct Hire, Workforce Scheduling and Dispatch, Timesheet and Attendance Management, Payroll Processing and Billing, Compliance and Credentialing Management

domains.name: candidate
domains.description: SSOT for all talent supply-side identity and qualification data. Owns candidate profiles, resumes, skills inventories, certifications, work history, availability, preferences, sourcing channel attribution, and candidate engagement records. Supports ATS workflows in Bullhorn and drives talent pool management, redeployment, and bench tracking across all placement types (W-2, 1099, EOR). Tracks candidate status from initial sourcing through placement and beyond.
domains.references: ISO 30405:2016 — Human Resource Management: Guidelines on Recruitment

products.name: orientation_session

Tracks orientation type (in-person, virtual, client-site, self-paced), session date, location or virtual link, facilitator, duration, topics covered, and per-worker attendance status. May be staffing-agency-led or client-led. Linked to onboarding_record for milestone completion tracking.

attributes.name: managed_program_id

attributes.name: order_header_id

Linking orientation_session to position_requirement enables 'orientation completion rate by position r

attributes.name: requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.requirement. Business justification: Orientation sessions are mandated by compliance requirements (state OSHA safety training, harassment prevention laws, federal contractor onboarding rules). The orientation_session.compliance_category

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: talent_pool_id

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the orientation session concluded. Used for duration tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the orientation session began. May differ from scheduled time.

attributes.name: assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether workers must pass an assessment or quiz to complete the orientation.

attributes.name: attended_count
attributes.description: Number of workers who actually attended the orientation session. Updated after session completion.

attributes.name: average_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Average satisfaction rating from attendee feedback surveys, typically on a scale of 1-5 or 1-10.

attributes.name: completed_count
attributes.description: Number of workers who successfully completed all orientation requirements and passed any assessments.

attributes.name: compliance_category
attributes.description: Classification of compliance requirements addressed by this orientation (e.g., OSHA safety, client-mandated, industry-specific).

attributes.name: cost_per_attendee
attributes.description: Cost incurred per worker attending the orientation, including facilitator time, materials, and facility costs. Used for internal cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the orientation session record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Planned or actual duration of the orientation session in hours. Used for scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: facilitator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the orientation facilitator for coordination and follow-up.

attributes.name: facilitator_name
attributes.description: Name of the person conducting or leading the orientation session (internal staff or client representative).

attributes.name: facilitator_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the orientation facilitator.

attributes.name: feedback_survey_sent

attributes.name: interpreter_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether language interpretation services are provided for this orientation session.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the orientation is conducted, using ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes (e.g., ENG, SPA, FRA).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the orientation session record was last updated.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Category of physical or virtual location where the orientation is conducted.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether attendance at this orientation session is mandatory for worker assignment eligibility.

attributes.name: materials_provided
attributes.description: Description of materials distributed during orientation (e.g., Employee Handbook, Safety Manual, Benefits Guide, ID Badge).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the orientation session, including special circumstances, issues encountered, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: orientation_type
attributes.description: Delivery method for the orientation session. Determines logistics and technology requirements.

attributes.name: passing_score_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage score required to pass the orientation assessment, if applicable.

attributes.name: physical_location
attributes.description: Physical address or facility name where in-person orientation is held (e.g., Main Office - Conference Room A, Client Site - Building 3).

attributes.name: recording_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recording of the orientation session is available for workers who missed the live session.

attributes.name: recording_url
attributes.description: URL or storage location of the orientation session recording. Confidential to control access.

attributes.name: registered_count
attributes.description: Number of workers currently registered for this orientation session.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date the orientation session is scheduled to occur. Used for planning and worker notification.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the orientation session is scheduled to end.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the orientation session is scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: session_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers that can attend this orientation session. Used for scheduling and logistics planning.

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the orientation session, used for external reference and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: session_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the orientation session (e.g., New Hire Orientation - Healthcare Division, Client-Site Safety Training).

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the orientation session. Tracks progression from planning through completion.

attributes.name: topics_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of topics covered in the orientation (e.g., Company Policies, Safety Procedures, Benefits Overview, Timekeeping, Compliance Training).

attributes.name: virtual_meeting_link
attributes.description: URL or meeting link for virtual orientation sessions (e.g., Zoom, Teams, WebEx). Confidential to prevent unauthorized access.

attributes.name: virtual_meeting_reference
attributes.description: Meeting ID or access code for virtual orientation platform. Confidential credential.

products.name: profile
products.description: SSOT master record for every talent supply-side individual tracked in the ATS. Stores core identity: legal name, preferred name, date of birth, gender, pronouns, contact details (email, phone, address), SSN (masked), LinkedIn URL, portfolio URL, candidate type (W-2, 1099, EOR), current employment status, ATS record ID, source system, data classification level, GDPR/CCPA consent flags, do-not-contact flag, and audit timestamps. Captures sourcing attribution: source channel type (job board, referral, social media, direct outreach, RPO campaign, VMS portal, career site, walk-in), source channel name, campaign ID, sourcing recruiter, sourcing date, cost-per-source, UTM parameters, and attribution model (first-touch, last-touch, multi-touch). Anchor entity for the entire candidate domain — all child entities resolve to this record via profile_id FK.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the candidate profile record. Primary key and anchor for all child entities in the candidate domain. MASTER_PARTY role — all downstream candidate domain products resolve to this record via FK.

attributes.name: job_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.job_category. Business justification: Candidate pipeline reporting and order-matching require categorizing profiles by job category. Recruiters filter candidate pools by job_category_id for open requisitions. A staffing ATS expert would e

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the candidates current residence. Used for tax jurisdiction determination (SUTA, FUTA, state income tax withholding), workers compensation policy assignment, and I-9 documentation.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the candidates residence (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address used in payroll tax filings and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: ats_candidate_ref
attributes.description: External candidate identifier assigned by the source Applicant Tracking System (ATS), e.g., Bullhorn candidate record ID. Used for cross-system reconciliation and deduplication between the lakehouse and the operational ATS.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: Attribution model applied to assign sourcing credit for this candidate. First-touch = credit to initial channel; Last-touch = credit to final channel before application; Multi-touch = distributed credit; Linear = equal credit across all touchpoints. Drives cost-per-source and channel ROI calculations.

attributes.name: availability_date
attributes.description: Earliest date the candidate is available to begin a new assignment or placement. Critical for Time to Fill (TTF) and Time to Start (TTS) KPI calculations and for matching candidates to job orders with specific start date requirements.

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Candidates date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for age verification, I-9 eligibility, background check identity matching, and EEOC reporting. Stored masked or access-controlled per GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: candidate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the candidate in the ATS talent pool. Active = available and engaged; Placed = currently on assignment; On Bench = unassigned but available for redeployment; Inactive = not currently pursuing opportunities; Do Not Use = flagged for exclusion; Pending Onboarding = offer accepted, onboarding in progress.

attributes.name: candidate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the candidates engagement model with the staffing firm. W-2 = employee on firms payroll; 1099 = independent contractor (IC); EOR = employer of record arrangement; C2C = corp-to-corp; PEO = professional employer organization. Drives payroll tax treatment, workers comp assignment, and co-employment risk assessment.

attributes.name: ccpa_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has acknowledged CCPA privacy rights disclosure and provided consent for data processing. Required for California residents. Supports CCPA opt-out and data deletion request workflows.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the candidates current residential address. Used for geographic talent pool analytics, commute radius matching, and state/local tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: cost_per_source
attributes.description: Monetary cost attributed to sourcing this specific candidate, in USD. Includes job board fees, advertising spend, referral bonuses, or RPO campaign costs allocated per candidate. Used for sourcing ROI and cost-per-hire analytics.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the candidates current residential address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Required for international operations, GDPR applicability determination, and work authorization validation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the candidate profile record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category. Used for data lineage, SLA measurement, and pipeline age calculations.

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Data governance classification level assigned to this candidate profile record. Drives access control policies, data masking rules, and retention schedules. Restricted = highest sensitivity (PII-heavy); Confidential = sensitive business data; Internal = standard operational; Public = no sensitivity.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has opted out of all recruiter outreach and communications. When True, all automated and manual contact must cease immediately. Enforced per GDPR right to erasure/restriction and CCPA opt-out rights.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Candidates current employment situation at the time of last profile update. Used to prioritize outreach urgency, assess availability, and tailor placement strategy (temp vs. perm vs. contract-to-hire).

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the candidate as recorded in the ATS. Used for identity verification, onboarding documentation (I-9, W-2), and candidate communications.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has provided explicit GDPR consent for the firm to store and process their personal data. Required for candidates in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Must be True before any data processing occurs for covered individuals.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Self-reported gender identity of the candidate. Collected voluntarily for EEOC workforce diversity reporting and OFCCP compliance. Not used in placement decisions per EEOC guidelines.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name (surname) of the candidate as recorded in the ATS. Required for identity verification, payroll tax filings (W-2, 1099), and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: URL to the candidates LinkedIn public profile. Used by recruiters for skills verification, professional history review, and social sourcing attribution. Supports talent pool enrichment and redeployment targeting.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the candidate. Required for background check (BGC) identity matching via Sterling and for I-9 employment eligibility verification.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number for the candidate. Used for SMS outreach, two-factor authentication during onboarding, and time-sensitive placement notifications. Distinct from primary_phone which may be a landline.

attributes.name: portfolio_url
attributes.description: URL to the candidates professional portfolio, personal website, or GitHub profile. Relevant for creative, technical, and IT roles where work samples are evaluated during screening.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the candidates current residential address. Used for geographic proximity matching to job orders, tax jurisdiction lookup, and workforce density analytics.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the candidate prefers to be addressed by in communications and recruiter interactions. May differ from legal name. Used in outreach, interview scheduling, and placement correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary email address used for all recruiter outreach, ATS communications, onboarding workflows, and digital document delivery (DocuSign). Must be unique per active candidate profile.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for candidate contact, stored in E.164 international format. Used for recruiter outreach, interview scheduling, and urgent placement communications.

attributes.name: pronouns
attributes.description: Candidates self-reported preferred pronouns (e.g., he/him, she/her, they/them). Collected voluntarily to support inclusive recruiter communications and workplace culture alignment.

attributes.name: source_channel_name
attributes.description: Specific name of the sourcing channel or platform (e.g., Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, ZipRecruiter, Employee Referral, Beeline VMS Portal, Company Career Site). Provides granular sourcing attribution below the channel type level.

attributes.name: source_channel_type
attributes.description: Category of the channel through which the candidate was originally sourced into the ATS. Used for sourcing ROI analysis, cost-per-source reporting, and channel attribution modeling. Supports talent acquisition strategy optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: job_board|referral|social_media|direct_outreach|rpo_campaign|vms_portal|career_site|walk_in — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this candidate profile was originally ingested into the lakehouse. Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and master data management. Bullhorn is the primary ATS source.

attributes.name: sourcing_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate was first sourced and entered into the ATS talent pool. Used to calculate candidate pipeline age, sourcing velocity metrics, and Time to Fill (TTF) baseline measurements.

attributes.name: ssn_masked
attributes.description: Last four digits of the candidates Social Security Number stored in masked format (XXX-XX-NNNN). Used for identity verification, payroll tax processing (W-2), and E-Verify matching. Full SSN is never stored in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the candidates current residential address (ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, e.g., CA, TX, NY). Critical for SUTA tax assignment, workers compensation rate determination, and FLSA/state labor law compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the candidate profile record in the lakehouse (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: UTM campaign parameter captured from the candidates application URL. Identifies the specific marketing campaign name or code for multi-touch attribution modeling and recruitment marketing ROI reporting.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: UTM medium parameter captured from the candidates application URL (e.g., cpc, organic, email, social). Identifies the marketing medium for digital sourcing attribution analysis.

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: UTM source parameter captured from the candidates application URL (e.g., indeed, linkedin, google). Used for digital marketing attribution and cost-per-source analytics in conjunction with utm_medium and utm_campaign.

attributes.name: visa_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the candidates work visa or employment authorization document (EAD). Used to trigger re-verification workflows, prevent non-compliant placements, and manage I-9 re-verification timelines.

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Candidates legal authorization to work in the applicable jurisdiction. Determines eligibility for placement, I-9 document requirements, and E-Verify processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: us_citizen|permanent_resident|tn_visa|h1b|opt|stem_opt|other_visa|not_authorized — promote to reference product]

products.name: resume
products.description: Stores parsed and raw resume content for each candidate version. Tracks resume version number, file format (PDF, DOCX), raw text blob, parsed structured content (skills extracted, titles extracted, education extracted), parsing engine used (e.g., Sovren, Textkernel), parse confidence score, upload source (portal, recruiter upload, email parse), upload timestamp, active version flag, and storage URI. Supports ATS resume search and talent pool matching workflows in Bullhorn.

attributes.name: resume_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each resume record in the Staffing Hr platform. Primary key for the resume data product within the candidate domain.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate profile that owns this resume. Links the resume to the candidate master record in the Bullhorn ATS candidate object.

attributes.name: bullhorn_resume_ref
attributes.description: External identifier for this resume record as assigned by the Bullhorn ATS/CRM system of record. Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracking, and integration with Bullhorn API workflows.

attributes.name: candidate_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has provided explicit consent for their resume data to be stored, processed, and used for talent matching and placement activities. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance in international and California-based operations.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the candidate provided consent for resume data processing. Required for GDPR and CCPA audit trails. Null if consent has not been obtained or is not applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the resume record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and SOC 2 compliance tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the resume is considered outdated and should be flagged for refresh or archival. Typically set based on business rules (e.g., 12–24 months from upload) to ensure talent pool data currency.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: File format of the uploaded resume document. Determines compatibility with parsing engines and downstream ATS workflows. Common formats include PDF and DOCX as supported by Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: Original file name of the uploaded resume document as provided by the candidate or recruiter. Used for document identification and retrieval from the storage system.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the resume file in bytes. Used for storage management, upload validation, and ensuring compliance with maximum file size limits enforced by the ATS or candidate portal.

attributes.name: highest_education_level
attributes.description: Highest academic degree or credential level attained as extracted from the resume. Used for candidate qualification filtering against job order education requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: High School|Associate|Bachelor|Master|Doctorate|Professional|Certificate|None — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_active_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this resume version is the current active version used for ATS search, talent pool matching, and recruiter review in Bullhorn. Only one resume per candidate should be flagged as active at any time.

attributes.name: is_parsed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resume has been successfully processed by the parsing engine and structured data has been extracted. False indicates the resume is raw/unprocessed or parsing failed.

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this resume is indexed and available for full-text search and talent pool matching queries in the ATS. May be set to false for resumes pending parsing, under compliance hold, or for candidates who have opted out of search.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or BCP 47 language code identifying the primary language in which the resume is written (e.g., en, es, fr). Supports multilingual candidate pools and international staffing operations.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which this resume version was submitted to a client or used in a job order submittal workflow. Supports redeployment tracking and identification of stale resumes requiring candidate outreach.

attributes.name: most_recent_employer
attributes.description: Name of the most recent employer extracted from the resume work history. Used for quick candidate qualification review and employment gap analysis in recruiter workflows.

attributes.name: most_recent_job_title
attributes.description: The most recent or current job title extracted from the resume. Used as the primary candidate headline in ATS search results, talent pool displays, and recruiter-facing candidate summaries.

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Number of pages in the resume document. Used for resume quality assessment and formatting compliance checks during candidate screening workflows.

attributes.name: parse_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric confidence score (0.00–100.00) assigned by the parsing engine indicating the quality and completeness of the structured data extracted from the resume. Low scores may trigger manual review workflows in the ATS.

attributes.name: parse_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the resume through the parsing pipeline. Indicates whether the resume has been successfully parsed, is awaiting parsing, encountered a failure, or requires manual review by a recruiter.

attributes.name: parse_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the resume parsing process was completed. Distinct from upload timestamp; captures the processing event time for SLA tracking of the parsing pipeline.

attributes.name: parsed_education
attributes.description: Structured education history extracted from the resume by the parsing engine, including degree levels, institutions, and fields of study. Supports candidate qualification screening and compliance with client education requirements.

attributes.name: parsed_employers
attributes.description: Structured list of employer names extracted from the resume work history by the parsing engine. Used for employment verification cross-referencing, candidate background check initiation via Sterling, and work history completeness assessment.

attributes.name: parsed_job_titles
attributes.description: Structured list of job titles extracted from the resume work history by the parsing engine. Used for candidate classification, talent pool segmentation, and job order matching in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: parsed_skills
attributes.description: Structured representation of skills extracted from the resume by the parsing engine, stored as a delimited string or serialized list. Feeds the candidate skills inventory and ATS job-order matching algorithms. Examples include technical skills, certifications, and soft skills.

attributes.name: parsing_engine
attributes.description: Name of the automated resume parsing engine used to extract structured data from the raw resume document. Enables quality benchmarking across parsing vendors and troubleshooting of parse failures.

attributes.name: parsing_engine_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the parsing engine used at the time of resume processing. Supports reproducibility audits and regression analysis when parsing engine versions are upgraded.

attributes.name: primary_skill_category
attributes.description: Top-level skill category or discipline assigned to the candidate based on parsed resume content (e.g., Information Technology, Healthcare, Finance, Engineering). Supports talent pool segmentation and workforce planning analytics.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Composite quality score (0.00–100.00) assigned to the resume based on completeness, formatting, keyword density, and parse confidence. Used for talent pool ranking and Quality of Submission (QoS) reporting in recruiter dashboards.

attributes.name: raw_text
attributes.description: Full plain-text extraction of the resume document content prior to structured parsing. Stored as a text blob to support full-text search, keyword matching, and AI/ML talent matching workflows in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: recruiter_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the recruiter during resume review, including observations about candidate qualifications, formatting issues, or follow-up actions required. Supports recruiter collaboration and ATS workflow documentation.

attributes.name: source_job_board
attributes.description: Name of the external job board or sourcing platform from which the resume was originally obtained (e.g., Indeed, LinkedIn, Monster, CareerBuilder, Dice). Supports sourcing channel attribution and cost-per-hire analytics.

attributes.name: storage_uri
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) pointing to the physical location of the resume file in the document storage system (e.g., Azure Blob Storage, AWS S3, or Bullhorn file storage). Used for document retrieval and rendering.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the resume record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: upload_source
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the resume was submitted or ingested into the system. Supports sourcing channel attribution analytics and ATS workflow routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: candidate_portal|recruiter_upload|email_parse|linkedin_import|job_board|vms_import|api_integration — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upload_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the resume file was uploaded or ingested into the system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the resume record lifecycle. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the resume for a given candidate. Increments each time a new resume is uploaded or parsed, enabling version history tracking and identification of the most current document.

attributes.name: word_count
attributes.description: Total number of words in the resume document as extracted during parsing. Used as a proxy for resume completeness and quality scoring in ATS workflows and talent pool management.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of professional work experience calculated or extracted from the resume work history by the parsing engine. Used as a primary screening criterion for job order matching and candidate ranking in ATS workflows.

products.name: work_history
products.description: Structured employment history records for each candidate, capturing prior employer name, job title held, employment type (FTE, contract, temp, self-employed), start date, end date, is_current flag, industry sector, responsibilities summary, reason for leaving, verified flag, verification source, and gap indicator. Sourced from resume parsing and candidate-submitted data in Bullhorn. Used for tenure analysis, skill inference, and placement suitability scoring.

attributes.name: work_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each candidate work history record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: credential_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_instance. Business justification: Employment verification BGC components produce a credential_instance record that verifies a specific work history entry. Linking work_history to credential_instance allows recruiters and compliance te

attributes.name: job_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.job_category. Business justification: Candidate experience classification by job category drives order-matching analytics and redeployment targeting. Staffing firms categorize each work history entry against the standard job_category taxo

attributes.name: prior_client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_account. Business justification: Recruiters routinely check whether a candidate has previously worked at a client account (prior placement history) before submitting — this affects RTR eligibility, DNP status, and relationship contex

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose employment history this record describes. Links to the candidate master profile in the Candidate domain.

attributes.name: resume_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to candidate.resume. Business justification: Work history records are frequently parsed or derived from a candidate's resume. Adding resume_id to work_history creates a traceable provenance link from each structured employment record back to the

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: When is_staffing_agency_placement=true, the prior staffing agency is a known supplier. Linking work_history to supplier enables competitive intelligence reporting, redeployment sourcing analysis, and

attributes.name: bullhorn_work_history_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier for this work history entry in the Bullhorn ATS/CRM system. Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracking, and incremental data loads from the source system.

attributes.name: compensation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the compensation reported in this work history record. Defaults to USD for domestic U.S. placements. Required for international candidate records.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work history record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the completeness and reliability of this work history record based on field population, verification status, and source system confidence. Used for talent pool quality reporting and AI/ML feature weighting.

attributes.name: direct_reports_count
attributes.description: Number of direct reports the candidate managed in this role. Zero for individual contributor roles. Used to assess leadership experience for management-level placements.

attributes.name: employer_location_city
attributes.description: City where the candidate performed work for this employer. Used for geographic placement matching and commute analysis.

attributes.name: employer_location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the candidate performed work for this employer. Supports international placement matching and cross-border compliance tracking.

attributes.name: employer_location_state
attributes.description: U.S. state (or province/region for international) where the candidate performed work for this employer. Used for geographic placement matching, state-specific compliance, and labor law applicability.

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization where the candidate was employed during this work history period. Sourced from resume parsing or candidate-submitted data in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement during this work history period (e.g., Full-Time Equivalent (FTE), contract, temporary, self-employed). Critical for distinguishing permanent vs. contingent experience. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTE|contract|temp|self_employed|part_time|internship — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidates employment at this employer in this role ended. Null if is_current is True. Used for tenure calculation and gap analysis.

attributes.name: gap_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the employment gap immediately preceding this work history records start date. Populated only when has_employment_gap is True. Used for tenure analysis and candidate risk scoring.

attributes.name: has_employment_gap
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is a notable gap in employment immediately preceding this work history records start date. Computed during ingestion from chronological work history analysis. Used for candidate screening and placement suitability assessment.

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: The industry sector of the employer for this work history record (e.g., Healthcare, Technology, Manufacturing, Finance). Used for industry-specific placement matching and talent pool segmentation. Aligned with NAICS or SIC classification.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the candidates current active employer and role. When True, end_date is expected to be null. Used to identify active employment status during placement suitability assessment.

attributes.name: is_relevant_experience
attributes.description: Recruiter-assigned flag indicating whether this work history record is considered relevant experience for current active job orders. Supports targeted talent pool filtering and placement suitability scoring.

attributes.name: is_staffing_agency_placement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work history record represents a placement made through a staffing agency (including Staffing Hr). Used to distinguish direct employment from contingent staffing experience and to identify redeployment candidates.

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work history record has been independently verified through a background check or employment verification process. Verified records carry higher confidence for placement decisions.

attributes.name: job_function
attributes.description: Standardized functional category of the role held (e.g., Engineering, Sales, Finance, Operations, Healthcare). Used for talent pool segmentation, placement matching, and workforce analytics reporting in Power BI.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The position title held by the candidate at the employer during this work history period. Used for skill inference, placement suitability scoring, and tenure analysis.

attributes.name: management_level
attributes.description: Seniority or management level of the role held during this work history period. Used for placement suitability scoring and headcount planning analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual_contributor|team_lead|manager|director|vp|c_suite|executive — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pay_rate_type
attributes.description: Compensation structure type for this work history record (e.g., hourly, salaried, daily rate, per diem, commission-based). Used for compensation benchmarking and pay rate analysis in placement decisions.

attributes.name: reason_for_leaving
attributes.description: Candidate-provided or recruiter-captured reason for departing this employer. Used for candidate risk assessment, fall-off rate analysis, and placement suitability evaluation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resignation|layoff|contract_end|termination|retirement|relocation|career_growth|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this work history record within the data platform (active, deleted by candidate request, flagged as duplicate, or pending verification). Supports GDPR/CCPA right-to-erasure workflows and data quality management.

attributes.name: reported_pay_rate
attributes.description: Candidate-reported compensation rate for this work history record, expressed in the unit defined by pay_rate_type and compensation_currency. Used for pay rate benchmarking and spread analysis in placement pricing. Classified confidential as candidate financial data.

attributes.name: responsibilities_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the candidates key duties, responsibilities, and accomplishments in this role. Sourced from resume parsing or candidate-submitted data in Bullhorn. Used for skill inference, keyword matching, and placement suitability scoring.

attributes.name: resume_section_order
attributes.description: Sequential position of this work history entry as it appeared in the candidates parsed resume (1 = most recent). Used to preserve resume ordering for recruiter review and ATS display.

attributes.name: skills_inferred
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of skills inferred or extracted from the responsibilities_summary and job_title for this work history record via resume parsing. Used to populate the candidate skills inventory and drive placement matching in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code mapped to the job title held in this work history record. Enables standardized occupational analysis, wage benchmarking, and cross-candidate skill comparison.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or ingestion method from which this work history record was originally captured (e.g., Bullhorn ATS resume parsing, candidate portal self-entry, manual recruiter entry). Used for data lineage and quality scoring.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate began employment at this employer in this role. Used for tenure calculation and chronological work history ordering.

attributes.name: tenure_months
attributes.description: Duration of employment at this employer in this role, expressed in whole months. Calculated from start_date and end_date (or current date if is_current). Stored for efficient tenure analysis and placement suitability scoring without repeated computation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work history record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this work history record was verified. Null if is_verified is False. Used for compliance tracking and background check audit trails.

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The source or method used to verify this work history record (e.g., Sterling Background Check, direct employer contact, reference check). Null or not_verified if is_verified is False.

attributes.name: work_arrangement
attributes.description: The physical work arrangement for this role (on-site, remote, or hybrid). Used for placement preference matching and workforce planning analytics.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Tax and legal classification of the candidates engagement type during this work history period (W-2 employee, 1099 independent contractor, Employer of Record (EOR), Corp-to-Corp (C2C)). Critical for IRS worker classification compliance and co-employment risk assessment.

products.name: skill
products.description: Canonical skill inventory record for a candidate, representing a single skill or competency attributed to the individual. Captures skill name (normalized to a controlled taxonomy where available), skill category (technical, soft skill, domain expertise, language, tool/platform), proficiency level (beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert), years of experience with the skill, last used date, skill source (self-reported, resume parsed, assessment verified, recruiter tagged), endorsement count, and is_primary flag indicating the candidates top marketable skills. Supports talent pool search, job order matching via skill-to-requirement mapping, and QoS (Quality of Submission) scoring workflows in Bullhorn. Skills may be linked to specific work_history entries or assessment results for provenance.

attributes.name: skill_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a candidate skill record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the skill data product within the candidate domain.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate who possesses this skill. Links the skill record to the owning candidate profile in the candidate domain SSOT.

attributes.name: billable_rate_premium
attributes.description: Incremental bill rate premium (in USD) associated with this skill when pricing candidate placements. Reflects the market premium clients pay for candidates with this specific skill. Used in rate card configuration and spread/markup calculations. Confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this skill record was first created in the system of record. Audit trail field supporting data governance, compliance reporting, and Silver Layer lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: demand_index
attributes.description: Relative market demand score for this skill based on open job order frequency, client request patterns, and labor market data. Used in workforce planning, bench management, and redeployment prioritization. Higher values indicate higher current market demand.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this skill record is considered valid and active for talent matching and placement purposes. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) patterns in the Silver Layer and enables point-in-time skill profile reconstruction for compliance and audit.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this skill record version expires or is superseded. Null for currently active records. Supports SCD Type 2 history tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse for point-in-time candidate skill profile reconstruction.

attributes.name: endorsement_count
attributes.description: Number of endorsements or validations this skill has received from recruiters, clients, or peers. Higher endorsement counts increase the skills credibility weight in QoS scoring and talent pool ranking algorithms.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this skill is designated as one of the candidates top marketable skills. Primary skills are surfaced prominently in Bullhorn ATS submittal profiles, talent pool search results, and QoS scoring. True = primary/top skill; False = secondary or supporting skill.

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this skill has been independently verified through a formal assessment, certification, or recruiter validation process. True = verified; False = unverified (self-reported or resume-parsed only). Verified skills carry higher weight in QoS scoring and submittal quality metrics.

attributes.name: language_proficiency_standard
attributes.description: Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) proficiency level applicable when skill_category is language. A1/A2: basic user; B1/B2: independent user; C1/C2: proficient user. Null for non-language skills. Enables standardized language skill matching for multilingual placement requirements.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the candidate actively applied this skill in a professional context. Used to assess skill currency and recency for job order matching. A stale last_used_date may reduce QoS score for time-sensitive technical skills.

attributes.name: normalized_skill_name
attributes.description: Canonical, taxonomy-normalized version of the skill name after standardization processing (e.g., MS Excel normalized to Microsoft Excel, JS normalized to JavaScript). Enables consistent cross-candidate skill comparison, deduplication, and job order matching across ATS and VMS platforms.

attributes.name: pay_rate_premium
attributes.description: Incremental pay rate premium (in USD) associated with this skill when compensating placed candidates. Reflects the market premium paid to candidates possessing this skill. Used alongside billable_rate_premium to calculate spread and gross margin for skill-based placements.

attributes.name: placement_type_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates which worker classification or placement type this skill is relevant for. W-2 (employee), 1099 (independent contractor), EOR (Employer of Record), or all placement types. Used to filter talent pools by worker classification in Bullhorn ATS and Beeline VMS matching workflows.

attributes.name: proficiency_level
attributes.description: Self-assessed or recruiter-assigned proficiency level for this skill. Drives Quality of Submission (QoS) scoring and candidate-to-job-order matching in Bullhorn. Beginner: foundational awareness; Intermediate: working knowledge; Advanced: deep proficiency; Expert: authoritative mastery.

attributes.name: proficiency_score
attributes.description: Numeric proficiency score assigned through a formal assessment or standardized test (e.g., 0.00–100.00 scale). Complements the categorical proficiency_level with a precise quantitative measure for advanced talent matching and QoS scoring. Null when no formal assessment has been conducted.

attributes.name: qos_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this skill for Quality of Submission (QoS) scoring in Bullhorn ATS. Reflects the relative importance of this skill in candidate-to-job-order matching. Higher weights indicate skills that are more critical to placement success. Expressed as a decimal between 0.0000 and 1.0000.

attributes.name: redeployment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this skill qualifies the candidate for redeployment consideration in bench management workflows. True = skill is in active demand and candidate should be surfaced for redeployment matching; False = skill does not currently support redeployment eligibility. Supports bench tracking and redeployment workflows in Bullhorn.

attributes.name: skill_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the skill type used to segment the talent pool and drive job order matching logic. Values: technical (programming, engineering), soft_skill (communication, leadership), domain_expertise (industry knowledge), language (spoken/written languages), tool_platform (software applications and platforms).

attributes.name: skill_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the candidates application of this skill, including specific tools, methodologies, or contexts in which the skill was used. Supports recruiter notes and enhances submittal quality in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: skill_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the skill or competency (e.g., Python, Payroll Processing, Conflict Resolution, SAP SuccessFactors). Normalized to a controlled taxonomy where available to support consistent talent pool search and job order matching in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: skill_source
attributes.description: Provenance indicator describing how this skill was attributed to the candidate. Self_reported: candidate entered directly; resume_parsed: extracted via ATS resume parsing in Bullhorn; assessment_verified: confirmed through a formal skills assessment; recruiter_tagged: added by a recruiter; certification_derived: inferred from a verified credential or certification record.

attributes.name: skill_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the skill record. Active: skill is current and searchable in talent pool; inactive: skill has been deactivated by recruiter or candidate; pending_verification: skill awaiting assessment or credential confirmation; archived: historical record retained for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this skill record originated or was last synchronized. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Values: bullhorn (Bullhorn ATS/CRM), successfactors (SAP SuccessFactors), beeline (Beeline VMS), linkedin (LinkedIn integration), manual (direct data entry), resume_parser (automated resume parsing engine).

attributes.name: source_system_skill_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier for this skill record in the originating operational system (e.g., Bullhorn skill record ID, SuccessFactors competency ID). Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and source systems for data quality and lineage purposes.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the skill_category (e.g., within technical: programming_language, database, cloud_platform; within domain_expertise: healthcare_staffing, finance, manufacturing). Supports fine-grained talent pool segmentation and job order matching.

attributes.name: taxonomy_code
attributes.description: Standardized code from a controlled skill taxonomy (e.g., O*NET SOC skill codes, ESCO skill URIs, or internal Staffing Hr taxonomy identifiers) used to normalize skill names across ATS, VMS, and job board integrations. Enables cross-system skill-to-requirement mapping in Beeline VMS and Bullhorn.

attributes.name: taxonomy_source
attributes.description: Identifies the controlled vocabulary or taxonomy system from which the taxonomy_code is drawn. Supports multi-taxonomy normalization across ATS and VMS platforms. Values: onet (U.S. DOL O*NET), esco (EU ESCO framework), internal (Staffing Hr proprietary taxonomy), linkedin (LinkedIn Skills taxonomy), custom (client-specific taxonomy).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this skill record in the system of record. Supports incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail requirements in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, system, or organization that verified this skill (e.g., recruiter name, assessment platform name, certification body). Provides audit trail for skill verification provenance.

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the skill was formally verified or validated. Populated when is_verified = True. Used to assess verification currency and determine if re-verification is required for compliance-sensitive placements.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total number of years the candidate has actively used or applied this skill across all work history entries. Expressed as a decimal to support fractional years (e.g., 2.5 years). Used in talent pool search filters and QoS scoring workflows.

products.name: availability
products.description: Tracks a candidates current and future availability for placement along with stated job search and placement preferences. Availability attributes: status (available, on assignment, bench, unavailable), available start date, preferred shift, preferred hours per week (min/max), preferred work arrangement (on-site, remote, hybrid), geographic availability (city, state, radius), willing to relocate flag, willing to travel flag, travel percentage max. Preference attributes: preferred job titles, preferred industries, preferred employment type (temp, contract-to-hire, direct placement, FTE), desired pay rate (min/max), desired bill rate awareness flag, preferred locations, preferred company size, preferred work culture attributes, open to temp-to-perm flag, open to per diem flag, preference last updated date. Critical for bench tracking, redeployment, dispatch workflows, and proactive sourcing outreach.

attributes.name: availability_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the candidate availability and preference record. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: job_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.job_category. Business justification: Available-candidate-by-job-category matching is a core daily staffing operation. Recruiters run 'show me available candidates for job category X' reports. Linking availability to job_category enables

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose availability and placement preferences this record describes. Links to the candidate master profile in the Candidate domain.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current placement availability state of the candidate. available indicates actively seeking work; on_assignment indicates currently placed; bench indicates between assignments but still engaged; unavailable indicates not seeking work; do_not_contact indicates candidate has opted out of outreach. Critical for bench tracking and redeployment workflows in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: available_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which the candidate has indicated availability, if bounded. Null indicates open-ended availability. Useful for temporary or project-based candidates with known commitment windows.

attributes.name: available_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which the candidate is available to begin a new assignment or placement. Used by recruiters for job order matching and dispatch scheduling. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS candidate record.

attributes.name: confirmed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the candidates current availability status was last confirmed by a recruiter or by the candidate directly. Distinct from preference_last_updated_date; specifically tracks confirmation of the availability_status field.

attributes.name: desired_bill_rate_aware
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has been informed of or is aware of the client bill rate associated with their placement. True = candidate is aware of bill rate; False = candidate has not been informed. Relevant for co-employment risk management and transparency compliance.

attributes.name: desired_pay_rate_max
attributes.description: Maximum hourly or annual pay rate the candidate is targeting, expressed in USD. Represents the upper bound of the candidates compensation expectation. Used alongside desired_pay_rate_min for range-based matching.

attributes.name: desired_pay_rate_min
attributes.description: Minimum hourly or annual pay rate the candidate is willing to accept, expressed in USD. Used by recruiters to qualify candidates against job order pay rate budgets and to calculate spread and gross margin. Confidential compensation data.

attributes.name: do_not_place_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has been flagged as ineligible for placement (e.g., due to performance issues, compliance violations, or client restrictions). True = do not place; False = eligible for placement. Critical compliance and risk management control.

attributes.name: do_not_place_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the candidate has been flagged as do-not-place. Populated only when do_not_place_flag is True. Examples: client_restriction, compliance_violation, performance_issue, voluntary_withdrawal.

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: City within which the candidate is willing to accept placements. Used for geographic matching in job order dispatch and sourcing outreach workflows.

attributes.name: geo_radius_miles
attributes.description: Maximum commute radius in miles from the candidates home location that they are willing to travel for an assignment. Used in proximity-based job order matching and sourcing outreach.

attributes.name: geo_state
attributes.description: U.S. state (two-letter USPS abbreviation) within which the candidate is willing to accept placements. Supports state-level labor law compliance checks (e.g., SUTA, state wage-hour laws).

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date on which a recruiter last made contact with the candidate to confirm or update their availability status. Used to identify stale availability records and trigger re-engagement outreach. Supports candidate engagement analytics.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text recruiter notes regarding the candidates availability, special circumstances, or placement preferences not captured in structured fields (e.g., Candidate available after current project ends mid-month; prefers no weekends).

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of notice the candidate requires before starting a new assignment or must give to their current employer. Used to calculate realistic Time to Start (TTS) for job order fulfillment planning.

attributes.name: open_to_per_diem
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is willing to accept per diem compensation arrangements (daily allowances for travel, lodging, meals). True = willing to accept per diem; False = not interested. Relevant for travel nursing, field services, and project-based placements.

attributes.name: open_to_temp_to_perm
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is open to a Temp-to-Perm (contract-to-hire) arrangement where a temporary assignment may convert to a permanent position. True = open to conversion; False = not interested in conversion. Drives conversion fee eligibility tracking.

attributes.name: pay_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidates desired pay rate is expressed as an hourly rate, annual salary, or daily per diem rate. Required to normalize compensation comparisons across job orders with different pay structures.

attributes.name: preference_last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the candidate last updated their placement preferences (job titles, industries, pay rate, work arrangement, etc.). Used to assess preference data freshness and trigger re-engagement when preferences are stale.

attributes.name: preferred_company_size
attributes.description: Candidates stated preference for the size of the client organization they wish to work with. Supports matching candidates to client accounts by headcount tier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: startup|small|mid_market|enterprise — promote to reference product if additional tiers are needed]

attributes.name: preferred_employment_type
attributes.description: Candidates stated preference for the type of engagement. temp = temporary/contract; contract_to_hire = Contract-to-Hire (CTH); direct_placement = Direct Hire/Permanent; fte = Full-Time Equivalent salaried role; per_diem = per diem/daily rate engagement. Drives job order matching logic in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: preferred_hours_per_week_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours per week the candidate is willing to work. Prevents over-scheduling and supports overtime (OT) management. Relevant for FLSA compliance and ACA hour-tracking thresholds.

attributes.name: preferred_hours_per_week_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours per week the candidate is willing to work. Used to qualify candidates for part-time versus full-time job orders. Supports FLSA classification analysis.

attributes.name: preferred_industries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of industries the candidate prefers to work in (e.g., Healthcare, Technology, Finance). Used to match candidates to client accounts by industry vertical. Aligns with SIC/NAICS industry classification.

attributes.name: preferred_job_titles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job titles the candidate is actively seeking. Used for keyword-based job order matching and proactive sourcing outreach in Bullhorn ATS. Examples: Software Engineer, Senior Developer, Tech Lead.

attributes.name: preferred_locations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific cities, metro areas, or regions the candidate prefers for placement (e.g., Austin TX, Dallas TX, Remote). More granular than geo_city/geo_state for multi-location preferences.

attributes.name: preferred_shift
attributes.description: Candidates preferred work shift. Used in workforce scheduling and dispatch workflows, particularly for light industrial, healthcare, and manufacturing placements managed through Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: preferred_work_arrangement
attributes.description: Candidates stated preference for physical work location arrangement: fully on-site, fully remote, or hybrid. Used to filter and match job orders by work model in ATS and VMS platforms.

attributes.name: preferred_work_culture
attributes.description: Free-text or comma-separated description of the candidates preferred workplace culture attributes (e.g., collaborative, fast-paced, diverse, mission-driven). Used in qualitative matching for direct hire and FTE placements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this availability record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR/CCPA data retention compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this availability record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for identifying recently updated availability records for recruiter workflows.

attributes.name: redeployment_candidate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this candidate has been flagged for proactive redeployment outreach before their current assignment ends. True = flagged for redeployment; False = not flagged. Supports bench management and redeployment workflows to reduce fall-off rate.

attributes.name: redeployment_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the recruiter aims to redeploy the candidate into a new assignment. Typically set relative to the current assignment end date. Drives redeployment pipeline reporting in Power BI.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.description: Date after which the assessment result is no longer considered valid for placement decisions. Particularly relevant for drug screens, background checks, and certifications with regulatory shelf-life requirements.

attributes.name: is_proctored
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment was administered under proctored conditions to ensure integrity and prevent cheating. Relevant for high-stakes technical screens and cognitive assessments.

attributes.name: is_req_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment was administered specifically for a particular job order/requisition (True) or as a general talent pool qualification assessment (False). Drives reusability logic for candidate redeployment.

attributes.name: medical_review_officer
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the licensed Medical Review Officer (MRO) who reviewed and certified the drug screen result. Required for DOT-regulated positions and federally mandated drug testing programs.

attributes.name: normalized_score
attributes.description: The standardized score after applying normalization logic (e.g., percentile conversion, scale adjustment) to enable cross-assessment and cross-candidate comparison. Drives Quality of Submission (QoS) and candidate ranking workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or assessor observations, qualitative feedback, or contextual notes about the assessment administration or result. Supports human-in-the-loop review workflows.

attributes.name: pass_fail_result
attributes.description: The binary or categorical outcome of the assessment indicating whether the candidate met the required threshold. Drives ATS workflow routing, submittal eligibility, and Quality of Submission (QoS) scoring.

attributes.name: passing_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum score required for a candidate to pass this assessment. Used to derive pass/fail result and enforce client-specific or role-specific screening standards.

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: The candidates score expressed as a percentile relative to the norming population for this assessment. Enables comparative ranking of candidates for a given requisition.

attributes.name: provider_assessment_code
attributes.description: The external identifier assigned to this assessment by the third-party assessment provider platform. Enables reconciliation between internal records and provider systems (e.g., Sterling, HireVue, Codility).

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or platform that administered the assessment (e.g., HireVue, Codility, Wonderlic, Sterling Background Check). Used for vendor performance tracking and cost allocation.

attributes.name: raw_score
attributes.description: The unprocessed numeric score returned directly by the assessment provider or evaluator before normalization. Retained for audit and re-scoring purposes.

attributes.name: reference_source_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who provided a reference check response, applicable when assessment_type is reference_check. Stored for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: reference_source_relationship
attributes.description: The professional relationship of the reference provider to the candidate (e.g., supervisor, colleague). Applicable when assessment_type is reference_check. Informs the weight given to the reference in QoS scoring.

attributes.name: result_detail
attributes.description: Narrative or structured detail describing the assessment outcome beyond the pass/fail result (e.g., drug screen substance detected, reference check summary, behavioral competency ratings). Supports recruiter review and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: reusable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment result can be reused for other job orders or placements without re-administration, subject to expiration date. Supports candidate redeployment and bench management efficiency.

attributes.name: score_scale_max
attributes.description: The maximum possible score on the assessment instruments scoring scale. Required to interpret raw and normalized scores in context and calculate score percentages.

attributes.name: score_scale_min
attributes.description: The minimum possible score on the assessment instruments scoring scale. Required to interpret raw and normalized scores in context.

attributes.name: skill_category
attributes.description: The primary skill domain or competency area evaluated by this assessment (e.g., Java Development, Microsoft Excel, Forklift Operation, Customer Service). Supports skills inventory management and talent pool segmentation.

attributes.name: source_system

Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse. attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this assessment record was last modified. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and audit compliance.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the assessment instrument or test form administered. Ensures score comparability across candidates assessed with different versions of the same test.

attributes.name: accreditation_body

attributes.name: concentration

attributes.name: credential_evaluation_body

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the education credential. Tracks whether the credential is active and valid, expired, revoked by the institution, or pending issuance. Drives compliance checks in the credentialing management workflow.

attributes.name: data_quality_score

attributes.name: degree_name
attributes.description: Full verbatim name of the degree or certificate as it appears on the official credential document (e.g., Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering, AWS Certified Solutions Architect). Preserves the exact credential title for client-facing submittals and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: degree_type

attributes.name: graduation_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year of graduation or program completion. Stored separately from graduation_date to support cases where only the year is known (e.g., resume-parsed data). Used for cohort analytics and workforce planning.

attributes.name: honors

attributes.name: institution_city

attributes.name: institution_country

attributes.name: institution_state

attributes.name: is_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate completed and received the degree or certificate (True) or attended without completing (False). Critical for qualification matching — incomplete degrees may not satisfy job order minimum education requirements.

attributes.name: is_deleted

attributes.name: is_highest_degree

attributes.name: is_verified

attributes.name: major

attributes.name: minor

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: source_channel
