attributes.description: Indicates whether this RTR grant is subject to an active dispute, such as a competing vendor claiming prior right to represent the same candidate to the same client. True = disputed; False = undisputed.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome and resolution of an RTR dispute, including the basis for the decision (e.g., timestamp comparison, client confirmation). Populated only when dispute_flag is True.

attributes.name: eeoc_disposition_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Disposition Code
attributes.description: Standardized EEOC disposition code associated with the candidates submittal outcome linked to this RTR, used for adverse action tracking and OFCCP/EEOC reporting. Populated after submittal disposition is determined. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: interviewed|not_selected|hired|withdrawn|no_show|position_cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: email_thread_reference
attributes.description: Message ID or thread reference from the email system capturing the candidates email-based RTR consent. Applicable when grant_method is email. Used for audit evidence retrieval.

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exclusivity period of the RTR grant ends, after which the candidate may be submitted by other vendors. Null when exclusivity_flag is False or exclusivity is open-ended.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTR grant is exclusive to this staffing firm for the specified scope, preventing the candidate from being submitted by competing vendors to the same client or requisition. True = exclusive; False = non-exclusive.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RTR grant expires and is no longer valid for new submittals. Null indicates no expiration (open-ended grant). Enforced by ATS workflow to prevent unauthorized submittals after expiry.

attributes.name: grant_method
attributes.description: The channel or mechanism by which the candidate provided RTR consent. verbal — spoken consent captured by recruiter; email — written consent via email; portal_consent — self-service ATS/candidate portal click-through; signed_form — wet or e-signature on RTR document; vms_portal — consent captured through a Vendor Management System (VMS) portal such as Beeline.

attributes.name: grant_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the candidate granted the Right to Represent authorization. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction, distinct from the record audit timestamp.

attributes.name: is_revoked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has revoked the RTR grant prior to its natural expiration. True = revoked; False = not revoked. Used as a fast-path filter in submittal eligibility checks.

attributes.name: nda_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to be in place before the candidates profile can be shared. True = NDA required prior to submittal; False = no NDA requirement.

attributes.name: nda_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required NDA has been executed by the candidate prior to or concurrent with the RTR grant. Relevant when nda_required is True. True = NDA signed; False = NDA not yet signed.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes entered by the recruiter or compliance team regarding this RTR grant, including any special conditions, client-specific requirements, or contextual information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: ofccp_audit_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RTR record has all required documentation and metadata to satisfy an Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) audit, including consent evidence, timestamps, and scope definition. True = audit-ready; False = documentation incomplete.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The worker classification and engagement type for which the RTR is being granted. w2_temp — W-2 temporary placement; 1099_contract — independent contractor (1099); contract_to_hire — contract-to-hire (temp-to-perm); direct_hire — direct placement/permanent; eor — Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement.

attributes.name: revocation_initiated_by
attributes.description: Identifies who initiated the revocation of the RTR grant. candidate — candidate self-revoked; recruiter — recruiter revoked on behalf of candidate; system — automated revocation triggered by business rule (e.g., placement made); client — client requested removal.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or categorized explanation provided by the candidate or recruiter for why the RTR was revoked. Examples: candidate accepted another offer, candidate withdrew from process, candidate requested removal from client consideration.

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the candidate revoked the RTR grant. Null when is_revoked is False. Required for audit trail and to determine the window during which submittals were authorized.

attributes.name: rtr_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for the RTR grant, used in recruiter communications, audit trails, and submittal documentation. Format: RTR-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: rtr_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the RTR authorization. single_req — limited to one specific requisition/job order; client_wide — covers all open requisitions at the named client; program_wide — covers all requisitions within a managed service program (MSP/VMS program).

attributes.name: rtr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the RTR grant. active — valid and usable for submittal; expired — past expiration date; revoked — candidate withdrew consent; pending — awaiting candidate confirmation; superseded — replaced by a newer RTR for the same scope.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system where the RTR consent was captured. bullhorn — Bullhorn ATS/CRM; beeline_vms — Beeline VMS portal; candidate_portal — self-service candidate portal; email — email-based capture; manual — manually entered by recruiter.

attributes.name: source_system_rtr_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this RTR record in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn submittal ID, Beeline VMS consent token). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this RTR record, including status changes, revocations, or scope updates.

attributes.name: valid_days_duration
attributes.description: The number of calendar days for which the RTR grant is valid from the grant_timestamp. Used to calculate expiration_date and to standardize RTR validity policies across client programs.

attributes.name: verbal_consent_notes
attributes.description: Recruiter-entered notes documenting the circumstances of a verbal RTR consent, including date, time, and summary of conversation. Required when grant_method is verbal to satisfy audit requirements.

The denormalized bgc_status, drug_screen_sta

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Vendor Management System (VMS) program associated with this talent pool membership, if the pool is managed under a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or VMS-driven contingent workforce program via Beeline VMS.

attributes.name: added_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the candidate was added to the talent pool. Used for tenure-in-pool analytics and redeployment SLA tracking.

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: Total number of recruiter contact attempts made to the candidate since being added to this talent pool. Used to identify unresponsive candidates and trigger escalation or exit workflows.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this talent pool membership record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: engagement_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) reflecting the candidates level of engagement with the talent pool, based on recruiter interactions, response rates, and activity signals. Higher scores indicate more responsive and engaged candidates. Used to prioritize outreach and predict placement likelihood.

attributes.name: exit_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the candidate exited or was removed from the talent pool. Null if the membership is still active. Used for pool churn analysis and redeployment outcome tracking.

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: Reason the candidate exited the talent pool. placed indicates a successful placement was made; declined_offer indicates the candidate declined a placement offer; unresponsive indicates the candidate became unreachable; disqualified indicates the candidate no longer meets pool criteria; converted_to_perm indicates a temp-to-perm conversion occurred. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: placed|declined_offer|unresponsive|disqualified|converted_to_perm|pool_dissolved|candidate_request|credential_lapse — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: i9_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has a valid, completed I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on file, confirming work authorization in the United States. Required for all W-2 placements. Sourced from compliance.i9_verification.

attributes.name: interview_count
attributes.description: Number of client interviews the candidate has completed as a result of submittals from this talent pool membership. Used to measure pool conversion effectiveness and recruiter performance.

attributes.name: is_redeployment_candidate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pool membership record was created as part of a formal redeployment workflow triggered by an ending assignment. True when the candidate is being actively redeployed; False for general talent pool members. Supports bench and redeployment tracking KPIs.

attributes.name: is_willing_to_relocate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is willing to relocate for a placement sourced from this talent pool. True if the candidate has expressed willingness to relocate; False if the candidate requires local placements only. Expands the geographic matching radius for job order fulfillment.

attributes.name: is_willing_to_travel
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is willing to travel for assignments sourced from this talent pool. Relevant for travel nursing, per diem, and project-based staffing programs where travel is required.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recruiter contact or outreach activity with the candidate regarding this pool membership. Used to identify stale pool members who have not been contacted recently and to enforce pool maintenance SLAs.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the candidates membership in the talent pool. active indicates the candidate is actively managed within the pool; pending_review indicates awaiting recruiter qualification; suspended indicates temporarily paused; exited indicates the candidate has been removed from the pool.

attributes.name: membership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the candidates pool membership. redeployment indicates the candidate is being actively redeployed from an ending assignment; bench indicates an unassigned worker available for dispatch; talent_community indicates a passive talent community member; client_specific indicates a pool curated for a specific client program; specialty_practice indicates a domain-specific skill pool. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: redeployment|bench|talent_community|client_specific|specialty_practice|pipeline|vms_preferred|msp_approved — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pay_rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the pay rate values (pay_rate_min, pay_rate_max). Defaults to USD for domestic U.S. operations. Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing programs.

attributes.name: pay_rate_max
attributes.description: The maximum hourly or unit pay rate the candidate is targeting for placements sourced from this talent pool. Expressed in USD. Used alongside pay_rate_min to define the candidates acceptable pay range for matching and negotiation.

attributes.name: pay_rate_min
attributes.description: The minimum hourly or unit pay rate the candidate is willing to accept for placements sourced from this talent pool. Expressed in USD. Used by recruiters during job order matching to filter viable candidates. Supports spread and gross margin analysis.

attributes.name: pool_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the candidate was formally qualified and approved for inclusion in this talent pool by a recruiter or pool manager. May differ from added_date if a review/approval workflow is required before activation.

attributes.name: preferred_location_city
attributes.description: The candidates preferred city for work assignments sourced from this talent pool. Used for geographic matching of job orders to pool members. Supports workforce scheduling and dispatch workflows.

attributes.name: preferred_location_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code for the candidates preferred work location. Used for geographic filtering during job order matching and for state-specific compliance checks (SUTA, workers comp, wage-hour laws).

attributes.name: preferred_work_type
attributes.description: The candidates preferred employment classification or engagement type within this pool. Reflects whether the candidate prefers W-2 temporary, 1099 independent contractor, Employer of Record (EOR), or direct hire arrangements. Informs compliance and worker classification checks.

attributes.name: primary_skill_category
attributes.description: The primary skill category or discipline that qualifies the candidate for this talent pool (e.g., Information Technology, Healthcare - Nursing, Light Industrial, Finance & Accounting). Used for pool segmentation and job order matching. Free-text aligned to the pools defined skill taxonomy.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Recruiter-assigned priority tier indicating the urgency and desirability of placing this candidate from the pool. Tier 1 represents highest priority (e.g., actively redeploying workers with imminent assignment end dates); Tier 4 represents passive pipeline members. Drives recruiter workflow prioritization.

attributes.name: qualification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the recruiter or pool manager documenting the rationale for the candidates inclusion in the talent pool, any qualification criteria met, or special considerations for placement matching.

attributes.name: redeployment_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the recruiter aims to redeploy the candidate into a new assignment. Typically aligned with or shortly after the ending assignments end date. Used for redeployment SLA and Time to Start (TTS) tracking.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The sourcing channel or mechanism through which the candidate was identified and added to this talent pool. redeployment indicates the candidate was added as part of an assignment-end redeployment workflow; vms_import indicates the candidate was sourced via Beeline VMS. Supports sourcing channel attribution analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ats_sourcing|redeployment|referral|vms_import|job_board|direct_apply|recruiter_outreach|social_media|campus|alumni — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this talent pool membership record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver layer. bullhorn indicates the record was sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM; beeline_vms indicates a VMS-managed pool imported from Beeline.

attributes.name: source_system_record_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this talent pool membership record in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn Tearsheet Member ID or Beeline Pool Member ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and deduplication in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: submittal_count
attributes.description: Number of times the candidate has been submitted (submitted to a client for consideration) from this talent pool membership. A submittal is a formal presentation of a candidates profile to a client for a specific job order. Tracks pool productivity and Quality of Submission (QoS) metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this talent pool membership record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: The IRS and DOL worker classification applicable to this candidate within the context of this talent pool. Determines tax treatment, benefits eligibility, and co-employment risk. w2_employee indicates a W-2 temporary employee; 1099_ic indicates an Independent Contractor (IC); eor indicates Employer of Record arrangement; corp_to_corp indicates a business-to-business engagement.

domains.name: client
domains.description: SSOT for all client (employer) identity and commercial relationship data. Owns client company profiles, contacts, account hierarchies, locations, MSA agreements, rate cards, VMS integrations, SLA configurations, NPS scores, and CRM engagement history sourced from Bullhorn and Salesforce. Serves as the authoritative source for WHO the business serves on the demand side, supporting both direct clients and VMS/MSP program relationships.

products.name: client_account
products.description: Master record for every client (employer) organization that Staffing Hr serves. SSOT for client company identity, classification, and billing configuration. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM and Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Captures legal entity name, DBA name, DUNS number, FEIN, industry classification (NAICS/SIC), company size tier, client type (direct, VMS/MSP, RPO), account status (prospect, active, inactive, on-hold, terminated), primary business address, website, and CRM account owner. Also owns billing preferences: invoice delivery method, invoice frequency, invoice grouping rules (by location, department, cost center, or consolidated), PO number requirements, payment method (ACH, check, wire), billing contact, and preferred payment portal. Demand-side anchor entity for all job orders, placements, billing, and commercial relationships.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each client account record in the Staffing Hr system. System-generated identifier used as the anchor key for all downstream job orders, placements, billing, and commercial relationships.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the client account. Drives operational eligibility for job order creation, placement activity, and billing. Values: prospect (pre-contract sales stage), active (current client with open MSA), inactive (no current activity but relationship intact), on_hold (temporarily suspended per SLA or compliance issue), terminated (relationship ended).

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the designated billing contact at the client organization. Primary channel for electronic invoice delivery, payment reminders, and accounts receivable communications.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated billing contact at the client organization responsible for receiving and approving invoices. Used by Salesforce Revenue Cloud and accounts receivable for invoice delivery and payment follow-up.

attributes.name: bullhorn_client_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned to this client account within Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the Silver layer and the operational source system.

attributes.name: client_type
attributes.description: Classifies the commercial relationship model under which Staffing Hr serves this client. Values: direct (standard staffing client), vms_msp (client managed through a Vendor Management System or Managed Service Provider program), rpo (Recruitment Process Outsourcing engagement), eor (Employer of Record arrangement), peo (Professional Employer Organization), sow (Statement of Work-based engagement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|vms_msp|rpo|eor|peo|sow — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: company_size_tier
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the client organization by employee headcount or revenue band. Used for account segmentation, service tier assignment, pricing strategy, and sales territory management. Values: small (<100 FTE), mid_market (100–999 FTE), enterprise (1,000–9,999 FTE), global_enterprise (10,000+ FTE).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the client account record was first created in the system of record (Bullhorn ATS/CRM or Salesforce Revenue Cloud). Represents the audit trail creation event and is used for data lineage, compliance reporting, and record age analysis.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: The maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance approved for this client before new placements or billing activity is placed on hold. Managed in Oracle NetSuite ERP as part of credit risk controls. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all billing and financial transactions with this client (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Defaults to USD for domestic clients. Required for multi-currency revenue recognition in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or Doing Business As (DBA) name under which the client operates commercially, if different from the legal entity name. Used in client-facing communications, invoices, and CRM displays.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to uniquely identify the client organization globally. Used for credit risk assessment, vendor onboarding, and government contract compliance (OFCCP).

attributes.name: employee_headcount
attributes.description: Approximate total number of full-time equivalent (FTE) employees at the client organization at the time of account creation or last update. Used to validate company size tier classification and inform workforce planning and capacity estimates.

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: The Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) assigned by the IRS to uniquely identify the client as a tax entity. Required for W-2 co-employment compliance, tax reporting, and workers compensation administration.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: The preferred method by which invoices are delivered to the client. Values: email (electronic PDF via email), portal (client self-service billing portal), mail (physical mail), edi (Electronic Data Interchange), fax (facsimile). Configured in Salesforce Revenue Cloud billing preferences.

attributes.name: invoice_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed billing cycle frequency for generating and delivering invoices to this client. Values: weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, on_demand. Drives automated invoice generation scheduling in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: invoice_grouping_rule
attributes.description: Defines how timesheet and placement charges are consolidated onto invoices for this client. Values: consolidated (single invoice for all activity), by_location (separate invoice per work site), by_department (separate invoice per client department), by_cost_center (separate invoice per cost center), by_po (separate invoice per Purchase Order number). Configured per client MSA terms.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full registered legal name of the client organization as it appears on the Master Service Agreement (MSA) and all contractual and tax documents. This is the authoritative identity label for the client entity.

attributes.name: main_phone
attributes.description: Primary switchboard or main office phone number for the client organization. Used for account management outreach, service delivery coordination, and CRM contact records.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Staffing Hr account manager responsible for day-to-day service delivery, relationship management, and SLA compliance for this client. May differ from the CRM account owner (sales rep). Used for operational escalation and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: msa_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Master Service Agreement (MSA) between Staffing Hr and this client became legally effective. Marks the start of the contractual relationship and governs all placements, billing terms, and SLA obligations. Sourced from DocuSign CLM.

attributes.name: msa_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current Master Service Agreement (MSA) is scheduled to expire or must be renewed. Null for evergreen agreements with no fixed end date. Used to trigger renewal workflows in DocuSign CLM and Salesforce.

attributes.name: msp_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the Managed Service Provider (MSP) that administers the clients contingent workforce program on their behalf. Relevant when client_type = vms_msp. Staffing Hr submits requisitions and invoices through the MSP rather than directly to the client.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: The six-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code that classifies the clients primary business activity. Used for industry segmentation, workers compensation rate assignment, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: nda_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is on file for this client in DocuSign CLM. Required before sharing candidate profiles or proprietary workforce data with the client.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The most recently recorded Net Promoter Score (NPS) for this client, measured on a scale of -100 to 100. Reflects client satisfaction and likelihood to recommend Staffing Hr. Collected via periodic surveys and tracked in Salesforce and Power BI Analytics Platform.

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response was recorded for this client. Used to determine survey recency and schedule next survey cycle.

attributes.name: on_hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the client account has been placed on hold (account_status = on_hold). Examples include credit limit exceeded, compliance issue pending, contract renewal in progress, or client-requested pause. Null when account is not on hold.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The agreed payment instrument or mechanism used by the client to remit invoice payments. Values: ach (Automated Clearing House bank transfer), check (paper check), wire (wire transfer), credit_card, portal (client payment portal). Stored in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: The number of days from invoice date within which the client is contractually obligated to remit payment (e.g., Net 30 = 30, Net 45 = 45, Net 60 = 60). Used by Oracle NetSuite ERP for aging analysis, collections scheduling, and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: po_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires a valid Purchase Order (PO) number on all invoices before payment will be processed. When True, invoices without a PO number are blocked from submission. Enforced in Salesforce Revenue Cloud billing workflow.

attributes.name: primary_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the clients primary registered business address (street number and street name). Used for invoice delivery, compliance filings, and geographic territory assignment.

attributes.name: primary_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the clients primary registered business address (suite, floor, building, or unit number). Supplements address line 1 for complete mailing and compliance address records.

attributes.name: primary_city
attributes.description: City of the clients primary registered business address. Used for geographic segmentation, territory assignment, state tax jurisdiction determination, and SUTA rate mapping.

attributes.name: primary_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the clients primary registered business address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Determines applicable regulatory framework including GDPR for international clients.

attributes.name: primary_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the clients primary registered business address. Used for geographic routing, tax jurisdiction lookup, and territory management.

attributes.name: primary_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state or territory code of the clients primary registered business address (ISO 3166-2:US). Drives state tax jurisdiction, SUTA rate assignment, workers compensation classification, and OFCCP reporting.

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned to this client account within Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Enables reconciliation of billing, invoicing, and revenue management data sourced from Salesforce against the master client record.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: The four-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code for the clients primary industry. Maintained alongside NAICS for legacy system compatibility, EEOC reporting, and OFCCP compliance tracking.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The SLA service tier assigned to this client, which defines response time commitments, submittal quality standards (QoS), time-to-fill (TTF) targets, and escalation protocols. Values: standard, premium, enterprise, custom. Drives SLA configuration and KPI reporting in Power BI Analytics Platform.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the client account record was most recently modified in any source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: vms_platform
attributes.description: Name of the Vendor Management System (VMS) platform used by this client to manage contingent workforce requisitions and supplier interactions (e.g., Beeline, Fieldglass, IQNavigator, Coupa). Populated only for client_type = vms_msp. Drives integration configuration with Beeline VMS.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The primary public website URL of the client organization. Used for client profile enrichment, candidate research, and CRM account verification.

products.name: client_contact
products.description: Individual person record at a client organization who interacts with Staffing Hr in a business capacity. Sourced from Bullhorn CRM and Salesforce. Captures full name, job title, department, direct phone, mobile, business email, contact type (hiring manager, procurement, AP, executive sponsor, VMS coordinator), preferred communication channel, LinkedIn URL, contact status, and opt-in/opt-out flags. Supports CRM engagement tracking and relationship management workflows.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client contact record in the Staffing Hr data platform. Primary key for the contact entity within the client domain.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client organization this contact belongs to. Links the individual contact to the employer account within the client domain hierarchy.

attributes.name: client_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific physical office or site location within the client organization where this contact is based. Supports geographic segmentation of contacts and routing of on-site staffing activities.

attributes.name: reports_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the contacts manager or superior within the client organizations contact hierarchy. Supports org chart modeling and escalation path identification for complex enterprise client accounts.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the contacts office location. Used for correspondence, on-site visit planning, and geographic territory assignment. May differ from the parent clients corporate address for contacts at branch or satellite offices.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the contacts office location (suite, floor, building number). Supplements address_line1 for precise mail delivery and on-site visit navigation.

attributes.name: bullhorn_contact_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this contact record as assigned by Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the lakehouse and the operational CRM.

attributes.name: business_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the client contact. Used for job order submissions, submittal notifications, interview scheduling, and all formal CRM-driven communications. Governed by GDPR and CCPA for opt-in/opt-out management.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the contacts office location. Used for geographic territory management, local recruiter assignment, and workforce planning analytics by metro area.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record within the CRM. Active contacts are engaged in current staffing workflows. Inactive contacts are no longer at the client or not currently engaged. Do_not_contact reflects opt-out or legal hold. Archived contacts are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contacts functional role in the staffing relationship. Determines routing of communications, invoices, and requisitions. Key values: hiring_manager (submits reqs and approves submittals), procurement (manages MSA and rate cards), accounts_payable (AP — receives invoices), executive_sponsor (strategic relationship owner), vms_coordinator (manages VMS program interactions). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hiring_manager|procurement|accounts_payable|executive_sponsor|vms_coordinator|recruiter_liaison|legal|it_admin — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the contacts office location (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international staffing operations, GDPR applicability determination, and multi-country workforce analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the contact record was first created in the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage, and contact acquisition trend analysis. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Business department or functional unit within the client organization where the contact works (e.g., Human Resources, IT, Finance, Operations). Supports segmentation of contacts by functional area for targeted engagement.

attributes.name: direct_phone
attributes.description: Direct office or desk phone number for the client contact. Primary synchronous communication channel for recruiters and account managers to reach hiring managers and procurement contacts. Stored in E.164 international format.

attributes.name: do_not_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has requested to not be contacted by phone. True = do not call; False = phone contact is permitted. Enforced in CRM dialing workflows to ensure compliance with TCPA and internal communication policies.

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted in to receive marketing and promotional email communications from Staffing Hr. True = opted in; False = opted out or not consented. Critical for GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance in outbound marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the business relationship with this contact was terminated or the contact became inactive (e.g., contact left the client organization, account closed). Null for currently active contacts. Supports lifecycle analysis and historical reporting.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given (first) name of the client contact individual. Used in CRM communications, correspondence, and relationship management workflows.

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has authority to approve staffing requisitions, rate cards, or MSA terms. True = has decision-making authority; False = influencer or end-user without final approval authority. Used to prioritize executive engagement strategies.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary point of contact for the client account. True = primary contact for the account; False = secondary or supplementary contact. Used to route default communications and escalations for the client relationship.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the contact at their client organization (e.g., Hiring Manager, VP of Engineering, Procurement Director). Used to understand the contacts authority level and role in the staffing engagement.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent CRM-logged interaction with this contact (call, email, meeting, note). Used to identify dormant contacts, trigger re-engagement workflows, and measure account manager activity against SLA targets.

attributes.name: last_activity_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent CRM-logged interaction with this contact. Provides context for the last_activity_date and supports analysis of engagement channel effectiveness across the client contact portfolio.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family (last) name of the client contact individual. Combined with first_name to form the full display name used in CRM, reporting, and client-facing communications.

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: URL to the contacts LinkedIn professional profile. Used by account managers and recruiters for relationship intelligence, org chart mapping, and understanding the contacts professional background and tenure at the client organization.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the client contact. Supports formal correspondence and disambiguation of contacts with identical first and last names at the same client organization.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile or cell phone number for the client contact. Used for urgent communications, SMS outreach, and as a fallback when the direct office line is unavailable. Stored in E.164 international format.

attributes.name: name_prefix
attributes.description: Honorific or salutation prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.). Used in formal written correspondence and client-facing communications to ensure professional address.

attributes.name: name_suffix
attributes.description: Professional or generational suffix appended to the contact name (e.g., Jr., Sr., III, CPA, MBA). Supports accurate formal correspondence and professional credential display.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from this contact, on a scale of 0–10. NPS measures the contacts likelihood to recommend Staffing Hrs services. Scores 0–6 = Detractors, 7–8 = Passives, 9–10 = Promoters. Used in client satisfaction analytics and account health monitoring.

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was collected from this contact. Used to determine survey recency, schedule follow-up surveys, and track satisfaction trend over time.

attributes.name: office_phone_ext
attributes.description: Phone extension number associated with the contacts direct office line. Required when the client organization uses a PBX system and the direct_phone field contains the main switchboard number.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the contacts office location. Used for geographic segmentation, territory mapping, and proximity-based recruiter assignment for local staffing engagements.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contacts stated preferred method of communication for staffing-related outreach. Drives CRM engagement workflows and ensures recruiter and account manager interactions align with the contacts preferences, improving response rates and relationship quality.

attributes.name: salesforce_contact_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this contact record as assigned by Salesforce Revenue Cloud CRM. Enables bi-directional sync and deduplication between Bullhorn and Salesforce contact records.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The originating system or channel through which this contact record was first created or imported into the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports data lineage tracking, deduplication analysis, and source quality reporting.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the business relationship with this contact was formally initiated (e.g., first job order submitted, first meeting logged). Supports relationship tenure analysis and cohort-based client engagement reporting.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the contacts office location using standard two-letter postal abbreviation (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Drives state-level compliance requirements, SUTA jurisdiction, and territory-based account management assignments.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contacts office location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago). Used to schedule calls, interviews, and automated CRM communications at appropriate local times for the contact.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the contact record in the Staffing Hr data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: vms_user_code
attributes.description: The contacts user identifier within the clients Vendor Management System (VMS) platform (e.g., Beeline). Required for VMS-managed programs where job orders, submittals, and timesheets are processed through the VMS portal. Enables mapping of VMS workflow actions to the CRM contact record.

products.name: account_hierarchy
products.description: Parent-child organizational relationship between client accounts, enabling enterprise account structures such as global parent, regional subsidiary, and local site. Captures parent account reference, child account reference, hierarchy level, relationship type (corporate parent, division, subsidiary, franchise), effective date, and end date. Critical for consolidated billing, enterprise SLA management, MSP/VMS program roll-ups, and territory planning across account families.

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parent-child account hierarchy relationship record in the staffing client account structure.

attributes.name: child_account_client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the child (subordinate) client account in the hierarchy. Represents the subsidiary, division, franchise, or local site that rolls up to the parent account.

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: Account hierarchies can be associated with managed programs (RPO/MSP/hybrid) in addition to VMS programs. This allows tracking which hierarchies are part of managed workforce programs. One hierarchy a

attributes.name: msa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Master Service Agreement (MSA) that governs the commercial terms for this account hierarchy relationship. Links to the contract lifecycle management system for SLA, rate, and compliance term inheritance.

attributes.name: primary_client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent (superior) client account in the hierarchy. Represents the owning entity such as a global corporate parent, regional holding company, or divisional umbrella account.

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: External program identifier assigned by the Vendor Management System (VMS) platform (e.g., Beeline) for this account hierarchy node. Enables cross-system reconciliation for contingent workforce program management and rate card roll-ups.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state for this account hierarchy relationship. New or modified hierarchy relationships may require internal approval before becoming active for billing consolidation and SLA management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal stakeholder who approved this account hierarchy relationship for activation. Supports audit trail requirements under SOC 2 Type II and internal governance controls.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account hierarchy relationship was formally approved for activation. Part of the lifecycle audit trail for governance and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

attributes.name: billing_consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices and billing activity for the child account should be consolidated and rolled up to the parent account level. When true, Oracle NetSuite ERP and Salesforce Revenue Cloud aggregate charges at the parent account for enterprise billing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, SOC 2 Type II compliance, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this parent-child account hierarchy relationship became or becomes operationally binding. Used to determine which hierarchy structure applies for a given billing period or SLA evaluation window.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this parent-child account hierarchy relationship ceases to be operationally binding. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active relationship. Supports historical hierarchy reconstruction for audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this specific parent-child relationship within the enterprise account structure. Used for cross-system reconciliation between Bullhorn, Salesforce, and Beeline VMS.

attributes.name: hierarchy_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the business rationale or context for this parent-child account relationship, such as organizational restructuring notes or program scope details.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child account within the overall account tree, where level 1 represents the ultimate global parent. Used for territory planning, consolidated reporting, and enterprise SLA management across account families.

attributes.name: hierarchy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for this parent-child relationship, typically combining parent and child account names (e.g., Acme Corp > Acme Northeast Division). Used in reporting dashboards and CRM displays.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from the root parent to the current child node (e.g., /1001/1045/1078). Enables efficient tree traversal queries for enterprise roll-up reporting and consolidated billing in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the parent-child account hierarchy relationship. Controls whether the relationship is used in active billing roll-ups, SLA aggregations, and VMS program management.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the purpose or dimension of this hierarchy relationship. An account may participate in multiple hierarchy types simultaneously (e.g., organizational for CRM, billing for consolidated invoicing, VMS program for Beeline roll-ups).

attributes.name: is_primary_relationship
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary (canonical) parent-child relationship for the child account when multiple hierarchy relationships exist (e.g., a subsidiary may belong to both a geographic and a functional hierarchy). Ensures unambiguous roll-up for consolidated billing.

attributes.name: max_depth
attributes.description: The maximum number of levels in the account hierarchy subtree rooted at this node. Used for enterprise account structure validation and to enforce organizational depth limits in VMS program configurations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account hierarchy relationship record was last updated. Supports change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver layer and audit trail requirements under SOC 2 Type II.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual commentary related to this account hierarchy relationship. Used by account managers and operations teams in Bullhorn and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: nps_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey responses collected at the child account level should be aggregated and rolled up to the parent account for enterprise client satisfaction reporting.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Indicates the commercial program model governing this account relationship. Determines whether the hierarchy is managed as a direct staffing engagement, a Managed Service Provider (MSP) program, a Vendor Management System (VMS) program, a Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) engagement, or a hybrid model.

attributes.name: rate_card_inheritance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account inherits bill rates, pay rates, and markup percentages from the parent accounts rate card. When true, Beeline VMS and Salesforce Revenue Cloud apply parent-level rate structures to child account job orders.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the structural relationship between the parent and child accounts. Drives consolidated billing rules, SLA inheritance, and MSP/VMS program roll-up logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate_parent|division|subsidiary|franchise|affiliate|joint_venture — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: rollup_headcount_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the active worker headcount (Full-Time Equivalent and contingent) for the child account should be aggregated and rolled up to the parent account for enterprise workforce planning and reporting in Power BI.

attributes.name: rollup_spend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether contingent workforce spend (bill amounts, gross margin, markup) for the child account should be aggregated to the parent account level for enterprise spend analytics and MSP program reporting.

attributes.name: sla_inheritance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account inherits Service Level Agreement (SLA) configurations from the parent account. When true, SLA targets such as Time to Fill (TTF) and Quality of Submission (QoS) defined at the parent level apply to the child account.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this account hierarchy relationship was originated or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: source_system_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this account hierarchy relationship as recorded in the originating operational system (e.g., Bullhorn relationship ID, Salesforce AccountTeamMember ID, Beeline program node ID). Enables bidirectional traceability for reconciliation.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this parent-child account hierarchy relationship was terminated or deactivated. Examples include corporate restructuring, account consolidation, client offboarding, or VMS program exit.

products.name: location
products.description: Physical or virtual work site associated with a client account. Represents the specific facility, office, plant, or remote work designation where workers are deployed. Captures site name, address (street, city, state, zip, country), location type (headquarters, branch, warehouse, remote, on-site), OSHA establishment ID, workers comp jurisdiction state, site contact, parking/badge instructions, and active status. Used for assignment dispatch, workers comp classification, and compliance jurisdiction mapping.
products.reference: Bullhorn Client Location / Kronos Work Site

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client work site location record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the location entity.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account that owns this work site location. Links the location to its employer of record for assignment dispatch and billing.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the work site (street number and street name). Used for worker dispatch, OSHA establishment registration, and workers comp jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail for the work site such as suite, floor, building, or unit number. Supplements address_line1 for precise site identification.

attributes.name: background_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check (BGC) is mandatory for all workers placed at this location. Drives Sterling Background Check initiation during the onboarding workflow.

attributes.name: badge_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text instructions for obtaining and using site access badges or security credentials. Provided to workers during onboarding and assignment dispatch to ensure day-one site access.

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the billing or accounts payable contact at this location. Used for invoice delivery and billing dispute resolution.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the accounts payable or billing contact at this location. Used by Salesforce Revenue Cloud for invoice routing and payment follow-up specific to this work site.

attributes.name: bullhorn_location_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this location as stored in Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Used for system-of-record traceability and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the work site is located. Used for workers comp jurisdiction mapping, local tax determination, and geographic workforce analytics.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which this work site was or is scheduled to be closed and no longer eligible for new assignments. Null for currently active locations. Used for historical reporting and workforce redeployment planning.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the work site (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Required for international staffing operations and GDPR/CCPA compliance jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish in which the work site is located. Used for local tax jurisdiction mapping, workers comp rate tables, and OSHA regional compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this location record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

attributes.name: current_headcount
attributes.description: Current number of active contingent workers deployed at this location. Sourced from active placement records and used for real-time capacity monitoring and workforce analytics dashboards in Power BI.

attributes.name: dress_code
attributes.description: Description of the dress code or personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements for workers at this site. Communicated during assignment dispatch and onboarding.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this location became or becomes active and eligible for worker assignments and job orders. Used for temporal filtering in workforce planning and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether E-Verify employment eligibility verification is required for workers placed at this location, typically driven by federal contractor status or state mandate.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code associated with this location for revenue recognition and accounts receivable posting in Oracle NetSuite ERP. Enables location-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: is_drug_free_workplace
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has designated this site as a drug-free workplace, requiring pre-placement and random drug screening for all workers. Triggers Sterling Background Check drug screen requirements during onboarding.

attributes.name: is_remote
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location represents a remote or virtual work designation rather than a physical facility. Drives workers comp classification, tax nexus determination, and I-9 remote verification workflows.

attributes.name: is_union_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work site operates under a collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Affects pay rate floors, overtime rules, and worker eligibility requirements for placements at this location.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the work site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for geospatial workforce analytics, proximity-based candidate matching, and mapping integrations.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work site location. Active locations are eligible for new job orders and worker assignments. Inactive or closed locations are retained for historical reporting.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the work site that determines dispatch rules, workers comp classification, and compliance jurisdiction mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: headquarters|branch|warehouse|plant|remote|on_site — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the work site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for geospatial workforce analytics, proximity-based candidate matching, and mapping integrations.

attributes.name: max_headcount
attributes.description: Maximum number of contingent workers (headcount) authorized by the client to be deployed at this location simultaneously. Used for workforce planning, VMS (Vendor Management System) program controls, and capacity analytics.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code representing the primary industry activity conducted at this work site. Used for OSHA recordkeeping, EEOC reporting, OFCCP compliance, and workforce analytics segmentation.

attributes.name: osha_establishment_number
attributes.description: OSHA-assigned establishment identifier for this work site. Required for OSHA 300 log recordkeeping, injury and illness reporting, and OSHA inspection compliance under 29 CFR 1904.

attributes.name: parking_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text instructions for worker parking at the site (e.g., designated lot, permit requirements, street parking rules). Included in worker onboarding and assignment dispatch communications.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the work site. Used for geographic routing, local tax jurisdiction lookup, and workers comp rate determination.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the work site within the client account hierarchy. Used in timesheets, billing, and workforce scheduling systems such as Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: site_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary on-site contact. Used for timesheet approvals, assignment confirmations, and SLA (Service Level Agreement) communications.

attributes.name: site_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary on-site contact person (e.g., hiring manager, facility supervisor) responsible for coordinating worker assignments, timesheets, and day-to-day staffing operations at this location.

attributes.name: site_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary on-site contact. Used by staffing coordinators for dispatch coordination, worker check-in issues, and urgent placement communications.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the physical or virtual work site (e.g., Chicago Distribution Center, Austin HQ – Tower 2, Remote – Pacific Time Zone). Used in assignment dispatch, job orders, and worker communications.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-2 state or province code where the work site is located. Drives workers comp classification, SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act) assignment, FLSA overtime rules, and OSHA jurisdiction.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the work site (e.g., America/Chicago, America/Los_Angeles). Used by Kronos Workforce Ready for shift scheduling, timesheet cutoff calculations, and overtime rule application.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this location record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and Silver layer incremental processing.

attributes.name: workers_comp_class_code
attributes.description: NCCI (National Council on Compensation Insurance) four-digit classification code assigned to the work site based on the nature of work performed. Determines workers comp premium rates for temporary workers placed at this location.

attributes.name: workers_comp_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code that governs the workers compensation insurance policy for workers deployed at this site. May differ from the physical state for multi-state operations or border locations. Critical for TempWorks Payroll workers comp classification.

products.name: client_rate_card
products.description: Negotiated bill rate and markup schedule agreed upon with a client under an MSA or VMS program agreement. Captures job category, job title, skill level, bill rate (regular, OT, DT), pay rate guidance, markup percentage, spread (bill minus pay), burden rate inclusion flag, per diem rate, currency, effective date, expiration date, rate card version, and approval status. Sourced from Beeline VMS and Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Serves as the client-domain pricing reference for job order creation, candidate submittal pricing, and invoice generation. Note: contract-level rate schedule terms, rate escalation clauses, and contractual rate governance are owned by the contract domain; this product owns the operational rate table used in day-to-day staffing transactions.
products.reference: Beeline Rate Card / Bill Rate Schedule

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the rate card record in the Staffing Hr lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for whom this rate card is negotiated. Links the rate card to the client master record in the client domain.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: Rate cards can be associated with managed programs (RPO/MSP) in addition to VMS programs. This allows tracking negotiated rates specific to managed workforce programs. One rate card for one managed pr

attributes.name: msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: Rate cards reference MSA terms for markup caps, payment terms, and liability provisions. Essential for rate card approval workflow and compliance verification. Replaces denormalized msa_reference_numb

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Rate cards often tied to specific SOWs for project-based staffing engagements. Required for SOW-specific pricing enforcement, billing validation, and scope-of-work rate compliance in statement-of-work

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: External identifier of the VMS program (e.g., Beeline program code) under which this rate card is managed. Used to reconcile rate card data between the Staffing Hr lakehouse and the clients VMS platform.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the rate card in the approval lifecycle. Controls whether the rate card may be used for job order creation and invoice generation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|rejected|expired|superseded — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal approver (e.g., Account Manager, VP of Sales) who authorized this rate card version. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate card was formally approved by the authorized approver. Used for audit trail, compliance reporting, and rate card lifecycle management.

attributes.name: beeline_rate_card_code
attributes.description: Native rate card identifier from the Beeline VMS system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Staffing Hr lakehouse and the clients Beeline VMS program.

attributes.name: bill_rate_dt
attributes.description: Negotiated hourly bill rate charged to the client for double-time (DT) hours, applicable in jurisdictions or client agreements requiring double-time pay (e.g., California labor law, holiday work).

attributes.name: bill_rate_ot
attributes.description: Negotiated hourly bill rate charged to the client for overtime (OT) hours, typically hours worked beyond 40 per week. Governed by FLSA overtime provisions and client MSA terms.

attributes.name: bill_rate_regular
attributes.description: Negotiated hourly bill rate charged to the client for straight-time (regular) hours worked. This is the primary pricing field used in invoice generation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: burden_rate_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer burden costs (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation, benefits) are already embedded in the bill rate or markup percentage. True = burden is included in the stated rates; False = burden is calculated separately.

attributes.name: burden_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Employer burden rate as a percentage of pay rate, covering statutory costs including FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation, and applicable benefits. Used when burden_rate_included is True to document the embedded cost component.

attributes.name: conversion_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated fee percentage charged to the client when a temporary or contract worker is converted to a permanent (direct hire) employee (Temp-to-Perm conversion). Expressed as a percentage of the workers annualized salary.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate card record was first created in the Staffing Hr lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary rate values on this rate card are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency client programs.

attributes.name: direct_placement_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated fee percentage charged to the client for direct hire (permanent placement) engagements under this rate card. Expressed as a percentage of the placed candidates first-year base salary.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate card becomes active and may be applied to job orders, submittals, and invoices. Aligns with the MSA or VMS program agreement start date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate card ceases to be valid for new transactions. After this date, a new version must be approved before job orders can reference this rate schedule.

attributes.name: holiday_bill_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the regular bill rate for hours worked on client-designated holidays (e.g., 1.5 = time-and-a-half, 2.0 = double time). Null if no holiday premium is negotiated.

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated markup percentage applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 45.00 = 45%). Captures the agreed margin structure for this job category and skill level.

attributes.name: max_bill_rate
attributes.description: Ceiling bill rate above which the staffing firm may not price a submittal for this job category and skill level. Enforces client budget caps and VMS program rate compliance.

attributes.name: min_bill_rate
attributes.description: Floor bill rate below which the staffing firm may not price a submittal for this job category and skill level. Enforces margin floor compliance during job order creation and candidate pricing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or exceptions associated with this rate card line (e.g., client-specific rate exceptions, program notes, negotiation history summaries).

attributes.name: pay_rate_guidance
attributes.description: Recommended or maximum hourly pay rate for the worker under this rate card line. Used as a pricing guardrail during candidate submittal to ensure spread and margin targets are maintained. Not a contractual pay commitment.

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily allowance rate for travel, lodging, and meals applicable to workers on this rate card line when deployed away from their primary work location. Null if per diem is not applicable for this engagement.

attributes.name: rate_card_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the rate card, typically describing the client program, engagement type, or labor category scope (e.g., Acme Corp IT Contingent 2024).

attributes.name: rate_card_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the rate card, used in client communications, VMS integrations, and invoice references. Sourced from Beeline VMS or Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: salesforce_pricebook_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Price Book ID
attributes.description: Native price book entry identifier from Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse rate card and the Salesforce billing and invoicing configuration.

attributes.name: spread_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Spread Amount (Bill Rate Minus Pay Rate)
attributes.description: Calculated difference between the regular bill rate and the pay rate guidance (Spread = Bill Rate - Pay Rate). Represents the gross dollar margin per hour before burden costs. Stored for operational reference and reporting; not recomputed at query time.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate card record was last modified in the Staffing Hr lakehouse. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the rate card, incremented each time the rate schedule is renegotiated or amended. Enables tracking of rate card history and supersession.

products.name: vms_program
products.description: Vendor Management System program record representing a client-managed contingent workforce program administered through a VMS technology platform. Captures program name, VMS platform (Beeline, Fieldglass, Coupa, IQNavigator), MSP partner name (if applicable), program type (MSP-managed, self-managed, hybrid), program scope (all categories, IT only, light industrial, professional, etc.), supplier tier structure, requisition routing rules, markup cap, program start date, program end date, and program status. Sourced from Beeline VMS integration. Critical for staffing firms participating in managed programs where requisition flow, rate caps, and supplier tiering are controlled by the client or their MSP.

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the VMS program record in the Staffing Hr lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a long-running, binding contingent workforce program administered through a VMS platform.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that owns and administers this VMS program. Links the program to the authoritative client identity record in the client domain.

attributes.name: client_contact_id

attributes.name: managed_program_id
