attributes.name: msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: VMS programs operate under governing MSAs that define program terms, liability, and supplier obligations. Critical for program setup, compliance verification, and supplier onboarding. Replaces denorma

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: VMS programs in staffing frequently operate under a dedicated MSP/MSO SOW that defines program scope, fees, and deliverables separately from the master MSA. Direct SOW linkage enables program-level bi

attributes.name: beeline_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Beeline Vendor Management System (VMS) Program ID
attributes.description: Native program identifier assigned by the Beeline VMS platform. Used for system-of-record reconciliation and integration with the Beeline API. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement as known externally in the VMS ecosystem.

attributes.name: bgc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check (BGC) is mandatory for all workers placed through this VMS program prior to assignment start. Drives onboarding workflow and Sterling Background Check integration requirements.

attributes.name: bill_rate_cap_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to bill rate caps and financial terms within this VMS program (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Ensures correct currency context for rate card enforcement and financial reporting.

attributes.name: conversion_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage fee charged to the client when a temporary worker placed through this VMS program converts to a permanent (direct hire) employee. Governs temp-to-perm and contract-to-hire financial terms within the program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMS program record was first created in the Staffing Hr lakehouse. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Sourced from Beeline VMS integration load.

attributes.name: data_privacy_addendum_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Privacy Addendum On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Data Privacy Addendum (DPA) or data processing agreement has been executed for this VMS program. Required for programs subject to GDPR, CCPA, or other data privacy regulations where worker personal data is shared with the clients VMS platform.

attributes.name: drug_screen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-placement drug screening is required for all workers entering this VMS program. Impacts onboarding timelines and compliance with client safety and OSHA requirements.

attributes.name: eor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VMS program mandates use of an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement for worker engagement. When true, Staffing Hr or a designated EOR entity assumes employer obligations including payroll, benefits, and compliance.

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether E-Verify employment eligibility verification is mandated for all workers placed through this VMS program. Relevant for federal contractor clients and OFCCP compliance obligations.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the geographic scope of this VMS program (e.g., National, Northeast Region, California Only, Global — North America and EMEA). Determines which Staffing Hr branch offices and recruiters are eligible to fulfill requisitions under the program.

attributes.name: ic_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Independent Contractor (IC) worker classifications are permitted within this VMS program. Impacts worker classification compliance, IRS 1099 obligations, and co-employment risk management.

attributes.name: invoice_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which Staffing Hr generates and submits invoices to the client through this VMS program. Aligns with timesheet approval cycles and client accounts payable requirements. Drives billing workflow in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMS program record was most recently modified in the Staffing Hr lakehouse. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: markup_cap_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable markup percentage that Staffing Hr may apply above the pay rate when billing through this VMS program. Enforced by the VMS platform at time of rate submission. Critical financial constraint governing gross margin potential on all placements within the program. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.00 = 35%).

attributes.name: msp_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the Managed Service Provider (MSP) that administers the VMS program on behalf of the client (e.g., Allegis Global Solutions, Pontoon, Workforce Logiq). Null when program_type is self-managed. Critical for understanding the intermediary controlling requisition flow and supplier tiering.

attributes.name: nda_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) has been executed and is on file for this VMS program. Required for programs involving access to sensitive client data or proprietary information.

attributes.name: on_site_coordinator_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VMS program requires Staffing Hr to provide a dedicated on-site coordinator or account manager at the client location. Impacts staffing firm resource allocation and cost structure for program participation.

attributes.name: ot_markup_cap_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable markup percentage for overtime (OT) hours billed through this VMS program. May differ from the standard markup cap. Governs gross margin on OT billing and ensures FLSA-compliant rate submissions.

attributes.name: per_diem_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether per diem expense reimbursements are permitted for workers placed through this VMS program. Relevant for travel-intensive assignments and impacts payroll burden calculations in TempWorks.

attributes.name: po_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Purchase Order (PO) number is required on all invoices submitted through this VMS program. Impacts invoice processing workflow and accounts receivable management in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: primary_labor_category
attributes.description: The dominant workforce labor category served by this VMS program (e.g., Information Technology, Light Industrial, Professional Services, Healthcare, Finance and Accounting). Used for program segmentation, analytics, and workforce planning reporting in Power BI.

attributes.name: program_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the VMS program is scheduled to expire or was terminated. Nullable for open-ended programs. Defines the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL boundary for supplier participation and rate applicability.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official name of the VMS contingent workforce program as configured in the VMS platform (e.g., Acme Corp Global Contingent Workforce Program). Used in reporting, supplier communications, and requisition routing. Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this agreement.

attributes.name: program_scope
attributes.description: Description of the workforce categories and labor types covered by this VMS program (e.g., All Categories, IT Only, Light Industrial, Professional Services, SOW and Services). Determines which job orders from this client flow through the VMS versus direct channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all_categories|it_only|light_industrial|professional|sow_services|clinical|finance_accounting — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: program_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the VMS program became or is scheduled to become operationally active. Defines the EFFECTIVE_FROM boundary for supplier participation, rate caps, and requisition routing rules.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the VMS program. Drives requisition routing eligibility, supplier participation, and rate card applicability. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Operational model under which the VMS program is administered. MSP-managed indicates a third-party Managed Service Provider controls supplier relationships and requisition flow; self-managed means the client administers directly; hybrid combines both models. CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.

attributes.name: requisition_routing_rule
attributes.description: Rule or logic governing how new requisitions are distributed to suppliers within this VMS program (e.g., sequential by tier, broadcast to all tier-1, round-robin, category-based routing). Determines how Staffing Hr receives job orders and the competitive dynamics of the program.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier classification assigned to this VMS program, reflecting the contractual service commitment level. Higher tiers carry stricter TTF, TTS, and QoS requirements. Aligns with the SLA tier defined in the client MSA.

attributes.name: submission_limit_per_req
attributes.description: Maximum number of candidate submittals Staffing Hr is permitted to submit per requisition within this VMS program. Enforced by the VMS platform. Impacts sourcing strategy and Quality of Submission (QoS) focus.

attributes.name: supplier_portal_url
attributes.description: URL of the VMS supplier portal through which Staffing Hr accesses requisitions, submits candidates, and manages worker records for this program. Operational reference for recruiter and account management teams.

attributes.name: supplier_tier
attributes.description: Staffing Hrs designated tier level within the clients VMS supplier hierarchy. Tier 1 suppliers receive first-look requisition routing; lower tiers receive overflow or secondary routing. Directly impacts requisition volume, fill rate opportunity, and competitive positioning within the program.

attributes.name: time_to_fill_days
attributes.description: Target number of calendar days from requisition open date to placement confirmation as defined in the VMS program SLA. Key performance indicator (KPI) for program compliance and client satisfaction measurement.

attributes.name: time_to_submit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours from requisition release to candidate submittal allowed under this VMS programs SLA. Drives internal sourcing urgency and recruiter workflow prioritization. Measured in business hours unless otherwise specified.

attributes.name: timesheet_approval_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which worker timesheets are submitted and approved within this VMS program. Drives Kronos Workforce Ready scheduling, payroll processing cycles in TempWorks, and billing cadence in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: vms_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage fee charged by the VMS platform or MSP to Staffing Hr on each placement or billing transaction within this program. Deducted from the spread and directly reduces gross margin. Expressed as a percentage of bill rate (e.g., 2.50 = 2.5%).

attributes.name: vms_platform
attributes.description: Name of the VMS technology platform through which this contingent workforce program is administered. Determines integration protocols, API endpoints, and data exchange formats used by Staffing Hr to receive requisitions and submit candidates.

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: Workers Compensation insurance classification code applicable to the primary labor category within this VMS program. Drives burden rate calculations, insurance premium allocation, and payroll processing in TempWorks.

Supports relationship health monitoring, account management cadence tracking, and pipeline development.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Optional reference to a specific job order (requisition) that was the subject of this engagement. Enables linkage of engagement activity to open requisitions for pipeline and fill-rate analytics.

attributes.name: sourcing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or outreach campaign in Salesforce that generated or is associated with this engagement. Supports marketing attribution and campaign effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Client engagements (meetings, QBRs, calls) frequently discuss specific supplier performance, issues, or selection decisions. Tracking which supplier was the subject enables relationship management, is

attributes.name: assigned_staff_name
attributes.description: Full name of the internal Staffing Hr employee (recruiter or account manager) who conducted or owns this engagement. Denormalized for reporting convenience and historical accuracy in case of staff record changes.

attributes.name: assigned_staff_role

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The SLA (Service Level Agreement) tier of the client account at the time of this engagement. Denormalized from the client account record to support historical analysis of engagement cadence relative to SLA commitments.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this engagement record was sourced (Bullhorn ATS/CRM, Salesforce, or manually entered). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief title or subject line describing the purpose or topic of the engagement activity. Mirrors the subject field in Bullhorn and Salesforce activity records. Used for search, filtering, and reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this engagement record was last modified in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Silver layer.

products.name: account_segment
products.description: Commercial segmentation and classification record for a client account, defining strategic tier, revenue potential, and service model. Captures segment tier (strategic, key, growth, transactional), vertical industry focus, geographic market, annual revenue band, headcount band, estimated annual staffing spend, wallet share estimate, primary service line (temp staffing, direct hire, RPO, MSP), account manager assignment, and segment review date. Used for territory planning, resource allocation, and go-to-market prioritization.

attributes.name: account_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the account segment record. Primary key for the account_segment data product in the client domain. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — this product defines a commercial segmentation and classification record for a client account, carrying its own identity, lifecycle, and quantitative facts.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account record in the client.client_account product. Establishes which client employer this segmentation record belongs to.

attributes.name: job_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.job_category. Business justification: Account segments are often defined by primary labor category (e.g., light industrial, IT, clerical). Linking account_segment to job_category enables market rate benchmarking, segment-level fill rate a

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: Account segments have msp_program_flag and rpo_program_flag indicating managed program participation, but lack the FK to identify which specific managed program. This enables segmentation analysis by

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.vms_program. Business justification: Account segments have vms_program_flag indicating VMS program participation, but lack the FK to identify which specific VMS program. This enables segmentation analysis by VMS program. One segment can

attributes.name: active_placement_count
attributes.description: Current number of active worker placements (temporary assignments and permanent placements) at this account segment as of the last data refresh. Key operational metric for workforce density and account health assessment. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM placement records.

attributes.name: active_req_count
attributes.description: Current number of open job requisitions (Reqs) active for this account segment at the time of the last data refresh. Provides a real-time demand signal for recruiter capacity planning and segment health monitoring. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM job order data.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_band
attributes.description: Banded classification of the client companys estimated annual revenue, used for market sizing, credit risk assessment, and service tier alignment. Bands: under_1m, 1m_to_10m, 10m_to_50m, 50m_to_250m, over_250m (USD). Confidential business intelligence used in go-to-market prioritization.

attributes.name: conversion_fee_pct
attributes.description: Agreed conversion fee percentage charged to the client when a temporary worker converts to a permanent (direct hire) employee, expressed as a percentage of the converted workers first-year salary. Applicable for temp-to-perm and contract-to-hire arrangements. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account segment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this entity. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance (in USD) approved for this account segment before new placements or timesheets are placed on hold. Segment-level credit limit may be more restrictive than the parent client_account credit limit for specific service lines or geographies.

attributes.name: direct_hire_fee_pct
attributes.description: Agreed placement fee percentage charged to the client for direct hire (permanent placement) engagements, expressed as a percentage of the placed candidates first-year base salary. Confidential commercial pricing term negotiated at the account segment level.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment classification became effective and began driving territory planning, resource allocation, and go-to-market prioritization decisions. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_staffing_spend
attributes.description: Estimated total annual spend (in USD) the client account allocates to contingent and permanent staffing services across all providers. Used to calculate wallet share and prioritize account investment. This is the principal quantitative fact (MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE) for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud opportunity data and market intelligence.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment classification expires and is subject to review or reclassification. Nullable for open-ended segment assignments. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: fall_off_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of placements at this account segment that ended prematurely (fall-offs) within the trailing 12-month period, calculated as (fall-off placements / total placements) * 100. Fall-off rate is a key quality metric in staffing, indicating placement quality and candidate-client fit. Used to assess recruiter performance and account health.

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Primary geographic market or territory associated with this client account segment, used for territory planning and regional resource allocation (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West, National, International). Drives assignment of regional account managers and branch coverage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: northeast|southeast|midwest|west|southwest|national|international — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gross_margin_target_pct
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for this account segment, representing the spread (bill rate minus pay rate and burden costs) as a percentage of the bill rate. Used to evaluate account profitability and guide pricing decisions. Confidential financial target data.

attributes.name: headcount_band
attributes.description: Banded classification of the client companys total employee headcount, used to estimate staffing demand potential and align service model complexity. Bands represent total FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) employees at the client organization.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this account segment classification was most recently reviewed and confirmed or updated by the account management team. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify stale segment assignments.

attributes.name: markup_pct
attributes.description: Standard markup percentage applied to pay rates to derive bill rates for this account segment, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 45.00 = 45%). Markup covers burden costs (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Comp), overhead, and gross margin. Confidential commercial pricing data. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud rate card configuration.

attributes.name: msp_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account is managed through a Managed Service Provider (MSP) program, where a third-party MSP intermediary manages the contingent workforce program on behalf of the client. Affects supplier tier, rate card access, and billing routing.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) recorded for this account segment, ranging from -100 to 100. NPS measures client loyalty and likelihood to recommend Staffing Hrs services. Segment-level NPS may differ from the parent client_account NPS if multiple business units or service lines are surveyed independently.

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey was conducted for this account segment. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data and trigger follow-up surveys per client experience policy.

attributes.name: on_site_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account has an on-site staffing program where a Staffing Hr on-site manager or coordinator is physically embedded at the client location to manage the contingent workforce. Drives on-site headcount budgeting and operational cost allocation.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the client is contractually required to remit payment for this account segment (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, Net 60). May differ from the parent client_account default payment terms if segment-specific terms have been negotiated.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_status
attributes.description: Staffing Hrs supplier status designation within the clients vendor program. Preferred indicates highest-priority routing of requisitions. Tier_1 and Tier_2 reflect VMS/MSP program supplier tiers. Approved indicates active but non-preferred status. Not_listed indicates no formal supplier agreement in place.

attributes.name: primary_service_line
attributes.description: The principal staffing service line through which this client account is primarily served. Temp Staffing (temporary placement), Direct Hire (permanent placement), RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing), MSP (Managed Service Provider program), Contract-to-Hire (temp-to-perm), SOW (Statement of Work-based project staffing). Drives billing model, recruiter assignment, and operational workflow.

attributes.name: prior_segment_tier
attributes.description: The segment tier assigned to this account immediately before the most recent reclassification event. Enables trend analysis of account movement across tiers (upgrades vs. downgrades). Null if this is the initial segment assignment.

attributes.name: reclassification_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this account segment was reclassified from a prior tier or service model. Supports audit trail and trend analysis of segment movement (e.g., Revenue decline below key tier threshold, New MSP program win — upgraded to strategic). Populated only when a reclassification event occurs.

attributes.name: rpo_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account has an active Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) engagement with Staffing Hr, where Staffing Hr manages some or all of the clients permanent hiring process. Drives RPO-specific SLA tracking and dedicated recruiter team assignment.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this segment classification record, used in territory planning reports, go-to-market materials, and CRM tagging (e.g., SEG-STRAT-001). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: segment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers and strategic planners to capture qualitative context about this account segment, including competitive intelligence, relationship history, strategic initiatives, or special handling instructions not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: segment_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review and potential reclassification of this account segment. Ensures segment tiers remain current with client revenue performance and strategic fit. Typically set on an annual or semi-annual cadence per territory planning policy.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account segment record. Active indicates the segmentation is in force and driving territory and resource decisions. Under_review indicates a pending reclassification. Inactive indicates the segment assignment has lapsed. Archived indicates historical record retained for audit. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: segment_tier
attributes.description: Strategic classification tier assigned to the client account, defining the level of investment, service intensity, and executive attention. Values: strategic (top-tier, highest revenue potential), key (established high-value), growth (emerging high-potential), transactional (volume-based, lower-touch). Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this entity.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA (Service Level Agreement) tier assigned to this account segment, defining the contractual service performance standards including Time to Fill (TTF), Time to Start (TTS), submittal quality, and response time commitments. Platinum and Gold tiers carry the most stringent SLA obligations. Distinct from the sla_tier on client_account which may reflect the MSA-level SLA; this field reflects the segment-specific SLA classification.

attributes.name: target_ttf_days
attributes.description: Target number of business days from job order receipt to candidate submittal, as defined for this account segments SLA tier. TTF (Time to Fill) is a core KPI in staffing operations. Used to set recruiter performance expectations and measure delivery quality against segment commitments.

attributes.name: target_tts_days
attributes.description: Target number of calendar days from job order receipt to candidate start date, as defined for this account segments SLA tier. TTS (Time to Start) measures the full cycle from requisition to placement and is a key client satisfaction metric in staffing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account segment record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: vertical_industry
attributes.description: Primary industry vertical the client account operates in, used to align staffing service delivery, recruiter specialization, and go-to-market strategy (e.g., Healthcare, Technology, Manufacturing, Financial Services, Logistics). Aligns with NAICS/SIC classification on the parent client_account record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|technology|manufacturing|financial_services|logistics|retail|energy|government|education|professional_services — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vms_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account operates through a Vendor Management System (VMS) program, requiring Staffing Hr to submit candidates and timesheets through a third-party VMS platform (e.g., Beeline, SAP Fieldglass, Coupa). Drives operational workflow routing and VMS compliance requirements.

attributes.name: wallet_share_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the clients total annual staffing spend currently captured by Staffing Hr, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 35.50 = 35.5%). Calculated as (Staffing Hr annual billings / estimated_annual_staffing_spend) * 100. Used to identify whitespace and cross-sell opportunities. Stored as a raw business estimate, not a computed KPI.

products.name: program_supplier
products.description: Association record linking a staffing supplier (vendor) to a specific VMS program, capturing the suppliers participation terms and performance within a client-managed contingent workforce program. Captures supplier tier (preferred, approved, backup), category authorization (which job categories the supplier can fill), markup cap for this supplier within the program, submission limit per requisition, performance score, program enrollment date, certification/compliance status within the program, and supplier status (active, suspended, removed). Sourced from Beeline VMS. Note: supplier/vendor identity and master data are owned by the vendor domain; this product owns only the program-specific participation terms, tier assignments, and performance metrics within the clients program context.
products.reference: Beeline Supplier Program Enrollment / VMS Supplier Tier

attributes.name: program_supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the program supplier association record. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer. Entity role: JUNCTION (extended) — links a staffing supplier/vendor to a specific VMS program and carries its own participation terms, tier assignments, and performance metrics.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that owns and manages this VMS contingent workforce program. Establishes the demand-side context for the supplier participation record.

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_package. Business justification: Suppliers enrolled in a managed program must comply with a specific credential package defining BGC, drug screen, and training requirements for their workers. MSP program management requires linking e

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: Suppliers can participate in managed programs (RPO/MSP) in addition to VMS programs. This allows tracking supplier participation across both VMS and managed program types. One supplier association to

attributes.name: nda_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.nda. Business justification: Supplier NDA compliance per program enrollment is a standard staffing procurement requirement. Normalizing nda_on_file (boolean) to a direct NDA FK enables expiration tracking, document retrieval, and

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing supplier/vendor master record in the vendor domain. Vendor identity and master data are owned by the vendor domain; this product owns only the program-specific participation terms.

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: Each supplier enrolled in a managed program operates under a specific vendor agreement governing rates, compliance, and terms. Normalizing replaces denormalized msa_on_file/msa_effective_date/msa_expi

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS contingent workforce program this supplier is enrolled in. Links to the client-managed program record within the Beeline VMS platform.

attributes.name: active_assignment_count
attributes.description: Current number of active worker assignments placed by this supplier within the program at the time of the last data refresh. Provides a real-time headcount view of the suppliers workforce contribution to the program. Sourced from Beeline VMS.

attributes.name: authorized_job_categories
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of job category codes or names that this supplier is authorized to fill within the program (e.g., IT, Finance, Engineering, Light Industrial). Restricts the suppliers submission eligibility to approved labor categories only.

attributes.name: avg_time_to_fill_days
attributes.description: Average number of calendar days from requisition release to candidate placement for this supplier within the program. A core SLA and KPI metric used to evaluate supplier responsiveness and efficiency. Sourced from Beeline VMS supplier scorecard.

attributes.name: beeline_supplier_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Beeline Vendor Management System (VMS) Supplier Program ID
attributes.description: The externally-known unique identifier assigned by Beeline VMS to this supplier-program enrollment record. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration with the source VMS platform.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Certification and compliance status of the supplier within the program. Reflects whether the supplier has met all program-required compliance obligations including insurance certificates, diversity certifications, background check protocols, I-9 compliance, and contractual requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this program supplier association record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary rate fields for this supplier-program record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency VMS programs for multinational clients.

attributes.name: diversity_certification_type
attributes.description: The specific type of diversity certification held by this supplier, if applicable. Used for OFCCP compliance reporting and corporate diversity spend analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MBE|WBE|SDVOSB|HUBZone|LGBTBE|DVBE|none — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: diversity_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier holds a recognized diversity certification (e.g., MBE, WBE, SDVOSB, HUBZone). Many enterprise VMS programs track diversity supplier participation for OFCCP compliance and corporate diversity spend reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supplier was formally enrolled and activated within the VMS program. Marks the effective start of the suppliers participation terms and eligibility to receive requisitions.

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the suppliers participation in the VMS program is scheduled to end or was terminated. Null for open-ended enrollments. Used for contract lifecycle management and program renewal tracking.

attributes.name: fall_off_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of placements made by this supplier within the program that ended prematurely (before the scheduled assignment end date). High fall-off rates indicate poor candidate quality or fit. Used in tier review and supplier performance management.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of requisitions assigned to this supplier that were successfully filled within the program period. Calculated as filled requisitions divided by total requisitions routed to the supplier. Key KPI for supplier performance evaluation and tier assignment.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the suppliers most recently verified insurance certificate on file for this program. Used to trigger renewal alerts and compliance reviews before coverage lapses.

attributes.name: insurance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suppliers required insurance certificates (general liability, workers compensation, professional liability) have been verified and are current within the program. Required for program participation and compliance.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal performance review conducted for this supplier within the program. Used to track review cadence and ensure timely tier reassessment based on performance metrics.

attributes.name: markup_cap_percent
attributes.description: The maximum markup percentage this supplier is permitted to apply above the pay rate when billing within this program. Enforced by the VMS platform at submission time. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.00 = 35%). Represents the Spread/Markup ceiling negotiated for this supplier within the program.

attributes.name: max_bill_rate
attributes.description: The maximum bill rate (in the programs currency) that this supplier is authorized to submit for any candidate within this program. Acts as a rate ceiling enforced by the VMS platform at submission time. Distinct from the markup cap percentage.

attributes.name: next_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this supplier within the program. Supports proactive program management and ensures regular supplier evaluation cadence.

attributes.name: onboarding_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has completed all required onboarding steps for this program, including document submission, compliance verification, system access provisioning, and training acknowledgments. Prerequisite for receiving live requisitions.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Composite performance score for this supplier within the program, calculated by the VMS platform based on fill rate, time-to-fill (TTF), quality of submission (QoS), assignment completion rate, and fall-off rate. Typically expressed on a 0–100 scale. Used for tier review and program renewal decisions.

attributes.name: preferred_worker_type
attributes.description: The worker classification type(s) this supplier primarily places within the program (W-2 employees, 1099 independent contractors, Corp-to-Corp, or Employer of Record). Relevant for IRS worker classification compliance and co-employment risk management.

attributes.name: program_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the supplier organization for this program. Used for requisition notifications, compliance alerts, and program communications via Beeline VMS.

attributes.name: program_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the supplier organization responsible for managing this program relationship. This is the supplier-side account manager or program coordinator for the VMS engagement.

attributes.name: requisition_routing_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position determining the order in which this supplier receives requisition notifications within the program tier. Lower numbers receive requisitions first. Used to implement tiered routing logic (e.g., preferred suppliers receive reqs before approved suppliers).

attributes.name: response_time_sla_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Response Time Service Level Agreement (SLA) Hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which this supplier is contractually required to respond to a new requisition notification within the program. Defines the SLA commitment for supplier responsiveness. Tracked against actual response times for SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: submission_limit_per_req
attributes.description: Maximum number of candidate submittals this supplier is allowed to make per open requisition within the program. Controls Quality of Submission (QoS) and prevents requisition flooding. Enforced by Beeline VMS at the time of submittal.

attributes.name: supplier_status
attributes.description: Current participation status of the supplier within this specific VMS program. Active suppliers can receive and respond to requisitions; suspended suppliers are temporarily blocked; removed suppliers have been permanently disqualified from the program.

attributes.name: supplier_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification of the supplier within the VMS program, determining routing priority for requisitions. Preferred suppliers receive first-look on new requisitions; approved suppliers are standard participants; backup suppliers are used when preferred/approved cannot fill; probationary suppliers are under performance review.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supplier was suspended or removed from the program. Populated when supplier_status transitions to suspended or removed. Used for compliance audit trails and program governance reporting.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for supplier suspension or removal from the program, if applicable. Populated when supplier_status is suspended or removed. Supports audit trail and program governance documentation.

attributes.name: total_submittals_ytd
attributes.description: Total number of candidate submittals made by this supplier within the program in the current calendar year. Used to assess supplier engagement level and submission volume relative to program activity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this program supplier association record was most recently modified. Tracks the last update event for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: vms_supplier_code
attributes.description: The supplier code or identifier assigned by the clients VMS platform (Beeline) to this supplier within the program. Used as the operational reference key in VMS-generated reports, requisition routing, and timesheet approvals.

products.name: sla_measurement
products.description: Periodic performance measurement record capturing actual results against a defined SLA configuration for a specific reporting window. Captures measurement period (start/end date), SLA config reference, measured value, target value, variance, compliance flag (met/missed), requisition count in scope, fill count, TTF (Time to Fill) actual average, TTS (Time to Start) actual average, QoS (Quality of Submission) actual rate, fill rate actual, and measurement source system. Generated from operational data in the recruitment and placement domains. Enables SLA compliance reporting, client QBR (Quarterly Business Review) preparation, penalty/bonus calculation triggers, and account health scoring.

attributes.name: sla_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each SLA measurement record. Identifies a single periodic performance measurement instance against a defined SLA configuration. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete business event capturing actual vs. target SLA performance for a reporting window.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client (employer) account for whom this SLA measurement is being evaluated. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE linking this measurement to the demand-side client entity in the client domain.

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: SLA measurements can apply to managed programs (RPO/MSP) in addition to VMS programs. This allows tracking SLA performance for managed workforce programs. One measurement for one managed program.

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA configuration record that defines the metric type, target thresholds, and measurement rules governing this measurement. Links the measurement to its governing SLA definition.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: SLA measurements frequently track supplier-specific metrics (fill rate, time-to-fill, quality of submission) within VMS/MSP programs. Linking measurements to suppliers enables performance reporting, s

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: The program identifier from the Beeline VMS or equivalent VMS platform for clients operating under a VMS/MSP (Managed Service Provider) program. Enables correlation of SLA measurements with VMS-tracked requisitions and submittals.

attributes.name: account_health_score
attributes.description: A composite numeric score (0–100) representing the overall health of the client account based on this measurement periods SLA performance. Derived from weighted SLA compliance results and used for account risk segmentation and QBR preparation.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: The contractual bonus dollar amount earned by over-performance in this measurement period, as calculated per the bonus formula in the SLA configuration. Populated only when bonus_triggered is True. Used for billing adjustments and incentive tracking.

attributes.name: bonus_triggered
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the SLA over-performance in this measurement period has triggered a contractual bonus or incentive clause. True = bonus applies; False = no bonus. Drives positive billing adjustments in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: compliance_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether a higher or lower measured value represents better performance for this metric type. higher_is_better applies to fill_rate, qos, retention_rate; lower_is_better applies to TTF and TTS (fewer days is better). Required to correctly interpret variance sign for compliance determination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SLA measurement record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to penalty_amount and bonus_amount fields (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency client engagements in international staffing operations.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the clients stated reason for disputing this SLA measurement result. Populated only when measurement_status is disputed. Supports dispute resolution workflows and MSA compliance documentation.

attributes.name: dispute_resolved_date
attributes.description: The date on which a disputed SLA measurement was formally resolved between the staffing firm and the client. Populated only when a dispute has been closed. Used to track dispute resolution cycle times and SLA governance compliance.

attributes.name: excluded_req_count
attributes.description: Number of requisitions excluded from the SLA measurement scope due to agreed exclusion criteria (e.g., client holds, force majeure, late job order submissions). Provides transparency into the effective denominator used in SLA calculations.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Describes any agreed-upon exclusions applied to the measurement scope (e.g., client-caused delays, force majeure, requisitions excluded per MSA terms). Populated when certain requisitions or placements were removed from the SLA calculation denominator.

attributes.name: fall_off_count
attributes.description: Number of placements that ended prematurely (fall-offs) during the measurement period before the expected assignment end date. High fall-off counts negatively impact retention rate SLA metrics and may trigger penalty clauses.

attributes.name: fill_count
attributes.description: Number of requisitions that were successfully filled (placement confirmed) within the measurement period. Used as the numerator in fill rate calculations and as a direct performance indicator for talent acquisition effectiveness.

attributes.name: fill_rate_actual
attributes.description: The actual fill rate for the measurement period expressed as a percentage (0–100), calculated as fill_count divided by req_count multiplied by 100. Measures the staffing firms ability to fulfill client demand within the period.

attributes.name: finalized_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA measurement record was locked and finalized for reporting. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the finalization lifecycle event. Once finalized, the record is immutable for audit and billing purposes.

attributes.name: is_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the measured performance met or exceeded the SLA target for this measurement period. True = SLA met (compliant); False = SLA missed (breach). Primary compliance indicator used in account health scoring and QBR reporting.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual observed performance value for the SLA metric during the measurement period. Interpretation depends on sla_metric_type: for TTF/TTS this is average calendar days; for fill_rate/qos/retention_rate this is a percentage (0–100); for submittal_ratio this is a ratio. This is the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT for this transaction.

attributes.name: measurement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers or operations staff to document contextual notes about this measurement record, such as explanations for SLA misses, data quality caveats, client-agreed exclusions, or force majeure circumstances affecting performance.

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this measurement record, used in client-facing QBR (Quarterly Business Review) reports, penalty/bonus calculations, and audit trails. Format: SLA-MEAS-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.

attributes.name: measurement_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the measurement data was sourced. Identifies data lineage for audit and reconciliation purposes. manual indicates data was entered directly by an account manager outside of automated system feeds.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA measurement record. draft indicates data is being collected; pending_review awaits account manager sign-off; finalized is locked for reporting; disputed is under client challenge; voided has been invalidated.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The contractual penalty dollar amount triggered by this SLA breach, as calculated per the penalty formula in the SLA configuration. Populated only when penalty_triggered is True. Used for billing credit adjustments and financial reporting.

attributes.name: penalty_triggered
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the SLA breach in this measurement period has triggered a contractual penalty clause as defined in the MSA or SLA addendum. True = penalty applies; False = no penalty. Drives billing adjustments in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reporting window for which SLA performance is being measured. Defines the close of the measurement interval and determines which requisitions, placements, and timesheets fall within scope.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reporting window for which SLA performance is being measured. Combined with period_end_date, defines the exact scope of the measurement interval (weekly, monthly, quarterly, etc.).

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the cadence of the measurement window. Determines how frequently SLA compliance is evaluated and reported to the client. Drives QBR preparation and penalty/bonus calculation cycles.

attributes.name: qbr_period_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement record falls within a QBR reporting period and should be included in the formal Quarterly Business Review package presented to the client. True = include in QBR; False = standard operational measurement only.

attributes.name: qos_actual_rate
attributes.description: The actual QoS rate for the measurement period, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Typically calculated as the ratio of client-accepted submittals to total submittals, or interview-to-submittal ratio. Measures the quality and relevance of candidate submittals.

attributes.name: req_count
attributes.description: Total number of open requisitions (job orders) that fell within the measurement period scope and were included in the SLA calculation. Provides the denominator context for fill rate and submittal ratio calculations.

attributes.name: retention_rate_actual
attributes.description: The actual assignment retention rate for the measurement period expressed as a percentage (0–100). Measures the proportion of placed workers who remained on assignment through the expected end date, excluding early terminations and fall-offs.

attributes.name: sla_metric_type
attributes.description: The specific KPI (Key Performance Indicator) being measured in this record. TTF = Time to Fill; TTS = Time to Start; fill_rate = percentage of requisitions filled; QoS = Quality of Submission rate; submittal_ratio = submittals per req; retention_rate = assignment retention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ttf|tts|fill_rate|qos|submittal_ratio|retention_rate|on_time_start|absence_rate — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submittal_count
attributes.description: Total number of candidate submittals made to the client across all in-scope requisitions during the measurement period. Used in QoS (Quality of Submission) and submittal ratio calculations.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The contractually agreed performance threshold for the SLA metric as defined in the SLA configuration. Represents what was promised to the client in the MSA (Master Service Agreement) or SLA addendum. Used as the benchmark for compliance determination.

attributes.name: ttf_actual_avg_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time to Fill (TTF) Actual Average Days
attributes.description: The actual average number of calendar days from requisition open date to confirmed placement (fill) across all in-scope requisitions during the measurement period. Core TTF KPI metric used in SLA compliance evaluation and client QBR reporting.

attributes.name: tts_actual_avg_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time to Start (TTS) Actual Average Days
attributes.description: The actual average number of calendar days from requisition open date to the workers first day on assignment across all in-scope placements during the measurement period. TTS measures end-to-end speed including onboarding and credentialing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SLA measurement record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and Silver layer delta processing.

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the target value ((measured_value - target_value) / target_value * 100). Enables normalized comparison of SLA performance across different metric types and clients regardless of unit scale.

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between measured_value and target_value (measured_value minus target_value). Positive variance indicates over-performance; negative variance indicates under-performance. Used to quantify the degree of SLA compliance or breach for penalty/bonus triggers.

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Client credit and financial risk assessment record used to evaluate and monitor a clients creditworthiness and ability to pay invoices on agreed terms. Captures credit score (D&B PAYDEX, internal composite score), credit limit, approved payment terms (net days), credit hold flag, credit hold reason, last credit review date, next scheduled review date, DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) actual, aging bucket summary (current, 30, 60, 90+ days), bank reference, trade references, credit decision (approved, conditional, declined), decision date, approving authority, and risk tier (low, medium, high, watch). Sourced from D&B Direct, internal AR aging reports, and credit committee decisions. Critical for staffing firms managing significant accounts receivable exposure — supports go/no-go decisions on new business, headcount expansion approvals, and credit hold enforcement during invoice generation.

products.name: rate_card_line
products.description: This association product represents the pricing line items within a client rate card, linking negotiated rates to specific job categories. Each record captures the bill rates, pay guidance, markup, and effective dates that apply when a specific job category is priced under a specific client rate card. This is the operational pricing matrix used daily in job order creation, candidate submittal pricing, and invoice generation.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, a single rate card negotiated with a client contains pricing for multiple job categories (e.g., Software Engineer, Project Manager, Business Analyst), and each job category appears across multiple client rate cards with different negotiated rates. The rate card is a pricing matrix, not a single-category document. Recruiters and account managers actively manage these rate card lines when creating job orders, pricing candidate submittals, and generating invoices.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: experience_level

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: industry_vertical

attributes.name: is_remote_eligible

attributes.name: is_security_clearance_required

attributes.name: pay_rate_max

attributes.name: pay_rate_min

attributes.name: pay_rate_type

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: sourcing_campaign_status

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sourcing campaign officially launches and begins generating candidate activity. Used for TTF (Time to Fill) and campaign duration calculations.

attributes.name: target_country_code

attributes.name: target_fill_date
attributes.description: The business-committed date by which the associated job order(s) must be filled. Drives urgency scoring and SLA compliance tracking for TTF (Time to Fill) KPI measurement.

attributes.name: target_headcount
attributes.description: The number of positions (headcount) this sourcing campaign is designed to fill. Drives submittal volume targets and sourcing capacity planning.

attributes.name: target_job_title
attributes.description: The primary job title or role designation being sourced in this campaign (e.g., Senior Java Developer, Registered Nurse). Used for job board posting titles and candidate matching.

attributes.name: target_skill_set
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or free-text description of the primary skills, certifications, or competencies this campaign is sourcing for (e.g., Java, AWS, Agile, PMP). Drives Boolean search strings and job board targeting.

attributes.name: target_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code for the primary sourcing geography (e.g., IL, NY, CA). Used for SUTA, workers comp, and state-specific labor law compliance.

attributes.name: target_submittal_count
attributes.description: The planned number of qualified candidate submittals this campaign aims to generate. Used to set QoS (Quality of Submission) benchmarks and recruiter productivity targets.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this sourcing campaign record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental data loads, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the recruiter at the time of submittal. May include candidate highlights, match rationale, availability details, or special considerations communicated to the client contact.

attributes.name: offer_accepted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate formally accepted the offer for this submittal. Marks the conversion of a submittal to a placement. Used for submittal-to-hire ratio and TTS calculations.

attributes.name: offer_extended_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal employment or engagement offer was extended to the candidate following a successful interview. Used for offer-to-acceptance cycle time measurement and TTF milestone tracking.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intended engagement type for this submittal. Distinguishes between temporary staffing, contract-to-hire (CTH), direct placement, temp-to-perm, and Statement of Work (SOW) engagements. Drives billing, compliance, and conversion fee logic.

attributes.name: proposed_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or periodic bill rate proposed to the client at the time of submittal. Represents the rate charged to the client for the candidates services. Used in spread and gross margin calculations. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: proposed_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or periodic pay rate proposed for the candidate at the time of submittal. Represents the compensation offered to the worker. Used in spread and gross margin calculations. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: qos_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes accompanying the QoS rating, providing qualitative context on why the candidate was rated at that quality level. May include match strengths, gaps, or client-specific considerations.

attributes.name: qos_rating
attributes.description: Numeric quality score assigned to this submittal reflecting how well the candidate profile matches the job order requirements. Scored on a defined scale (e.g., 1.0–5.0). Used as a KPI for recruiter performance, submittal quality benchmarking, and client satisfaction analysis.

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the proposed pay rate and bill rate on this submittal (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates the pay and bill rate period basis for this submittal (e.g., hourly, daily, weekly, annual, per diem). Determines how proposed_pay_rate and proposed_bill_rate are interpreted for compensation and billing calculations.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason a submittal was rejected by the client or withdrawn by the candidate. Used for pipeline analytics, fall-off rate analysis, and process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overqualified|underqualified|rate_mismatch|availability|culture_fit|position_filled|no_response|candidate_withdrew — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rtr_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate granted Right to Represent (RTR) authorization to the staffing firm for this submittal. Used for compliance tracking and dispute resolution in cases of duplicate representation claims.

attributes.name: rtr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has granted the staffing firm the Right to Represent (RTR) them for this specific job order and client. A True value confirms the candidate has authorized the submittal, preventing duplicate representation conflicts.

attributes.name: rtr_method
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the candidate provided Right to Represent (RTR) consent (e.g., email, phone, text, verbal, self-service portal). Supports compliance documentation and audit trail for RTR disputes.

attributes.name: sla_response_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Due Date
attributes.description: The date by which the client is contractually required to respond to this submittal per the Master Service Agreement (MSA) or VMS program SLA. Used to flag overdue submittals and measure client SLA compliance.

attributes.name: submittal_date
attributes.description: The date and time the candidate profile was formally submitted to the client contact for the specified job order. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp. Used as the start point for Time-to-Fill (TTF) and Time-to-Start (TTS) KPI calculations. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: submittal_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-visible business identifier for this submittal (e.g., SUB-2024-00123). Used in client communications, ATS references, and operational reporting. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: submittal_source
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the candidate submittal was delivered to the client (e.g., ATS portal, VMS portal, email, phone, direct). Used for channel effectiveness analysis and process standardization.

attributes.name: submittal_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the candidate submittal in the recruitment pipeline. Tracks progression from initial submission through client review to hiring decision. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|viewed|shortlisted|interview_requested|rejected|offer_extended|hired|withdrawn — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this submittal record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the submittal record for audit and change management purposes. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: vms_submittal_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the clients Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, to this submittal. Required for MSP/VMS-managed programs to reconcile submittal records between the staffing firms ATS and the clients VMS platform.

Ensures legal protection of candidate representation rights and prevents co-representation disputes.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_contact. Business justification: RTR agreements are negotiated with and acknowledged by a specific vendor contact; tracking the vendor contact enables dispute resolution when multiple agencies claim representation rights. rtr_agreeme

attributes.name: acknowledgment_method
attributes.description: The channel or method by which the candidate acknowledged and granted the RTR. Supports audit and legal defensibility. Values: email = email reply confirmation; portal = candidate self-service portal; verbal = phone/in-person verbal consent (requires recruiter attestation); sms = text message confirmation; signed_document = formal signed RTR form.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the candidate formally acknowledged and granted the RTR agreement. Distinct from the request timestamp; captures the moment consent was received.

attributes.name: bullhorn_rtr_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier for this RTR agreement as stored in Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Used for system-of-record cross-referencing, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational ATS.

attributes.name: candidate_consent_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the stored consent document (e.g., signed RTR form, email thread ID, DocuSign envelope ID) that evidences the candidates acknowledgment. Supports FCRA and GDPR audit requirements.

attributes.name: conflict_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the competing staffing agency that has also claimed representation rights for the same candidate-client pairing, triggering a co-representation conflict. Populated only when conflict_flag is True.

attributes.name: conflict_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a co-representation conflict has been detected for this RTR agreement — i.e., another agency has also claimed the right to represent the same candidate to the same client or job order.

attributes.name: conflict_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the co-representation conflict was formally resolved. Populated only when conflict_resolution_status is not unresolved.

attributes.name: conflict_resolution_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the co-representation conflict resolution process. unresolved = conflict is open; resolved_in_favor = this firms RTR was upheld; resolved_against = competing agencys RTR was upheld; withdrawn = one party withdrew the claim.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this RTR agreement record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: The recruitment delivery model under which this RTR agreement was established. direct = standard staffing firm direct placement; rpo = Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) engagement; msp = Managed Service Provider (MSP) program; vms = Vendor Management System (VMS) submitted requisition.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the RTR agreement expires if no placement or extension has occurred. After this date, the staffing firm loses exclusive or non-exclusive representation rights for this candidate-client pairing.

attributes.name: extension_count
attributes.description: The number of times this RTR agreement has been extended beyond its original expiration date. Tracks repeated extensions that may indicate slow client decision-making or candidate availability issues.

attributes.name: grant_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the RTR agreement was formally granted and the staffing firms right to represent the candidate to the specified client or job order became effective.

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTR agreement grants exclusive representation rights to this staffing firm for the specified candidate-client pairing. True = exclusive (candidate cannot be submitted by another agency); False = non-exclusive.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title or position title associated with the job order for which the RTR agreement is established. Captured at the time of RTR creation to preserve historical context even if the job order title changes.

attributes.name: last_extension_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the RTR agreement expiration was extended. Null if no extensions have been granted.

attributes.name: nda_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires the candidate to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) as a condition of representation or submission. True = NDA required before submittal.

attributes.name: non_compete_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a non-compete agreement review is required for this candidate before representation can proceed. True = recruiter must verify no active non-compete conflicts exist with the target client.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or account manager notes related to the RTR agreement, such as special client instructions, candidate preferences, or conflict resolution details.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of placement this RTR agreement is intended to support. contract = temporary/contingent assignment; temp_to_perm = temporary with conversion option; direct_hire = permanent direct placement; contract_to_hire = contract with defined conversion path.

attributes.name: representation_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the representation right. job_order = limited to a single requisition; client = covers all open roles at the client account; client_division = covers all roles within a specific client division or business unit.

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the RTR request was initiated by the recruiter and sent to the candidate for acknowledgment. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this agreement.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the RTR agreement was formally revoked. Populated only when rtr_status is revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for revoking the RTR agreement. Populated only when rtr_status is revoked. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: candidate_request|firm_decision|conflict_lost|placement_made|job_order_closed|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]

attributes.name: rtr_duration_days
attributes.description: The agreed-upon duration of the RTR agreement in calendar days, measured from grant_date to expiration_date. Standard industry practice ranges from 30 to 90 days. Used for SLA monitoring and TTF (Time-to-Fill) analytics.

attributes.name: rtr_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the RTR agreement, used in recruiter communications, ATS tracking, and dispute resolution. Format: RTR-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.

attributes.name: rtr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the RTR agreement. pending = awaiting candidate acknowledgment; granted = candidate has confirmed representation rights; expired = past expiration date without placement; revoked = candidate or firm withdrew consent; disputed = co-representation conflict under review.

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the candidate was originally sourced before the RTR was established. Used for sourcing effectiveness analytics and QoS (Quality of Submission) reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this RTR agreement record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vms_req_number
attributes.description: The requisition or job order number as assigned by the clients Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline. Used to cross-reference the RTR agreement with the VMS-managed program when delivery_model is vms or msp.

products.name: interview

Captures interview date/time, type (phone screen, video, onsite, panel), format, client interviewer names, candidate confirmation status, coordinator, location or video link, reschedule/cancellation tracking, overall rating, individual competency ratings, hire recommendation (yes/no/maybe), detailed feedback notes, feedback submission date, decision outcome (advance, reject, hold), and rejection reason code. Central to interview coordination workflows, scheduling efficiency metrics, QoS scoring, and submittal-to-hire ratio analytics. Single source of truth for all interview scheduling and feedback data.
