attributes.name: bonus_payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the referral bonus payment process. Tracks approval and payment workflow.

attributes.name: bullhorn_referral_code
attributes.description: External identifier from Bullhorn ATS/CRM system for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this referral record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: days_to_placement
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from referral submission to successful placement. Key metric for referral program effectiveness. Null if not yet placed.

attributes.name: is_duplicate_referral
attributes.description: Indicates whether this referral is a duplicate of an existing candidate record or prior referral. Used to manage bonus eligibility and prevent duplicate processing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments provided by the referrer about the candidates qualifications, background, or fit for the role.

attributes.name: placement_date
attributes.description: Date when the referred candidate was successfully placed. Used to calculate time-to-placement from referral and determine bonus eligibility timing.

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the referral was submitted or recorded in the system. Used to calculate bonus eligibility windows and track referral velocity.

attributes.name: referral_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the referral, used for tracking and communication purposes.

attributes.name: referral_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the referral. Tracks progression from submission through placement and bonus payment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_review|accepted|rejected|placed|bonus_pending|bonus_paid|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: referrer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the referrer for communication and bonus notification purposes.

attributes.name: referrer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person who made the referral. Captured for tracking and bonus payment purposes.

attributes.name: referrer_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the referrer.

attributes.name: referrer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the person or entity who made the referral. Determines bonus eligibility rules and tracking requirements.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date when the referral was rejected or declined. Null if referral was accepted or is still under review.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the referral was rejected. Used for referrer feedback and program improvement. Null if referral was not rejected.

attributes.name: relationship_to_candidate
attributes.description: Description of the referrers relationship to the referred candidate (e.g., former colleague, friend, family member, professional contact). Used for quality and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the referral was reviewed by the recruiting team. Used to track referral processing time and responsiveness.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the referral was submitted. Used for program effectiveness analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|portal|mobile_app|phone|in_person|social_media|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this referral record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

domains.name: joborder
domains.description: SSOT for all client requisitions (reqs) and job order demand data. Owns job order headers, position requirements, skill specifications, headcount targets, duration, bill rates, pay rates, markup percentages, SLA commitments, TTF and TTS targets, and fulfillment status lifecycle. Tracks the complete job order lifecycle from intake through closure including extensions, modifications, and cancellations. Central operational hub connecting client demand to candidate supply.

products.name: tax_form_submission
products.description: Records worker tax form submissions collected during onboarding. Covers W-4 (federal withholding), state withholding equivalents, W-9 (independent contractor), and 1099 setup forms. Tracks form type, tax year, filing status, allowances or exemptions claimed, additional withholding amount, submission date, effective date, and whether the form supersedes a prior submission. Feeds payroll tax configuration in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: tax_form_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax form submission record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the placement or assignment for which this tax form was submitted. May be null for pre-placement onboarding.

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Tax form submission is a required onboarding task. Linking to the onboarding engagement enables tracking tax form completion status as part of overall onboarding workflow and supports compliance repor

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the worker who submitted the tax form. Links to the worker profile in the candidate or placement domain.

attributes.name: supersedes_submission_tax_form_submission_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the prior tax form submission that this submission replaces. Workers may submit updated forms when life events (marriage, dependents, income changes) affect withholding. Null for initial submissions.

attributes.name: task_assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the onboarding task or checklist item that triggered this tax form submission requirement.

attributes.name: backup_withholding_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is subject to backup withholding (currently 24% federal rate). IRS notifies payers when backup withholding is required due to TIN mismatch or underreporting.

attributes.name: business_name
attributes.description: Legal business name for independent contractors (1099 workers) who operate as business entities. Captured on W-9 forms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax form submission record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: deductions_amount
attributes.description: Annual amount of deductions beyond the standard deduction (itemized deductions, student loan interest, etc.) declared on W-4 Step 4(b). Reduces withholding.

attributes.name: dependents_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of dependent credits claimed on the W-4 (Step 3). Reduces withholding based on qualifying dependents.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the withholding configuration specified in this form becomes effective in payroll processing. Typically the start date of the next pay period after submission.

attributes.name: exempt_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the workers exemption from withholding expires. IRS requires annual renewal of exemption claims by February 15.

attributes.name: exempt_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker claims exemption from federal and/or state income tax withholding. Workers must meet IRS criteria (no tax liability prior year and current year) to claim exemption.

attributes.name: extra_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Additional dollar amount the worker requests to be withheld from each paycheck, declared on W-4 Step 4(c). Used to avoid underpayment penalties or increase refund.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: The workers federal tax filing status as declared on the W-4. Determines standard deduction and withholding calculation method.
attributes.value_regex: Single|Married Filing Jointly|Married Filing Separately|Head of Household|Qualifying Widow(er)

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: Type of tax form submitted. W-4 for federal withholding, State W-4 for state withholding, W-9 for independent contractors, 1099 Setup for contractor tax configuration, Local Tax Form for municipal withholding, or Other for additional forms.

attributes.name: form_version
attributes.description: Version or year of the tax form template used (e.g., 2023, 2024). IRS and state agencies periodically update form layouts and calculation rules.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax form submission record was last updated. Tracks changes to verification status, payroll sync status, or corrections.

attributes.name: local_exemptions
attributes.description: Number of exemptions claimed for local tax withholding purposes.

attributes.name: local_tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name or code of the local tax jurisdiction (city, county, school district) for which local withholding applies. Relevant in states with local income taxes (e.g., Ohio, Pennsylvania, Indiana).

attributes.name: multiple_jobs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has multiple jobs or a working spouse, requiring adjusted withholding calculation per IRS W-4 Step 2.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the tax form submission. May include worker explanations for unusual withholding requests, HR reviewer notes, or correction instructions.

attributes.name: payroll_system_sync_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the withholding configuration was successfully synchronized to the payroll system.

attributes.name: payroll_system_sync_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the withholding configuration from this form has been successfully transmitted to and applied in the payroll processing system (TempWorks Payroll).

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the worker signed the tax form, certifying the information is accurate under penalty of perjury. Required for legal validity of the form.

attributes.name: signature_method
attributes.description: Method by which the worker signed the form. Electronic signatures via DocuSign or similar platforms are legally equivalent to wet signatures under ESIGN Act.

attributes.name: state_allowances
attributes.description: Number of state withholding allowances claimed. Some states still use allowance-based withholding systems (pre-2020 federal model).

attributes.name: state_extra_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Additional dollar amount the worker requests to be withheld for state taxes from each paycheck.

attributes.name: state_filing_status
attributes.description: The workers state tax filing status as declared on the state withholding form. May differ from federal filing status depending on state rules.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the worker submitted the completed tax form. Used for compliance tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the worker submitted the tax form. Electronic submissions via self-service portals or DocuSign are preferred for compliance and audit trail. Paper forms require scanning and manual data entry.
attributes.value_regex: Electronic - Self Service|Electronic - HR Portal|Paper - Scanned|Paper - Manual Entry|DocuSign|Other

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Federal tax classification of the payee for 1099 reporting purposes. Determines which 1099 form type (1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, 1099-K) applies and backup withholding rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Individual/Sole Proprietor|C Corporation|S Corporation|Partnership|Trust/Estate|LLC - C Corp|LLC - S Corp|LLC - Partnership|LLC - Disregarded Entity|Other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The tax year for which this form is effective. Typically the calendar year in which the worker will earn income under this withholding configuration.

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Type of Taxpayer Identification Number provided on the form. SSN (Social Security Number) for W-2 employees, EIN (Employer Identification Number) for business entities, ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number) for non-resident aliens.

attributes.name: tin_value
attributes.description: The actual Taxpayer Identification Number (SSN, EIN, or ITIN) provided by the worker. Highly sensitive PII used for tax reporting and payroll processing.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification status of the tax form submission. TIN Mismatch indicates IRS TIN validation failure requiring correction. Expired indicates exemption claim has lapsed.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the HR or payroll staff member who verified the completeness and accuracy of the tax form submission.

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tax form submission was verified and approved for use in payroll processing.

products.name: order_header
products.description: Core master entity representing a client requisition (req) — the authoritative job order header record and central hub of the joborder domain. Captures the full lifecycle of a client demand request from intake through closure. Stores requisition number, job title, position type (temp, contract-to-hire, direct placement, SOW), employment classification (W-2, 1099, C2C), headcount target (total positions authorized, positions filled, positions remaining), backfill indicator, priority level, order status (open, filled, cancelled, on-hold, closed), intake date, target start date, assignment end date, and originating source (VMS, CRM, direct). Central hub connecting client demand to candidate supply in the ATS/CRM. All other joborder products reference this entity via req_id.

attributes.description: Primary key for order_header

attributes.name: client_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific client work site or office location where the placed worker will report. Drives workers compensation classification, tax jurisdiction, and scheduling.

attributes.name: client_rate_card_id

attributes.name: contract_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_rate_schedule. Business justification: Job orders inherit bill/pay rates from contracted rate schedules. Linking enables automated rate validation, prevents off-contract pricing, supports rate variance analysis, and ensures every requisiti

attributes.description: Reference to the Master Service Agreement governing the commercial terms for this requisition. Links to the DocuSign CLM contract record. Ensures billing and compliance terms are applied correctly.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.preferred_supplier_list. Business justification: Orders may be restricted to preferred supplier lists by client program. Order routing eligibility, supplier access control, and PSL compliance enforcement require direct PSL reference.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.rate_agreement. Business justification: Job orders are priced under specific rate agreements with suppliers. Rate validation, markup enforcement, contract compliance auditing, and invoice reconciliation require direct link to governing rate

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Staffing orders placed under a client SOW must reference it for scope compliance, billing against SOW budget, and deliverable tracking. The existing sow_agreement_id points to vendor.sow_agreement (su

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Job orders are awarded to/fulfilled by specific suppliers. Supplier assignment drives submittal routing, performance tracking, and invoice reconciliation. Core staffing workflow requires knowing which

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS program through which this requisition was received, when applicable. Links to the Beeline VMS program configuration for rate card and supplier management rules.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The anticipated or confirmed end date of the temporary assignment or contract engagement. Drives redeployment planning, bench management, and extension workflow triggers.

attributes.name: bgc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check (BGC) is required for candidates on this requisition. Triggers the Sterling Background Check credentialing workflow. Governed by FCRA adverse action requirements.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate charged to the client for each worker placed on this requisition. Expressed in USD per hour for temporary and contract engagements. Core component of gross margin and spread calculations. MONETARY_TRIPLET component for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: clearance_required
attributes.description: Security clearance level required for the position. Critical for government and defense staffing engagements. Drives candidate eligibility screening and credentialing requirements.

attributes.name: conversion_fee
attributes.description: The fee charged to the client upon permanent conversion of a temp-to-perm worker. May be expressed as a flat dollar amount or percentage of first-year salary. Applicable only when is_temp_to_perm is true.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this job order header record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SLA baseline calculations.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary rate fields on this requisition (bill_rate, pay_rate, etc.). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements. MONETARY_TRIPLET currency component.

attributes.name: drug_screen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-placement drug screening is required for candidates on this requisition. Triggers the credentialing workflow in Sterling Background Check upon placement.

attributes.name: education_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum educational qualification required for candidates on this requisition. Used in candidate screening and EEOC-compliant job requirement documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|high_school|associate|bachelor|master|doctorate|professional_cert — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: employment_classification
attributes.description: Worker tax and employment classification for this requisition. W-2 = employee on staffing firm payroll; 1099 = independent contractor; C2C = corp-to-corp engagement. Drives payroll processing, tax withholding, and co-employment risk assessment.

attributes.name: headcount_filled
attributes.description: Current count of positions on this requisition that have been successfully filled with an active placement. Derived operationally from placement records but stored here for fast reporting and SLA dashboards.

attributes.name: headcount_remaining
attributes.description: Number of unfilled positions remaining on this requisition (headcount_target minus headcount_filled). Drives active recruiting prioritization and capacity planning.

attributes.name: headcount_target
attributes.description: Total number of positions authorized by the client for this requisition. Represents the maximum number of workers that can be placed against this job order. Used for demand planning and fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: hours_per_week
attributes.description: Expected number of hours per week for the position. Used to determine full-time equivalent (FTE) classification, ACA benefits eligibility thresholds, and total assignment cost projections.

attributes.name: intake_date
attributes.description: The date the requisition was formally received and entered into the ATS/CRM. Serves as the start point for Time to Fill (TTF) and Time to Start (TTS) SLA calculations. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: is_backfill
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition is a backfill for a previously vacated position rather than a new headcount addition. Backfill reqs typically have faster fill expectations and known role profiles.

attributes.name: is_temp_to_perm
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition has a contractual temp-to-perm (contract-to-hire) conversion option. When true, a conversion fee schedule applies upon permanent hire. Drives conversion tracking and fee billing.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the position including responsibilities, qualifications, and working conditions as provided by the client. Source content for ATS job postings and candidate screening.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The client-specified job title for the open position. Used in candidate matching, submittal communications, and workforce analytics. May differ from the internal job category classification.

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45%). Encapsulates burden, overhead, and profit margin. Used for pricing analysis and client negotiations.

attributes.name: min_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for candidates to be considered for this position. Used in ATS candidate screening and quality of submission (QoS) scoring.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the job order requisition. Drives recruiter workflow, reporting dashboards, and SLA tracking. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Values: open (actively recruiting), filled (all headcount placed), on_hold (client-paused), cancelled (client-withdrawn), closed (administratively closed).

attributes.name: originating_source
attributes.description: The channel or system through which this requisition was received. Tracks demand intake source for channel analytics and process efficiency measurement. VMS = Beeline or similar; CRM = Salesforce/Bullhorn direct; Direct = client phone/email; Portal = self-service client portal.

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for overtime hours worked by placed workers on this requisition. Typically 1.5x the regular bill rate per FLSA requirements. Required for accurate client invoicing.

attributes.name: ot_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for overtime hours paid to workers placed on this requisition. Must comply with FLSA 1.5x overtime rule for non-exempt workers. Drives payroll cost calculations.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate paid to the worker placed on this requisition. Expressed in USD per hour. Used to calculate spread (bill rate minus pay rate) and gross margin. Must comply with FLSA minimum wage and applicable prevailing wage requirements.

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily allowance paid to the worker for travel, lodging, or meals when the assignment requires relocation or travel. Expressed in currency per day. Applicable for travel-intensive or remote assignments.

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement model for this requisition. Determines billing structure, conversion fee applicability, and compliance requirements. Temp = temporary staffing; Contract-to-Hire = temp with conversion option; Direct Placement = permanent placement; SOW = Statement of Work project-based engagement.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Recruiter-assigned or client-designated urgency level for this requisition. Drives work queue prioritization and resource allocation. Critical = immediate fill required; High = fill within SLA; Medium = standard; Low = backfill or pipeline.

attributes.name: req_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable requisition number assigned at intake. Used by clients, recruiters, and VMS systems to reference the job order. Corresponds to the Bullhorn Job Order external ID or VMS requisition number. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The work shift schedule required for this position. Drives candidate availability matching, differential pay calculations, and scheduling in Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: target_start_date
attributes.description: The client-requested date by which the placed worker should begin the assignment. Used to calculate Time to Start (TTS) SLA performance and to prioritize recruiter activity.

attributes.name: ttf_target_days
attributes.description: The SLA-committed number of calendar days from intake to first qualified submittal or fill, as agreed with the client. Used to measure recruiter and program performance against TTF KPI benchmarks.

attributes.name: tts_target_days
attributes.description: The SLA-committed number of calendar days from requisition intake to worker start date. Distinct from TTF; measures the full cycle from demand signal to worker on-site.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this job order header record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vms_req_number
attributes.description: The requisition number assigned by the clients VMS platform (e.g., Beeline). Distinct from the internal req_number; used for cross-system reconciliation and supplier portal submissions.

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the position requires the worker to be physically on-site, fully remote, or a hybrid arrangement. Impacts candidate sourcing geography, per diem eligibility, and tax nexus determination.

products.name: position_requirement
products.description: Defines the detailed position specifications attached to a requisition. Captures job description, required education level, years of experience, work location type (on-site, remote, hybrid), shift type, travel requirements, physical demands, security clearance level, drug screen requirement, background check requirement, and any client-specific screening criteria. Represents the structured demand profile that drives candidate matching and submittal qualification.

attributes.name: position_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the position requirement record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a structured demand profile (position specification) attached to a job order requisition.

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_package. For multi-position orders, different positions ma

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: Position requirements specify BGC type, drug screen panel, and worker classification that must align with vendor agreement standards. Staffing compliance teams validate position requirements against t

attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check (BGC) is required for candidates submitting to this position. Drives the credentialing workflow in Sterling Background Check and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: bgc_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type(s) of background check required (e.g., criminal, employment verification, education verification, credit, motor vehicle record). attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The agreed-upon hourly or periodic rate charged to the client for this position. Used in revenue recognition, spread calculation (Bill Rate minus Pay Rate), and gross margin analysis. Sourced from Bullhorn Job Order or Beeline VMS rate card.

attributes.name: certifications_required
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of mandatory professional certifications or licenses required for the position (e.g., PMP, RN, CPA, CDL). Drives the credentialing verification workflow and readiness status checks.

attributes.name: client_screening_criteria
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any client-specific screening requirements beyond standard criteria (e.g., proprietary assessments, client interviews, specific onboarding steps, NDA requirements). Sourced from client MSA or VMS program requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: drug_screen_panel
attributes.description: Specifies the drug screening panel type required for this position (e.g., 5-panel, 10-panel, 12-panel, hair follicle, oral fluid). Drives the specific test order in Sterling Background Check.

attributes.name: drug_screen_required

attributes.name: education_field_of_study
attributes.description: Specific academic discipline or field of study required or preferred for the position (e.g., Computer Science, Nursing, Accounting). Complements education_level for precise candidate qualification.

attributes.name: education_level

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether E-Verify employment eligibility verification is required for this position. Mandatory for federal contractors and certain state-regulated engagements.

attributes.name: headcount

attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the pay rate to arrive at the bill rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45%). Used for rate card compliance, margin analysis, and client pricing governance.

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current status of the workers onboarding process for this assignment. Tracks completion of I-9, E-Verify, background check, drug screen, and orientation steps required before the worker can begin. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding.

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for overtime hours worked by the placed worker. Typically 1.5x the standard bill rate per FLSA requirements. Required for accurate client invoicing and OT cost tracking.

attributes.name: ot_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate paid to the worker for overtime hours. Typically 1.5x the standard pay rate per FLSA requirements. Required for payroll processing and FLSA compliance auditing.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate paid to the worker for services rendered. Core financial field used in payroll processing, spread calculation, and markup analysis. Expressed in USD per hour unless otherwise noted.

attributes.name: per_diem_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is eligible to receive per diem allowances (meals, lodging, incidentals) for this assignment. Typically applies to travel assignments or placements away from the workers tax home. Affects payroll tax treatment.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: The client-issued purchase order number authorizing spend for this assignment. Required for invoice matching and accounts payable processing at the client. Sourced from Beeline VMS or client ERP.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: The originally contracted or currently scheduled end date of the assignment. Used for proactive redeployment planning, extension tracking, and workforce bench management.

attributes.name: scheduled_hours_per_week
attributes.description: The standard number of hours per week the worker is scheduled to work on this assignment. Used for FTE calculation, workforce planning, and prorated billing. Typically 40 for full-time placements.

attributes.name: spread
attributes.description: The gross spread per hour calculated as bill rate minus pay rate. Represents the staffing firms gross revenue per hour before burden costs. Key profitability metric tracked at the assignment level per ASA industry standards.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The actual date the worker began the assignment at the client work location. Used for tenure calculations, billing cycle initiation, and Time to Start (TTS) KPI measurement.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Worker Classification (W-2 / 1099 / Corp-to-Corp / Employer of Record)
attributes.description: Tax and employment classification of the worker for this assignment. W-2 = employee of the staffing firm; 1099 = independent contractor; Corp-to-Corp = contractor through their own entity; EOR = employer of record arrangement. Drives payroll tax treatment and IRS compliance.

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: The NCCI or state-specific workers compensation class code assigned to this placement based on the job duties performed. Determines the workers comp insurance premium rate applied to the assignment. Required for accurate burden rate calculation and insurance compliance.

products.name: direct_hire

Owned by the placement domain as the SSOT for permanent placement outcomes. Sourced from Bullhorn permanent placement module.

attributes.description: Reference to the physical or remote work location where the placed candidate will perform their duties. Links to the client location record in the Client domain.

attributes.name: accepted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate formally accepted the employment offer. Used to calculate offer acceptance cycle time and track placement progression from offered to accepted status.

attributes.name: base_salary
attributes.description: The annual base salary (in USD) agreed upon for the permanent placement. Used as the basis for conversion fee calculation (fee_percentage × base_salary). Classified as confidential financial data. MONETARY_TRIPLET component per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: bgc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pre-employment background check (BGC) for the candidate in this direct hire placement. Sourced from Sterling Background Check integration. Required for compliance with FCRA and client onboarding requirements.

attributes.name: bullhorn_placement_reference
attributes.description: External identifier from the Bullhorn ATS/CRM permanent placement module. Used to trace this record back to the originating system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: conversion_fee_amount
attributes.description: The gross dollar amount of the placement fee charged to the client for the direct hire engagement. Typically calculated as fee_percentage × base_salary. This is the primary revenue line for direct hire placements. MONETARY_TRIPLET component per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this direct hire placement record was first created in the system. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or business unit within the client organization where the candidate will be permanently placed. Used for workforce planning analytics and client reporting.

attributes.name: drug_screen_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pre-employment drug screening for the candidate in this direct hire placement. Sourced from Sterling Background Check integration. Required for compliance with client-specific and DOT/OSHA regulated positions.

attributes.name: eeoc_job_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Job Category
attributes.description: The EEOC EEO-1 job category code assigned to the placed position (e.g., Officials and Managers, Professionals, Technicians). Required for EEOC and OFCCP regulatory reporting on workforce composition.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement for the direct hire placement. Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) is the standard for direct hire; part-time direct hire is less common but supported.

attributes.name: exempt_status
attributes.description: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) classification of the placed position as exempt (salaried, not eligible for overtime) or non-exempt (eligible for overtime pay). Critical for client compliance and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: fall_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the placed candidate left or was terminated from the client, triggering a fall-off event within the guarantee period. Null if the placement has not fallen off. Used to calculate fall-off rate KPI and assess recruiter performance.

attributes.name: fall_off_reason
attributes.description: The categorized reason why a direct hire placement fell off within the guarantee period. Used for root cause analysis, recruiter coaching, and quality of submission (QoS) reporting. Null if placement has not fallen off. attributes.name: fee_collected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the conversion fee has been fully collected (payment received) from the client for this direct hire placement. Used for cash flow reporting and accounts receivable aging analysis.

attributes.name: fee_invoiced
attributes.description: Indicates whether the conversion fee invoice has been generated and sent to the client for this direct hire placement. Used to track billing completeness and revenue recognition readiness.

attributes.name: fee_payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed-upon payment terms for the conversion fee invoice. Defines when the client is obligated to remit payment after the placement start date or invoice date. Sourced from the client MSA.

attributes.name: fee_percentage

attributes.name: guarantee_end_date
attributes.description: The calculated date on which the guarantee period expires (start_date + guarantee_period_days). After this date, the staffing firm has no replacement obligation. Used for fall-off risk monitoring and financial liability tracking.

attributes.name: guarantee_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from the candidates start date during which the staffing firm is obligated to provide a free replacement if the candidate leaves or is terminated (fall-off window). Typically 30, 60, or 90 days. Defined in the client MSA.

attributes.name: i9_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidates I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification has been completed and verified for this direct hire placement. Mandatory under the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) for all U.S. employees.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title of the position the candidate is being permanently placed into at the client organization. Captured at time of placement as the agreed-upon title.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or account manager notes related to this direct hire placement, including special client requirements, candidate considerations, or placement context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal employment offer was extended to the candidate by the client. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Key metric for Time to Fill (TTF) calculation.

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current status of the candidate onboarding process for this direct hire placement, including I-9 verification, document collection, and system provisioning. Tracked to ensure readiness for the confirmed start date.

attributes.name: placement_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for this direct hire placement record (e.g., DH-2024-00123). Used in client communications, invoicing, and reporting. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: placement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the direct hire placement. Tracks the progression from offer through active employment or fall-off. LIFECYCLE_STATUS per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Values: offered (offer extended to candidate), accepted (candidate accepted offer), started (candidate began employment), fell_off (candidate did not start or left within guarantee period), replaced (replacement candidate provided per guarantee obligation).

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the permanent placement engagement type. Direct Hire is a full-time permanent placement from the outset; Temp-to-Perm and Contract-to-Hire indicate a conversion from a temporary or contract assignment to permanent employment.

attributes.name: replacement_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staffing firm is currently obligated to provide a free replacement candidate due to a fall-off within the guarantee period. True when placement_status is fell_off and the guarantee period has not expired.

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the base salary (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international placements. MONETARY_TRIPLET component per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the candidate was originally sourced for this direct hire placement. Used for sourcing effectiveness analytics and recruiter performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: job_board|referral|linkedin|direct_sourcing|internal_database|rpo|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The confirmed date on which the candidate begins employment with the client. Used to calculate Time to Start (TTS) and triggers the guarantee period window. Key operational milestone for billing and fall-off monitoring.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this direct hire placement record was most recently modified. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: work_arrangement
attributes.description: The agreed-upon work location arrangement for the permanent placement. Onsite requires physical presence at the client location; remote is fully off-site; hybrid is a combination. Captured at time of placement.

attributes.name: prior_end_date

attributes.name: prior_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate paid to the worker that was in effect on the assignment immediately before this extension event. Stored for rate change audit and gross margin analysis.

attributes.name: rate_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this extension event included a renegotiation of the bill rate or pay rate. True when either revised_bill_rate or revised_pay_rate differs from the prior rate. Enables quick filtering of rate-change extensions for financial impact analysis.

attributes.name: redeployment_candidate_flag
