attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Conversions track which supplier originally placed the worker for conversion fee calculation, supplier credit, and supplier performance metrics (conversion rate). Essential for MSA fee terms enforceme

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: Temp-to-perm conversion fees and waiver eligibility are defined in the vendor agreement. Finance teams calculating conversion fee_amount and fee_percentage must reference the governing vendor_agreemen

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS program (e.g., Beeline) under which the original temporary assignment was managed. Relevant for MSP/VMS-managed programs where conversion fees and processes are governed by the VMS program terms.

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client work location where the converted worker will be permanently employed. Used for geographic workforce analytics and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: worker_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.worker_classification. Business justification: Conversions from contingent contractor to permanent FTE trigger reclassification from temporary to employee status. Business process: documenting worker classification change for IRS/state compliance

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Hours Worked Prior to Conversion
attributes.description: Total billable hours worked by the temporary worker on the original assignment prior to the conversion date. Used to validate minimum tenure hour thresholds for fee waiver eligibility and for conversion rate analytics.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the temporary or contract assignment formally ended as a result of the conversion. Marks the transition point from contingent to permanent employment status.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the original temporary or contract assignment from which the conversion originated. Used to calculate the total assignment duration prior to conversion and to validate minimum tenure requirements per the MSA.

attributes.name: bullhorn_conversion_reference
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by Bullhorn ATS/CRM to the placement conversion workflow record. Used for system-of-record traceability and reconciliation with the source system.

attributes.name: client_confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client formally confirmed the conversion hire in writing or via the system. Triggers the conversion fee billing process in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the temporary worker officially transitioned to permanent employment with the client. This is the principal business event date for the conversion and is used for KPI calculations such as conversion rate and time-to-convert.

attributes.name: conversion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the conversion event. pending = conversion initiated but not yet confirmed by client; confirmed = client has confirmed the hire; invoiced = conversion fee invoice has been issued; fell_off = conversion did not complete (fall-off event); cancelled = conversion was voided.

attributes.name: conversion_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the conversion event. temp_to_perm indicates a temporary worker transitioning to permanent employment; contract_to_hire (CTH) indicates a contract worker being hired directly; direct_conversion covers other direct placement conversions.

attributes.name: converted_worker_annual_salary
attributes.description: The first-year annual base salary agreed upon for the converted worker in their new permanent role with the client. Used as the basis for percentage-based conversion fee calculations. Sourced from client confirmation documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this conversion record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: fall_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which a confirmed conversion fell off — i.e., the converted worker left the clients permanent employment within the guarantee period. Populated only when conversion_status is fell_off. Used for fall-off rate KPI monitoring.

attributes.name: fall_off_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason why a confirmed conversion fell off within the guarantee period. Used for fall-off rate analysis and to determine whether a replacement or fee credit is owed to the client per MSA guarantee terms.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The gross conversion fee charged to the client for the temp-to-perm or contract-to-hire conversion. Typically calculated as a percentage of the converted workers first-year annual salary or as a flat fee per the MSA. Critical for revenue recognition and billing in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: fee_basis_type
attributes.description: Indicates the method used to calculate the conversion fee. percentage_of_salary = fee is a percentage of the converted workers first-year annual salary; flat_fee = fixed dollar amount per the MSA rate card; negotiated = custom fee agreed upon for this specific conversion.

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the conversion fee amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.

attributes.name: fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the converted workers first-year annual salary used to calculate the conversion fee, when fee_basis_type is percentage_of_salary. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Null when fee_basis_type is flat_fee.

attributes.name: fee_waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal approver (e.g., account manager, branch manager, or VP) who authorized the conversion fee waiver. Required for audit and revenue exception tracking.

attributes.name: fee_waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the conversion fee has been waived for this conversion event. True = fee waived; False = fee applies. Fee waivers may occur due to MSA terms, client relationship considerations, or minimum tenure provisions.

attributes.name: fee_waiver_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for waiving the conversion fee when fee_waiver_flag is True. msa_tenure_clause = worker met minimum tenure hours per MSA; client_relationship = strategic client concession; negotiated_waiver = pre-negotiated waiver in contract; minimum_hours_met = minimum billable hours threshold reached; other = other documented reason.

attributes.name: guarantee_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the permanent start date during which the staffing agency guarantees the placement. If the converted worker leaves within this period, a replacement or fee credit may be owed per the MSA. Sourced from the applicable MSA terms.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the conversion fee invoice was issued to the client. Used for accounts receivable aging and revenue recognition timing in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title of the permanent position the converted worker is being hired into at the client organization. May differ from the temporary assignment title and is used for workforce planning and conversion analytics.

attributes.name: minimum_tenure_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Tenure Hours for Fee Waiver
attributes.description: The minimum number of billable hours the temporary worker must have worked on the assignment before the conversion fee is waived per the MSA terms. Used to determine fee_waiver_flag eligibility when fee_waiver_reason is minimum_hours_met.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting additional context, special circumstances, or operational notes related to the conversion event. Examples include negotiation details, client-specific conditions, or exception handling notes.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client formally notified the staffing agency of their intent to convert the temporary worker to a permanent employee. Used to calculate notice period compliance per the Master Service Agreement (MSA) terms.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the client is contractually required to remit payment for the conversion fee invoice, per the payment terms defined in the MSA.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment for the conversion fee was received from the client. Used for cash application, revenue recognition, and accounts receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: permanent_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the converted worker officially begins permanent employment with the client. May differ from conversion_date if there is a gap between conversion confirmation and the first day of permanent employment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this conversion record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this conversion record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail compliance. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: assignment_status_history
products.description: Audit trail of all status transitions for a worker assignment throughout its lifecycle (e.g., offered → confirmed → active → extended → ended, or active → cancelled). Captures prior status, new status, transition timestamp, changed-by user, change reason code, and any associated notes. Enables SLA compliance tracking (TTF, TTS), fall-off rate analysis, and regulatory audit requirements. Supports Bullhorn status change event log.

attributes.name: assignment_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each assignment status history record. Primary key for this audit trail entity. Role: EVENT_LOG — append-only record of immutable status transition events for worker assignments.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which this assignment is being fulfilled. Denormalized to enable direct client-level SLA compliance and fall-off rate reporting without joining through the placement or job order records.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (requisition) associated with this assignment. Supports TTF (Time to Fill) and TTS (Time to Start) SLA tracking by linking status transitions back to the originating job order.

attributes.name: primary_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent worker assignment record for which this status transition event was recorded. EVENT_SOURCE_REFERENCE — the assignment entity that emitted this status change event.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate (worker) whose assignment status changed. Enables candidate-level fall-off rate analysis, redeployment tracking, and SLA compliance reporting across all assignments for a given worker.

attributes.name: req_pipeline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.req_pipeline. Business justification: Assignment status transitions such as on-hold or cancelled are reflected in the req pipeline stage. Linking status history to pipeline enables pipeline-stage-to-assignment-status correlation reports u

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS (Vendor Management System) program under which this assignment operates, if applicable. Links to Beeline VMS program configuration for contingent workforce programs. Null for direct-client assignments not managed through a VMS.

attributes.name: actual_transition_hours
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time in hours between the triggering business event and this status transition. Compared against sla_target_hours to determine SLA compliance. Supports TTF and TTS metric calculation in Power BI Analytics dashboards.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition required a formal approval step (e.g., client approval for an extension, manager approval for a conversion). Supports workflow compliance and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the status transition was formally approved by the approving user. Null when no approval was required. Used to measure approval cycle time for SLA compliance and process efficiency analytics.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual end date of the worker assignment at the time of this status transition. Captures the end date as it was known at the moment of the status change, supporting extension tracking and fall-off analysis.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the status transition occurred. Drives fall-off rate analysis, redeployment eligibility, and regulatory reporting. Values: voluntary_resignation, client_termination, assignment_end, extension_approved, no_show, fall_off, conversion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|client_termination|assignment_end|extension_approved|no_show|fall_off|conversion|medical_leave|performance|background_check_fail — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the status transition beyond the standardized change_reason_code. Captures recruiter or account manager notes entered at the time of the change. Supports regulatory audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: client_contact_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client contact (hiring manager or program manager) was notified of this status transition. Critical for client relationship management and SLA compliance evidence, particularly for fall-off and cancellation events.

attributes.name: compliance_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was triggered by or resulted in a compliance hold — for example, a failed background check (BGC), incomplete I-9 verification, E-Verify mismatch, or missing credentialing. Links to compliance domain for regulatory audit.

attributes.name: compliance_hold_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for a compliance hold when compliance_hold_flag is true. Values: bgc_pending (Background Check pending), bgc_failed, i9_incomplete (I-9 incomplete), everify_mismatch (E-Verify mismatch), credential_missing, drug_screen_pending, drug_screen_failed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bgc_pending|bgc_failed|i9_incomplete|everify_mismatch|credential_missing|drug_screen_pending|drug_screen_failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED — the date and time when this status history record was first captured in the data platform. Distinct from transition_timestamp (the business event time). Used for data pipeline monitoring and audit trail completeness verification.

attributes.name: days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the assignment spent in the prior_status before this transition. Calculated at ingestion time and stored for efficient SLA compliance analysis (e.g., how long an assignment was in offered before confirmed). Supports TTF and TTS KPI reporting.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date on which the new status takes operational effect. May differ from transition_timestamp when a status change is backdated or future-dated (e.g., an extension approved today but effective next Monday).

attributes.name: is_backfill
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this assignment is a backfill — replacing a worker who left a position. Backfill assignments are tracked separately for workforce planning analytics and client relationship management reporting.

attributes.name: is_conversion
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this status transition represents a temp-to-perm or contract-to-hire conversion event, where the temporary worker is being converted to a permanent employee of the client. Triggers conversion fee billing processes.

attributes.name: is_extension
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this status transition represents an assignment extension event, where the original end date has been pushed forward. Extensions are a key revenue retention metric and trigger redeployment planning suppression.

attributes.name: is_fall_off
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this status transition represents a fall-off event — a placement that ended prematurely before the originally scheduled end date. Fall-off rate is a critical KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for staffing firm quality and recruiter performance measurement.

attributes.name: is_redeployment_eligible
attributes.description: Flag set at the time of this status transition indicating whether the worker is eligible for redeployment to a new assignment. Drives bench management workflows and proactive candidate outreach to minimize bench time and maximize utilization.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The assignment status value after this transition event. This is the EVENT_TYPE_OR_CHANNEL discriminator for the kind of status change. Common values include: offered, confirmed, active, on_hold, extended, ended, cancelled, no_show, fall_off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: offered|confirmed|active|on_hold|extended|ended|cancelled|no_show|fall_off|pending_start — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes field capturing any additional context, observations, or instructions associated with this status transition event. Mirrors the Bullhorn ATS/CRM note/comment field attached to status change events. Supports recruiter communication and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated notifications (to the candidate, client contact, or internal team) were triggered and sent as a result of this status transition. Supports communication audit trails and onboarding/offboarding workflow compliance.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the placement type at the time of this status transition. Denormalized here to support efficient analytics without joining to the placement record. Values: temporary, contract_to_hire (CTH), temp_to_perm, direct_hire, sow (Statement of Work).

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The assignment status value immediately before this transition event. Together with new_status, defines the state transition vector. Common values include: offered, confirmed, active, on_hold, extended, ended, cancelled, no_show, fall_off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: offered|confirmed|active|on_hold|extended|ended|cancelled|no_show|fall_off|pending_start — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for status transitions within a single assignment, starting at 1 for the first transition. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full assignment status lifecycle and identification of the current (latest) status without relying on timestamp ordering alone.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition occurred outside the agreed SLA (Service Level Agreement) window for the associated client program or VMS program. Enables SLA compliance tracking and client reporting for MSP/VMS programs managed through Beeline.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The SLA target response time in hours for this specific status transition type, as defined in the clients MSA (Master Service Agreement) or VMS program configuration. Used to evaluate whether sla_breach_flag should be set.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this status change event. Enables data lineage tracing and reconciliation across Bullhorn ATS/CRM, Beeline VMS, SAP SuccessFactors, TempWorks, and Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: The native event or record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn status change event ID, Beeline VMS transaction ID). Enables exact record traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: transition_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the status transition was initiated. Distinguishes between manual recruiter actions, automated system rules, VMS (Vendor Management System) sync events from Beeline, API integrations, or bulk update operations. Critical for data lineage and audit integrity.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the status transition occurred. EVENT_TIMESTAMP — the principal real-world event time for this status change. Used for TTS (Time to Start) and TTF (Time to Fill) SLA calculations and fall-off rate analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED — the date and time when this status history record was last modified in the data platform. While status history records are ideally immutable, corrections or enrichments may update this field. Supports data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workers employment arrangement at the time of this status transition. Values: w2_employee (W-2), 1099_contractor (independent contractor), corp_to_corp, eor (Employer of Record). Critical for IRS worker classification compliance and co-employment risk management.

products.name: redeployment
products.description: Tracks redeployment events and pipeline management for workers coming off active assignments (bench management). Records the ending assignment reference, redeployment target date, redeployment status (bench, in-process, redeployed, separated), candidate availability date, preferred work type, preferred location, redeployment coordinator, days on bench, and outcome (redeployed to new assignment, converted, separated). Enables proactive bench management and reduces time-to-redeploy KPI. Sourced from Bullhorn redeployment workflow.

attributes.name: redeployment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each redeployment event record. Primary key for the redeployment data product within the placement domain. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — tracks a discrete lifecycle event of a worker transitioning off an assignment into the redeployment pipeline.

attributes.name: availability_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to candidate.availability. Business justification: Redeployment planning uses the candidate's current availability record to match open roles to available workers. Linking redeployment directly to availability enables automated redeployment matching,

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_package. Business justification: Redeployment viability depends on whether the worker's existing credentials satisfy the target role's package. Recruiters assess credential gaps before committing to redeployment to avoid costly re-cr

attributes.name: msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: Redeployment places a worker at a target client under a governing MSA. Compliance teams must verify the target client MSA covers the redeployed worker's classification and terms. redeployment has targ

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific job order (requisition) being pursued for this workers redeployment. Null until a specific job order match is identified by the coordinator.

attributes.name: placement_compliance_check_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.placement_compliance_check. Business justification: Redeployments to new clients require fresh compliance clearance (new client BGC requirements, updated credentials, new work location requirements). Compliance teams run placement_compliance_check reco

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate (worker) who is entering the redeployment pipeline. Links to the candidate master record in the Candidate domain. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE required for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: recruiter_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.recruiter_assignment. Business justification: A specific recruiter is assigned to manage each redeployment effort. Linking redeployment to recruiter_assignment enables recruiter performance tracking on redeployment outcomes and bench-cost reducti

attributes.name: redeployment_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active or recently ended placement/assignment that triggered this redeployment event. Establishes the originating assignment context for bench management tracking.

attributes.name: redeployment_client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account associated with the ending assignment. Used to track which client the worker is departing from and to identify potential redeployment opportunities within the same client account.

attributes.name: req_pipeline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.req_pipeline. Business justification: Redeployment candidates are actively tracked in the req pipeline for the target role. Linking redeployment to the pipeline record enables redeployment-fill-rate reporting and prevents duplicate sourci

attributes.name: submittal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.submittal. Business justification: Redeployment candidates reference original submittal for skills verification, client preference history, and prior RTR agreements. Essential for bench management and rapid redeployment to similar role

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Redeployment tracks original supplier for bench management, redeployment success rate metrics, and supplier obligation to assist in redeployment. Used in MSP programs where suppliers maintain responsi

attributes.name: talent_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to candidate.talent_pool. Business justification: Redeployment sourcing: staffing firms source redeployment candidates from bench/redeployment talent pools. Tracking which pool a redeployment was sourced from enables pool performance analytics, redep

attributes.name: target_client_client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account being targeted for the workers next placement during the redeployment process. Null until a specific client opportunity is identified.

attributes.name: target_placement_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new placement record created as the successful outcome of this redeployment event. Null until the worker is successfully redeployed to a new assignment.

attributes.name: actual_redeploy_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker was successfully placed on a new assignment or converted. Null until redeployment outcome is achieved. Used to calculate actual time-to-redeploy against the target.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The actual or scheduled end date of the ending assignment that triggered this redeployment event. Used to calculate days on bench and drive proactive outreach timelines. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP anchor for the redeployment lifecycle.

attributes.name: availability_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate becomes fully available for a new assignment. May differ from assignment_end_date due to notice periods, PTO, or contractual obligations. Critical input for redeployment scheduling and coordinator outreach.

attributes.name: bench_cost_risk
attributes.description: Estimated financial exposure (in pay_rate_currency) associated with the worker remaining on bench, calculated as the workers pay rate multiplied by projected bench days. Stored as a point-in-time snapshot for financial risk reporting. Confidential financial data.

attributes.name: conversion_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged to the client when a temporary worker is converted to a permanent hire (temp-to-perm conversion). Applicable when redeployment_type is temp_to_perm. Confidential financial data tied to the MSA/contract terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this redeployment record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: interviews_count
attributes.description: Number of client interviews the worker attended during this redeployment event. Used to measure conversion rate from submittal to interview and assess redeployment pipeline health.

attributes.name: is_backfill
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redeployment event is associated with a backfill scenario, where the worker is being redeployed to replace another departing worker at the same or different client site.

attributes.name: last_outreach_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the coordinator made contact or attempted contact with the worker regarding redeployment opportunities. Used to identify stale redeployment records requiring follow-up.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text coordinator notes capturing context, candidate preferences, client feedback, or special circumstances relevant to this redeployment event. Supports qualitative tracking alongside structured fields.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final disposition of the redeployment event. redeployed = placed on new assignment; converted = temp-to-perm conversion; separated = worker left the workforce pool; extended = original assignment extended; declined = worker declined available opportunities; no_show = worker became unresponsive.

attributes.name: outreach_attempts
attributes.description: Count of coordinator contact attempts made to the worker during the redeployment process (calls, emails, texts). Used to measure engagement effort and trigger escalation workflows when thresholds are exceeded.

attributes.name: pay_rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the pay rate fields (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.

attributes.name: pay_rate_min
attributes.description: The minimum hourly or salary pay rate the worker is willing to accept for a new assignment. Used by coordinators to filter job orders and negotiate placements during redeployment. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: preferred_location
attributes.description: The workers preferred geographic area or city/state for their next assignment. Free-text or structured location string used by coordinators to filter and match available job orders during redeployment outreach.

attributes.name: preferred_work_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the workers preferred state for redeployment. Used for geographic filtering in job order matching and workforce planning analytics.

attributes.name: preferred_work_type
attributes.description: The workers stated preference for the type of engagement on their next assignment. Guides coordinator matching and job order targeting during the redeployment process.

attributes.name: primary_skill
attributes.description: The workers primary professional skill or job title used as the lead matching criterion during redeployment job order search. Sourced from the candidate profile in Bullhorn ATS.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Coordinator-assigned urgency level for this redeployment event. critical = worker at risk of separation or has specialized skills in high demand; high = near-term bench cost risk; medium = standard pipeline; low = worker has indicated flexibility or is not immediately available.

attributes.name: redeployment_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this redeployment event, used in coordinator workflows, reporting, and communications. Format: RDP- followed by 7 digits. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: redeployment_source
attributes.description: Indicates how this redeployment record was created. bullhorn_workflow = auto-generated by Bullhorn redeployment workflow trigger; manual_entry = coordinator manually created; vms_notification = triggered by Beeline VMS assignment end notification; coordinator_initiated = proactive coordinator action; system_auto = automated rule-based creation.

attributes.name: redeployment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the redeployment event. bench = worker is unassigned and available; in_process = active outreach and submittal activity underway; redeployed = successfully placed on a new assignment; converted = temp-to-perm conversion occurred; separated = worker exited the workforce pool. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: redeployment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the redeployment pathway. internal_transfer = moved to another assignment within same client; new_client = placed with a different client; temp_to_perm = converted to permanent hire; contract_extension = existing assignment extended; reactivation = previously separated worker re-engaged.

attributes.name: remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is eligible and willing to accept a fully remote or hybrid assignment. Used to expand redeployment matching to remote job orders.

attributes.name: separation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why the worker separated from the workforce pool when redeployment_outcome is separated. Used for fall-off rate analysis and workforce retention reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|involuntary_termination|retirement|contract_end|declined_opportunities|no_response|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: skill_category
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping for the workers primary skill (e.g., Information Technology, Healthcare, Light Industrial, Finance, Administrative). Used for workforce planning segmentation and bench analytics.

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this redeployment record in the originating source system (Bullhorn ATS/CRM). Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and lineage purposes.

attributes.name: submittals_count
attributes.description: Number of candidate submittals made to client job orders during this redeployment event. Tracks the volume of active placement attempts and supports QoS (Quality of Submission) analytics.

attributes.name: target_redeploy_date
attributes.description: The goal date by which the coordinator aims to have the worker placed on a new assignment. Used to measure time-to-redeploy KPI performance and drive urgency in the redeployment pipeline.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this redeployment record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: willing_to_relocate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is open to relocating for a new assignment beyond their preferred location. Expands the matching pool for coordinators when set to true.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: The tax and employment classification of the worker for the redeployment engagement. W-2 = employee on payroll; 1099 = independent contractor; C2C = corp-to-corp; EOR = employer of record arrangement. Drives payroll, tax, and compliance handling for the new assignment.

products.name: rate
products.description: Master record for all negotiated rate components associated with a specific assignment or direct hire placement. Each rate record represents a single rate type — standard bill/pay rate, overtime (OT), double-time (DT), holiday, per diem (travel, lodging, meals, incidentals), or burden rate. Tracks effective date, expiration date, rate type, bill rate amount, pay rate amount, spread amount, markup percentage, gross margin percentage, burden rate, workers comp rate, IRS GSA rate reference (for per diem), taxable flag, reimbursement method, per diem daily allowance, per diem budget cap, rate approval status, and rate card source. Serves as the SSOT for all placement-level rate and per diem data feeding payroll and billing domains. Per diem rate types include travel, lodging, meals, and incidentals with IRS GSA compliance tracking. Sourced from Bullhorn rate card, Beeline VMS rate management, and TempWorks Payroll per diem configuration.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate charged to the client for the workers services. Represents the client-facing price component used in invoicing and revenue recognition. Expressed in the applicable currency unit.

attributes.name: burden_rate
attributes.description: The total employer-side cost loading rate applied on top of the pay rate, expressed as a decimal percentage. Encompasses FICA, FUTA, SUTA, workers compensation, and benefits costs. Used in true cost-of-labor calculations.

attributes.name: conversion_fee

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate record was first created in the system. Provides the foundational audit trail entry for data lineage, compliance, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: direct_hire_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the placed candidates first-year annual salary charged as the direct hire placement fee. Applicable only for direct hire and permanent placement engagements. Defined in the client MSA.

attributes.name: dt_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for double-time hours, typically applicable on holidays or after extended daily thresholds per client contract or state law. Used in client invoicing for DT hours.

attributes.name: dt_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for double-time hours, typically 2x the regular pay rate. Applicable per client contract terms or state-mandated double-time rules. Used in payroll processing for DT-eligible hours.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate record becomes active and applicable to payroll and billing calculations. Marks the start of the rates binding period for the associated placement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate record ceases to be applicable. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no defined end. Used to manage rate versioning, extensions, and contract renewals.

attributes.name: gross_margin_percentage
attributes.description: The gross margin expressed as a percentage of the bill rate, calculated as (Spread / Bill Rate). Represents the profitability ratio for this rate record and is a primary KPI for financial reporting and account management.

attributes.name: gsa_rate_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS GSA (General Services Administration) Rate Reference

attributes.name: holiday_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for hours worked on designated holidays. Defined in the client MSA or SOW and used in holiday billing calculations.

attributes.name: holiday_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for hours worked on designated holidays. Defined in the workers assignment terms and used in payroll processing for holiday-worked hours.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate record is currently active and eligible for use in payroll and billing calculations. A rate may be inactive due to expiration, supersession by a newer rate version, or manual deactivation.

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate or per diem allowance is subject to federal and state income tax withholding. Per diem amounts at or below GSA rates are typically non-taxable; amounts exceeding GSA rates are taxable as wages.

attributes.name: job_classification_code
attributes.description: The occupational classification code (e.g., DOL SOC code or client-defined job category code) associated with this rate. Drives workers compensation rate assignment, FLSA exemption status, and rate card categorization.

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.35 = 35%). Used in rate negotiations, client proposals, and margin analysis reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, negotiation history, special conditions, or exceptions associated with this rate record. Used by account managers and recruiters to document rate-specific business decisions.

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for overtime hours worked beyond the standard threshold (typically 40 hours/week under FLSA). Distinct from the standard bill rate to support accurate client invoicing for OT hours.

attributes.name: ot_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for overtime hours, required to be at least 1.5x the regular pay rate under FLSA. Used in payroll processing for hours exceeding the standard weekly threshold.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate paid to the worker for services rendered. Represents the worker-facing compensation component used in payroll processing. Must comply with applicable minimum wage laws under FLSA.

attributes.name: per_diem_budget_cap
attributes.description: The maximum total per diem budget authorized for this rate record over the assignment period. Used to enforce spending controls and flag overages in per diem reimbursement processing.

attributes.name: per_diem_category
attributes.description: Sub-classification of per diem rate type indicating the specific allowance category. Applicable only when rate_type = per_diem. Aligns with IRS GSA per diem schedule categories for tax compliance and reimbursement tracking.

attributes.name: per_diem_daily_allowance
attributes.description: The approved daily monetary allowance for the per diem category (travel, lodging, meals, or incidentals). Represents the maximum reimbursable or taxable daily amount for the applicable per diem category.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of placement engagement this rate record supports. Temporary covers standard temp assignments; contract_to_hire (temp-to-perm) includes conversion terms; direct_hire covers permanent placement fees; SOW (Statement of Work) covers project-based engagements.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this rate record within the source system (Bullhorn, Beeline VMS, or TempWorks). Used for cross-system reconciliation and rate card referencing.

attributes.name: rate_source

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate component this record represents. Standard covers regular bill/pay rates; overtime (OT) and double-time (DT) apply to FLSA-governed hours; holiday covers premium holiday pay; per_diem covers travel/lodging/meals/incidentals allowances; burden covers employer-side cost loading. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|overtime|double_time|holiday|per_diem|burden — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: spread_amount

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: The time or work unit basis for the bill and pay rates. Hourly is standard for temporary staffing; daily/weekly/monthly may apply to contract or SOW engagements; fixed applies to direct hire placement fees.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization across systems, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: annual_salary

attributes.name: bgc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check (BGC) is required as a condition of this offer. Drives Sterling Background Check initiation workflow and offer contingency tracking.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit bill rate offered to the client for the temporary or contract worker. Applicable for temp, CTH, and SOW offer types. Used in spread and gross margin calculations.

attributes.name: bullhorn_offer_reference
attributes.description: Native offer record identifier from the Bullhorn ATS/CRM system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability back to the source system of record.

attributes.name: counter_offer_amount
attributes.description: The compensation amount proposed by the candidate as a counter-offer to the original offer. Applicable when offer_status is counter_offered. Used in negotiation tracking and compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: counter_offer_rate_type
attributes.description: The rate basis (hourly, annual, etc.) for the candidates counter-offer amount. Required to correctly interpret counter_offer_amount in negotiation analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the offer record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage, SOC 2 Type II compliance, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this offer record (bill rate, pay rate, salary, sign-on bonus). Defaults to USD for domestic U.S. operations.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the candidate declined the offer (e.g., COMP_LOW, ACCEPTED_COMPETITOR, LOCATION, ROLE_MISMATCH, PERSONAL). Null if offer was not declined. Critical for competitive intelligence and offer strategy improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: comp_low|accepted_competitor|location|role_mismatch|personal|counter_accepted — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: declined_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate formally declined the offer. Null if not declined. Used in fall-off rate monitoring and competitive compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The clients organizational department or cost center to which the offered position belongs. Used for client billing allocation and workforce planning analytics.

attributes.name: drug_screen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-employment drug screen is required as a condition of this offer. Drives Sterling drug screening workflow and offer contingency tracking.

attributes.name: exempt_status
attributes.description: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) classification of the offered position as exempt (salaried, not eligible for overtime) or non-exempt (eligible for overtime pay). Critical for payroll compliance and OT/DT calculations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date by which the candidate must accept or decline the offer before it automatically expires. Used to enforce offer validity windows and trigger follow-up workflows.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title communicated to the candidate as part of the offer. May differ from the internal job order title. Used in candidate communications, onboarding, and EEOC job category reporting.

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate, representing the staffing firms gross margin component. Calculated as ((bill_rate - pay_rate) / pay_rate) * 100. Stored for offer-level financial benchmarking.

attributes.name: msp_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer is part of a Managed Service Provider (MSP)-managed contingent workforce program. Drives VMS submission workflows, rate card compliance checks, and MSP fee calculations.

attributes.name: negotiation_round_count
attributes.description: The total number of negotiation rounds completed for this offer, including the initial offer and any counter-offers. Used to measure negotiation complexity and recruiter efficiency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or account manager notes related to the offer, including negotiation context, special conditions, client-specific requirements, or candidate feedback not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the formal job offer was extended to the candidate. Principal business event date used in Time-to-Fill (TTF) and offer cycle time analytics.

attributes.name: offer_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-visible business identifier for the offer (e.g., OFR-2024-00123). Used in candidate communications, recruiter workflows, and reporting.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the offer. Drives offer acceptance rate KPI and time-to-fill analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|accepted|declined|rescinded|expired|counter_offered — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the offer by engagement model: temp (temporary assignment), contract_to_hire (Contract-to-Hire / CTH), perm (permanent/direct placement), or sow (Statement of Work / SOW-based engagement).

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit pay rate offered to the candidate for the temporary or contract assignment. Applicable for temp, CTH, and SOW offer types. Used in spread and markup percentage calculations.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The staffing engagement model for this offer, aligned with the downstream placement record type. Distinguishes temporary, temp-to-perm, contract-to-hire (CTH), direct hire, and SOW engagements for routing to the correct placement workflow.

attributes.name: proposed_start_date
attributes.description: The anticipated assignment or employment start date communicated to the candidate as part of the offer. Used in Time-to-Start (TTS) analytics and workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Specifies the unit basis for the offered pay rate and bill rate (e.g., hourly for temp workers, annual for direct hire, fixed for SOW engagements). Drives payroll and billing calculations.

attributes.name: rescind_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the offer was rescinded by the firm or client (e.g., BGC_FAILED, DRUG_SCREEN_FAILED, CLIENT_CANCELLED, HEADCOUNT_FREEZE, CANDIDATE_MISREPRESENTATION). Null if not rescinded. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bgc_failed|drug_screen_failed|client_cancelled|headcount_freeze|candidate_misrepresentation|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rescinded_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staffing firm or client rescinded (withdrew) the offer after it had been extended. Null if not rescinded. Tracked for compliance and candidate experience reporting.

attributes.name: sign_on_bonus
attributes.description: One-time sign-on bonus amount offered to the candidate as part of the compensation package. Null if no sign-on bonus is included. Relevant for compensation benchmarking and candidate attraction analytics.

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: The recruitment sourcing channel through which the candidate was originally identified and submitted (e.g., job_board, referral, internal_database, social_media, campus, direct_sourcing). Used in sourcing effectiveness and cost-per-hire analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: job_board|referral|internal_database|social_media|campus|direct_sourcing|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: to_acceptance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the offer_date and the accepted_date. Populated upon acceptance. Key KPI for Time-to-Fill (TTF) analytics and recruiter performance measurement.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the offer record was last modified. Audit trail field used for change data capture (CDC), Silver layer incremental processing, and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: work_arrangement
attributes.description: The physical work arrangement offered to the candidate: onsite (at client location), remote (fully remote), or hybrid (combination). Relevant for candidate matching, client SLA compliance, and workforce planning.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Tax and employment classification of the worker under this offer: W-2 (employee), 1099 (independent contractor / IC), corp-to-corp (C2C), or EOR (Employer of Record). Drives payroll tax treatment, co-employment risk assessment, and IRS compliance.

products.name: assignment_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance fulfillment relationship between a worker assignment and a regulatory or client-specific compliance requirement. It captures the operational tracking of which requirements must be satisfied for each assignment, the completion status, verification methods, and re-verification schedules. Each record links one assignment to one compliance requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific assignment-requirement pairing, enabling the business to enforce compliance gates, track waivers, and manage re-verification workflows.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each worker assignment must satisfy multiple compliance requirements (I-9 employment eligibility, background checks, drug screens, client-specific credentials, industry certifications, training mandates). Simultaneously, each compliance requirement applies to many assignments across different workers, clients, and time periods. The business actively manages the fulfillment status of each assignment-requirement pairing, tracking completion dates, verification methods, waivers, expiration dates, and re-verification schedules as operational data that belongs to neither the assignment nor the requirement alone.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compliance requirement was successfully fulfilled for this assignment. Used to calculate re-verification due dates and track compliance history.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment-compliance requirement record was created, typically at assignment activation when requirements are evaluated and assigned

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this completed requirement expires for this assignment and must be re-verified. Calculated from completion_date plus the requirements re_verification_interval_days. Null if requirement does not expire.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this assignment-compliance fulfillment record, tracking status changes, completions, and re-verifications

attributes.name: re_verification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which this requirement must be re-verified for this assignment to maintain compliance. Typically set before expiration_date to allow processing time. Drives operational workflows and alerts.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current status of this compliance requirement for this specific assignment: pending (not yet started), in_progress (documentation being collected), completed (requirement satisfied), waived (exception granted), expired (completed but now expired and needs re-verification), failed (requirement not met), not_applicable (requirement determined not to apply to this assignment)

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify fulfillment of this requirement for this assignment: document_review (manual review of uploaded documents), background_check (third-party BGC vendor), drug_test (lab results), training_completion (LMS integration), credential_verification (license/certification check), client_attestation (client confirmation), system_integration (automated verification via API)

attributes.name: verification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the verifying user regarding the fulfillment of this requirement for this assignment. May include document names, vendor confirmation numbers, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a waiver or exception was granted for this requirement on this assignment, allowing the assignment to proceed despite non-completion

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for granting a waiver for this requirement on this assignment. Required when waiver_flag is true. Captures approval authority and business rationale.

domains.name: timesheet
domains.description: Owns all worker time and attendance data for contingent workers. Covers daily timesheet submission, hours worked, approval workflows, overtime (OT), double-time (DT), breaks, absences, PTO usage, per diem tracking, schedule management, and labor hour records sourced from Kronos Workforce Ready. Captures billable hours for client invoicing and payable hours for worker compensation. Feeds payroll processing and client billing with authoritative hours data.

products.name: approved_hours_summary
products.description: Unified aggregated summary of approved hours for a worker-assignment-client combination within a pay period, broken down by pay type (regular, OT, DT, per diem, holiday). Serves as the single authoritative handoff record for both client invoice generation (billing domain) and payroll processing (payroll domain). Captures total regular hours, OT hours, DT hours, per diem units, bill rate applied, pay rate applied, total billable amount, total payable amount, burden rate components, approval confirmation flag, and payroll transmission status. Replaces separate billable and payable hour summaries to ensure a single reconciled SSOT. Distinct from raw time_entry records — this is the approved, billing-and-payroll-ready output of the timesheet approval process.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Approved hours summaries drive vendor billing and diversity spend reporting. Attributing each summary to the supplying vendor is required for MSP program spend analytics, vendor scorecards, and client

attributes.description: Reference to the source timesheet record from which this approved hours summary was derived. Provides traceability back to the raw time entry data in Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: wage_hour_determination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.wage_hour_determination. attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any post-approval amendment to this hours summary. Required when is_amended is True. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the approved hours summary record within the timesheet approval workflow. approved indicates hours are cleared for billing and payroll; disputed indicates a client or worker challenge is open; amended indicates a post-approval correction was applied.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the timesheet hours were formally approved by the authorized approver. Represents the principal business event timestamp that triggers downstream billing and payroll processing.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate charged to the client for the workers regular hours during this pay period, as defined in the client MSA or VMS rate card. Expressed in USD per hour. Used to calculate total billable amount.

attributes.name: billing_transmission_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of this approved hours summarys transmission to the client billing system (Salesforce Revenue Cloud). invoiced means a client invoice has been generated from this record.

attributes.name: burden_rate_pct
attributes.description: The total employer burden rate applied to this workers payable wages for the pay period, expressed as a decimal percentage. Encompasses FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation (Workers Comp), and benefits costs. Used to calculate fully-loaded labor cost.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved hours summary record was first created in the Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.

attributes.name: dt_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate charged to the client for double-time (DT) hours during this pay period. Typically 2x the regular bill rate per the client MSA or applicable state labor law.

attributes.name: dt_hours
attributes.description: Total approved double-time (DT) hours worked during the pay period, applicable in jurisdictions or client agreements requiring 2x pay for hours beyond a daily or weekly threshold (e.g., California daily OT rules).

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is classified as exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) for this assignment. Non-exempt workers are entitled to overtime pay at 1.5x for hours exceeding 40 per week.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: The gross margin (Spread) for this pay period, calculated as total_billable_amount minus total_payable_amount minus burden costs. Represents the staffing agencys gross profit contribution from this worker-assignment combination before SG&A.

attributes.name: holiday_hours
attributes.description: Total approved hours worked on designated company or client holidays during the pay period. Holiday hours may carry a premium bill rate and pay rate per the client MSA or worker agreement.

attributes.name: is_amended
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approved hours summary record has been amended after initial approval (e.g., due to a timesheet correction, missed punch adjustment, or retroactive rate change). True triggers a reconciliation process in payroll and billing.

attributes.name: is_approved
attributes.description: Boolean flag confirming that all hours in this summary have been formally approved by an authorized approver. True indicates the record is cleared for payroll and billing handoff. False indicates approval is still pending or was revoked.

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate charged to the client for overtime (OT) hours during this pay period. Typically 1.5x the regular bill rate, but may be negotiated differently in the client MSA.

attributes.name: ot_hours
attributes.description: Total approved overtime (OT) hours worked during the pay period, typically hours exceeding 40 per week for non-exempt workers under FLSA. Billed and paid at the OT multiplier rate (commonly 1.5x).

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this approved hours summary. Defines the inclusive end boundary for all hours aggregated in this record.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this approved hours summary. Defines the inclusive start boundary for all hours aggregated in this record.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate paid to the worker for regular hours during this pay period, as defined in the workers placement agreement. Expressed in USD per hour. Used to calculate total payable amount and gross margin (Spread).

attributes.name: payroll_transmission_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of this approved hours summarys transmission to the payroll processing system (TempWorks Payroll). confirmed means payroll has acknowledged receipt and the record is locked for the pay run.

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: The daily per diem allowance rate paid to the worker per approved per diem unit. Must not exceed IRS-published per diem limits to maintain tax-free treatment. Expressed in USD per day.

attributes.name: per_diem_units
attributes.description: Number of per diem units (typically days) approved for the worker during the pay period. Per diem is a daily allowance paid to workers for meals, lodging, or incidentals when working away from their tax home. Not subject to payroll taxes when within IRS limits.

attributes.name: pto_hours
attributes.description: Total approved paid time off (PTO) hours for the worker during the pay period. PTO hours are payable to the worker but are typically not billable to the client unless specified in the MSA.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total approved regular (straight-time) hours worked by the worker during the pay period, excluding overtime and double-time. Used as the base quantity for both client billing and worker payroll at the standard bill rate and pay rate respectively.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this approved hours summary was sourced or triggered. Kronos Workforce Ready is the primary source; Beeline VMS may be the source for MSP-managed programs; Manual indicates a staffing coordinator override entry.

attributes.name: summary_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this approved hours summary record, formatted as AHS-{YYYY}-{WW}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in billing and payroll correspondence to reference a specific approved period.

attributes.name: total_billable_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount to be invoiced to the client for this pay period, calculated as the sum of (regular_hours × bill_rate) + (ot_hours × ot_bill_rate) + (dt_hours × dt_bill_rate) + (holiday_hours × applicable holiday bill rate). Feeds Salesforce Revenue Cloud invoice generation.

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Sum of all approved hour types (regular + OT + DT + holiday) for the worker during the pay period. Represents the total time-based quantity used for workforce analytics and FTE calculations. Excludes PTO hours.

attributes.name: total_payable_amount
attributes.description: Total gross wages payable to the worker for this pay period, calculated as the sum of (regular_hours × pay_rate) + (ot_hours × ot_pay_rate) + (dt_hours × dt_pay_rate) + (holiday_hours × holiday pay rate) + (per_diem_units × per_diem_rate). Feeds TempWorks Payroll processing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved hours summary record was last modified. Tracks amendments such as retroactive adjustments or correction reprocessing.

attributes.name: vms_requisition_number
attributes.description: The requisition or purchase order number assigned by the clients Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, for this workers engagement. Required on client invoices for MSP-managed programs.

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker performed services on-site at the client location, fully remote, or in a hybrid arrangement during this pay period. Affects per diem eligibility and certain state tax obligations.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workers tax and employment relationship for this assignment. W-2 indicates a staffing agency employee; 1099 indicates an independent contractor (IC); C2C indicates a corp-to-corp engagement. Drives payroll tax treatment and burden rate application.

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: The National Council on Compensation Insurance (NCCI) workers compensation class code assigned to the worker for this assignment. Determines the workers comp insurance premium rate applied within the burden rate calculation.

products.name: direct_deposit_setup
products.description: Captures worker direct deposit banking instructions collected during onboarding. Tracks bank name, routing number (masked), account number (masked/tokenized), account type (checking, savings), allocation type (full amount, fixed amount, percentage), allocation value, priority sequence (for split deposits), effective date, and verification status (prenote sent, prenote cleared, active, rejected). Supports split-deposit configurations with multiple records per worker. Feeds TempWorks Payroll for pay distribution.

attributes.name: direct_deposit_setup_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the direct deposit setup record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific placement or assignment for which this direct deposit setup applies. Allows workers to have different banking instructions per assignment if needed.

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Direct hire placements require direct deposit setup for the worker's first paycheck processed through the staffing firm during the guarantee period. Payroll operations need direct_deposit_setup→direct

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Direct deposit setup is a core onboarding task. Linking to the onboarding engagement enables tracking banking setup as part of the overall onboarding workflow and allows reporting on onboarding comple

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (candidate placed on assignment) for whom this direct deposit instruction is configured. Links to the worker master record in the placement or candidate domain.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Workers bank account number. Stored encrypted or tokenized. Masked in all user interfaces and reports to protect worker financial data. Required for ACH direct deposit transactions.

attributes.name: account_number_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number. Used for display and worker verification purposes without exposing the full account number.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account for deposit. Checking is most common for payroll; savings and prepaid card options are also supported.

attributes.name: ach_return_code
attributes.description: Standard NACHA return code if the direct deposit transaction was returned by the receiving bank. Examples: R01 (insufficient funds), R02 (account closed), R03 (no account/unable to locate), R04 (invalid account number).

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Method by which pay is allocated to this account. Full amount deposits entire net pay; fixed amount deposits a specific dollar value; percentage deposits a specified percentage of net pay. Supports split-deposit configurations.

attributes.name: allocation_value
attributes.description: Numeric value for the allocation. For fixed_amount type, this is the dollar amount (e.g., 500.00). For percentage type, this is the percentage (e.g., 25.00 for 25%). Null for full_amount type.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the account is held. Used for worker reference and audit purposes.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date when the worker provided consent for direct deposit enrollment. Captured during onboarding process for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker provided explicit consent for direct deposit enrollment. Required for compliance with electronic funds transfer regulations and company policy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this direct deposit setup record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this direct deposit instruction is no longer active. Null for currently active instructions. Used when worker changes banking details or ends assignment.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this direct deposit instruction becomes active and will be used for payroll processing. Allows for future-dated setup changes.

attributes.name: is_primary_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the workers primary direct deposit account. True for the main account; false for secondary split-deposit accounts. Only one account per worker should be marked primary at any given time.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Date when this direct deposit instruction was last used for an actual payroll transaction. Helps identify stale or unused banking setups for cleanup and security purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this direct deposit setup record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Audit field for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or comments about this direct deposit setup. Used by HR staff to document special circumstances, worker requests, or troubleshooting details.

attributes.name: prenote_cleared_date
attributes.description: Date when the prenotification was successfully cleared by the bank, confirming the account is valid and ready for live payroll deposits. Typically 2-3 business days after prenote_sent_date.

attributes.name: prenote_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when the prenotification (zero-dollar test transaction) was sent to the bank to verify account validity. Required by NACHA rules before live direct deposit can begin.

attributes.name: priority_sequence
attributes.description: Order in which this deposit instruction is processed when multiple accounts are configured (split deposit). Lower numbers are processed first. Typically 1 for primary account, 2+ for secondary accounts.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation if the direct deposit setup was rejected during prenote or live processing. Common reasons include invalid routing number, closed account, or account type mismatch. Populated from ACH return codes.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the financial institution. Masked or tokenized in reporting layers for security. Required for ACH transactions.

attributes.name: setup_method
attributes.description: Method by which the direct deposit information was captured. Worker self-service is most common during onboarding via SAP SuccessFactors portal. HR manual entry used for exceptions. Bulk import and API integration used for large-scale onboarding events.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification and activation status of the direct deposit setup. Prenote (prenotification) is a zero-dollar ACH transaction sent to validate account details before live payroll. Active indicates the account is verified and in use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|prenote_sent|prenote_cleared|active|rejected|suspended|inactive — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: timesheet

This is the SSOT for all billable and payable hours for a given worker-assignment-period combination. Subject to FLSA §516 recordkeeping requirements (minimum 3-year retention of hours worked, wages paid, and conditions of employment). Supports state-specific meal/rest break compliance tracking for California, Washington, Oregon, and other jurisdictions with mandatory break laws.

attributes.name: approval_status
