attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timesheet was formally approved by the authorized approver (supervisor or client manager). Triggers eligibility for payroll processing and client billing. Null if not yet approved. Supports approval SLA measurement and audit compliance.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: Hourly bill rate (in USD) charged to the client for regular straight-time hours during this pay period. Sourced from the assignment/VMS rate card. Used by Salesforce Revenue Cloud to generate client invoices. Classified confidential as client pricing data.

attributes.name: billable_hours
attributes.description: Total hours that are billable to the client for this pay period. Typically equals regular + OT + DT + holiday hours (excludes PTO and unpaid absences which are not client-billable). Authoritative input to Salesforce Revenue Cloud for client invoice generation. May differ from total_hours when non-billable paid time is present.

attributes.name: break_hours
attributes.description: Total unpaid break time (meal periods) recorded during the pay period. Tracked to support state-mandated meal and rest break compliance (California IWC Wage Orders, Washington WAC 296-126-092, Oregon ORS 653.261). Ensures break deductions are correctly applied to gross hours to derive net payable hours.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the timesheet record was first created in Kronos Workforce Ready. Represents the audit record creation event. Required for FLSA §516 minimum 3-year retention compliance and SOC 2 Type II audit trail.

attributes.name: dt_hours
attributes.description: Total double-time hours worked during the pay period. Applicable under state-specific laws (e.g., California Labor Code §510 — hours over 12 in a day or all hours on the 7th consecutive day). Billed at the DT bill rate and paid at 2x the regular pay rate. Null or zero in jurisdictions without DT requirements.

attributes.name: expense_amount
attributes.description: Total approved expense reimbursements (in USD) for the pay period beyond per diem (e.g., mileage, tools, uniforms). Payable to the worker and potentially billable to the client per MSA terms. Tracked separately from wages for payroll and billing accuracy.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Workers FLSA classification for this assignment: exempt (not entitled to OT under FLSA salary/duties tests) or non_exempt (entitled to OT at 1.5x for hours over 40/week). Drives overtime eligibility logic in payroll processing. Subject to DOL enforcement and IRS worker classification rules.

attributes.name: holiday_hours
attributes.description: Hours worked on designated company or client-observed holidays during the pay period. May be billed at a premium holiday bill rate and paid at a holiday pay rate per the assignment agreement or client MSA. Tracked separately for accurate payroll and billing rate application.

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the timesheet has been formally disputed by the worker, client, or staffing firm. Triggers a dispute resolution workflow and places a hold on payroll processing and client billing until resolved. Supports dispute rate KPI and compliance audit.

attributes.name: is_late_submission
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the worker submitted the timesheet after the client or staffing firms defined submission deadline for the pay period. Used for late submission rate KPI reporting, worker compliance tracking, and payroll processing delay root cause analysis.

attributes.name: kronos_timesheet_ref
attributes.description: Native timesheet identifier from the Kronos Workforce Ready source system. Enables direct traceability from the Silver layer record back to the operational system of record for audit, reconciliation, and support purposes.

attributes.name: meal_break_waiver
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the worker signed a valid meal break waiver for this pay period, as permitted under California IWC Wage Orders for shifts of 6 hours or less, or mutual consent waivers for second meal periods. Required for California, Oregon, and Washington meal break compliance documentation. Null for non-applicable jurisdictions.

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: Hourly bill rate (in USD) charged to the client for overtime hours. Typically 1.5x the regular bill rate per the client MSA or VMS rate card. Used by Salesforce Revenue Cloud for OT billing line generation.

attributes.name: ot_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked during the pay period, typically hours exceeding 40 in a workweek under FLSA federal rules, or daily thresholds under state law (e.g., California 8-hour daily OT rule). Billed at the OT bill rate and paid at 1.5x the regular pay rate. Critical for FLSA §207 compliance and accurate payroll/billing.

attributes.name: ot_pay_rate
attributes.description: Hourly pay rate (in USD) applied to overtime hours. Typically 1.5x the regular pay rate per FLSA §207. May vary by state law or assignment agreement. Used by TempWorks Payroll for OT gross wage calculation.

attributes.name: pay_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the pay period covered by this timesheet. Determines payroll processing schedule and FLSA workweek overtime calculation methodology. weekly = 7-day period; biweekly = 14-day period; semi_monthly = twice per month; monthly = full calendar month.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: Hourly pay rate (in USD) at which the worker is compensated for regular straight-time hours during this pay period. Sourced from the assignment agreement. Used by TempWorks Payroll to calculate gross wages. Subject to FLSA minimum wage compliance and state minimum wage laws. Classified confidential as worker compensation data.

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: Total per diem reimbursement amount (in USD) for the pay period, covering meals, lodging, and incidental expenses for workers on travel assignments. Non-taxable up to IRS GSA per diem rates. Payable to the worker but may or may not be billable to the client depending on the MSA. Tracked separately from wages for IRS tax treatment.

attributes.name: pto_hours
attributes.description: Hours of paid time off (PTO) used by the worker during the pay period. Includes vacation, sick leave, and other approved paid absences. Payable but not billable to the client. Tracked for PTO balance management and payroll cost allocation. Subject to state-mandated paid sick leave laws (e.g., California SB 3, Washington ESSB 5975).

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total straight-time (non-overtime, non-double-time) hours worked by the worker during the pay period. Represents the base billable and payable hours at the standard pay rate and bill rate. Core input to payroll gross pay calculation and client invoice generation. Subject to FLSA §207 threshold monitoring.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the approver when a timesheet is rejected. Captures the basis for rejection (e.g., hours discrepancy, missing punch, unauthorized OT, incorrect cost center). Supports worker correction guidance, rejection pattern analysis, and audit documentation.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the worker electronically submitted the timesheet for approval. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the timesheet lifecycle. Used for SLA tracking (time-to-approve), late submission reporting, and audit trail under FLSA §516 recordkeeping requirements.

attributes.name: timesheet_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally visible timesheet reference number used in worker communications, client invoices, and payroll remittances. Sourced from Kronos Workforce Ready and carried through to billing and payroll systems.

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Sum of all compensable hours for the pay period: regular + OT + DT + holiday + PTO hours. Represents the total payable hours used as the basis for gross pay calculation. Excludes unpaid break hours and unpaid absences. Authoritative hours figure fed to TempWorks Payroll for payroll processing.

attributes.name: unpaid_absence_hours
attributes.description: Hours of unpaid absence recorded during the pay period (e.g., unexcused absences, unpaid leave). Not billable to the client and not payable to the worker. Tracked for attendance management, assignment compliance monitoring, and potential assignment termination triggers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the timesheet record. Tracks any changes post-creation including corrections, re-submissions, or approval status changes. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vms_timesheet_ref
attributes.description: External timesheet identifier assigned by the clients Vendor Management System (e.g., Beeline VMS) when the client manages contingent labor through a VMS program. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the staffing firms Kronos records and the clients VMS approval records. Null for non-VMS-managed assignments.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Client-issued work order or purchase order number associated with the workers assignment for this pay period. Required on client invoices for accounts payable matching. Sourced from the clients procurement or VMS system. Null if the client does not require PO-based billing.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workers engagement type for this timesheet period. Determines tax treatment, payroll processing path, and co-employment risk profile. w2_temp = W-2 temporary employee; w2_contract = W-2 contract worker; 1099_ic = Independent Contractor (1099); corp_to_corp = C2C vendor engagement; eor = Employer of Record arrangement. products.name: time_entry
products.description: Granular daily or shift-level time record representing a single worked period for a contingent worker. This is the unified SSOT for all shift-level and daily worked-time data — there is no separate shift product. Captures the specific date, planned and actual start/end times, break duration, meal break compliance flag, rest break compliance flag, net hours worked, pay type (regular, OT, DT), shift differential code, shift type (day/evening/night/weekend), labor category, cost center, schedule variance (planned vs actual hours delta), and entry source (Kronos clock, mobile, manual). Child record of the timesheet header. Incorporates shift-level schedule comparison, shift differential tracking, and dispatch-relevant shift metadata. Feeds both payroll and billing calculations. Links raw punch events to the timesheet summary. Subject to FLSA §516 and state-specific recordkeeping requirements including California Labor Code §226 (itemized wage statement backing data).

attributes.description: Client or internal cost center code to which the labor hours are allocated for billing and financial reporting. Sourced from the clients organizational hierarchy in Beeline VMS or Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Enables cost allocation reporting in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this time entry record was first created in the source system (Kronos Workforce Ready). Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for data lineage, ETL watermarking, and audit trail.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the worked period occurred (yyyy-MM-dd). Serves as the primary business event date for this time entry. Used for daily labor reporting, schedule variance analysis, and FLSA workweek calculations. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE anchor date.

attributes.name: entry_source
attributes.description: The method or system through which this time entry was captured: Kronos hardware clock (badge/biometric), Kronos mobile app, manual supervisor entry, VMS import from Beeline, or supervisor-entered correction. Supports audit trail requirements and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the time entry record. Controls whether the entry is editable, pending approval, approved for payroll/billing processing, rejected for correction, voided, or locked after payroll run. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT lifecycle dimension.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hours in this time entry are billable to the client. False for internal training time, orientation hours, or non-billable absence periods. Drives inclusion/exclusion in Salesforce Revenue Cloud invoice generation.

attributes.name: is_payable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hours in this time entry are payable to the worker. May differ from is_billable in cases such as orientation (payable but not billable) or disputed hours (billable but payment withheld pending resolution). Drives TempWorks Payroll gross pay inclusion.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job classification code identifying the role or position being performed during this time entry. Aligns with the job orders position code and is used for EEOC reporting, OFCCP compliance, and workforce analytics by job classification.

attributes.name: kronos_punch_ref
attributes.description: Source system identifier from Kronos Workforce Ready linking this time entry back to the originating raw punch event record. Enables drill-through from the Silver layer aggregated entry to the raw punch event for audit and dispute resolution. Null for manually entered records.

attributes.name: labor_category
attributes.description: Classification of the type of work performed during this entry (e.g., Light Industrial, IT Professional, Healthcare, Administrative, Engineering). Used for workforce analytics, cost allocation, and Beeline VMS rate card alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: light_industrial|it_professional|healthcare|administrative|engineering|skilled_trades|clerical|professional — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this time entry within its parent timesheet header. Enables ordered display and processing of multiple daily entries within a single timesheet period. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.

attributes.name: meal_break_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required meal break was taken in compliance with applicable state law (e.g., California Labor Code §512 requires a 30-minute unpaid meal period for shifts exceeding 5 hours). True = compliant; False = potential violation requiring premium pay or legal review.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this time entry record. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Tracks corrections, retroactive adjustments, and re-approvals. Essential for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer pipeline.

attributes.name: net_hours_worked
attributes.description: Actual compensable hours worked during this entry period, computed as (actual_end_time − actual_start_time) − break_duration_minutes, expressed in decimal hours. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category. This is the authoritative hours figure fed to payroll and client billing. Subject to FLSA §516 recordkeeping.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate (in USD) applicable to this time entry for worker compensation. Captured at the entry level to preserve the rate-in-effect at time of work, which may differ from the current placement rate due to retroactive adjustments or mid-period rate changes. Feeds TempWorks Payroll gross pay calculation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT monetary dimension.

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hours worked for compensation purposes: regular straight-time (REG), overtime at 1.5x (OT), double-time at 2x (DT), holiday premium, per diem allowance, or paid time off (PTO). Drives the pay rate multiplier applied in TempWorks Payroll and the bill rate applied in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: Per diem allowance amount (in USD) associated with this time entry for travel, lodging, or meal reimbursement when the worker is on a remote or travel assignment. Tracked separately from wages for IRS per diem tax treatment. Zero if no per diem applies.

attributes.name: pto_hours
attributes.description: Number of paid time off (PTO) hours applied to this entry when the worker is absent but entitled to paid leave. Distinct from net_hours_worked (which reflects physically worked hours). Feeds PTO balance deduction in SAP SuccessFactors and payroll processing in TempWorks.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the approver when a time entry is rejected (entry_status = rejected). Documents the basis for rejection to guide worker or supervisor correction. Null when entry is not in rejected status.

attributes.name: rest_break_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required paid rest breaks were provided in compliance with applicable state law (e.g., California IWC Wage Orders require a 10-minute paid rest period for every 4 hours worked). True = compliant; False = potential premium pay obligation.

attributes.name: schedule_variance_hours
attributes.description: Delta between planned hours (derived from scheduled_start_time and scheduled_end_time) and actual net_hours_worked for this entry. Positive value indicates overtime relative to schedule; negative indicates early departure or absence. Key KPI for workforce scheduling compliance and dispatch analytics.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The planned shift end date-time as defined in the workers schedule. Paired with scheduled_start_time to derive planned shift duration for schedule variance and workforce planning analytics.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned shift start date-time as defined in the workers schedule in Kronos Workforce Ready. Used to compute schedule variance (planned vs. actual hours delta) and to assess punctuality and dispatch compliance.

attributes.name: shift_differential_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the applicable shift differential pay rule (e.g., EVE15, NIGHT20, WKD10). Maps to the differential rate table in TempWorks Payroll to apply the correct premium multiplier to base pay rate. Distinct from shift_type which is a broad category.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the shift period for differential pay and workforce scheduling analytics. Day, evening, night, weekend, and holiday shifts may carry different pay and bill rate differentials per the client MSA or worker agreement.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX) identifying the state where the work was physically performed. Determines applicable state wage and hour laws, state income tax withholding jurisdiction, SUTA rate, and state-specific break and overtime rules. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the worker or supervisor submitted this time entry for approval. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category. Used to measure submission timeliness against payroll cutoff deadlines and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: vms_time_entry_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Time Entry Reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier assigned by the clients Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, for this time entry when the client manages contingent labor through a VMS program. Enables reconciliation between Staffing Hrs internal records and the clients VMS for invoice matching and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: workers_comp_class_code
attributes.description: NCCI or state-specific workers compensation classification code applicable to the work performed during this entry. Determined by the job type and worksite state. Used by TempWorks Payroll to calculate workers comp premium allocation and for state insurance reporting.

products.name: approval_workflow
products.description: Tracks the multi-step approval workflow lifecycle for a timesheet submission. Captures each approval stage (worker submission, supervisor review, client approval, back-office audit), the approver identity, approval action (approved, rejected, escalated, auto-approved), action timestamp, rejection reason, and SLA compliance flag. Enables full audit trail of who approved what and when, supporting dispute resolution and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each timesheet approval workflow record. Serves as the primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — tracks the multi-step approval lifecycle for a single timesheet submission.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker placement or assignment associated with this timesheet approval workflow. Ties the approval to the specific contingent worker assignment and client engagement.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client organization for whom the contingent worker performed services. Used to route approval to the correct client contact and enforce client-specific SLA rules.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Client-side timesheet approvers are contacts; approval routing, SLA tracking, and audit trails require knowing which client contact approved hours. Critical for dispute resolution and compliance audit

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Timesheet approval workflow completion triggers billing release (billing_released_flag exists on this product). Linking to the resulting invoice enables billing release audit trails — staffing billing

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll pay period to which the approved timesheet hours will be applied. Links the approval workflow to downstream payroll processing and ensures hours are captured in the correct pay cycle.

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.pay_run. Business justification: timesheet_approval_workflow has payroll_released_flag indicating when approval triggers payroll. Linking timesheet_approval_workflow.pay_run_id → payroll.pay_run enables tracing which approval workflo

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contingent worker (candidate) who submitted the timesheet being reviewed in this approval workflow. Supports worker-level audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: sla_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.sla_commitment. Business justification: MSP/VMS programs measure timesheet approval cycle times against SLA commitments. timesheet_approval_workflow tracks sla_breach_minutes and sla_compliant_flag but has no FK to the governing sla_commitm

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sla. Business justification: Timesheet approval workflows are measured against contractual SLAs (approval turnaround time, submission deadlines). The workflow already tracks sla_breach_minutes and sla_compliant_flag but has no FK

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: Timesheet approval workflows for SOW workers must route to the correct SOW engagement approver, who may differ from standard assignment supervisors. MSP programs require this link to enforce SOW-speci

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Vendor SLA compliance reporting requires measuring approval turnaround time per supplier. Linking approval workflows to the supplying vendor enables SLA breach analysis by vendor, a standard KPI in MS

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent timesheet record for which this approval workflow instance was initiated. Links the approval workflow to the specific worker time submission being reviewed.

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.vms_program. Business justification: vms_program.timesheet_approval_cycle governs the approval workflow rules for VMS-managed programs. Linking timesheet_approval_workflow to vms_program enables VMS-driven approval routing, SLA complianc

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the approver performed the approval action at this workflow stage. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Critical for SLA compliance measurement and audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_action
attributes.description: The specific action taken by the approver at this workflow stage. Distinct from approval_status in that it captures the discrete action event (e.g., delegated) rather than the resulting state. Used for audit trail and workflow analytics.

attributes.name: approval_channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the approver submitted their approval action. Supports channel adoption analytics and helps identify approval bottlenecks by channel type.

attributes.name: approval_stage
attributes.description: The specific step in the multi-stage approval workflow at which this record applies. Stages include worker submission, supervisor review, client approval, back-office audit, and payroll release. Each stage represents a distinct checkpoint in the timesheet lifecycle.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this approval workflow stage. Indicates whether the stage is awaiting action (pending), has been approved, rejected, escalated to a higher authority, auto-approved per system rules, or recalled by the submitter.

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: The functional role of the approver at this workflow stage. Distinguishes between worker self-submission, direct supervisor review, client manager approval, back-office audit, payroll admin release, and MSP coordinator oversight.

attributes.name: auto_approval_rule_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the system-defined auto-approval rule that triggered automatic approval of this timesheet stage without manual intervention. Populated only when approval_action is auto_approved. Enables audit of automated decisions.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate at which the client is billed for the workers time as defined in the client contract or VMS program. Used to validate that approved hours will generate the correct client invoice amount.

attributes.name: billing_released_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved timesheet hours have been released to the client billing system (Salesforce Revenue Cloud) for invoice generation. Enables reconciliation between approved hours and billed hours.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approval workflow record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and SOC 2 compliance purposes.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timesheet approval workflow record is associated with a formal dispute raised by the worker, client, or staffing agency. When True, the record is flagged for dispute resolution review and may be excluded from standard payroll processing until resolved.

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: The case or ticket number associated with a formal timesheet dispute. Populated when dispute_flag is True. Used to link the approval workflow record to the dispute management process for resolution tracking.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why this approval stage was escalated to a higher authority. Populated when approval_action is escalated. Supports escalation pattern analysis and workflow optimization.

attributes.name: final_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workflow record represents the final, fully-approved state of the timesheet across all required approval stages. When True, the timesheet is cleared for payroll processing and client billing. Enables efficient filtering for downstream payroll and billing feeds.

attributes.name: kronos_timesheet_ref
attributes.description: The source system reference identifier from Kronos Workforce Ready for the timesheet record associated with this approval workflow. Supports data lineage tracing and reconciliation with the system of record.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate at which the contingent worker is compensated for approved hours. Used to validate payroll calculations downstream. The spread (bill_rate minus pay_rate) represents gross margin.

attributes.name: payroll_released_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved timesheet hours have been released to the payroll processing system (TempWorks Payroll) for worker compensation. Distinct from final_approved_flag as it confirms the downstream handoff has occurred.

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: The total per diem dollar amount claimed by the worker on this timesheet. Populated when per_diem_claimed is True. Subject to IRS per diem rate limits and client contract terms. Feeds into billing and payroll calculations.

attributes.name: per_diem_claimed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker claimed a per diem allowance (daily expense reimbursement for travel, meals, or lodging) on this timesheet. Per diem claims require separate approval validation against the assignment agreement.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason the timesheet was rejected at this approval stage. Used for root-cause analysis of rejection patterns and worker coaching. Populated only when approval_action is rejected. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hours_discrepancy|missing_entries|unauthorized_overtime|unapproved_per_diem|policy_violation|duplicate_submission|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rejection_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the approver explaining the specific reason for rejecting the timesheet at this stage. Supplements the rejection_reason_code with contextual detail for dispute resolution and worker communication.

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: The number of times the worker has resubmitted this timesheet after a rejection. A high resubmission count indicates recurring errors or disputes and is used for quality-of-submission (QoS) analytics and worker coaching.

attributes.name: sla_breach_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Duration Minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes by which the approval action exceeded the SLA deadline. Populated only when sla_compliant_flag is False. Zero or null when SLA was met. Enables severity-based SLA breach analysis and client reporting.

attributes.name: sla_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approval action was completed within the SLA-defined deadline for this stage. True if the action_timestamp is on or before sla_due_timestamp; False if the SLA was breached. Supports SLA compliance reporting and client KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: sla_due_timestamp
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally defined deadline by which this approval stage must be completed per the applicable SLA. Derived from the SLA configuration for the client or program. Used to calculate SLA compliance.

attributes.name: stage_sequence_number
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of this approval stage within the overall workflow. Enables reconstruction of the full approval chain in chronological order and supports multi-step workflow analytics.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the worker originally submitted the timesheet that triggered this approval workflow. Used as the baseline for SLA elapsed time calculations and Time-to-Approve (TTA) reporting.

attributes.name: total_dt_hours
attributes.description: Total number of double-time (DT) hours recorded on the timesheet, applicable in jurisdictions or contracts where hours beyond a threshold (e.g., 12 hours/day or 7th consecutive day) are compensated at double the regular rate.

attributes.name: total_ot_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime (OT) hours recorded on the timesheet, typically hours worked beyond 40 per week or 8 per day per FLSA or applicable state law. Requires explicit approval and is a common rejection trigger.

attributes.name: total_regular_hours
attributes.description: Total number of straight-time (non-overtime) hours recorded on the timesheet being reviewed in this approval workflow. Used to validate hours against scheduled hours and client purchase order limits.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approval workflow record was last modified. Tracks the most recent state change for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: vms_workflow_ref
attributes.description: The external workflow identifier assigned by the Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, for this timesheet approval transaction. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the internal approval record and the clients VMS portal.

attributes.name: work_week_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the work week covered by the timesheet being approved. Used to align the approval workflow with payroll processing cycles and client billing periods.

attributes.name: workflow_instance_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this approval workflow instance, used in communications, dispute resolution, and audit references. Typically formatted as a sequential or alphanumeric code (e.g., WF-2024-00123).

products.name: absence_record
products.description: Records worker absences, PTO usage, sick leave, FMLA leave, holiday observances, jury duty, bereavement, and unexcused absences within a pay period. Captures absence type, absence date range, hours absent, PTO balance consumed, leave reason code, approval status, paid/unpaid indicator, client notification flag, and replacement worker request trigger. Sourced from Kronos Workforce Ready leave management module. Feeds payroll deductions, workforce availability reporting, and client SLA compliance tracking. For contingent workers, unexcused absences may trigger assignment termination workflows. Subject to FMLA recordkeeping requirements (3-year retention) and state-specific paid sick leave laws (e.g., California Healthy Workplaces, Healthy Families Act).
products.reference: Kronos Workforce Ready - Leave / Absence Management

attributes.name: absence_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each absence record. Primary key for the absence_record data product within the timesheet domain.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the active placement or assignment during which the absence occurred. Used to associate the absence with the specific client engagement and job order.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the client organization at whose worksite the worker was assigned when the absence occurred. Used for client SLA compliance tracking and notification workflows.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_contact. Business justification: absence_record has client_notified and client_notification_timestamp attributes indicating a specific client contact notification process. Staffing coordinators must notify the designated client conta

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Absences impact client site staffing levels and trigger replacement workflows; site managers need absence visibility for scheduling. Essential for client site headcount management and replacement requ

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to timesheet.pay_period. Business justification: An absence record falls within a specific pay period for payroll processing purposes. The absence_record currently stores pay_period_start_date and pay_period_end_date as denormalized fields. Adding p

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.pay_run. Business justification: absence_record has payroll_processed flag but no FK to the pay_run that processed the PTO/FMLA payment. Linking absence_record.pay_run_id → payroll.pay_run enables payroll auditors to trace which pay

attributes.name: primary_absence_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contingent worker associated with this absence record. Links to the worker master record in the workforce management system.

attributes.name: requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.requirement. Business justification: FMLA, ADA, and state leave compliance requirements mandate specific documentation, notification timelines, and certification processes for absences. Compliance officers tracking leave requirement fulf

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: Absences for SOW workers impact deliverable timelines and engagement billing. Program managers need absence_record→SOW engagement linkage to assess schedule risk, notify clients, and determine if enga

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: State leave laws (FMLA, CFRA, PFML, state-specific paid leave) are modeled in state_compliance_rule. Absence records must reference the governing state rule to enforce documentation deadlines, notific

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the timesheet record for the pay period in which this absence falls. Links the absence to the authoritative hours record for payroll and billing.

attributes.name: absence_duration_days
attributes.description: Total calendar duration of the absence expressed in days (may be fractional for partial-day absences). Derived from absence_start_date and absence_end_date but stored for reporting efficiency and workforce availability analytics.

attributes.name: absence_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the absence period. Null for open-ended absences (e.g., ongoing FMLA leave). Combined with absence_start_date to determine total absence duration.

attributes.name: absence_hours
attributes.description: Total number of scheduled work hours missed during the absence period. Used for payroll deduction calculations, PTO balance consumption, and workforce availability reporting.

attributes.name: absence_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the worker, manager, or HR coordinator providing additional context for the absence (e.g., nature of illness, family emergency details). Classified as confidential due to potential sensitivity of leave-related information.

attributes.name: absence_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this absence record (e.g., ABS-2024-00123). Used in worker communications, manager approvals, and leave management correspondence.

attributes.name: absence_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the absence period. Used to calculate absence duration, determine pay period impact, and trigger FMLA tracking windows.

attributes.name: absence_type
attributes.description: Classification of the absence by leave category as defined in the leave management policy. Drives payroll treatment (paid vs. unpaid), compliance recordkeeping, and workforce availability reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PTO|Sick Leave|FMLA|Holiday|Jury Duty|Bereavement|Unexcused|Personal|Military|Workers Comp — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the absence request through the manager approval process. Drives payroll processing eligibility and client notification triggers. Pending = submitted awaiting review; Approved = manager authorized; Denied = rejected; Cancelled = worker withdrew; Under Review = escalated.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or system identifier of the manager, supervisor, or automated workflow that approved or denied the absence request. Supports audit trail and accountability for leave decisions.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the absence request was approved or denied by the authorized approver. Null if still pending. Used for approval workflow SLA tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: client_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the client was notified of the worker absence. Null if client_notified is False. Used to measure notification SLA compliance against MSA contractual obligations.

attributes.name: client_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client organization has been notified of this worker absence (True) or not (False). Critical for client SLA compliance tracking — unnotified absences may breach MSA notification obligations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this absence record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail start point and is used for data lineage tracking in the Silver layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: documentation_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the worker must submit required leave documentation. Under FMLA, employers may require documentation within 15 calendar days of the leave request. Drives compliance follow-up workflows.

attributes.name: documentation_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether required supporting documentation (e.g., physician certification for FMLA, jury summons, death certificate for bereavement) has been received and verified (True) or is outstanding (False).

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Used
attributes.description: Number of hours counted against the workers annual FMLA entitlement (up to 480 hours / 12 weeks per year). Populated only when fmla_qualifying is True. Required for DOL FMLA recordkeeping compliance.

attributes.name: fmla_qualifying
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Qualifying Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence qualifies under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (True) or not (False). Triggers FMLA tracking, 3-year recordkeeping retention, and DOL compliance workflows.

attributes.name: is_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the absence is compensated (True) or unpaid (False). Determines payroll treatment: paid absences draw from PTO/sick balances or holiday pay; unpaid absences result in payroll deductions.

attributes.name: is_partial_day
attributes.description: Indicates whether the absence covers only part of a scheduled workday (True) rather than full days (False). Partial-day absences require hour-level tracking for accurate payroll deduction and FMLA intermittent leave accounting.

attributes.name: kronos_leave_ref
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this absence record as assigned by the Kronos Workforce Ready leave management module. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration with the Silver layer from the operational system of record.

attributes.name: leave_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code from the Kronos leave management module identifying the specific reason for the absence (e.g., FMLA-SELF, FMLA-FAMILY, PSL-CA, JURY, BRVMT-IMM). Supports regulatory reporting and state-specific paid sick leave law compliance.

attributes.name: payroll_processed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence record has been included in a completed payroll processing run (True) or is still pending payroll (False). Prevents double-processing and confirms the absence has been reflected in worker compensation.

attributes.name: per_diem_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the workers per diem allowance is affected by this absence (True) or not (False). Per diem payments may be suspended or prorated for absent days depending on the assignment contract terms.

attributes.name: pto_balance_before
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Balance Before Absence
attributes.description: Workers available PTO balance in hours immediately prior to this absence being applied. Provides a point-in-time snapshot for audit, dispute resolution, and worker self-service reporting.

attributes.name: pto_hours_consumed
attributes.description: Number of accrued Paid Time Off (PTO) hours deducted from the workers PTO balance to cover this absence. Zero for unpaid absences or absences covered by other leave types (e.g., FMLA, holiday pay).

attributes.name: replacement_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether a replacement worker has been requested to cover this absence (True) or not (False). Triggers workforce scheduling and dispatch workflows to source a backfill worker for the client site.

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the worker was originally scheduled to work during the absence period. Provides the baseline against which absence_hours is measured for partial-day absence tracking.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence has caused or is at risk of causing a breach of the client SLA (True) — for example, if the absence results in insufficient staffing levels below the contracted headcount threshold. Feeds client SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: state_leave_law_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable state-specific paid sick leave or family leave law governing this absence (e.g., CA-HWHFA for California Healthy Workplaces Healthy Families Act, NY-PFL for New York Paid Family Leave). Ensures compliance with state-level leave mandates beyond federal FMLA.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the worker or manager submitted the absence request in Kronos Workforce Ready. Establishes the start of the approval workflow and is used for SLA measurement of approval turnaround time.

attributes.name: termination_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence has triggered an assignment termination workflow (True) in Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Applicable for contingent workers with unexcused absences that breach the no-call/no-show policy threshold.

attributes.name: unexcused_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence has been classified as unexcused (True) — i.e., the worker did not provide adequate notice or documentation. Unexcused absences for contingent workers may trigger assignment termination workflows per staffing agency policy.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Supports blended OT rate calculation for workers on multiple assignments. Includes prevailing wage OT rules for Davis-Bacon Act compliance on government staffing contracts. Ensures compliant OT/DT classification across all time entries in multi-state staffing operations.

attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the payroll manager, compliance officer, or HR administrator who approved this OT rule configuration for activation. Required for SOC 2 Type II change management controls and FLSA compliance audit trails. Populated when rule_status transitions to active.

Distinct from effective_date (when the rule starts being applied) and created_timestamp (when the record was created). Supports change management audit trails per SOC 2 Type II.
