attributes.description: Defines how holiday hours are treated for OT threshold calculation. count_as_worked = holiday pay hours count toward weekly OT threshold; exclude = holiday hours are excluded from OT threshold calculation; premium_separate = holiday premium is calculated separately and does not affect OT threshold. Configured per client MSA or state law.

attributes.name: job_category_scope
attributes.description: Job category or occupational classification to which this OT rule is restricted (e.g., light_industrial, healthcare_rn, it_professional, clerical, all). Null or all indicates the rule applies across all job categories. Supports differentiated OT rules for prevailing wage or union-covered job categories.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Level of legal jurisdiction governing this OT rule. federal = applies nationwide under FLSA; state = applies within a specific U.S. state; local = applies within a specific municipality or county; contract = applies per client MSA or SOW terms regardless of geography.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OT rule record was most recently updated (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Used to detect configuration changes, trigger downstream recalculation of affected timesheets, and support SOC 2 Type II audit logging.

attributes.name: ot_multiplier
attributes.description: Pay rate multiplier applied to the workers regular rate of pay for hours classified as overtime (e.g., 1.50 for time-and-a-half per FLSA §207). Used by TempWorks Payroll to calculate OT wages and by Salesforce Revenue Cloud to calculate OT bill amounts.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OT rule incorporates prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act (for federal construction contracts) or the Service Contract Act (SCA) for government service contracts. True = prevailing wage OT rates apply; False = standard commercial OT rates apply. Critical for government staffing contract compliance.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_determination_number
attributes.description: DOL wage determination number associated with the prevailing wage schedule governing this OT rule (e.g., WD 2023-0001). Populated only when prevailing_wage_applies is True. Required for Davis-Bacon Act and SCA compliance documentation on government staffing contracts.

attributes.name: pto_counts_toward_ot
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Counts Toward Overtime (OT) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether paid time off (PTO) hours are included in the weekly hours count for OT threshold purposes. True = PTO hours count toward the OT threshold (e.g., 32 hours worked + 8 PTO = 40 hours, no OT triggered); False = only actual hours worked count toward OT threshold per FLSA standard. Configurable per client MSA.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this OT/DT rule for reference in payroll configurations, VMS integrations, and client billing systems (e.g., FLSA_FED_STD, CA_510_DAILY, DAVIS_BACON_GOV). Used as the business key in Kronos Workforce Ready and TempWorks Payroll rule tables.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the overtime rule, including the legal basis, applicable thresholds, and any special conditions (e.g., seventh-consecutive-day provisions, blended rate requirements, prevailing wage applicability). Supports compliance documentation and auditor review.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the overtime rule (e.g., Federal FLSA Standard 40-Hour Weekly OT, California Daily OT 8/12 Rule, Davis-Bacon Prevailing Wage OT). Used in payroll configuration UIs, compliance reports, and worker assignment documentation.

attributes.name: rule_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank used for conflict resolution when multiple OT rules are applicable to the same time entry (e.g., a worker in California on a government contract may have federal FLSA, California state, and Davis-Bacon rules all applicable). Lower integer = higher priority. Ensures deterministic OT rule selection in Kronos Workforce Ready and TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OT rule record. active = currently applied to time entry calculations; inactive = disabled and not applied; draft = under review before activation; superseded = replaced by a newer rule version but retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the overtime rule by its governing authority or applicability scope. federal = FLSA-based federal standard; state = state-specific labor law (e.g., California, Nevada); client_specific = client-negotiated OT terms in MSA; prevailing_wage = Davis-Bacon Act or SCA government contract rules; blended = multi-assignment blended rate OT calculation.

attributes.name: seventh_day_dt_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seventh Consecutive Day Double-Time (DT) Threshold Hours
attributes.description: On the seventh consecutive workday, the number of hours beyond which double-time pay applies (e.g., 8.00 hours per California Labor Code §510 — first 8 hours at OT, beyond 8 at DT). Null if seventh_day_ot_applies is False or if no DT tier applies on the seventh day.

attributes.name: seventh_day_ot_applies
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seventh Consecutive Day Overtime (OT) Applies Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule includes the seventh-consecutive-day OT provision, where all hours worked on the seventh consecutive day of a workweek are paid at OT rate (True) per California Labor Code §510. False for rules that do not include this provision.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this OT rule configuration was sourced or is mastered. kronos = Kronos Workforce Ready time and attendance; tempworks = TempWorks Payroll rule configuration; beeline = Beeline VMS rate and rule management; manual = manually entered by payroll or compliance team; bullhorn = Bullhorn ATS/CRM placement configuration.

attributes.name: source_system_rule_ref
attributes.description: Native identifier of this OT rule in the originating operational system (e.g., Kronos Workforce Ready pay rule ID, TempWorks Payroll OT rule code). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system for audit and troubleshooting purposes.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state abbreviation (ISO 3166-2:US) identifying the state whose labor law governs this OT rule (e.g., CA for California Labor Code §510, NV for Nevada daily OT). Null for federal-level rules applicable nationwide. Used for multi-state OT rule resolution in Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: union_agreement_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OT rule is governed by or must comply with a collective bargaining agreement (CBA) or union contract. True = union OT provisions apply and may override standard FLSA or state rules; False = no union agreement governs this rule. Relevant for unionized light industrial and healthcare staffing placements.

attributes.name: union_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the collective bargaining agreement (CBA) that governs this OT rule when union_agreement_applies is True (e.g., SEIU Local 1199 CBA 2023-2026, Teamsters Local 25 CBA). Null when union_agreement_applies is False. Used for compliance documentation and payroll audit.

attributes.name: weekly_dt_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a workweek beyond which double-time pay is triggered (e.g., some state or client rules apply DT after 60 hours/week). Null if the rule does not apply a weekly DT threshold. Distinct from the daily DT threshold.

attributes.name: weekly_ot_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a workweek beyond which overtime pay is triggered (e.g., 40.00 hours per FLSA §207 federal standard). Hours worked above this threshold are compensated at the OT multiplier rate. Null if the rule does not apply a weekly OT threshold.

attributes.name: worker_classification_scope
attributes.description: Worker tax classification to which this OT rule applies. w2_employee = applies only to W-2 employees on payroll; 1099_ic = applies to independent contractors (IC) per contract terms; all = applies regardless of worker classification. Aligns with IRS worker classification rules and FLSA co-employment considerations.

attributes.name: workweek_start_day
attributes.description: The designated first day of the workweek for purposes of weekly OT threshold calculation (e.g., sunday for a Sunday–Saturday workweek per FLSA §207). Workweek definition is fixed and regularly recurring per FLSA. Configured in Kronos Workforce Ready per client or assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sunday|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: pay_period
products.description: Reference entity defining pay period cycles used across the staffing operation. Captures pay period type (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly), period start date, period end date, payroll processing cutoff date, check date, fiscal week number, holiday adjustment flag, and active status. Serves as the authoritative calendar for timesheet grouping, payroll runs, and billing cycle alignment. Critical for multi-state operations where different clients may operate on different pay cycles.

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each pay period record in the staffing operation. Primary key for the timesheet_pay_period reference entity. [_canonical_skip_reason: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this entity is a calendar/reference table defining pay period cycles; per-role minimums do not apply, but comprehensive coverage is still provided for operational completeness.]

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: State compliance rules mandate pay frequency (weekly in some states, bi-weekly in others) and pay period structure. Pay periods must reference the governing state rule for payroll compliance audits. a

attributes.name: approval_deadline
attributes.description: Precise timestamp by which client supervisors or staffing coordinators must approve submitted timesheets. Drives SLA enforcement for approval workflows and escalation triggers in Kronos Workforce Ready. Supports on-time payroll processing and client billing cycle alignment.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_date
attributes.description: The date on which client invoices are generated for billable hours worked during this pay period. May differ from check_date in cases where billing and payroll cycles are offset. Feeds Salesforce Revenue Cloud invoice generation and Oracle NetSuite Accounts Receivable.

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The standard calendar year (4-digit integer, e.g., 2024) to which this pay period belongs. Distinct from fiscal_year when the business operates on a non-calendar fiscal year. Used for W-2 and 1099 tax year alignment in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which worker paychecks or direct deposit payments are issued for this pay period. Represents the actual pay date visible on W-2 wage statements and worker pay stubs. Used for tax reporting, FICA, FUTA, and SUTA liability calculations in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: client_segment
attributes.description: Business segment or client grouping for which this pay period definition is applicable (e.g., Healthcare, Light Industrial, IT Staffing, All). Supports multi-client staffing operations where different client verticals may operate on different pay cycles per MSA (Master Service Agreement) terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pay period record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Populated automatically at record insertion and never updated.

attributes.name: dt_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond which double-time (DT) pay rates apply for this pay period. Applicable in states such as California where DT is mandated after 12 hours in a workday or on the 7th consecutive workday. Supports multi-state payroll compliance in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pay Period Definition Effective From Date
attributes.description: The date from which this pay period definition record became effective in the system. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) tracking for pay period calendar changes (e.g., a client switching from weekly to bi-weekly pay cycles). Enables historical payroll reprocessing and audit compliance.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pay Period Definition Effective Until Date
attributes.description: The date on which this pay period definition record ceases to be effective. Null indicates the record is currently active with no planned end date. Supports SCD Type 2 history tracking for pay period calendar changes and enables point-in-time payroll audit queries.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period. All timesheet hours submitted with a work date on or before this date are grouped into this pay period. Together with start_date, defines the authoritative time boundary for worker compensation and client billing.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month (1–12) within the fiscal year to which this pay period belongs. Supports monthly financial close processes in Oracle NetSuite ERP and monthly workforce analytics reporting in Power BI Analytics Platform.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1–4) within the fiscal year to which this pay period belongs. Used for quarterly payroll tax filings (941, SUTA), financial reporting, and KPI dashboards in Power BI Analytics Platform.

attributes.name: fiscal_week_number
attributes.description: The sequential fiscal week number (1–53) within the fiscal year. Used for weekly labor analytics, overtime threshold tracking, and workforce scheduling reports in Kronos Workforce Ready and Power BI Analytics Platform. Particularly important for weekly pay period types.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (4-digit integer, e.g., 2024) to which this pay period belongs. Used for financial reporting, budget allocation, and year-end tax filings in Oracle NetSuite ERP. Supports multi-year analytics in Power BI Analytics Platform.

attributes.name: holiday_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period contains one or more observed holidays that affect standard workday counts, holiday pay eligibility, or payroll processing schedules. When True, payroll coordinators must review holiday pay rules and adjusted cutoff dates. Sourced from Kronos Workforce Ready holiday calendar.

attributes.name: holiday_count
attributes.description: Number of observed holidays falling within this pay period. Used to calculate adjusted workday counts, holiday pay liability, and per diem adjustments. Supports holiday pay eligibility rules for temporary workers under client MSA (Master Service Agreement) terms.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period record is currently active and available for timesheet assignment and payroll processing. False records represent historical, future-dated, or deactivated periods. Used to filter active periods in Kronos Workforce Ready scheduling and TempWorks Payroll run selection.

attributes.name: is_current_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the currently active pay period (i.e., todays date falls within start_date and end_date). Only one record per period_type should have this flag set to True at any given time. Used as a quick filter in operational dashboards and payroll processing queues.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll coordinators to document special instructions, exceptions, or contextual information for this pay period (e.g., Adjusted cutoff due to Thanksgiving holiday, Early check date for Christmas week). Supports operational communication and audit documentation.

attributes.name: ot_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond which overtime (OT) pay rates apply for this pay period. Typically 40.00 hours for weekly FLSA overtime, but may vary by state law (e.g., California daily OT at 8 hours). Critical for payroll compliance and accurate OT cost calculations in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: payroll_cutoff_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which all timesheets must be submitted and approved for inclusion in this pay periods payroll run. Timesheets received after this date are held for the next pay period or processed as off-cycle adjustments. Operationally critical for TempWorks Payroll batch processing.

attributes.name: payroll_provider_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the payroll processing provider or entity responsible for executing payroll for this pay period (e.g., TEMPWORKS, EOR_PARTNER_01). Relevant for EOR (Employer of Record) arrangements where a third-party provider processes payroll on behalf of the staffing firm.

attributes.name: payroll_run_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of payroll run associated with this pay period. regular = standard scheduled payroll; off_cycle = unscheduled run for missed payments or terminations; supplemental = bonus or commission payments; correction = retroactive adjustment for prior period errors. Drives payroll processing logic in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: per_diem_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether per diem allowances are applicable and tracked within this pay period. When True, per diem expense records are expected to be submitted alongside timesheets. Relevant for travel-intensive placements (e.g., healthcare travel nurses, field technicians) where IRS per diem rates apply.

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this pay period across systems (e.g., PP-2024-01-001). Used for cross-system reconciliation between Kronos Workforce Ready, TempWorks Payroll, and Salesforce Revenue Cloud billing cycles.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the pay period (e.g., Week 1 Jan 2024, Bi-Weekly Period 3 - Q1 2024). Used in payroll reports, worker pay stubs, and client billing statements for clear period identification.

attributes.name: period_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal number of this pay period within its fiscal year and period type (e.g., 1st bi-weekly period = 1, 2nd = 2). Used for period-over-period comparison analytics, payroll run ordering, and audit trail sequencing.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pay period. open = timesheets can be submitted; processing = payroll run in progress; locked = no further timesheet changes permitted; closed = payroll finalized and disbursed; cancelled = period voided (rare, e.g., system error). Drives workflow gating in TempWorks Payroll and Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pay period cycle frequency. Weekly = 52 periods/year; bi_weekly = 26 periods/year; semi_monthly = 24 periods/year; monthly = 12 periods/year. Critical for multi-client operations where different clients may operate on different pay cycles. Drives payroll run scheduling in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: pto_accrual_period_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual Period Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether PTO (Paid Time Off) accruals are calculated and posted during this pay period. Some staffing arrangements accrue PTO on a per-pay-period basis per state law (e.g., California AB 1522, New York Paid Sick Leave). Drives PTO accrual batch processing in TempWorks Payroll and SAP SuccessFactors.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this pay period definition originated. Kronos Workforce Ready is the primary source for time and attendance pay period calendars; TempWorks Payroll for payroll-specific period definitions; Beeline VMS for contingent workforce program pay cycles. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_period_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this pay period record in the originating source system (e.g., Kronos pay period ID, TempWorks period key). Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and integration audit trails between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.

attributes.name: standard_hours
attributes.description: Expected number of standard straight-time hours for a full-time worker during this pay period (e.g., 40.00 for a weekly period, 80.00 for bi-weekly). Used as the baseline for overtime (OT) threshold calculations, FTE normalization, and payroll burden rate computations.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period. All timesheet hours submitted with a work date on or after this date are grouped into this pay period. Authoritative boundary for timesheet aggregation and payroll processing.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The IRS tax year (4-digit integer) to which payroll taxes for this period are reported. Typically matches calendar_year but may differ for periods spanning year-end (e.g., a bi-weekly period starting Dec 28 and ending Jan 10). Critical for W-2, 1099, FICA, FUTA, and SUTA tax filing accuracy.

attributes.name: timesheet_submission_deadline
attributes.description: Precise timestamp by which contingent workers must submit their timesheets for the pay period. Includes time-of-day precision to support automated reminder workflows in Kronos Workforce Ready and Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Distinct from payroll_cutoff_date which governs the payroll processing batch.

attributes.name: total_calendar_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in this pay period (end_date minus start_date plus 1). Used for pro-ration calculations for partial-period placements, per diem allowance calculations, and FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) normalization in workforce analytics.

attributes.name: total_workdays
attributes.description: Number of standard business workdays (Monday–Friday, excluding holidays) within this pay period. Used for expected hours calculations, attendance rate reporting, and workforce scheduling in Kronos Workforce Ready. Supports SLA (Service Level Agreement) headcount compliance reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this pay period record in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance. Updated automatically on every record modification.

attributes.name: vms_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period is associated with a VMS (Vendor Management System) managed contingent workforce program (e.g., Beeline VMS). VMS programs may have distinct pay period calendars, approval workflows, and billing cycle alignment requirements separate from direct-client placements.

attributes.name: year_end_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period spans or falls at the calendar year-end boundary (e.g., a bi-weekly period crossing December 31 into January). When True, special year-end payroll processing rules apply including W-2 cutoff handling, FICA wage base reset, and FUTA/SUTA annual limit resets in TempWorks Payroll.

domains.name: payroll
domains.description: Owns all worker pay and tax processing data. Covers gross pay calculation, pay rates, gross-to-net calculations, tax withholdings (FICA, FUTA, SUTA), burden rates, deductions, net pay, workers compensation insurance premiums, W-2 and 1099 tax form processing, payroll tax filing, PTO accruals, and benefits administration processed through TempWorks Payroll. Handles multi-state payroll compliance and supports EOR and co-employment payroll models.
domains.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) / IRS Worker Classification Rules

products.name: pay_run
products.description: Master record for each payroll processing cycle executed through TempWorks Payroll. Captures the payroll run header including pay period start and end dates, pay date, pay frequency, run type (regular, off-cycle, adjustment, void-and-reissue), run status (open, processing, approved, posted, voided), total gross pay, total net pay, total tax withholdings, total deductions, total employer burden, worker count, processing timestamps, and approver. Serves as the authoritative anchor for all payroll transactions within a given cycle and the primary reconciliation point for payroll operations.

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each payroll processing cycle (pay run) executed through TempWorks Payroll. Serves as the primary key and authoritative anchor for all payroll transactions within a given cycle.

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to timesheet.pay_period. Business justification: pay_run has pay_period_start_date/end_date as plain columns but no FK to the authoritative pay_period record. Linking pay_run.pay_period_id → timesheet.pay_period is fundamental to payroll period reco

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll run was formally approved by the authorized approver. Captured for audit trail, SLA compliance, and payroll processing timeline analytics.

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: Staffing branch or cost center code associated with this payroll run. Used for branch-level payroll cost allocation, P&L reporting, and operational analytics in Power BI.

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: Date printed on physical payroll checks or used as the effective date for direct deposit transactions. May differ from pay_date when banking processing windows shift the settlement date.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the legal employing entity or EOR entity under which this payroll run is processed. Supports multi-entity payroll operations and co-employment models where Staffing Hr acts as the employer of record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pay run record was first created in TempWorks Payroll. Serves as the audit record creation timestamp for data lineage and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll run. Typically USD for domestic operations; supports multi-currency for international EOR engagements.

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to disburse net pay to workers in this run. Direct deposit (ACH) is standard; check and pay card are alternatives for workers without bank accounts; wire for special high-value payments.

attributes.name: gl_post_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payroll runs journal entries were posted to the Oracle NetSuite ERP General Ledger. Marks the accounting period in which payroll costs are recognized.

attributes.name: ic_worker_count
attributes.description: Number of 1099 independent contractors (ICs) included in this payroll run. Used for IRS 1099-NEC filing thresholds and worker classification compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: is_multi_state
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run spans workers in more than one US state, triggering multi-state tax withholding, SUTA apportionment, and additional compliance review requirements.

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which worker net pay is disbursed via direct deposit, check, or pay card. Determines the tax deposit due date per IRS deposit schedule rules.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which workers are paid within this run. Drives pay period date calculations and tax withholding schedules per IRS Publication 15 annualization tables.

attributes.name: payroll_state_codes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of two-letter US state codes (e.g., CA,TX,NY) representing all states in which workers were paid in this run. Drives multi-state tax filing obligations and SUTA rate application.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run was finalized and posted to the General Ledger in Oracle NetSuite ERP, making it immutable for the accounting period.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when TempWorks Payroll completed the payroll calculation and tax computation processing for this run. Used for payroll operations SLA monitoring and processing time analytics.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the pay run, used in reconciliation, audit trails, and payroll operations communications. Format: PR-YYYY-MM-NNNN.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run within TempWorks Payroll workflow. Progresses from open (data entry) through processing, approved, and posted (finalized to GL). Voided indicates the run was reversed.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run indicating its operational purpose. Regular runs cover standard pay periods; off-cycle handles out-of-band payments; adjustment corrects prior-period errors; void-and-reissue replaces a voided run; supplemental covers bonuses or special payments.

attributes.name: tax_quarter
attributes.description: Calendar quarter (1–4) to which this payroll run belongs, used for IRS Form 941 quarterly payroll tax filing and FUTA/SUTA quarterly reporting.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar year to which this payroll runs earnings and withholdings are attributed for IRS W-2 and 1099 tax reporting purposes. Critical for year-end tax form generation.

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all voluntary and involuntary employee deductions (benefits, garnishments, 401k, health insurance premiums, etc.) withheld from worker gross pay in this run. Reconciles gross-to-net pay calculations.

attributes.name: total_dt_pay
attributes.description: Sum of double time (DT) earnings for all workers in this run, applicable in states such as California where DT is mandated for hours exceeding 12 in a workday or 8 on the seventh consecutive day.

attributes.name: total_employer_burden
attributes.description: Sum of all employer-side payroll costs beyond gross wages in this run, including employer FICA, FUTA, SUTA, workers comp premiums, and employer-paid benefits. Used to calculate the burden rate and total cost of workforce deployment.

attributes.name: total_fica_employee
attributes.description: Sum of employee-side Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) withholdings (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%) across all workers in this run. Reported on IRS Form 941.

attributes.name: total_fica_employer
attributes.description: Sum of employer-side Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) matching contributions (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%) for all W-2 workers in this run. Included in total employer burden calculation.

attributes.name: total_futa_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Tax
attributes.description: Sum of Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) employer tax accrued in this payroll run, calculated at 6.0% on the first $7,000 of each employees wages (net of SUTA credit). Filed annually on IRS Form 940.

attributes.name: total_gross_pay
attributes.description: Sum of all gross earnings for all workers in this payroll run before any deductions or tax withholdings. Includes regular pay, overtime (OT), double time (DT), per diem, and other earnings components.

attributes.name: total_net_pay
attributes.description: Sum of net pay disbursed to all workers in this run after all tax withholdings and deductions. Represents the total cash outflow for worker compensation and is the primary reconciliation figure against bank ACH/check totals.

attributes.name: total_ot_pay
attributes.description: Sum of overtime (OT) premium earnings for all workers in this run, calculated at 1.5x the regular rate for hours exceeding 40 per workweek per FLSA. Supports OT cost monitoring and client billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_per_diem_pay
attributes.description: Sum of per diem allowances paid to workers in this run for travel, lodging, and meal reimbursements. Per diem amounts within IRS GSA rates are non-taxable; amounts above are taxable wages.

attributes.name: total_pto_pay
attributes.description: Sum of paid time off (PTO) earnings disbursed in this payroll run, including vacation, sick, and holiday pay. Supports PTO accrual reconciliation and state-mandated paid leave compliance.

attributes.name: total_regular_pay
attributes.description: Sum of straight-time (regular rate) earnings for all workers in this run, excluding overtime, double time, and premium pay components. Used for pay rate analytics and FLSA regular rate of pay calculations.

attributes.name: total_suta_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Tax
attributes.description: Sum of State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) employer tax accrued across all applicable states in this payroll run. Rates and wage bases vary by state; critical for multi-state payroll compliance.

attributes.name: total_tax_withholding
attributes.description: Sum of all employee-side tax withholdings across all workers in this run, including federal income tax, state income tax, local taxes, and employee FICA (Social Security and Medicare). Used for IRS Form 941 and state tax deposit reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_workers_comp_premium
attributes.description: Sum of workers compensation insurance premiums accrued for all workers in this payroll run, calculated based on payroll amounts and applicable workers comp class codes and rates. Supports insurance carrier reporting and burden rate analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pay run record was last modified in TempWorks Payroll or the Silver Layer. Supports change data capture, data lineage, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for voiding this payroll run. Required when run_status = voided to support audit compliance and payroll error tracking.

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run was voided, if applicable. Populated only for runs with run_status = voided. Supports payroll reversal audit trail and GL correction tracking.

attributes.name: w2_worker_count
attributes.description: Number of W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement) employees included in this payroll run. Distinguishes co-employed temporary workers from independent contractors for tax and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: worker_count
attributes.description: Total number of workers (W-2 employees and 1099 independent contractors) included in this payroll run. Used for headcount reporting, payroll audit reconciliation, and workforce analytics.

products.name: pay_stub
products.description: Transactional record representing the individual worker pay statement generated for each pay run, including full pay disbursement details. Captures worker identifier, pay run reference, gross pay, regular hours, overtime hours, double-time hours, per diem amounts, gross-to-net calculation details, total deductions, total tax withholdings, net pay, and stub status. Disbursement attributes: pay delivery method (direct deposit, check, pay card), check number or ACH trace number, bank routing number, account number (masked), account type (checking, savings), deposit allocation type (full net, fixed amount, percentage split), allocation amounts for split-deposit configurations, deposit priority for multiple accounts, prenote status, account verification status, and pay card routing for unbanked workers. SSOT for individual worker earnings per pay period, associated payment disbursement instructions, and banking configuration — consolidates all direct deposit and ACH details formerly tracked separately.

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual pay stub record. Primary key for the pay_stub data product. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — serves as the anchor for all gross-to-net pay disbursement details for a single worker in a single pay run.

attributes.name: assignment_id

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account designated for direct deposit disbursement. checking or savings as required by NACHA ACH transaction codes (PPD). Determines the ACH SEC code used in the payment file. Null for check and pay card disbursements.

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: Unique 15-digit NACHA ACH trace number assigned to the direct deposit transaction for this pay stub. Null for check and pay card disbursements. Used for ACH payment tracing, return item resolution, and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Sequential check number printed on the physical paycheck when pay_delivery_method is check. Null for direct deposit and pay card disbursements. Used for check reconciliation, stop-payment requests, and positive pay bank file matching.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pay stub record was first created in the payroll system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for audit trails and payroll processing SLA measurement.

attributes.name: deposit_allocation_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount or percentage value of net pay allocated to this account in a split-deposit arrangement. Populated when deposit_allocation_type is fixed_amount or percentage. Null when deposit_allocation_type is full_net.

attributes.name: deposit_allocation_type
attributes.description: Specifies how net pay is allocated to this bank account in a split-deposit configuration. full_net = entire net pay to one account; fixed_amount = a specific dollar amount; percentage = a defined percentage of net pay. Supports multi-account direct deposit configurations.

attributes.name: deposit_priority
attributes.description: Numeric sequence (1 = highest priority) determining the order in which net pay is allocated across multiple bank accounts in a split-deposit configuration. Ensures correct disbursement sequencing when a worker has designated multiple accounts.

attributes.name: dt_earnings
attributes.description: Dollar amount of earnings for double-time hours (dt_hours × pay_rate × 2.0). Applicable in states with double-time mandates. Stored as a discrete earnings component for gross pay audit and state compliance reporting.

attributes.name: dt_hours
attributes.description: Total double-time hours worked during the pay period, subject to the 2x pay multiplier. Applicable in states such as California with daily double-time thresholds (e.g., hours beyond 12 in a workday). Required for accurate gross pay calculation in multi-state payroll.

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Dollar amount of federal income tax withheld from the workers wages for this pay period based on W-4 elections and IRS withholding tables. Required for W-2 reporting (Box 2) and federal tax deposit obligations.

attributes.name: futa_taxable_wages
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Taxable Wages
attributes.description: Portion of the workers gross wages subject to Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) employer tax for this pay period, up to the $7,000 annual wage base. Required for IRS Form 940 filing and employer burden rate reporting.

attributes.name: gross_pay
attributes.description: Total pre-deduction, pre-tax earnings for the pay period. Sum of regular_earnings, ot_earnings, dt_earnings, per_diem_amount, and any other pay components. Represents the gross-base amount in the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction. Used as the basis for all tax withholding calculations.

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Medicare (HI) tax withheld under FICA at the applicable rate (1.45%, plus 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax for high earners). Required for W-2 reporting (Box 6) and FICA deposit compliance.

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: Final take-home amount disbursed to the worker after all deductions and tax withholdings (gross_pay − total_deductions − total_tax_withheld). Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET. The amount actually paid via direct deposit, check, or pay card.

attributes.name: ot_earnings
attributes.description: Dollar amount of earnings for overtime hours (ot_hours × pay_rate × 1.5). Stored separately from regular earnings to support FLSA compliance reporting, overtime cost analytics, and client billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: ot_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked during the pay period, subject to the 1.5x pay multiplier under FLSA. Includes hours exceeding the standard weekly threshold or daily OT thresholds per applicable state law. Critical for gross pay calculation and FLSA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was or is scheduled to be disbursed to the worker. Represents the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Used for cash flow reporting, tax period assignment, and worker payment scheduling.

attributes.name: pay_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the worker. direct_deposit = ACH electronic transfer to bank account; check = physical paper check; pay_card = prepaid debit card for unbanked workers. Determines downstream disbursement routing logic.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the worker is paid, determining the pay period cadence for this stub. Drives payroll scheduling, tax withholding annualization, and benefit deduction timing. Most staffing workers are paid weekly or biweekly.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The workers base hourly or unit pay rate applied during this pay period, expressed in USD. Represents the agreed compensation rate from the placement rate card. Used to calculate regular earnings and validate gross pay. Classified confidential as worker compensation data.

attributes.name: pay_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pay rate basis for this stub. hourly = standard time-based; salary = fixed periodic amount; per_diem = daily allowance-based; piece_rate = unit-of-output based. Determines gross pay calculation method and FLSA overtime applicability.

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: Non-taxable per diem allowance paid to the worker for travel, meals, or lodging during the pay period. Sourced from approved per diem claims. Tracked separately from taxable wages for IRS accountable plan compliance and gross pay composition.

attributes.name: prenote_status
attributes.description: Status of the NACHA prenote (zero-dollar test transaction) process for this bank account. pending = prenote initiated; sent = prenote transmitted to bank; verified = bank confirmed account valid; failed = account validation failed. Governs whether live ACH disbursement is permitted.

attributes.name: pto_accrual_balance
attributes.description: Workers remaining PTO accrual balance as of this pay stubs pay period end date, expressed in hours. Snapshot value captured at time of pay run for worker statement display and leave liability reporting.

attributes.name: pto_hours_used
attributes.description: Number of PTO hours applied to this pay stub for the pay period. Represents paid leave hours that contribute to gross pay but are not worked hours. Required for PTO accrual balance management and FLSA leave tracking.

attributes.name: regular_earnings
attributes.description: Dollar amount of earnings for regular straight-time hours (regular_hours × pay_rate). Core component of gross pay. Stored as a raw earnings component to support gross-to-net audit trail and payroll reconciliation.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total straight-time hours worked by the worker during the pay period, up to the overtime threshold (typically 40 hours per week under FLSA). Sourced from approved timesheet records in Kronos Workforce Ready. Used to calculate regular earnings.

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld under FICA at the applicable rate (6.2% up to the annual wage base). Required for W-2 reporting (Box 4) and FICA tax deposit compliance.

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Dollar amount of state income tax withheld for the primary work state during this pay period. Supports multi-state payroll compliance and state W-2 / equivalent reporting. May be zero for states with no income tax.

attributes.name: stub_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this pay stub as printed on the workers pay statement (e.g., PS-2024-00045231). Used for worker inquiries, audit trails, and payroll reconciliation. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: stub_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pay stub within the payroll processing workflow. draft = in calculation; calculated = gross-to-net complete pending approval; approved = authorized for disbursement; issued = payment released to worker; voided = cancelled before disbursement; reversed = post-issuance correction applied. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS requirement.

attributes.name: suta_taxable_wages
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Taxable Wages
attributes.description: Portion of the workers gross wages subject to State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) employer tax for this pay period, up to the applicable state wage base. Required for state unemployment tax filing and workforce cost burden rate calculation.

attributes.name: tax_filing_status
attributes.description: Workers federal income tax filing status as declared on IRS Form W-4, used to determine the correct withholding amount for this pay stub. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|married_filing_jointly|married_filing_separately|head_of_household|exempt|qualifying_surviving_spouse — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Aggregate dollar amount of all pre-tax and post-tax deductions applied to this pay stub, including benefits premiums, garnishments, voluntary deductions, and advances. Represents the adjustment component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Supports gross-to-net reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Aggregate dollar amount of all federal, state, and local taxes withheld from the workers gross pay for this pay period. Includes FICA (Social Security and Medicare), federal income tax, and applicable state/local income taxes. Key component of gross-to-net calculation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this pay stub record. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Tracks corrections, reversals, and status transitions for audit compliance.

attributes.name: w2_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay stub is associated with a W-2 employee (True) versus a 1099 independent contractor (False). Drives tax withholding applicability, FICA obligations, and year-end tax form generation routing in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: NCCI or state-specific workers compensation classification code assigned to the worker for this pay period based on job duties and work location. Drives workers comp premium calculation and is required for policy compliance and audit.

attributes.name: workers_comp_premium
attributes.description: Employer-paid workers compensation insurance premium allocated to this pay stub for the pay period, calculated as (workers_comp_rate × payroll_basis). Represents a key component of the employer burden rate and total labor cost.

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay earned by the worker from the start of the calendar year through this pay stubs pay period end date. Displayed on the workers pay statement and used for W-2 wage box population, FICA wage base tracking, and annual compensation reporting.

attributes.name: ytd_net_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative net pay disbursed to the worker from the start of the calendar year through this pay stubs pay period end date. Displayed on the workers pay statement for annual earnings visibility and financial planning.

attributes.name: ytd_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all taxes withheld from the workers pay from the start of the calendar year through this pay stubs pay period end date. Displayed on the pay statement and used for W-2 Box 2/4/6 population and tax deposit reconciliation.

products.name: pay_rate
products.description: Master record defining the pay rate structure for a worker on a specific assignment or job order. Captures regular pay rate, overtime (OT) rate multiplier, double-time (DT) rate multiplier, per diem rate, shift differential rate, effective start and end dates, rate type (hourly, salary, piece-rate, daily), pay frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly), currency, rate source (negotiated, VMS-driven, standard), and approval status. Supports multi-rate scenarios for workers on multiple assignments.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker assignment this pay rate applies to. Supports multi-rate scenarios where a worker may have different rates across concurrent assignments.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: Pay rates must meet state-specific minimum wage, prevailing wage, and overtime rules. Staffing firms link rate records to the governing state compliance rule to validate rates against jurisdictional m

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.wage_hour_determination. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.work_location. Business justification: Pay rates vary by work location due to prevailing wage laws, state minimum wage, and shift differentials. pay_rate has location_id (→client.location) but placement.work_location carries workers_comp_c
