Staffing firms must link rate records to the governing classification determination for FLSA comp

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the pay rate record. Pending = awaiting manager or compliance approval; approved = active and payroll-eligible; rejected = denied; expired = past effective end date. Controls whether the rate can be used in payroll processing.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager, recruiter, or compliance officer who approved this pay rate. Provides audit trail for rate authorization in compliance with internal controls and OFCCP requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pay rate was formally approved. Part of the rate lifecycle audit trail. Required for SOC 2 Type II compliance and internal payroll controls.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The rate charged to the client for each unit of the workers time (typically per hour). Stored alongside the pay rate to enable spread and gross margin calculation. The spread (bill_rate minus regular_pay_rate) is the primary revenue metric in staffing. Sourced from the client rate card or VMS.

attributes.name: conversion_fee_waiver_date
attributes.description: Date after which the clients conversion fee obligation is waived if the worker is converted to a permanent employee. Typically tied to a minimum number of hours worked or weeks on assignment per the MSA terms. Null if no conversion fee waiver applies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pay rate record was first created in TempWorks Payroll. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for SOC 2 Type II compliance and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary rate fields are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency payroll for international staffing operations.

attributes.name: dt_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the regular pay rate to calculate the double-time (DT) pay rate. Typically 2.0x, applicable in states such as California for hours over 12 in a day or on the 7th consecutive day. Applied by TempWorks Payroll for DT hours.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this pay rate is no longer active. Nullable for open-ended rates. When populated, payroll processing after this date must use a successor rate record. Supports rate versioning and assignment extensions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this pay rate becomes active and applicable to payroll processing. Defines the beginning of the rates binding period. Payroll transactions on or after this date use this rate.

attributes.name: fica_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Exempt Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is exempt from FICA (Social Security and Medicare) withholding for this assignment. True for certain visa holders (e.g., F-1, J-1 students) or specific worker classifications. Drives TempWorks Payroll tax withholding logic.

attributes.name: flsa_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exempt Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is classified as exempt from FLSA overtime requirements (True = exempt salaried; False = non-exempt hourly). Determines whether OT and DT multipliers apply. Critical for wage and hour compliance and DOL audit defense.

attributes.name: is_blended_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay rate is a blended rate covering multiple job duties or skill levels within a single assignment. True = blended rate applies; False = single-role rate. Common in SOW engagements and multi-skill temporary placements.

attributes.name: markup_pct
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the regular pay rate to arrive at the bill rate. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45% markup). Used for pricing analysis, margin reporting, and VMS rate negotiations. Markup = (bill_rate - regular_pay_rate) / regular_pay_rate.

attributes.name: max_straight_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours per week or pay period at the regular pay rate before overtime (OT) rates apply. Typically 40 hours per week under FLSA, but may be lower per client contract or state law (e.g., California daily OT threshold). Drives OT calculation trigger in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: min_guaranteed_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours per pay period the worker is guaranteed to be paid, regardless of actual hours worked. Common in certain staffing contracts and SOW engagements. Impacts gross pay floor calculation in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: ot_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the regular pay rate to calculate the overtime (OT) pay rate. Standard FLSA minimum is 1.5x for hours over 40 per week. May be higher per client contract or state law. Applied by TempWorks Payroll for OT hours on timesheets.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the worker is paid. Determines payroll cycle alignment in TempWorks Payroll. Weekly is most common for temporary staffing; bi-weekly and semi-monthly for salaried placements.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Internal compensation band or grade classification assigned to this pay rate (e.g., G1, G2, Band A). Used for workforce analytics, compensation equity analysis, and EEOC/OFCCP reporting on pay equity across worker populations.

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily non-taxable allowance paid to the worker for meals, lodging, and incidentals when working away from their tax home. Expressed in currency per day. Must comply with IRS per diem guidelines to maintain non-taxable status. Tracked separately from regular pay for tax reporting.

attributes.name: pto_accrual_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker accrues Paid Time Off (PTO) under this pay rate configuration. Eligibility may depend on assignment duration, worker classification, or client program rules. Drives PTO accrual processing in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: pto_accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which PTO hours accrue per hour worked or per pay period, expressed in hours. For example, 0.0385 hours of PTO per hour worked equates to approximately 1 week of PTO per year. Populated only when pto_accrual_eligible = True.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this pay rate configuration within TempWorks Payroll and Beeline VMS. Used for rate card lookups and VMS-driven rate matching.

attributes.name: rate_negotiation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the rationale, context, or special conditions behind the negotiated pay rate. May include references to candidate counter-offers, market data justifications, or client-specific rate exceptions. Supports recruiter and account manager context for future rate reviews.

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: Origin of the pay rate determination. Negotiated = individually agreed with worker; vms_driven = rate set by Vendor Management System (VMS) such as Beeline; standard = internal standard rate table; client_rate_card = derived from client-specific rate card agreement.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the worker is compensated. Hourly = per hour worked; salary = fixed periodic amount; piece_rate = per unit produced; daily = per day worked. Drives gross pay calculation logic in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: regular_pay_rate
attributes.description: The base pay rate for the worker expressed in the applicable rate_type unit (e.g., dollars per hour for hourly workers, dollars per day for daily workers). This is the principal quantitative compensation fact. Used as the basis for gross pay calculation in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional pay rate amount added to the regular pay rate for workers assigned to non-standard shifts (e.g., evening, overnight, weekend). Expressed as a flat dollar amount per hour or as a percentage add-on depending on the shift_differential_type field.

attributes.name: shift_differential_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shift_differential_rate is a flat dollar amount added per hour or a percentage of the regular pay rate. Determines how TempWorks Payroll calculates the effective shift pay.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this pay rate record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and conflict resolution in the Databricks Silver Layer when rates are ingested from multiple upstream systems.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the worker performs services under this pay rate. Determines applicable SUTA rate, state income tax withholding rules, state-specific overtime laws, and workers comp jurisdiction. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance.

attributes.name: suta_state_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) State Code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code designating the state to which SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act) taxes are remitted for this worker. May differ from work state_code in multi-state scenarios or when the workers base state differs from the work location state.

attributes.name: temp_to_perm_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker under this pay rate is eligible for conversion from temporary to permanent (temp-to-perm or contract-to-hire) placement. Affects conversion fee applicability and rate renegotiation triggers upon conversion.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pay rate record was last modified. Tracks rate amendments, approval status changes, and effective date adjustments. Required for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: NCCI or state-specific workers compensation classification code associated with the job duties for this pay rate. Determines the workers comp insurance premium rate applied to the workers wages. Critical for accurate burden rate calculation and insurance compliance.

products.name: earnings_line
products.description: Transactional line-item record capturing each individual earnings component within a worker pay stub. Covers regular pay, OT pay, DT pay, holiday pay, PTO payout, bonus, commission, per diem, expense reimbursement, shift differential, and other earning types. Stores hours or units, rate applied, earning code, earning description, taxability flag, and computed gross amount. Enables granular gross pay decomposition for reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: earnings_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual earnings line item within a worker pay stub. Primary key for the earnings_line product in the payroll domain. TRANSACTION_LINE role — each record represents one earnings component (e.g., regular pay, OT, per diem) within a parent pay stub header.

attributes.name: absence_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to timesheet.absence_record. Business justification: PTO and FMLA earnings lines must trace back to the approved absence record. Linking earnings_line.absence_record_id → timesheet.absence_record enables FMLA/PTO payroll audit trails and ensures paid le

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the placement assignment under which this earnings line was generated. Links the pay line to the specific client engagement, job order, and work location context in Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Enables earnings analysis by assignment, client, and job order.

attributes.name: contract_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_rate_schedule. Business justification: Individual earnings must trace to contracted rate schedules for audit compliance and dispute resolution. Staffing operations require line-level validation that billed rates match contracted terms, esp

attributes.name: credential_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_instance. Business justification: Time-to-pay processing validates credential status at earning line level; blocks payment for specific shifts worked without valid credentials (e.g., expired nursing license). Granular compliance enfor

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Direct hire placements generate earnings (salary, bonuses, adjustments). Links payroll earnings to permanent placement for fee reconciliation, guarantee period tracking, and revenue recognition valida

attributes.name: ic_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.ic_agreement. Business justification: IC agreement's payment_structure (milestone, hourly, fixed) and form_1099_reporting_flag govern how earnings lines are coded and reported for IC workers. IRS 1099-NEC reporting requires tracing each e

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Individual earnings require traceability to the onboarding engagement that authorized the work arrangement. Essential for compliance audits verifying workers were properly onboarded before earning wag

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.order_header. Business justification: Individual earnings lines require job order context for client billing detail, markup calculation per order terms, and granular job profitability analysis. Core to staffing agency revenue and cost tra

attributes.name: original_line_earnings_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original earnings_line_id that this adjustment or correction line is reversing or modifying. Populated only when is_adjustment is True. Enables full audit trail of payroll corrections and supports prior-period adjustment reporting. Null for original (non-adjustment) earnings lines.

attributes.name: pay_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.pay_rate. Business justification: Each earnings line item is computed from a specific pay rate record (regular rate, OT multiplier, DT multiplier, per diem rate). Adding pay_rate_id to earnings_line links each gross pay component back

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll processing run that generated this earnings line. Links to the payroll batch/run record in TempWorks Payroll. Used for payroll audit trails, reprocessing identification, and reconciliation of payroll runs against approved timesheets and pay stub totals.

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent pay stub (TRANSACTION_HEADER) that this earnings line belongs to. Satisfies HEADER_REFERENCE minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role. Links the line item to the workers gross-to-net pay stub record in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: position_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.position_requirement. Business justification: For orders with multiple position requirements at different pay rates, earnings lines must trace to the specific position for position-level payroll reconciliation, prevailing wage compliance reportin

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the worker (temporary associate, contractor, or permanent employee) whose earnings this line represents. Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE minimum category. Links to the candidate/worker master record in Bullhorn ATS/CRM and SAP SuccessFactors.

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: SOW engagements generate earnings when worker is W-2 employee. Milestone or hourly SOW work creates payroll earnings that must link to engagement for billing reconciliation and cost tracking.

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: Earnings lines are computed under state-specific overtime thresholds, minimum wage floors, and prevailing wage rules. Staffing firms link earnings lines to the governing state compliance rule for stat

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to timesheet.time_entry. Business justification: Each earnings line is derived from one or more time entries. Linking earnings_line.time_entry_id → timesheet.time_entry enables payroll auditors to trace each earnings line to the specific punch recor

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved timesheet record from which this earnings line was derived. Links payroll earnings back to the source time and attendance data captured in Kronos Workforce Ready. Null for non-hour-based earnings such as bonuses or expense reimbursements.

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.training_record. Business justification: Training pay earnings lines (orientation pay, mandatory training stipends) are directly triggered by completed training records. 'Training Pay Audit: Earnings Lines by Training Record' is a real staff

attributes.name: wage_hour_determination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.wage_hour_determination. Business justification: Each earnings line must comply with overtime rules, prevailing wage requirements, and FLSA classifications. Payroll systems validate earnings against wage/hour determinations to ensure compliant OT ca

attributes.name: wc_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.wc_policy. Business justification: Each earnings line carries a workers_comp_code (STRING) identifying the NCCI class applicable to that earnings component. Adding wc_policy_id to earnings_line links each pay component to the specific

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific client work location where the worker performed services during this pay period. Used for workers compensation premium allocation by location, multi-state tax nexus determination, and client billing reconciliation. Links to the placement work location record.

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workers paycheck or direct deposit is issued. Represents the principal business event date for this earnings line. Used for tax period determination (W-2 year allocation), cash flow reporting, and worker payment confirmation. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP minimum category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this earnings line record was first created in the payroll system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED minimum category. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary amounts on this earnings line. Defaults to USD for domestic US staffing operations. Relevant for international EOR (Employer of Record) arrangements and cross-border staffing engagements. Supports multi-currency payroll processing for global staffing operations.

attributes.name: earning_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the type of earning component (e.g., REG for regular pay, OT for overtime, DT for double time, HOL for holiday, PTO for paid time off, BONUS, COMM for commission, PERDIEM, EXPREIM for expense reimbursement, SHFTDIFF for shift differential). Satisfies RESOURCE_REFERENCE minimum category as the classification key for the earning type resource. Drives tax treatment, GL account mapping, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: earning_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the earning component as it appears on the workers pay stub. Examples: Regular Hours, Overtime Pay, Holiday Pay - Labor Day, PTO Payout, Weekly Per Diem - Chicago Assignment. Provides transparency to the worker and supports payroll audit trails.

attributes.name: earning_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the earning component. Drives gross pay decomposition, tax withholding logic, and compliance reporting. Regular = straight-time wages; OT (Overtime) = FLSA-mandated 1.5x pay; DT (Double Time) = 2x pay per CBA or client agreement; PTO (Paid Time Off) = accrued leave payout; Per Diem = non-taxable daily allowance; Expense Reimbursement = accountable plan reimbursement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|overtime|double_time|holiday|pto|bonus|commission|per_diem|expense_reimbursement|shift_differential|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: FLSA overtime exemption classification for the worker on this earnings line. Non-exempt workers are entitled to OT pay at 1.5x for hours over 40/week. Exempt classifications (executive, administrative, professional, highly compensated) are not entitled to FLSA overtime. Drives overtime eligibility and compliance with DOL wage and hour regulations.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Computed gross dollar amount for this earnings line, calculated as hours_quantity multiplied by pay_rate, or as a flat amount for non-hourly earnings. Represents the workers pre-tax, pre-deduction compensation for this specific earning component. Satisfies LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role. Feeds into gross pay totals on the pay stub.

attributes.name: hours_quantity
attributes.description: Number of hours or units associated with this earnings line. For hour-based earnings (regular, OT, DT, holiday, PTO), this is the number of hours worked or paid. For unit-based earnings (piece rate, per diem days), this represents the unit count. Null for flat-amount earnings such as bonuses or expense reimbursements. Satisfies LINE_QUANTITY minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role.

attributes.name: is_adjustment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earnings line is a payroll adjustment or correction entry rather than an original earnings line. True for retroactive pay corrections, prior-period adjustments, and manual override entries. Adjustment lines may carry negative gross_amount values to reverse prior earnings. Used for payroll audit and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: is_fica_subject
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Subject Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earning component is subject to FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act) taxes, comprising Social Security (6.2%) and Medicare (1.45%) withholding. False for per diem reimbursements, expense reimbursements under accountable plans, and certain non-cash fringe benefits. Critical for accurate payroll tax calculation and IRS Form 941 filing.

attributes.name: is_overtime
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earnings line represents overtime pay as defined under FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — hours worked beyond 40 in a workweek compensated at a minimum of 1.5x the regular rate. Used for FLSA compliance reporting, overtime cost analytics, and client billing reconciliation where OT bill rates differ from straight-time rates.

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earning component is subject to federal and state income tax withholding. True for wages, OT, DT, holiday pay, bonuses, and commissions. False for qualifying per diem allowances within IRS GSA limits, accountable plan expense reimbursements, and certain fringe benefits. Drives FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and income tax withholding calculations.

attributes.name: labor_category_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the labor category or job classification for this earnings line (e.g., LIGHT_IND for light industrial, IT_PROF for IT professional, CLERICAL, HEALTHCARE). Used for workforce cost analytics, bill rate reconciliation, and compliance with prevailing wage determinations under DOL regulations. Aligns with timesheet.labor_category.

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering this earnings component within the parent pay stub. Satisfies LINE_SEQUENCE minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role. Used for display ordering on pay stubs and for deterministic processing order during gross pay calculation.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this earnings line within the payroll workflow. Pending = awaiting payroll approval; Approved = authorized for payment; Processed = included in a completed payroll run; Voided = cancelled/reversed; Adjusted = corrected via an adjustment entry. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role.

attributes.name: ot_multiplier
attributes.description: The pay rate multiplier applied to the base pay rate for premium pay earnings. Standard values: 1.0000 for regular pay, 1.5000 for OT (overtime), 2.0000 for DT (double time). May reflect CBA (collective bargaining agreement) or client-specific premium rates. Used to validate gross_amount calculation and support FLSA compliance audits.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the worker is paid, determining the pay period structure for this earnings line. Weekly is most common for temporary staffing workers. Biweekly and semimonthly are common for permanent placements. Drives payroll processing schedule in TempWorks Payroll and tax withholding table selection.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the pay period to which this earnings line applies. Defines the closing boundary of the work period being compensated. Used in conjunction with pay_period_start_date for FLSA overtime workweek calculations and state wage statement compliance.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the pay period to which this earnings line applies. Combined with pay_period_end_date, defines the work period being compensated. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance, FLSA overtime calculation, and tax period allocation.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly, daily, or unit rate applied to this earnings line to compute the gross amount. Represents the workers agreed compensation rate for this earning type (e.g., straight-time rate, OT rate at 1.5x, DT rate at 2x). Sourced from the placement rate agreement in Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Confidential as it contains worker compensation data.

attributes.name: per_diem_rate_daily
attributes.description: The daily per diem rate applied for this earnings line when earning_type is per_diem. Compared against GSA (General Services Administration) published rates to determine taxability — amounts within GSA limits are non-taxable; excess amounts are taxable wages. Null for non-per-diem earning types.

attributes.name: per_diem_type
attributes.description: Classification of per diem allowance type when earning_type is per_diem. Lodging = accommodation allowance; Meals and Incidentals (M&IE) = daily meal and incidental expense allowance; Combined = single daily rate covering both; None = not a per diem line. GSA per diem rates determine taxability thresholds. Null or none for non-per-diem earning types.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earnings line is subject to prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act, Service Contract Act, or state prevailing wage laws. True for government contract assignments requiring certified payroll reporting. Triggers additional compliance reporting obligations to DOL and OFCCP.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the work shift associated with this earnings line (e.g., DAY, EVE for evening, NIGHT, WKND for weekend). Used to apply shift differential pay rates and to reconcile earnings with Kronos Workforce Ready scheduling data. Relevant for shift_differential earning types.

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating payroll system (TempWorks Payroll) for this earnings line. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year (YYYY) to which this earnings line is attributed for W-2 or 1099 reporting purposes. Determined by the check_date. Critical for year-end tax form preparation, IRS reporting, and multi-year payroll analytics. Enables accurate W-2 box 1 (wages) and 1099-NEC box 1 (nonemployee compensation) aggregation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this earnings line record was most recently modified. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED minimum category. Tracks payroll corrections, status changes, and retroactive adjustments. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the work was performed for this earnings line. Drives state income tax withholding, SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act) employer contributions, state-specific overtime rules, and workers compensation premium allocation. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance in staffing operations where workers may be deployed across multiple states.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Tax and employment classification of the worker for this earnings line. W-2 Temp = temporary employee on agency payroll; W-2 Perm = permanent placed employee; 1099 IC (Independent Contractor) = self-employed contractor; EOR (Employer of Record) = worker employed through EOR arrangement. Determines tax withholding obligations, FICA applicability, FUTA/SUTA liability, and W-2 vs 1099 year-end tax form issuance.

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: NCCI (National Council on Compensation Insurance) workers compensation class code applicable to this earnings line. Determines the workers comp insurance premium rate applied to the gross wages. Critical for accurate workers comp cost allocation, experience modification factor calculations, and compliance with state workers compensation insurance requirements.

products.name: tax_line
products.description: Transactional record capturing all payroll tax obligations — both employee withholdings and employer-side taxes — per worker per pay stub within a pay run. Employee side: federal income tax, state income tax, local/city tax, FICA Social Security and Medicare employee shares, additional Medicare surtax, and supplemental withholdings. Employer side: FICA Social Security and Medicare employer match, FUTA, SUTA by state, and local employer taxes. Stores tax side discriminator (employee/employer), tax authority jurisdiction, tax type code, taxable wage base, tax rate applied, withholding method (percentage, flat, table-based), computed amount, YTD taxable wages, YTD amount, and multi-state jurisdiction details. SSOT for ALL payroll tax line items — both employee withholdings and employer taxes are unified in this single product with a tax_side discriminator. Critical for gross-to-net calculation, burden rate validation, multi-state payroll tax filing, and quarterly/annual tax reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for tax_line

attributes.name: original_tax_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original tax line record that this adjustment line corrects or reverses. Null for original (non-adjustment) lines. Enables audit trail linking between original and corrected tax line records.

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll processing run (batch) in which this tax line was computed. Supports reconciliation of all tax lines within a single payroll cycle.

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent pay stub (paycheck) that this tax line belongs to. Establishes the header/detail relationship between the pay stub and its individual tax line items. TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (W-2 employee or 1099 independent contractor) for whom this tax line is computed. TRANSACTION_LINE PARTY_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: Tax lines are computed under state-specific tax rules (rates, wage bases, deposit schedules, SUTA experience rates). Staffing firms link tax lines to the governing state compliance rule for state tax

attributes.name: tax_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.tax_filing. Business justification: Tax line records (individual tax obligations per pay stub) feed into aggregate tax filings (941, state quarterly filings). Adding FK tax_filing_id → tax_filing.payroll_tax_filing_id links each tax_lin

attributes.name: tax_withholding_election_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.tax_withholding_election. Business justification: Tax withholding execution (tax_line) should reference the workers tax withholding election (W-4 form data) that drove the calculation. tax_line currently has denormalized attributes filing_status, al

attributes.name: add_medicare_surtax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax line represents the Additional Medicare Tax (0.9% surtax) applicable to high-earning employees whose wages exceed the IRS threshold ($200,000 for single filers). Employer does not match this surtax.

attributes.name: adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax line is an adjustment or correction to a previously processed tax line (e.g., retroactive rate change, prior-period correction, amended return adjustment). When True, adjustment_reason should be populated.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for a tax line adjustment when adjustment_flag is True (e.g., Retroactive SUTA rate change Q1 2024, W-4 correction applied, Prior period underpayment correction).

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the paycheck or direct deposit was issued to the worker. Determines the tax deposit liability date and the calendar year to which the tax obligation is attributed for W-2 reporting purposes.

attributes.name: computed_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax dollar amount for this line in the current pay period (taxable_wage_base × tax_rate, or flat amount for flat-rate taxes). Core value used in gross-to-net calculation and payroll tax remittance. TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 Type II compliance requirements. TRANSACTION_LINE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: deposit_schedule
attributes.description: The employers IRS-assigned federal tax deposit schedule for this tax type (monthly, semi-weekly, or next-day for large deposits). Determines the tax_deposit_liability_date. State deposit schedules may differ.

attributes.name: futa_credit_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) State Credit Rate
attributes.description: The FUTA state tax credit rate (up to 5.4%) applied to reduce the gross FUTA rate of 6.0% when the employer has paid SUTA taxes in a credit-reduction state. Applies only to FUTA tax type lines.

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this tax line within the parent pay stub. Enables deterministic ordering and display of all tax line items on a pay stub. TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period to which this tax line applies. Together with pay_period_start_date, defines the exact payroll period for tax obligation accrual and filing.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period to which this tax line applies. Used for period-over-period tax reporting, quarterly filing (Form 941/940), and annual W-2 reconciliation.

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the tax remittance for this line to the applicable tax authority. Tracks whether the tax has been deposited on time, is pending, was remitted late (triggering penalty exposure), has been adjusted, or voided. TRANSACTION_LINE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from TempWorks Payroll (the system of record) for this tax line. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational payroll system.

attributes.name: suta_experience_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Experience Rate
attributes.description: The employers SUTA experience-rated tax rate for the applicable state, as assigned by the state unemployment agency based on the companys claims history. Applies only to SUTA tax type lines. Drives burden rate calculations.

attributes.name: suta_state
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) State Code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code identifying the state to which SUTA taxes are remitted for this worker. May differ from the workers work state in multi-state assignments. Applies only to SUTA tax type lines.

attributes.name: tax_authority_level
attributes.description: Level of government authority imposing this tax obligation. Supports multi-state payroll compliance and jurisdiction-level tax filing and reporting.

attributes.name: tax_deposit_liability_date
attributes.description: The date by which the employer must remit this tax to the applicable tax authority (IRS, state, or local). Determined by the employers deposit schedule (monthly or semi-weekly for federal; varies by state). Critical for avoiding late deposit penalties.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is exempt from this specific tax type (e.g., FICA exemption for certain visa holders, FUTA exemption for specific worker categories). When True, computed_amount is zero and the exemption basis should be documented.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_reason
attributes.description: Reason or basis for the tax exemption when tax_exempt_flag is True (e.g., F-1 Visa FICA Exemption, W-4 Exempt Election, Agricultural Worker FUTA Exemption). Required for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_fips
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tax Jurisdiction Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code uniquely identifying the county or county-equivalent jurisdiction for this tax line. Enables precise multi-state and local tax jurisdiction mapping and filing.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_locality
attributes.description: Name of the local taxing jurisdiction (city, county, municipality, school district) for local/city tax lines. Null for federal and state-level taxes. Supports local tax filing compliance.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code (USPS abbreviation) for the state in which this tax obligation applies. Null for federal-only taxes. Critical for multi-state payroll tax filing and SUTA rate management.

attributes.name: tax_quarter
attributes.description: Calendar quarter (1–4) in which this tax line falls, derived from the check date. Used for quarterly payroll tax filing (IRS Form 941, FUTA Form 940, and state equivalents) and quarterly reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The effective tax rate (as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.062000 for 6.2%) applied to the taxable wage base to compute the tax amount for this line. For flat-dollar taxes, this may be zero with the flat amount captured in computed_amount.

attributes.name: tax_side
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this tax line represents an employee-side withholding (deducted from worker gross pay) or an employer-side tax obligation (borne by the staffing company). Critical for gross-to-net calculation and burden rate validation. TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category (discriminator).

attributes.name: tax_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific type of tax obligation on this line (e.g., FIT, SIT, FICA_SS_EE, FICA_MED_EE, FICA_SS_ER, FICA_MED_ER, FUTA, SUTA, LOCAL, ADD_MED, SUPP). Used for tax filing, reporting, and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FIT|SIT|LOCAL|FICA_SS_EE|FICA_MED_EE|FICA_SS_ER|FICA_MED_ER|FUTA|SUTA|ADD_MED|SUPP — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tax type (e.g., Federal Income Tax, California State Income Tax, FICA Social Security Employee, Federal Unemployment Tax). Displayed on pay stubs and tax reports.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar year (e.g., 2024) to which this tax line is attributed for annual tax reporting, W-2/1099 issuance, and year-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: taxable_wage_base
attributes.description: The portion of the workers gross wages subject to this specific tax in the current pay period, after applying any applicable wage base caps (e.g., Social Security wage base, FUTA/SUTA wage base limits). TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax line record was last modified. Tracks adjustments, corrections, and status changes for audit trail and data lineage purposes. TRANSACTION_LINE RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

attributes.name: wage_base_annual_limit
attributes.description: The annual taxable wage base ceiling for this tax type (e.g., $168,600 for Social Security in 2024; $7,000 for FUTA). Once the workers YTD wages exceed this limit, no further tax is assessed for this tax type in the calendar year.

attributes.name: wage_base_cap_reached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has reached the annual taxable wage base ceiling for this tax type in the current calendar year. When True, no further tax is assessed for this tax type until the next calendar year reset.

attributes.name: withholding_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax withholding for this line: percentage of taxable wages, flat dollar amount, IRS tax table lookup, supplemental flat rate, or exempt (no withholding). Drives the calculation logic applied in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: worker_tax_form_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is classified as a W-2 employee (subject to withholding) or a 1099 independent contractor (IC) for this tax line. Drives which tax obligations apply and which annual tax form is issued. Aligns with IRS worker classification rules.

attributes.name: ytd_tax_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative tax amount withheld or assessed for this worker under this tax type from the start of the calendar year through and including this pay period. Critical for quarterly (941/940) and annual (W-2/1099) tax reconciliation and filing.

attributes.name: ytd_taxable_wages
attributes.description: Cumulative taxable wages for this worker under this tax type from the start of the calendar year through and including this pay period. Used to enforce annual wage base limits and for W-2/1099 annual reconciliation.

products.name: deduction_line
products.description: Transactional line-item record for each voluntary or involuntary deduction applied to a worker pay stub, serving as the SSOT for all payroll deductions including benefit enrollment-driven withholdings. For benefit-type deductions: stores benefit plan name, plan type (medical, dental, vision, 401k, FSA, HSA, life, supplemental), coverage tier (employee only, employee+spouse, family), employee premium contribution, employer contribution, benefit carrier, enrollment effective and termination dates, and enrollment status. For garnishment-type deductions: references the governing garnishment order. For all deductions: stores deduction code, deduction type (pre-tax, post-tax, benefit, garnishment), deduction amount, deduction frequency, YTD deduction total, court order reference for garnishments, and deduction status (active, suspended, terminated). Consolidates benefit enrollment tracking with deduction processing — enrollment attributes drive premium withholding calculations each pay period.

attributes.name: deduction_line_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each deduction line item on a worker pay stub. Primary key for the deduction_line product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_LINE — represents one deduction item within a payroll check/pay stub header.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.assignment. Business justification: Garnishments and benefit deductions are applied in the context of a specific assignment. Assignment-level deduction audit reports and garnishment compliance (CCPA limits per assignment income) require

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to timesheet.pay_period. Business justification: deduction_line has pay_period_start_date/end_date as plain columns with no FK to the authoritative pay_period. Linking deduction_line.pay_period_id → timesheet.pay_period normalizes period reference f

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll processing run batch in which this deduction line was calculated and applied. Enables traceability of deductions back to a specific payroll cycle execution.

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payroll check (pay stub) to which this deduction line belongs. TRANSACTION_LINE role: HEADER_REFERENCE — links this line to its parent payroll transaction header.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (employee, temporary associate, or contractor) whose pay is being reduced by this deduction. Supports multi-worker payroll processing across W-2 and 1099 classifications.

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: Deduction permissibility varies by state (prohibited deductions, garnishment rules, benefit mandate requirements). Staffing firms link deduction lines to the governing state compliance rule for state

attributes.name: annual_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that may be withheld for this deduction type in a calendar year, as set by IRS regulations or plan rules (e.g., IRS 401k elective deferral limit, FSA annual contribution cap, HSA annual contribution limit). Used to automatically stop withholding once the limit is reached. Null for deductions with no annual cap.

attributes.name: arrears_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of deduction that was missed in a prior pay period and is being carried forward for collection in a subsequent period. Common for garnishments when disposable earnings were insufficient to cover the full order amount, or for benefit premiums missed during a leave of absence. Zero if no arrears exist.

attributes.name: benefit_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or financial institution administering the benefit plan associated with this deduction (e.g., Aetna, MetLife, Fidelity Investments, WageWorks). Used for carrier remittance reconciliation and benefits vendor management. Null for non-benefit deductions.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the worker in the benefit plan driving this deduction. Determines whether premium withholding should be active. COBRA status indicates the worker is continuing coverage under COBRA after employment separation. Null for non-benefit deductions.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_name
attributes.description: Name of the employer-sponsored benefit plan associated with this deduction (e.g., Aetna PPO Gold, Delta Dental Premier, VSP Vision Basic, Fidelity 401k Plan). Populated only for benefit-type deductions. Sourced from the benefit enrollment record and used for benefits administration reporting and carrier remittance.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the benefit plan type driving this deduction. Used to categorize benefit deductions for ACA reporting, W-2 Box 12 coding, and benefits analytics. Null for non-benefit deductions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|401k|roth_401k|fsa|hsa|life|supplemental — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the paycheck containing this deduction was issued to the worker. Represents the actual payment date used for tax deposit timing, W-2 year assignment, and garnishment remittance deadlines. TRANSACTION_LINE role: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision).

attributes.name: court_order_number
attributes.description: Official court case number or agency order reference for garnishment-type deductions (child support, tax levy, creditor garnishment). Required for legal compliance and remittance to the issuing court or agency. Null for non-garnishment deductions.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The coverage tier elected by the worker for this benefit plan, which determines the premium amount withheld. Applicable to medical, dental, and vision benefit deductions. Values: employee_only (single coverage), employee_spouse (worker plus spouse/domestic partner), employee_children (worker plus dependents), family (worker plus all dependents). Null for non-benefit deductions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deduction line record was first created in the source payroll system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the deduction amount (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency payroll processing for international staffing operations and EOR (Employer of Record) arrangements.

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount withheld from the workers gross pay for this deduction line in the current pay period. For benefit deductions, represents the employee premium contribution. For garnishments, represents the court-ordered withholding amount. TRANSACTION_LINE role: LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT — the principal monetary fact for this line.

attributes.name: deduction_category
attributes.description: Granular business category of the deduction used for benefits administration reporting, compliance, and analytics. Distinguishes benefit plan types (medical, dental, vision, 401k, FSA, HSA, life, supplemental) from garnishment subtypes (child_support, tax_levy, creditor_garnishment, student_loan) and other voluntary deductions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|401k|roth_401k|fsa|hsa|life|supplemental|child_support|tax_levy|creditor_garnishment|student_loan|uniform|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deduction_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the specific deduction type as configured in the payroll system (e.g., MED01, DENT01, 401K, GARNCS, UNIFEE). Maps to the deduction setup table in TempWorks Payroll and drives calculation rules, GL account mapping, and tax treatment.

attributes.name: deduction_frequency
attributes.description: How often this deduction is applied to the workers paycheck. Drives whether the deduction is taken every pay period or on a specific schedule (e.g., some benefit premiums are taken only on first and third paycheck of the month for semimonthly payroll). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per_pay_period|weekly|biweekly|semimonthly|monthly|quarterly|annual|one_time — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deduction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the deduction as it appears on the workers pay stub (e.g., Medical Insurance - Employee, Child Support Garnishment, 401(k) Contribution). Sourced from the deduction code setup in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: deduction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this deduction line: active (currently being withheld), suspended (temporarily halted, e.g., worker on leave), terminated (permanently stopped, e.g., benefit cancelled or garnishment satisfied), pending (set up but not yet effective), waived (worker or employer elected to waive for this period). TRANSACTION_LINE role: maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS of the deduction arrangement.

attributes.name: deduction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deduction by tax treatment and origin: pre_tax (reduces taxable gross, e.g., 401k, FSA, HSA, Section 125 benefits), post_tax (applied after tax calculation, e.g., Roth 401k, after-tax life insurance), benefit (employer-sponsored benefit premium withholding), garnishment (court-ordered or agency-mandated wage withholding), voluntary (worker-elected non-benefit deduction). Drives gross-to-net calculation sequencing.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this deduction arrangement became active for the worker. For benefit deductions, aligns with the benefit enrollment effective date. For garnishments, aligns with the court order service date. Determines when withholding begins.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount contributed by the employer toward this benefit deduction in the current pay period (e.g., employer share of medical premium, employer 401k match). Applicable only to benefit-type deductions. Zero or null for garnishments and purely employee-funded deductions. Used in total compensation reporting and burden rate calculations.

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the workers benefit enrollment became effective, triggering the start of premium withholding for this deduction. May differ from the deduction effective_date if there is a retroactive enrollment adjustment. Null for non-benefit deductions.

attributes.name: enrollment_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the workers benefit enrollment ended, triggering cessation of premium withholding. Populated when a worker loses eligibility, voluntarily cancels coverage, or separates from employment. Null if enrollment is ongoing. Null for non-benefit deductions.

attributes.name: garnishment_issuing_agency
attributes.description: Name of the court, government agency, or child support enforcement agency that issued the garnishment order (e.g., Cook County Circuit Court, IRS, Illinois DCSS). Used for remittance routing and compliance documentation. Null for non-garnishment deductions.

attributes.name: garnishment_remittance_date
attributes.description: Date by which the withheld garnishment amount must be remitted to the issuing court or agency. Derived from the court order terms and state-specific remittance deadlines. Null for non-garnishment deductions.

attributes.name: is_arrears_recovery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deduction line represents a recovery of a previously missed (arrears) deduction amount rather than a standard current-period deduction. True when the deduction_amount includes or consists entirely of arrears recovery. Used to distinguish regular deductions from catch-up withholdings in payroll analytics.

attributes.name: is_fica_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act) Exempt Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deduction amount is exempt from FICA (Social Security and Medicare) taxes. True for qualified Section 125 benefit deductions and HSA employer contributions. False for most other deductions. Drives FICA taxable wage base calculation in payroll processing.

attributes.name: is_pretax
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deduction reduces the workers taxable gross wages before FICA, federal income tax, and applicable state income tax are calculated. True for Section 125 cafeteria plan deductions (medical, dental, vision, FSA), traditional 401k contributions, and HSA contributions. False for post-tax deductions such as Roth 401k and after-tax life insurance. Critical for accurate gross-to-net payroll calculation.

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this deduction line within the parent paycheck. Enables ordered display of deductions on pay stubs and supports reconciliation of multiple deductions per pay period. TRANSACTION_LINE role: LINE_SEQUENCE.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this deduction line record originated. Primarily TempWorks Payroll for payroll-processed deductions, SAP SuccessFactors for benefit enrollment-driven deductions, or manual for corrections entered directly. Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this deduction arrangement was or is scheduled to be permanently stopped. For benefit deductions, aligns with benefit enrollment termination or coverage end date. For garnishments, the date the order is satisfied or released. Null if the deduction is ongoing with no defined end.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deduction line record was last modified in the source payroll system (e.g., amount correction, status change, suspension). Supports change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: w2_box_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement) Box Code
attributes.description: IRS W-2 form box code under which this deduction amount must be reported at year-end (e.g., D for 401k elective deferrals, W for HSA employer contributions, DD for employer-sponsored health coverage cost). Drives W-2 generation in TempWorks Payroll. Null for deductions not reportable on W-2.

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code for the state in which the worker performed services during this pay period. Determines applicable state income tax withholding rules, state-specific garnishment limits, SUTA taxability, and state benefit deduction regulations. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance.

attributes.name: ytd_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of this deduction withheld from the workers pay from the start of the calendar year through and including the current pay period. Used for W-2 reporting, IRS annual contribution limit enforcement (e.g., 401k IRS limit, FSA/HSA annual caps), and year-end tax reconciliation.

products.name: burden_rate
products.description: Master record defining the employer burden rate structure applied to worker pay for cost modeling, spread calculation, and client billing markup in staffing operations. Captures burden components including FICA employer share percentage, FUTA rate, SUTA rate by state, workers compensation (WC) rate by NCCI class code (with state-specific overrides, class description, hazard category, and base rate per $100 of payroll), general liability rate, benefits load percentage, overhead percentage, and total burden percentage. Stores effective dates, state jurisdiction, WC policy reference, client or assignment applicability, and rate source (manual, system-calculated, carrier-provided). Used to compute total employer cost per worker hour, validate bill rate margins, and support spread analysis for staffing profitability reporting.

attributes.name: burden_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the burden rate record. Primary key for the burden_rate data product in the payroll domain.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which this burden rate is specifically configured, when applicability_scope is client_specific. Null for enterprise-wide or assignment-specific rates. Links to the client account master in the CRM.

attributes.name: contract_msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: Burden rates (FICA, SUTA, workers comp) are negotiated in MSAs and determine employer cost structure. Staffing firms must link burden to MSA for accurate gross margin calculation, client billing, and

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_package. Business justification: Burden rates in staffing are differentiated by credential package — healthcare credential packages carry different WC rates, liability loads, and compliance costs than light industrial. 'Burden Rate A

attributes.name: job_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.job_category. Business justification: Burden rates (SUTA, WC, FICA) vary materially by job category (e.g., construction vs. clerical). Staffing firms maintain category-specific burden rate tables for accurate cost modeling and bid pricing

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Workers comp rates, SUTA rates, and employer burden vary significantly by work location and state jurisdiction. Required for accurate cost modeling, pricing, and margin analysis by client location in
