Dispute resolution teams must validate the contested bill rate against the applicabl

attributes.name: worker_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.worker_classification. Business justification: Invoice disputes frequently arise from worker classification disagreements (client disputes IC vs W2 billing rates, markup applicability). Dispute resolution requires referencing the official classifi

attributes.name: agreed_bill_rate
attributes.description: The contractually agreed bill rate per the client rate card, MSA, or VMS program at the time of the disputed invoice. Used to calculate the rate variance driving the dispute and to validate the correct rate for invoice adjustment.

attributes.name: approved_credit_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount approved for credit or adjustment as the outcome of dispute resolution. May be equal to, less than, or zero relative to the disputed_amount depending on resolution type. Feeds credit memo generation in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: approved_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the client acknowledges as correctly approved and billable, as determined during dispute investigation. Used to calculate the hours variance and determine the correct invoice adjustment amount.

attributes.name: bill_rate_disputed
attributes.description: The bill rate (hourly or per-diem) that the client is contesting as incorrect on the disputed invoice. Captured specifically for rate_discrepancy dispute types to enable direct comparison against the agreed rate on the client rate card or MSA.

attributes.name: billing_model
attributes.description: The billing model under which the disputed charge was generated. Determines the applicable rate structure and dispute resolution approach. Hourly applies to time-and-materials temp staffing; per_diem applies to daily rate assignments; project applies to milestone-based billing; sow applies to Statement of Work engagements; direct_placement applies to permanent placement fee billing.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the client submitted the dispute. VMS portal disputes originate from Beeline or similar vendor management systems; client portal disputes come through the staffing firms self-service portal; written notice includes formal letters or legal correspondence.

attributes.name: collections_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disputed invoice or invoice line has been placed on collections hold pending dispute resolution. True prevents collections activity on the disputed amount; False allows normal collections processing to proceed.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the credit memo issued in Oracle NetSuite ERP as the financial resolution of the dispute. Populated only when resolution_type is credit_issued or partial_credit. Links the dispute outcome to the accounts receivable credit transaction.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this dispute record (disputed_amount, approved_credit_amount). Supports multi-currency client billing for international staffing engagements.

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature of the billing dispute as submitted by the client or captured by the billing operations team. Provides context beyond the structured dispute_type classification for investigation and resolution purposes.

attributes.name: dispute_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the dispute, used in client communications, collections correspondence, and dispute tracking. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud case numbering.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the dispute through its resolution lifecycle. Drives collections hold logic — invoices with open or under_review disputes are typically placed on collections hold pending resolution.

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the billing dispute. Rate discrepancy indicates bill rate vs. agreed rate mismatch; hours mismatch indicates timesheet vs. billed hours variance; unauthorized charge indicates a charge not covered by the MSA or SOW; duplicate invoice indicates the same charge was billed twice; worker eligibility indicates the worker did not meet client-specified credential or compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_discrepancy|hours_mismatch|unauthorized_charge|duplicate_invoice|worker_eligibility|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The gross dollar amount the client is contesting on the invoice or invoice line. Represents the full value under dispute before any partial credit or adjustment is determined. Used in accounts receivable aging and collections hold logic.

attributes.name: disputed_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the client is contesting as incorrectly billed. Captured specifically for hours_mismatch dispute types to enable reconciliation against approved timesheet records in Kronos Workforce Ready.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dispute was escalated to a higher resolution tier. Null when escalation_flag is False. Used to measure escalation response time and SLA compliance at the escalated tier.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute has been formally escalated to senior management or a specialized resolution team due to complexity, high value, or SLA breach. True when escalated; False when being handled at standard tier.

attributes.name: invoice_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by the disputed invoice. Used alongside invoice_period_start to define the exact work period under dispute for timesheet reconciliation and billing audit purposes.

attributes.name: invoice_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by the disputed invoice. Provides temporal context for the dispute, enabling correlation with timesheet records, placement assignments, and pay period data.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dispute record was most recently modified, including status changes, amount adjustments, or resolution updates. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the client formally raised the billing dispute. Used as the start point for SLA measurement, aging calculations, and dispute-to-resolution cycle time reporting.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the dispute, typically based on disputed amount, client tier, or SLA requirements. Drives resolution queue ordering and escalation thresholds within the billing operations workflow.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the dispute was first captured in the system of record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED anchor for SLA tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the dispute was formally resolved and closed. Used to calculate dispute cycle time (open_date to resolution_date) and to measure SLA compliance for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the investigation findings, resolution rationale, and any client communication outcomes. Captured by the resolution owner upon closing the dispute. Supports audit trail and process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The outcome category of the dispute resolution. Credit issued means a credit memo was generated; invoice adjusted means the original invoice was corrected; dispute rejected means the client claim was denied; partial credit means a portion of the disputed amount was credited; write_off means the amount was written off to bad debt.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorization of the underlying cause of the billing dispute after investigation. Used for process improvement analytics, identifying systemic billing errors, and reducing future dispute rates. Billing error indicates internal invoicing mistake; timesheet error indicates incorrect hours submitted; rate setup error indicates incorrect bill rate configured in the system; worker compliance indicates the worker did not meet eligibility requirements; system error indicates a technical processing failure; client error indicates the dispute was raised in error by the client.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute resolution exceeded the sla_target_days threshold. True when the dispute remained unresolved beyond the SLA target; False when resolved within the target. Drives SLA compliance reporting and client relationship management alerts.

attributes.name: sla_target_days
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally defined target number of calendar days within which the dispute must be resolved, per the client SLA or internal KPI standard. Used to calculate SLA compliance and flag at-risk disputes.

products.name: collection_activity
products.description: Operational record of collections actions taken against past-due client billing accounts. Captures activity date, type (phone call, email, demand letter, escalation, legal referral, payment plan setup, write-off recommendation), collector, client contact, outcome (promise to pay, dispute raised, payment received, no response, escalated, payment plan agreed), follow-up date, notes, and associated invoice references. Drives the collections workflow, DSO reduction efforts, and aging bucket management.

attributes.name: collection_activity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collection activity record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific client contact person reached during the collection activity. Tracks which decision-maker or accounts payable contact was engaged.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the credit memo issued as a result of this collection activity, if applicable. Links collection outcome to financial adjustment.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice associated with this collection activity. Links to the primary invoice being pursued for payment.

attributes.name: activity_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collection activity was performed. Used for tracking collections timeline and aging analysis.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The type of collection action taken. Categorizes the nature of the collection effort for workflow management and effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: The accounts receivable aging category of the invoice at the time of the collection activity. Used for prioritization and DSO analysis.

attributes.name: collection_activity_status
attributes.description: The current status of the collection activity record. Tracks whether the activity is complete or requires further action.

attributes.name: contact_email_address
attributes.description: The email address used to reach the client contact during this activity, if applicable. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_method
attributes.description: The communication channel used for the collection activity. Distinct from activity_type; tracks the medium of contact for effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: contact_phone_number
attributes.description: The phone number used to reach the client contact during this activity, if applicable. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this collection activity record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: credit_memo_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit memo was issued as a result of this collection activity, typically due to a validated dispute. Impacts revenue recognition and accounts receivable.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the client for disputing the invoice, if a dispute was raised. Enables dispute categorization and root cause analysis for billing quality improvement.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: The duration of the collection activity in minutes, particularly for phone calls or in-person meetings. Used for resource allocation and efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The escalation tier to which the collection activity has been elevated. Tracks progression through collections workflow from initial contact through legal action or write-off recommendation.

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next collection action or follow-up. Drives collections workflow and ensures timely pursuit of outstanding receivables.

attributes.name: legal_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this activity involved or resulted in legal action or referral to legal counsel. Critical for compliance and risk management tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this collection activity record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the details of the collection activity, including conversation summary, client responses, objections raised, and any commitments made. Provides audit trail and context for future actions.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The result of the collection activity. Drives next-action workflow and measures collection effectiveness. Critical for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) reduction tracking.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The total amount outstanding on the invoice at the time of the collection activity. Provides context for collection priority and effort allocation.

attributes.name: payment_received_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of payment received as a direct result of this collection activity, if applicable. Links collection effort to revenue realization.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date payment was received as a result of this collection activity, if applicable. Used for measuring time-to-payment and collection effectiveness.

attributes.name: promise_to_pay_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount the client committed to pay, if a promise to pay was obtained. May be partial or full invoice amount.

attributes.name: promise_to_pay_date
attributes.description: The date the client committed to making payment, if a promise to pay was obtained. Used for follow-up scheduling and commitment tracking.

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: The business justification for recommending write-off, if applicable. Supports bad debt analysis and collections process improvement.

attributes.name: write_off_recommended_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collector recommended writing off the outstanding balance as uncollectible. Triggers approval workflow and financial reporting.

SSOT for client billing identity and payment terms within the billing domain.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the client entity to which invoices are issued. Reflects the billing entity name as it appears on invoices and AR records. May differ from the CRM client profile name if the billing entity is a subsidiary or parent.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable billing account number assigned to the clients financial billing entity. Used on invoices, statements, and AR correspondence. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud or Oracle NetSuite ERP customer record.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing account. Controls whether new invoices can be generated and whether payments are being accepted. on_hold indicates a credit or collections hold. suspended indicates a temporary freeze pending resolution.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account by the nature of the client engagement model. Drives billing rules, markup structures, and invoice formats. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_client|msp_program|vms_program|peo_client|eor_client|rpo_client — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the billing entity. Used on invoice headers, statements, and AR correspondence. Must match the legal billing address on the Master Service Agreement (MSA).

attributes.name: billing_address_line2

attributes.name: billing_city

attributes.name: billing_country_code

attributes.name: billing_cycle

attributes.name: billing_model
attributes.description: Primary billing model applied to this account. Determines how invoices are calculated and structured. time_and_materials is standard for temporary staffing (hourly bill rate × hours). sow_based applies to Statement of Work (SOW) engagements. direct_placement_fee applies to permanent placement.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the billing entitys legal billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction lookup and invoice address formatting.

attributes.name: billing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the billing entitys legal billing address. Drives state tax applicability, SUTA jurisdiction, and invoice compliance requirements.

attributes.name: consolidated_invoicing
attributes.description: Indicates whether multiple job orders or work locations should be consolidated into a single invoice per billing cycle, rather than generating separate invoices per placement or location. Common for enterprise MSP clients.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing account record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation event. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding AR balance (in account currency) that Staffing Hr will extend to this billing account before requiring payment or placing the account on hold. Enforced during invoice generation and placement approval workflows.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit standing of the billing account as assessed by the AR/credit team. Determines whether new placements and invoices can be extended to this client. probationary indicates reduced credit terms are in effect.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which invoices are denominated and payments are received for this billing account (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Drives multi-currency AR processing and FX conversion in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the client must pay to qualify for the early payment discount percentage. For example, 10 in a 2/10 Net 30 arrangement. Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered to the client if payment is received within the early payment discount window (e.g., 0.0200 = 2% discount). Supports 2/10 Net 30 and similar early payment incentive structures common in staffing billing.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing account became active and eligible to receive invoices. Marks the start of the billing relationship with this client entity. Used for AR aging calculations and contract alignment.

attributes.name: external_customer_code
attributes.description: The clients own internal account or vendor number assigned to Staffing Hr within the clients ERP or VMS system (e.g., Beeline VMS supplier ID, client SAP vendor number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and remittance matching.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Oracle NetSuite ERP General Ledger (GL) account code to which AR transactions for this billing account are posted. Ensures correct revenue and receivables classification in the financial statements.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred method by which invoices are delivered to the clients AR department. vms_portal indicates delivery through the clients Vendor Management System (VMS) such as Beeline. edi indicates Electronic Data Interchange transmission.

attributes.name: invoice_format
attributes.description: Format template used when generating invoices for this billing account. detailed includes line-level timesheet and worker detail. summary provides consolidated totals only. custom indicates a client-specific format defined in the MSA.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the billing account record. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: late_fee_pct
attributes.description: Monthly percentage fee applied to overdue invoice balances beyond the payment terms net days. For example, 0.0150 = 1.5% per month. Defined in the Master Service Agreement (MSA). Null if no late fee applies.

attributes.name: netsuite_customer_code
attributes.description: Oracle NetSuite ERP internal customer record identifier for this billing account. Used for GL posting, AR sub-ledger reconciliation, and revenue recognition alignment between the billing domain and the ERP general ledger.

attributes.name: payment_terms_net_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from invoice date within which the client is contractually obligated to remit payment (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, Net 60). Drives AR aging buckets, dunning schedules, and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: preferred_payment_method
attributes.description: Clients preferred method for remitting payment against invoices. ach (Automated Clearing House) is most common for enterprise staffing clients. vms_payment indicates payment processed through the clients VMS platform.

attributes.name: purchase_order_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid Purchase Order (PO) number must be present on all invoices issued to this billing account. When True, invoices without a PO number will be rejected by the clients AP department.

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.description: Salesforce Revenue Cloud account record identifier linked to this billing account. Enables traceability between the billing domain SSOT and the upstream CRM/revenue system for invoice generation and client financial management.

attributes.name: tax_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the billing account holds a valid tax exemption certificate, meaning sales tax or applicable taxes should not be applied to invoices. When True, tax_exempt_certificate_number must be populated.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number of the clients tax exemption documentation. Required when tax_exempt is True. Used to substantiate tax-exempt invoice treatment during audits and state tax authority reviews.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) of the billing entity. Required for IRS 1099 reporting, tax exemption validation, and invoice compliance. Format: XX-XXXXXXX (EIN format).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts. Once set, no new invoices should be generated against this account. Supports AR close-out and final billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: vms_billing_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Billing Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing account is managed through a clients Vendor Management System (VMS) such as Beeline, requiring invoice submission and payment processing through the VMS portal rather than direct billing.

products.name: placement_fee
products.description: Transactional record for direct placement and permanent hire fee billing. Captures fee type (direct placement, temp-to-perm conversion, RPO fee, retained search), fee amount, fee percentage of first-year salary, guarantee period (fall-off window in days), fall-off date, replacement eligibility, invoiced amount, invoice reference, payment status, and associated job order and candidate references. SSOT for permanent placement revenue, distinct from time-and-materials billing. Supports fall-off tracking and guarantee period management critical to direct hire operations.
products.reference: Placement Fee / Direct Hire Fee / Conversion Fee

attributes.name: placement_fee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the placement fee record. Primary key for the billing.placement_fee data product. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — represents a discrete direct placement or permanent hire fee billing event with its own lifecycle.

attributes.name: bgc_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.bgc_order. Business justification: Direct hire placement fees are contingent on BGC clearance — the fee is only billable once the background check passes. Staffing firms track 'fee contingency on BGC' as a named billing hold process; t

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that is being billed for the direct placement or permanent hire fee. The primary counterparty (PARTY_REFERENCE) for this billing transaction. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM client record.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_contact. Business justification: Direct hire placement fees are negotiated and authorized by a specific client contact (hiring manager or HR director). Linking placement_fee to client_contact enables fee authorization tracking, dispu

attributes.name: contract_msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: Direct placement fees governed by MSA conversion fee percentages and guarantee periods. Essential for fee calculation, guarantee tracking, and MSA compliance in perm placement billing.

attributes.name: contract_sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Placement fees tied to SOW headcount commitments and project staffing targets. Required for SOW fulfillment tracking, fee calculation against SOW terms, and project-based perm placement billing.

attributes.name: conversion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.conversion. Business justification: Temp-to-perm conversions generate conversion fees (contractual fee when temp converts to permanent). Placement_fee tracks conversion fee invoicing, payment terms, and guarantee periods. Essential for

attributes.name: credential_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_instance. Business justification: Placement fee revenue recognition in credentialed staffing (healthcare, legal, IT) is contingent on verified credential status. AR teams run 'fee clearance' reports confirming the candidate's credenti

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Direct hire placements generate placement fees (core revenue for perm placement business). Placement_fee tracks fee invoicing, payment, guarantee period, and fall-off credits. Essential for direct hir

attributes.name: hiring_decision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.hiring_decision. Business justification: Direct placement fees are triggered by hiring decisions (offer accepted). Links fee calculation, guarantee period tracking, and revenue recognition to the specific hiring event. No existing column fit

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice record in the billing system under which this placement fee was billed to the client. Supports accounts receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.offer. Business justification: Placement fees originate from accepted offers; fee audits trace back to the original offer terms (salary, fee percentage, start date). Staffing billing teams require this link to validate fee calculat

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Direct placement fees are contingent on successful onboarding through guarantee period. Critical for revenue recognition (cant recognize until onboarding complete), guarantee tracking (fall-off durin

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (requisition) that originated the placement for which this fee is being billed. Links fee revenue to the originating client requirement.

attributes.name: primary_replacement_placement_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the replacement placement record created when a fall-off occurs and the client exercises their guarantee replacement right. Links the original fee record to the replacement placement for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate who was placed in the direct hire or permanent position for which this fee is being charged. Links to the candidate profile in the ATS.

attributes.name: rate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.rate_agreement. Business justification: Direct hire placement fees are governed by vendor rate agreements specifying conversion fee percentages. Fee compliance audits and revenue recognition require knowing which rate agreement authorized t

attributes.name: recruiter_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.recruiter_assignment. Business justification: Placement fees must reference recruiter assignments to calculate split fees, determine commission eligibility, and track recruiter performance. Essential for commission payout and split fee allocation

attributes.name: right_to_represent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to candidate.right_to_represent. Business justification: Placement fee legitimacy audit requires confirming an active right-to-represent agreement existed at time of placement. Staffing compliance and finance teams must verify RTR before approving or disput

attributes.name: submittal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.submittal. Business justification: Direct-hire and temp-to-perm placement fee calculation, fall-off tracking, and guarantee period management require tracing the fee to the originating submittal. Staffing billing analysts routinely aud

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Direct placement fees are often paid to recruiting suppliers/agencies; tracking supplier enables fee reconciliation, supplier ROI analysis, accounts payable matching, and evaluation of supplier effect

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: Placement fees paid to or from suppliers are governed by vendor agreements (fee_schedule_type, conversion_fee terms). Fee compliance validation and split-fee arrangements require linking placement_fee

attributes.name: work_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.work_authorization. Business justification: Placement fees for visa-sponsored or work-authorized candidates are contingent on valid work authorization status. International staffing firms track 'work authorization clearance' as a fee release ga

attributes.name: worker_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.worker_classification. Business justification: Placement fee structure and eligibility depend on worker classification (direct hire fees vs contract-to-hire, W2 conversion fees). Fee calculation logic and guarantee terms require classification dat

attributes.name: candidate_annual_salary
attributes.description: The candidates agreed first-year annual base salary for the placed position, used as the basis for percentage-based fee calculations. Expressed in the billing currency. Sourced from the placement record in Bullhorn ATS/CRM.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The organizational cost center or profit center code to which this placement fee revenue is attributed. Supports divisional P&L reporting and recruiter/branch performance analytics in Oracle NetSuite ERP and Power BI.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the placement fee record was first created in the system. Audit trail field sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud or Oracle NetSuite ERP record creation event.

attributes.name: credit_memo_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the credit memo issued to the client, representing the fee amount credited back due to a fall-off within the guarantee period or a billing dispute resolution. Expressed as a positive value; applied as a reduction to the clients AR balance.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: The reference number of any credit memo issued to the client as a result of a fall-off, fee dispute, or negotiated adjustment. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud or Oracle NetSuite ERP. Null if no credit memo was issued.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this placement fee record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing for international staffing operations.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the client disputed the placement fee invoice. Captured during dispute intake in Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Used for dispute pattern analysis and client relationship management.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any billing dispute raised by the client against this placement fee invoice. Tracks the dispute lifecycle from initial client challenge through resolution. Drives collections hold and escalation workflows.

attributes.name: fall_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the placed candidate left or was terminated from the clients position within the guarantee period, triggering a fall-off event. Null if no fall-off occurred. A fall-off within the guarantee period may require fee reversal, credit memo issuance, or replacement candidate sourcing.

attributes.name: fall_off_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the placed candidate left the position within the guarantee period. Used for fall-off rate analytics, recruiter performance tracking, and quality-of-submission (QoS) reporting. Null if no fall-off occurred.

attributes.name: fee_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any negotiated discount, credit memo, or adjustment applied to the gross fee amount. Negative values represent discounts or credits. Supports scenarios such as volume discounts, client concessions, or partial credit for guarantee period replacements.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The gross calculated placement fee amount billed to the client before any adjustments, credits, or discounts. For percentage-based fees, this equals candidate_annual_salary multiplied by fee_percentage. For flat fees, this is the agreed fixed amount. Primary revenue figure for direct placement billing.

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the placement fee is calculated as a percentage of the candidates first-year annual salary, a flat fixed fee amount, or a hybrid of both. Drives fee calculation logic in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: fee_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the placement fee was earned, typically aligned to the candidates confirmed start date or the date the direct placement was finalized and accepted by the client. Used as the revenue recognition date.

attributes.name: fee_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the placement fee transaction, used in client communications, invoices, and reconciliation. Format: PF-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud opportunity/order object.

attributes.name: fee_percentage
attributes.description: The agreed-upon percentage of the candidates first-year annual salary used to calculate the placement fee when fee_basis is percentage_of_salary or hybrid. Typically ranges from 15% to 30% for direct placement. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 20.00 = 20%). Sourced from the client rate card or MSA.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the placement fee by the nature of the engagement model. Direct Placement: one-time fee for permanent hire. Temp-to-Perm: conversion fee when a temporary worker converts to permanent. RPO Fee: fee under a Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) engagement. Retained Search: upfront retainer-based executive search fee. Contingency Search: fee paid only upon successful placement.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code in Oracle NetSuite ERP to which this placement fee revenue is posted. Used for financial reporting, revenue categorization by fee type, and P&L attribution.

attributes.name: guarantee_end_date
attributes.description: The calculated date on which the guarantee period expires, derived from the candidates start date plus guarantee_period_days. After this date, the placement fee is fully earned with no replacement obligation. Used for fall-off risk monitoring and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: guarantee_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days from the candidates start date during which the staffing firm guarantees the placement. If the candidate leaves or is terminated within this window (fall-off), the client is entitled to a replacement or fee credit. Industry standard ranges from 30 to 90 days. Critical to direct hire operations and fall-off risk management.

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: The net amount actually invoiced to the client after applying any adjustments (fee_amount + fee_adjustment_amount). This is the amount reflected on the client invoice and tracked in accounts receivable. Supports revenue recognition and AR aging reporting.

attributes.name: is_fall_off
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this placement experienced a fall-off event within the guarantee period. True when fall_off_date is populated and falls within the guarantee window. Drives fall-off rate KPI calculations and revenue reversal workflows.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: The total amount received from the client against this placement fee invoice. May be less than invoiced_amount if partially paid or disputed. Used for AR reconciliation and cash application in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the client must remit payment for the placement fee invoice, calculated from invoice_date based on the agreed payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 45). Drives collections and overdue status transitions.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was received from the client for this placement fee. Used for cash application, days-sales-outstanding (DSO) calculation, and AR aging reporting in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the placement fee billing transaction, tracking progression from fee generation through collection. Drives accounts receivable workflows and collections activity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|invoiced|partially_paid|paid|overdue|disputed|written_off — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms governing when the client must pay the placement fee invoice. Sourced from the clients Master Service Agreement (MSA) or rate card. Drives payment_due_date calculation and collections SLA.

attributes.name: replacement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client is eligible to receive a replacement candidate at no additional fee charge following a fall-off event within the guarantee period. Determined by the terms of the clients MSA and the nature of the fall-off.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the placement fee revenue is recognized in the general ledger per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition standards. For direct placement, typically the candidates confirmed start date or guarantee period expiry, depending on the firms accounting policy.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this placement fee record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across Bullhorn ATS/CRM, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, and Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: source_system_fee_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this placement fee record in the originating source system (Bullhorn, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, or NetSuite). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems for reconciliation and support.

attributes.name: split_fee_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this placement fee is shared between multiple recruiters or offices (split placement). When true, the fee revenue and commission are divided according to the split arrangement. Common in executive search and cross-office placements.

attributes.name: split_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total placement fee allocated to this recruiter or office in a split placement arrangement. Applicable only when split_fee_indicator is true. Used for commission calculation and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the placement fee record. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data pipeline processing.

products.name: expense_charge
products.description: Transactional record of billable expenses incurred by workers or staffing operations and passed through to client invoices. Captures expense type (per diem, travel, lodging, mileage, equipment, training), date, amount, currency, receipt reference, approval status, billable flag, markup percentage, client PO reference, cost center, GL account, and associated assignment and invoice line references. Supports pass-through expense billing in project-based and SOW engagements.

attributes.name: expense_charge_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each billable expense charge record in the billing domain. Primary key for the expense_charge data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete billable expense event with its own lifecycle.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker assignment or placement under which this expense was incurred. Links the expense charge to the specific temporary or contract engagement. Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: bgc_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.bgc_order. Business justification: Background check costs are routinely passed through to clients as billable expense charges. Billing operations require linking each expense charge to the specific BGC order for accurate cost recovery,

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account to which this expense charge is billed. Used for accounts receivable tracking, invoice generation, and client-level expense reporting.

attributes.name: contract_sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Reimbursable expenses tied to SOW scope, budget caps, and expense policies. Critical for SOW budget tracking, expense approval workflows, and client billing validation in project-based staffing.

attributes.name: credential_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_instance. Business justification: General credential-related expenses (license verification fees, skills assessment costs, training charges, immunization records) are often billed as pass-through charges. Billing operations require li

attributes.name: drug_screen_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.drug_screen. Business justification: Drug screening costs are frequently billable expenses in staffing contracts. Finance teams need to link expense charges to specific drug screen orders for client billing, vendor payment reconciliation

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice line item on which this expense charge appears once billed. Null until the expense is included in a client invoice. Supports reconciliation between expense charges and billed amounts.

attributes.name: license_verification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.license_verification. Business justification: License verification fees (state board verification costs, third-party verification service fees) are billed as expense charges to clients or charged to workers. expense_charge already links to bgc_or

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Expense charges in staffing (travel, per diem, relocation) are incurred at specific client work sites. Linking expense_charge to client location enables location-level expense reporting, site-specific

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Onboarding-related expenses (background checks, drug screens, orientation, equipment) are often billable to client. Direct linkage supports expense recovery, client billing transparency (itemized onbo

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order or requisition associated with the worker assignment for which this expense was incurred. Enables expense tracking at the requisition level for project-based and SOW engagements.

attributes.name: orientation_session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to candidate.orientation_session. Business justification: Orientation session costs (materials, venue, facilitator fees tracked via cost_per_attendee) are billed as expense charges to clients. Staffing ops teams need to reconcile expense charges against spec

attributes.name: requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.requirement. Business justification: Compliance-mandated expense charges (required BGC, drug screen, safety training costs) must reference the controlling compliance requirement for client billing justification and audit trail. expense_c

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: SOW engagements incur billable expenses (travel, materials, equipment). Expense charges must link to specific SOW placements for client billing and project cost tracking. Essential for SOW profitabili

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Reimbursable expenses (travel, per diem, equipment) for vendor-supplied workers must track supplier for proper client billing markup, expense policy compliance verification, supplier invoice reconcili

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.training_record. Business justification: Mandatory training costs (LMS fees, compliance training, client-required orientation) are billed as expense charges in managed services programs. The expense_charge must reference the training_record

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval workflow state of the expense charge, distinct from the overall charge_status. Tracks whether the expense has been reviewed and authorized by the appropriate approver (client manager, internal supervisor, or VMS workflow). Required for SOX-compliant expense approval controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual (client manager, staffing supervisor, or VMS approver) who approved this expense charge. Supports audit trail and compliance reporting requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the expense charge was approved by the designated approver. Used for SLA measurement on expense approval turnaround and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: billable_amount
attributes.description: The total amount charged to the client for this expense, equal to expense_amount plus markup_amount. This is the net total included on the client invoice. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET net total component.

attributes.name: billing_model
attributes.description: The billing arrangement under which this expense charge is processed. Determines invoice format, markup applicability, and revenue recognition method. Aligns with the engagement type: hourly time-and-materials, per diem, project-based, SOW (Statement of Work)-based, or direct placement fee billing.

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period in which this expense charge is included for client invoicing. Together with billing_period_start, defines the invoice cycle window for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period in which this expense charge is included for client invoicing. Aligns expense charges to invoice cycles for time-and-materials and SOW-based engagements.

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the expense charge record. Drives approval routing, invoice inclusion eligibility, and collections processing. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: client_po_number
attributes.description: The client-issued Purchase Order number authorizing this expense charge. Required for invoice processing by many enterprise clients and VMS-managed programs. Used for client-side accounts payable matching.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The client or internal cost center code to which this expense charge is allocated. Used for client-side cost allocation reporting, internal P&L tracking, and GL journal entry generation in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this expense charge record was first created in the system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for aging analysis and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit memo issued to the client if this expense charge was disputed, rejected, or reversed after billing. Links the expense charge to the corresponding credit memo in Oracle NetSuite ERP or Salesforce Revenue Cloud.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this expense charge record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Required for multi-currency client engagements and international staffing operations. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET currency component.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for a client or internal dispute on this expense charge. Populated when charge_status transitions to disputed. Used for dispute management, credit memo processing, and client relationship management.

attributes.name: expense_amount
attributes.description: The gross base amount of the expense as incurred, before any markup or adjustment. Represents the raw cost passed through from the worker or vendor. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: expense_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the expense was incurred by the worker or staffing operation. Used for period matching, per diem eligibility, and invoice period alignment. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: expense_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the expense charge providing additional context about the nature, purpose, or business justification of the expense. Appears on client invoices and expense reports for transparency.

attributes.name: expense_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable identifier for the expense charge record, used in client communications, invoice line references, and dispute management. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud or Oracle NetSuite ERP. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: expense_type
attributes.description: Classification of the expense category incurred by the worker or staffing operation. Drives billing rules, markup applicability, and GL account mapping. Standard types include Per Diem (daily allowance), travel, lodging, mileage reimbursement, equipment, and training costs. Satisfies CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per_diem|travel|lodging|mileage|equipment|training|meals|parking|communication|relocation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expense charge is eligible to be passed through and billed to the client. Non-billable expenses are absorbed by the staffing firm and excluded from client invoices. Critical for revenue recognition and invoice generation logic.

attributes.name: is_reimbursable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is entitled to reimbursement for this expense from the staffing firm, independent of whether it is billed to the client. Drives payroll reimbursement processing in TempWorks Payroll.

attributes.name: markup_amount
attributes.description: The calculated dollar value of the markup applied to the base expense amount (expense_amount × markup_percentage / 100). Stored as a discrete field for audit and invoice line transparency. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage applied on top of the base expense amount to calculate the billable amount charged to the client. Represents the staffing firms margin on pass-through expenses. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.

attributes.name: mileage_rate
attributes.description: The per-mile or per-kilometer reimbursement rate applied to mileage expense charges. May reflect the IRS standard mileage rate or a client-negotiated rate. Used to validate that expense_amount equals mileage_units × mileage_rate.

attributes.name: mileage_units
attributes.description: Number of miles or kilometers driven for mileage-type expense charges. Used to calculate reimbursement at the applicable IRS standard mileage rate or client-negotiated rate. Applicable only when expense_type is mileage.

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: The daily allowance rate applied for per diem expense charges, representing the authorized daily amount for meals, incidentals, or lodging. May reflect GSA federal per diem rates or client-negotiated rates. Applicable when expense_type is per_diem.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date shown on the supporting receipt or expense documentation. May differ from expense_date in cases of delayed submission. Used for IRS substantiation compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: receipt_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the supporting receipt or proof of expense. Used for audit trail, FCRA-compliant recordkeeping, and expense dispute resolution. May reference a document stored in DocuSign CLM or an external document management system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this expense charge record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across the billing domains multi-system architecture.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the expense charge was submitted for approval by the worker or staffing coordinator. Used for aging analysis, SLA tracking, and expense cycle time reporting.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount applied to the billable expense charge based on the applicable tax code and jurisdiction. Included on client invoices where tax applies. Supports tax remittance and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: tax_code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this expense charge record was last modified. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and Silver layer incremental processing in Databricks.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or supplier from whom the expense was incurred (e.g., hotel chain, airline, equipment supplier). Used for vendor spend analysis, preferred vendor compliance, and accounts payable matching in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: worker_name
attributes.description: Full name of the worker (temporary employee, contractor, or W-2 employee) who incurred the expense. Retained on the expense record for audit trail and dispute resolution purposes. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR, CCPA, and FCRA.

Ensures all placements meet federal, state, and client-specific compliance requirements.

attributes.name: alien_registration_number
attributes.description: USCIS Alien Registration Number (A-Number) provided by the employee in Section 1 when applicable. Required for lawful permanent residents and certain aliens authorized to work. Highly sensitive government-issued identifier.

attributes.name: authorized_representative_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employers authorized representative who physically examined the employees documents and completed Section 2 of the I-9 form. Required for audit trail and employer liability documentation.

attributes.name: authorized_representative_title
attributes.description: Job title of the employers authorized representative who completed Section 2. Documents the authority level of the individual who performed the document inspection.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Unique externally-known case reference number assigned to this I-9 verification record, often sourced from the onboarding workflow or Sterling BGC system. Used for audit trail and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Employees attested citizenship or immigration status as declared in Section 1 of the I-9 form. Determines document list requirements for Section 2 verification. Sensitive PII per USCIS and FCRA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this I-9 verification record was first created in the system. Audit trail field required for DOL, OSHA, and IRS regulatory audit frameworks. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: document_issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or authority that issued the primary document used for verification (e.g., U.S. Department of State for passports, state DMV for drivers licenses, SSA for Social Security cards).

attributes.name: employer_business_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the employer (staffing firm or client company) recorded in Section 2 of the I-9. In co-employment or joint employment scenarios, this identifies which entity is the employer of record for I-9 purposes.

attributes.name: employer_of_record_type
attributes.description: Identifies which entity type is acting as the Employer of Record (EOR) for I-9 compliance purposes. Critical in staffing and co-employment arrangements to determine I-9 responsibility. Values: staffing_firm (staffing agency is EOR), client_company (client is EOR), peo (Professional Employer Organization), eor (dedicated Employer of Record service).

attributes.name: everify_case_number
attributes.description: Unique case number assigned by the DHS/SSA E-Verify system when the employer submits the I-9 information for electronic employment eligibility verification. Links this I-9 record to the corresponding E-Verify transaction.

attributes.name: everify_final_result_date
attributes.description: Date on which the E-Verify case reached a final determination (Employment Authorized or Final Nonconfirmation). Used for compliance reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: everify_status
attributes.description: Current status of the E-Verify case associated with this I-9 verification. Tracks the electronic verification result from DHS/SSA. A Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC) requires employee notification and contest opportunity.

attributes.name: everify_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer submitted the I-9 information to the E-Verify system. Must occur no later than 3 business days after the hire date per E-Verify program requirements.

attributes.name: foreign_passport_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country that issued the foreign passport referenced in Section 1. Required when a foreign passport number is provided.

attributes.name: foreign_passport_number
attributes.description: Foreign passport number provided by the employee in Section 1 when applicable, along with the country of issuance. Used for aliens authorized to work who provide a foreign passport with Form I-94.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The date the worker was hired or the assignment commenced. Section 1 of the I-9 must be completed no later than the first day of employment; Section 2 must be completed within 3 business days of this date.

attributes.name: i94_admission_number
attributes.description: CBP Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record number provided by the employee in Section 1 when applicable. Used for aliens authorized to work who do not have an A-Number or foreign passport with visa.

attributes.name: list_a_document_number
attributes.description: Document number from the List A identity and employment authorization document presented in Section 2. Recorded by the employer/authorized representative during physical document inspection.

attributes.name: list_a_document_type
attributes.description: Type of List A document (establishes both identity and employment authorization) presented by the employee in Section 2. Examples include U.S. Passport, Permanent Resident Card (I-551), Employment Authorization Document (I-766). Mutually exclusive with List B/C combination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: us_passport|us_passport_card|permanent_resident_card|alien_registration_receipt_card|employment_auth_document|foreign_passport_i94|foreign_passport_i551|passport_i94_i20|passport_i94_ds2019 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: list_a_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the List A document as recorded in Section 2. Used to determine reverification requirements. Null if the document has no expiration date.

attributes.name: list_b_document_number
attributes.description: Document number from the List B identity document presented in Section 2. Recorded by the employer/authorized representative during physical document inspection.

attributes.name: list_b_document_type
attributes.description: Type of List B document (establishes identity only) presented by the employee in Section 2 when no List A document is provided. Examples include drivers license, state ID card, school ID with photo. Must be used in combination with a List C document. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drivers_license|state_id|school_id_photo|voter_registration|us_military_card|military_dependent_id|us_coast_guard_id|native_american_tribal_doc|canadian_drivers_license — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: list_b_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the List B document as recorded in Section 2. Null if the document has no expiration date.

attributes.name: list_c_document_number
attributes.description: Document number from the List C employment authorization document presented in Section 2. Recorded by the employer/authorized representative during physical document inspection.

attributes.name: list_c_document_type
attributes.description: Type of List C document (establishes employment authorization only) presented by the employee in Section 2 when no List A document is provided. Examples include Social Security card, birth certificate, employment authorization issued by DHS. Must be used in combination with a List B document. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: social_security_card|us_birth_certificate|us_citizen_id_card|native_american_tribal_doc|us_id_card_for_use_in_us|dhs_employment_auth — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: list_c_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the List C document as recorded in Section 2. Null if the document has no expiration date.

attributes.name: onboarding_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system from which this I-9 record was sourced or initiated. Supports data lineage and reconciliation between SAP SuccessFactors onboarding workflows and Sterling BGC verification system.

attributes.name: preparer_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a preparer or translator assisted the employee in completing Section 1 of the I-9 form. When True, the preparer/translator certification fields must also be completed.

attributes.name: remote_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the I-9 document examination was conducted remotely using the DHS-authorized alternative procedure (video link, fax, or email) rather than in-person physical inspection. Remote verification requires additional documentation and is subject to specific DHS authorization.

attributes.name: reverification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which Section 3 reverification must be completed to maintain continuous employment authorization compliance. Typically set to the work authorization expiration date or document expiration date, whichever is earlier.

attributes.name: reverification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this I-9 record requires reverification of employment authorization documents before the work authorization expiration date. Drives compliance workflow alerts and Section 3 completion.

attributes.name: section1_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee completed and signed Section 1 (Employee Information and Attestation) of the I-9 form. Must be completed no later than the first day of employment per INA requirements.

attributes.name: section2_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer or authorized representative completed Section 2 (Employer or Authorized Representative Review and Verification) of the I-9 form. Must be completed within 3 business days of the hire date.

attributes.name: section3_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which Section 3 (Reverification and Rehires) was completed. Populated when a worker is rehired within 3 years of the original I-9 date or when work authorization documents require reverification.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (SAP SuccessFactors, Sterling BGC, or Bullhorn) for this I-9 record. Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: tnc_contested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee chose to contest the Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC). If True, the employee has 8 federal government working days to contact SSA or DHS to resolve the discrepancy.

attributes.name: tnc_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC) was issued by E-Verify for this case. When True, the employer must notify the employee and provide the Further Action Notice. Triggers a mandatory contest window.

attributes.name: tnc_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer notified the employee of the Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC) result. Employer must notify the employee promptly and cannot take adverse action during the contest period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this I-9 verification record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change detection in the Silver layer lakehouse. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the I-9 verification record. Tracks progression from initial employee attestation through employer document review to final closure or reverification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|section1_complete|section2_complete|reverification_required|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]

attributes.name: work_auth_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employees work authorization expires as attested in Section 1. Drives reverification scheduling. Null for U.S. citizens, nationals, and lawful permanent residents with no expiration.

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: verified_credential_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_instance. Business process: E-Verify document validation and photo match reference the actual credential instance b

attributes.name: work_authorization_id
