attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual start date of the worker assignment or placement. Compliance clearance must be achieved prior to this date. Used to flag placements where clearance was obtained after assignment start.

attributes.name: bgc_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the background check screening was completed and a final result was returned by Sterling Background Check. Used to assess BGC turnaround time and compliance with client SLA requirements.

attributes.name: bgc_status
attributes.description: Status of the background check (BGC) screening for this placement as reported by Sterling Background Check. clear indicates no disqualifying findings. adverse_action indicates findings requiring pre-adverse and adverse action notices per FCRA. waived indicates client or internal authorization to proceed without BGC.

attributes.name: blocking_check_count
attributes.description: Count of individual compliance check items that are currently in a failed or pending status that would block placement activation. A value of 0 with check_status = cleared confirms full compliance. Used in real-time compliance dashboards to prioritize remediation.

attributes.name: check_initiated_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the compliance gate-check process was initiated for this placement. Represents the principal real-world event time for this transaction. Used to measure compliance processing cycle time and SLA adherence.

attributes.name: check_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this compliance check record, used in audit trails, compliance dashboards, and cross-system references. Typically formatted as CHK-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: check_status
attributes.description: Overall lifecycle status of the placement compliance gate-check. cleared indicates all required checks passed and placement may go active. failed blocks placement from generating billable hours. waived indicates authorized exception granted. expired indicates a previously cleared check has lapsed and requires renewal.

attributes.name: check_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the compliance gate-check. initial applies to new placements, extension to assignment extensions, reactivation to returning workers, annual_renewal for ongoing long-term assignments, client_change when a worker transfers to a new client.

attributes.name: clearance_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required compliance checks were satisfied and the placement was granted compliance clearance to go active. Null if clearance has not yet been granted. Used to calculate time-to-clearance metrics.

attributes.name: client_specific_req_status
attributes.description: Status of any additional compliance requirements mandated by the clients MSA or VMS program beyond standard federal and state requirements. Examples include client-specific background check panels, additional drug test panels, site-specific safety certifications, or vendor credentialing requirements in Beeline VMS.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance team annotations, exception documentation, escalation notes, or additional context related to this placement compliance check. Supports audit trail and case management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this placement compliance check record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record origination and supports SOC 2 Type II audit logging requirements.

attributes.name: credential_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of required professional credential and license verification for this placement. Applies to placements requiring specific certifications (e.g., nursing licenses, CDL, OSHA certifications, IT certifications). Verified through Sterling Background Check and internal credentialing processes.

attributes.name: drug_screen_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug screen specimen was collected and/or the final result was reported. Used to validate that drug screening was completed within the required pre-placement window.

attributes.name: drug_screen_status
attributes.description: Status of the pre-placement drug screening for this worker. negative clears the worker for placement. positive blocks placement and may trigger adverse action. not_required applies when client or placement type does not mandate drug screening. Managed through Sterling Background Check.

attributes.name: eeoc_self_id_collected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Self-Identification Collected Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EEOC voluntary self-identification form (race, ethnicity, gender, disability, veteran status) has been collected from the worker for this placement. Required for EEOC and OFCCP reporting compliance for federal contractor clients.

attributes.name: noncompete_nda_check_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Non-Compete and NDA Conflict Check Status
attributes.description: Status of the review for existing non-compete agreements and NDAs that could restrict the workers placement with the target client. conflict_identified requires legal review before placement proceeds. Tracked via DocuSign CLM.

attributes.name: ofccp_applicability_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this placement is subject to OFCCP affirmative action and equal employment opportunity requirements because the client is a federal contractor or subcontractor. Drives additional compliance obligations including AAP tracking and adverse impact analysis.

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Status of the worker onboarding process in SAP SuccessFactors, including completion of required forms, policy acknowledgments, direct deposit setup, and benefits enrollment. complete is required before a placement can generate billable hours.

attributes.name: overall_compliance_result
attributes.description: The final aggregated compliance determination for this placement. pass authorizes the placement to go active and generate billable hours. fail blocks activation. conditional_pass indicates clearance granted with documented exceptions or waivers. pending_review indicates escalation to compliance team.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of placement being compliance-checked. Determines which compliance requirements are applicable (e.g., I-9 requirements differ for SOW vs. direct placement; workers comp requirements differ for temporary vs. direct hire). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temporary|contract_to_hire|direct_placement|per_diem|sow|rpo — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this compliance check record originated or was primarily managed. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver layer lakehouse and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this placement compliance check record was most recently modified. Tracks the latest state change for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: waiver_authorization
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized approver who granted a compliance waiver for this placement (if applicable). Required when check_status = waived or overall_compliance_result = conditional_pass. Provides audit trail for waiver accountability.

attributes.name: waiver_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which a granted compliance waiver expires. After this date, the outstanding compliance item must be completed or the placement may be suspended. Drives automated compliance expiry alerts.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented business justification for any compliance waiver granted for this placement. Required for audit trail integrity. Examples include client-approved exceptions, emergency placements with post-start completion commitments, or regulatory exemptions.

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: The NCCI workers compensation classification code assigned to this placement based on the job duties and work environment. Drives workers comp premium calculation in TempWorks Payroll and ensures correct coverage is in place before assignment start.

products.name: state_compliance_rule
products.description: Reference master for state-specific and local jurisdiction compliance requirements that vary by geography and impact multi-state staffing operations. Captures state/locality, effective date, expiration date, requirement type (ban-the-box, pay transparency, salary history ban, state E-Verify mandate, state-specific drug testing restrictions, portable background check laws, paid sick leave mandate, predictive scheduling, wage theft prevention notice, state mini-WARN Act, independent contractor classification test variations such as ABC test vs. common law test), applicability criteria (employer size threshold, industry sector, worker type), penalty for non-compliance, enforcement agency, and source citation with URL. Drives jurisdiction-aware compliance enforcement for multi-state staffing operations. Distinct from compliance_requirement which owns federal regulations and client-specific contractual mandates.

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the state-specific compliance rule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: credential_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_requirement. Business justification: State compliance rules (licensing laws, AB5, state drug testing mandates) directly mandate specific credential requirements for placements in that jurisdiction. Linking state_compliance_rule to creden

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_rule_state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the state_compliance_rule_id of the newer rule that supersedes this rule. Null if this rule is current and not superseded.

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.template. Business justification: State compliance rules directly drive contract template clause selection (includes_flsa_compliance_clause, includes_eeoc_compliance_clause, includes_workers_comp_clause). Staffing contract teams must

attributes.name: applicability_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed business logic and conditions that determine when this compliance rule must be applied, including employer size, industry, worker type, and other qualifying factors.

attributes.name: applicable_industry_sector
attributes.description: Industry sector or North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code range to which this rule applies. Null if applies to all industries.

attributes.name: applicable_worker_type
attributes.description: Type of worker classification to which this compliance rule applies (e.g., all workers, W-2 only, 1099 independent contractors, temporary placements). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|W-2|1099|temporary|permanent|contract|direct hire|temp-to-perm — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal compliance team notes, implementation guidance, or special considerations for this state rule.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state compliance rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Description of documentation, records, or forms that must be maintained to demonstrate compliance with this state rule.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the state compliance rule becomes legally enforceable and must be applied to staffing operations.

attributes.name: employer_size_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of employees or Full-Time Equivalents (FTE) that triggers applicability of this compliance rule. Null if applies to all employer sizes.

attributes.name: enforcement_agency
attributes.description: Name of the state or local government agency responsible for enforcing this compliance rule (e.g., California Labor Commissioner, New York Department of Labor).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the state compliance rule ceases to be enforceable. Null for rules with no sunset provision.

attributes.name: ic_test_type
attributes.description: Type of legal test used by this jurisdiction to determine independent contractor classification (e.g., ABC test in California, common law test in other states). Only applicable for independent contractor classification rules.
attributes.value_regex: ABC test|common law test|hybrid test|not applicable

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Geographic scope level of the compliance rule indicating whether it applies at state, county, city, or municipal level.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_locality
attributes.description: City, county, or local jurisdiction name where this rule applies if more granular than state-level (e.g., San Francisco, Cook County). Null for state-wide rules.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation where this compliance rule applies (e.g., CA, NY, TX).

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this compliance rule was last reviewed by the compliance team to verify accuracy and currency.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this compliance rule to ensure it remains current with legislative changes.

attributes.name: penalty_amount_max
attributes.description: Maximum monetary penalty amount in USD that may be assessed for violation of this compliance rule. Null if no maximum specified.

attributes.name: penalty_amount_min
attributes.description: Minimum monetary penalty amount in USD that may be assessed for violation of this compliance rule. Null if no minimum specified.

attributes.name: penalty_description
attributes.description: Description of penalties, fines, or sanctions that may be imposed for non-compliance with this state rule.

attributes.name: penalty_per_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether penalties are assessed per individual violation (True) or as a single penalty regardless of violation count (False).

attributes.name: posting_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance rule requires physical posting of notices at worksites or inclusion in job postings (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: preempts_local_law
attributes.description: Indicates whether this state-level rule preempts or supersedes more restrictive local ordinances (True) or allows local jurisdictions to impose stricter requirements (False).

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Official legal citation to the statute, regulation, or ordinance that establishes this compliance requirement (e.g., California Labor Code Section 432.3).

attributes.name: requirement_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of what the compliance rule requires staffing operations to do or prohibits them from doing.

attributes.name: requirement_type
attributes.description: Category of state-specific compliance requirement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ban-the-box|pay transparency|salary history ban|state e-verify mandate|drug testing restriction|portable background check|paid sick leave mandate|predictive scheduling|wage theft prevention notice|state mini-WARN|independent contractor test variation|workers comp mandate|unemployment insurance requirement|disability insurance requirement|family leave mandate — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years that documentation related to this compliance rule must be retained. Null if no specific retention period mandated.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Internal risk rating assigned to this compliance rule based on penalty severity, enforcement frequency, and business impact of non-compliance.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the state compliance rule, typically formatted as state abbreviation followed by rule category code (e.g., CA-BTB001 for California Ban-the-Box).

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the state compliance rule (e.g., California Ban-the-Box Law, New York Salary Transparency Act).

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the state compliance rule indicating whether it is currently enforceable.

attributes.name: source_url
attributes.description: Web URL link to the authoritative source document, legislative text, or regulatory guidance for this compliance rule.

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance rule mandates specific training for recruiters, managers, or workers (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state compliance rule record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this compliance rule, incremented when amendments or updates are made to the underlying statute or regulation.

domains.name: credentialing
domains.description: Owns all candidate credential, certification, license, screening verification, and qualification data. Covers BGC (Background Check) results from Sterling, drug screen outcomes, professional license verification, skills assessments, training records, skill validations, credential expiration tracking, renewal requirements, and compliance with industry-specific certification mandates. Supports credentialing requirements for healthcare, IT, skilled trades, finance, government, and other specialized staffing verticals.
domains.references: FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act) / ASA Credentialing Standards

products.name: credential
products.description: Master record for every credential, certification, license, qualification, immunization, or safety certification type recognized by Staffing Hr across all staffing verticals (healthcare, IT, skilled trades, finance, government). Defines the credential taxonomy including credential name, issuing authority, governing body, credential category (license, certification, clearance, assessment, immunization, safety_certification), applicable industry vertical, required renewal cycle, expiration rules, and whether the credential is mandatory for placement eligibility. Covers professional licenses (RN, CPA, PE, CDL), safety certifications (OSHA 10/30/510), immunizations (Hep B, MMR, TB, COVID-19), security clearances, and skills assessments. This is the SSOT for credential definitions — distinct from a candidates actual held credential instance.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credential definition record. This is the primary key for the credential master catalog. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — this product defines the taxonomy of credential types recognized by Staffing Hr, not a candidate-held instance.

attributes.name: credential_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_type. Business justification: The credential master record must be classified by credential_type. credential_type is the reference table defining categories, validity periods, verification methods, and compliance frameworks for ea

attributes.name: advance_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiration that the system should trigger a renewal notification to the candidate and recruiter (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days). Enables proactive credential management to prevent placement disruptions due to lapsed credentials.

attributes.name: assessment_passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum passing score required for skills assessments or competency tests associated with this credential type (e.g., 70.00 for 70%). Null for non-assessment credential types. Used to evaluate candidate assessment results against the required threshold.

attributes.name: assessment_score_type
attributes.description: Defines how the assessment result is measured and reported for this credential type. Percentage (0-100%), raw score (numeric count), pass/fail (binary outcome), or grade (letter grade). Determines how passing_score is interpreted.

attributes.name: bgc_check_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of background check (BGC) associated with this credential when it involves a Sterling Background Check screening. Drives the BGC order type submitted to Sterling. None indicates the credential does not involve a background check component. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: criminal|drug_screen|employment_verification|education_verification|license_verification|credit|none|reference_check|sex_offender|mvr — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ceu_hours_required
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Education Unit (CEU) or professional development hours required per renewal cycle for this credential. Null if CEU is not required. Used to validate renewal completeness before credential re-issuance.

attributes.name: ceu_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential requires completion of Continuing Education Units (CEU) or Continuing Professional Development (CPD) hours as part of the renewal process. When True, the renewal workflow must capture CEU completion evidence.

attributes.name: clearance_level
attributes.description: For security clearance credential types, specifies the clearance level (e.g., Confidential, Secret, Top Secret, Top Secret/SCI). Null or none for non-clearance credentials. Critical for government staffing vertical placement eligibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential definition record was first created in the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 Type II compliance requirements.

attributes.name: credential_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code identifying this credential type across all systems (e.g., RN_LICENSE, OSHA_30, CDL_CLASS_A, CPA_CERT). Used as the business key in ATS, VMS, and compliance systems. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.

attributes.name: credential_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the credential, including its purpose, scope, and any special requirements or conditions. Provides context for recruiters, compliance officers, and candidates about what the credential entails and why it is required.

attributes.name: credential_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the credential, certification, license, or qualification (e.g., Registered Nurse License, OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety, Commercial Driver License Class A, Certified Public Accountant). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this credential definition in the Staffing Hr catalog. Active credentials are available for assignment to candidates and placement eligibility checks. Deprecated credentials are retained for historical reference only. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: drug_screen_panel
attributes.description: Specifies the drug screening panel type when this credential involves a drug screen (e.g., 5-Panel, 10-Panel, 12-Panel, DOT 5-Panel). Null if the credential does not involve drug screening. Aligns with DOT and employer-specific drug testing requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this credential definition became active and applicable in the Staffing Hr catalog. Used to determine which credential definitions were in effect at any given point in time for historical compliance audits.

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential type triggers an E-Verify case submission requirement. Relevant for federal contractor placements and states with mandatory E-Verify laws. Integrates with the compliance.everify_case product.

attributes.name: external_credential_code
attributes.description: The identifier for this credential type as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn credential type ID, Sterling check type code, SAP SuccessFactors qualification ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and deduplication.

attributes.name: flsa_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is relevant to FLSA worker classification determinations (e.g., professional exemption credentials like CPA, PE, RN may support exempt classification). Supports wage and hour compliance analysis.

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: The regulatory or professional body that oversees and mandates this credential (e.g., EEOC, DOL, OSHA, OFCCP, ASA, SHRM, State Nursing Board). May differ from the issuing authority. Used for regulatory reporting and compliance mapping.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the credential expiration date during which the credential is still considered valid for placement purposes (e.g., 30-day grace period while renewal is in process). Zero or null means no grace period is allowed.

attributes.name: i9_supporting_doc
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential type can serve as a supporting document for I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification (e.g., U.S. Passport, Permanent Resident Card, Employment Authorization Document). Drives I-9 document collection workflows during onboarding.

attributes.name: immunization_type
attributes.description: For immunization credential types, specifies the vaccine or immunization name (e.g., Hepatitis B, MMR, TB Test, COVID-19, Influenza, Varicella). Null for non-immunization credentials. Required for healthcare staffing vertical compliance.

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The staffing industry vertical for which this credential is applicable. Drives placement eligibility rules and compliance checks by vertical. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|skilled_trades|finance|government|general|education|energy|legal|manufacturing — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_expirable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential type has an expiration date. When True, candidate credential instances must track expiration and renewal. When False, the credential is considered permanent once earned (e.g., some degree-based certifications). Drives renewal workflow triggers.

attributes.name: is_multi_state
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is recognized across multiple states or jurisdictions (e.g., Nurse Licensure Compact states, CDL federal reciprocity). When True, a single credential instance may satisfy requirements in multiple states. Relevant for travel staffing and multi-state workforce deployments.

attributes.name: is_placement_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether possession of this credential is a mandatory prerequisite for placement eligibility in the applicable industry vertical or job type. When True, candidates without a valid instance of this credential cannot be submitted or placed. Drives automated compliance gates in the ATS and VMS.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organization, agency, or body that issues this credential (e.g., State Board of Nursing, OSHA, PMI, CompTIA, IRS, Department of Transportation). Critical for verification routing and compliance validation.

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which this credential is issued and recognized (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international staffing operations and GDPR/CCPA compliance scoping.

attributes.name: issuing_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where this credential is issued and valid (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Applicable for state-specific professional licenses (e.g., state nursing licenses, state CPA licenses, state CDL). Null for nationally or internationally recognized credentials.

attributes.name: license_number_format
attributes.description: Regular expression or format pattern that defines the valid format for license or certification numbers issued under this credential type (e.g., ^RN[0-9]{6}$ for a state nursing license). Used for data validation when candidates enter their credential instance details.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or special instructions related to this credential type (e.g., Requires notarized copy, Must be verified within 30 days of placement start, Accepted only from accredited institutions). Visible to credentialing coordinators and compliance staff.

attributes.name: osha_standard_ref
attributes.description: For safety certifications, the specific OSHA standard or regulation that mandates or governs this credential (e.g., 29 CFR 1926.503 for fall protection, 29 CFR 1910.120 for HAZWOPER). Null for non-safety credentials. Supports OSHA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: redeployment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid instance of this credential contributes to a candidates eligibility for redeployment to a new assignment without re-credentialing. Supports the redeployment workflow in the placement domain.

attributes.name: renewal_cycle_months
attributes.description: Standard renewal period for this credential expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial, 36 for triennial). Null if the credential does not expire. Used to calculate expected renewal dates and trigger advance notification workflows. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential definition was retired or deprecated from the Staffing Hr catalog. Null if the credential is still active. Retained for historical reference and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this credential definition originated (e.g., Bullhorn ATS, Sterling Background Check, SAP SuccessFactors, Beeline VMS). Supports data lineage and master data management reconciliation.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the credential category (e.g., within license: nursing, engineering, financial, transportation; within certification: project management, IT, healthcare). Enables fine-grained filtering and reporting across staffing verticals.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential definition record was last modified in the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The required method for verifying this credential type. Primary source verification contacts the issuing authority directly (required for healthcare licenses). Document review accepts copies of certificates. Third-party uses services like Sterling Background Check. Self-attestation accepts candidate declaration. Automated uses API-based verification.

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The specific system, database, or service used to verify this credential (e.g., Sterling Background Check, NURSYS National Nurse License Verification, SAM.gov Exclusions, State DOT CDL Database, FINRA BrokerCheck). Informs the verification workflow routing.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incrementing version number for this credential definition record, supporting optimistic concurrency control and change history tracking. Incremented each time the credential definition is materially updated (e.g., renewal cycle change, new governing body).

products.name: credential_instance
products.description: Transactional record capturing a specific credential held by a candidate — the instance of a credential type owned by a worker. Tracks credential number, issuing authority, issue date, expiration date, current verification status (pending, verified, expired, revoked), verification method, verification date, source system (Sterling BGC, manual upload, third-party registry), and extended attributes for specialized credential types (e.g., lot number and titer results for immunizations, card number for OSHA certifications, clearance level/granting agency/investigation type/polygraph details for security clearances). Also owns the full renewal lifecycle for the credential instance: renewal application date, submission date, renewal authority, renewal fee, renewal status (initiated, submitted, approved, denied, pending_documentation), new expiration date upon approval, and CEU requirements fulfilled. This is the operational SSOT for does this candidate currently hold this credential? and what is the renewal status? — drives placement eligibility checks, expiry alerting, and renewal workflows.

products.name: bgc_result
products.description: Consolidated SSOT for all screening and verification outcome data returned from Sterling or another screening vendor. Each record represents a single component result within a background check order or standalone screening event. Captures the check component type (criminal_search, employment_verification, education_verification, reference_check, sex_offender_registry, global_watchlist, drug_screen, credit_check, MVR), result status (clear, consider, adverse, pending, negative, positive, dilute, adulterated, substituted), finding details, county/jurisdiction searched, adjudication decision, adverse action flag, FCRA compliance flags, result received timestamp, and component-specific extended attributes. Drug screen attributes: panel type (5/10/12-panel), specimen type (urine, hair, oral fluid), collection site, collection date, lab processing date, MRO review status and decision, DOT vs. non-DOT flag, substances detected. Education verification attributes: institution name, degree type, field of study, graduation date, verification source (NSC, direct institution, third-party), verification outcome. Employment verification attributes: employer name, employment dates, job title, verification method (direct, The Work Number/Equifax), discrepancies found. Reference check attributes: reference contact name, relationship to candidate, structured ratings (work quality, reliability, communication, rehire eligibility), verbatim comments, overall recommendation. One bgc_order produces multiple bgc_result records. This is the single authoritative source for all screening outcomes — no separate sub-type products exist.

attributes.description: The number of days for which a completed credential package remains valid before re-credentialing is required. Drives expiration tracking and renewal alerts for active placements (e.g., 365 days for annual re-credentialing).

attributes.name: drug_screen_panel_type
attributes.description: The specific drug screen panel required by this credential package (e.g., 5-panel, 10-panel, DOT 5-panel, hair follicle). Null if drug_screen_required is false.

attributes.name: drug_screen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a drug screen is a mandatory component of this credential package. When true, the drug_screen_panel_type field specifies the required panel.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this version of the credential package becomes effective and can be applied to new candidate credentialing workflows. Candidates onboarded on or after this date must satisfy this package version.

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether E-Verify electronic employment eligibility confirmation is required for this credential package. Mandatory for federal contractors and certain state-regulated placements.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential package version expires and is no longer valid for new placements. Null for open-ended packages. Supports version lifecycle management and ensures compliance with updated client or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: i9_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification is required as part of this credential package. Typically true for all packages but may be explicitly flagged for compliance audit purposes.

attributes.name: immunization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether proof of immunization records is required as part of this credential package. Primarily applicable to healthcare staffing verticals (e.g., flu shot, hepatitis B, MMR, TB test).

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The staffing industry vertical this credential package is designed to serve (e.g., healthcare, information_technology, light_industrial). Drives vertical-specific credentialing workflows and compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|light_industrial|finance|government|skilled_trades|education|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_dot_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug screen component of this package must comply with U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations (49 CFR Part 40). Applicable for transportation, logistics, and safety-sensitive positions.

attributes.name: license_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether professional license verification is a mandatory component of this credential package. When true, the required_license_types field specifies which license types must be verified.

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Office of Inspector General (OIG) exclusion list check is required. Mandatory for healthcare placements to ensure candidates are not excluded from federally funded programs (Medicare/Medicaid).

attributes.name: onboarding_checklist_template
attributes.description: Code or identifier referencing the onboarding checklist template in SAP SuccessFactors or the ATS that is automatically assigned to candidates when this credential package is applied. Ensures consistent onboarding task generation.

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this credential package across systems (e.g., HC-TRV-NURSE-V2, FED-IT-CLR-V1, LI-WH-STD-V3). Used for cross-system reference in Bullhorn, Sterling, and Beeline VMS.

attributes.name: package_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the credential package, including its intended use case, applicable roles, and any special compliance notes. Used by recruiters and compliance teams to understand the full scope of requirements.

attributes.name: package_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the credential package (e.g., Healthcare Travel Nurse Package, Federal Government IT Clearance Package, Light Industrial Warehouse Package). Used in candidate-facing and recruiter-facing workflows.

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credential package. Active packages are available for assignment to candidates. Superseded packages have been replaced by a newer version. Archived packages are retained for historical compliance reference.

attributes.name: package_version
attributes.description: Integer version number of this credential package definition, incremented each time the package requirements are materially changed. Enables change tracking and ensures candidates are evaluated against the correct version at time of placement.

attributes.name: physical_exam_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-placement physical examination is required as part of this credential package. Common for healthcare, light industrial, and safety-sensitive positions.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of placement engagement this credential package applies to: temporary, contract, temp-to-perm (Contract-to-Hire), direct hire, or Statement of Work (SOW). Different placement types may require different credentialing depth.

attributes.name: renewal_lead_days
attributes.description: The number of days before credential expiration that the renewal process should be initiated. Used to trigger automated renewal alerts and recruiter tasks in the ATS (e.g., 30 days before expiry).

attributes.name: required_assessment_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of skills assessment or competency test codes required by this package (e.g., MS_OFFICE_BASIC|TYPING_40WPM|FORKLIFT_WRITTEN|CLINICAL_SKILLS_RN). Drives assessment assignment in the ATS onboarding workflow.

attributes.name: required_immunizations
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of required immunizations or health screenings for this credential package (e.g., FLU|HEP_B|MMR|VARICELLA|TB_TEST|COVID_VAX). Null if immunization_required is false.

attributes.name: required_license_types
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of professional license types that must be verified as part of this credential package (e.g., RN|LPN|CNA|CDL_A|PMP|CISSP). Drives license verification workflows in Sterling and the credentialing team.

attributes.name: required_training_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of training course codes or LMS module identifiers that must be completed as part of this credential package (e.g., OSHA_10|HIPAA_PRIVACY|BLOODBORNE_PATHOGENS|FORKLIFT_CERT). Maps to SAP SuccessFactors LMS course catalog.

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: The minimum government security clearance level required by this credential package (e.g., Public Trust, Secret, Top Secret, TS/SCI). Null if security_clearance_required is false.

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a government security clearance is required as part of this credential package. Applicable to federal government IT and defense staffing placements.

attributes.name: skills_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal skills assessment or competency test is required as part of this credential package. When true, the required_assessment_codes field specifies which assessments must be passed.

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of specific training courses or modules is a mandatory component of this credential package. When true, required_training_codes specifies the training requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential package record was last modified. Tracks changes to package requirements over time and supports version control and compliance audit trails.

products.name: work_authorization
products.description: Master record capturing a candidates work authorization status and documentation in the United States or other jurisdictions. Tracks authorization type (US Citizen, Permanent Resident, H-1B, OPT, TN, EAD, L-1, O-1, etc.), sponsorship required flag, visa number, visa category, authorized start date, authorized end date, country of authorization, sponsoring employer (if applicable), and USCIS case number. Distinct from I-9 verification (which is the compliance process) — this is the authoritative record of the workers legal right to work. Critical for placement eligibility, co-employment risk management, and ensuring compliance with immigration law in staffing engagements.

attributes.name: work_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the work authorization record. Serves as the authoritative identifier for a candidates legal right-to-work record within the Staffing Hr credentialing domain.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_account. Business justification: Work authorization requirements vary by client (federal contractors require E-Verify, some clients sponsor visas, client-specific I-9 policies). Real business process: client-specific work authorizati

attributes.name: credential_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the scanned or digitally stored work authorization document (e.g., visa copy, EAD card, passport) in the document management system (DocuSign CLM or equivalent). Enables retrieval of the underlying document for audit and compliance review without storing the document directly in the data lakehouse.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Link work authorization to the master credential definition (e.g., H1B Visa, Green Card, US Citizen). This allows standardizing work authorization types across all work authorization records. Removing

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_package. Business justification: Work authorization verification (I-9, E-Verify) is a mandatory component of many credential packages (credential_package.everify_required, i9_required = BOOLEAN). Adding credential_package_id to work_

attributes.name: credential_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_requirement. Business justification: Work authorization status satisfies specific credential requirements (e.g., 'E-Verify required for government contract placement'). credential_requirement.everify_required (BOOLEAN) and i9_required (B

attributes.name: ic_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.ic_agreement. Business justification: IC agreements for independent contractors specify work authorization and I-9/E-Verify requirements. Linking work_authorization to ic_agreement is a direct regulatory compliance need — IC agreement aud

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose work authorization is being recorded. Links this authorization record to the candidate master profile in Bullhorn ATS/CRM.

attributes.name: authorization_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers or recruiters to capture additional context about the candidates work authorization status, including pending renewals, special conditions, attorney notes, or immigration counsel observations. Not used for structured data — structured fields take precedence.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work authorization record. active indicates the candidate is currently authorized to work; expired indicates the authorization period has lapsed; pending indicates verification or renewal is in progress; revoked indicates authorization was withdrawn; under_review indicates a compliance review is ongoing. Critical for placement eligibility gating.

attributes.name: authorized_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidates work authorization expires. Null for permanent authorizations (e.g., US Citizens, Permanent Residents with no expiry). Drives credential expiration alerts, renewal workflows, and assignment end-date compliance checks. Critical for avoiding unauthorized employment liability.

attributes.name: authorized_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidates work authorization becomes effective. Used to determine earliest eligible placement start date and to enforce compliance with immigration law. Corresponds to the authorized to work from date on the underlying visa or EAD document.

attributes.name: authorized_to_work_unrestricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has unrestricted authorization to work for any employer without limitation (e.g., US Citizens, Permanent Residents). True = no employer or occupation restrictions; False = authorization is tied to a specific employer, occupation, or time period. Used for rapid placement eligibility screening.

attributes.name: bullhorn_candidate_ref
attributes.description: The external candidate identifier from Bullhorn ATS/CRM corresponding to this work authorization record. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the Staffing Hr data lakehouse and the Bullhorn operational system without relying solely on the internal surrogate key.

attributes.name: cap_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidates H-1B petition is exempt from the annual USCIS H-1B numerical cap (e.g., employed by a cap-exempt institution such as a university, nonprofit research organization, or government research entity). True = cap-exempt; False = subject to annual cap lottery. Relevant only for H-1B authorization type.

attributes.name: country_of_authorization
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction in which the candidate is authorized to work (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports multi-jurisdiction staffing operations and international placement compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work authorization record was first created in the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and compliance with SOC 2 Type II record-keeping obligations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ead_card_number
attributes.description: The USCIS-issued Employment Authorization Document (EAD) card number (Form I-766) for candidates whose work authorization is evidenced by an EAD card. Distinct from visa_number. Applicable for OPT, CPT, H-4 EAD, TPS, and other EAD-based authorization types. Sensitive PII.

attributes.name: everify_case_number
attributes.description: The case number assigned by the DHS E-Verify system when the candidates work authorization was electronically verified. Links this authorization record to the corresponding E-Verify transaction. Null if E-Verify was not used. Supports compliance with federal contractor E-Verify mandates.

attributes.name: expiration_alert_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expiration alert notification was sent. Null if expiration_alert_sent is False. Used to audit the timeliness of expiration notifications and to ensure compliance with internal SLA requirements for credential renewal management.

attributes.name: expiration_alert_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated expiration alert notification has been sent to the responsible recruiter or compliance team regarding the upcoming expiration of this work authorization. True = alert sent; False = alert not yet sent. Supports proactive credential management and prevents unauthorized employment.

attributes.name: green_card_priority_date
attributes.description: The priority date established when a PERM labor certification or I-140 immigrant petition was filed on behalf of the candidate. Determines the candidates place in the immigrant visa queue. Null if no green card process is underway. Used for long-term workforce planning and retention risk assessment.

attributes.name: i140_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether USCIS has approved an I-140 Immigrant Petition for Alien Workers on behalf of the candidate. True = I-140 approved; False = not approved or not filed. An approved I-140 enables H-1B extensions beyond the standard 6-year cap and supports AC21 portability analysis.

attributes.name: i94_admission_number
attributes.description: The 11-digit admission number from the candidates USCIS Form I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record), which establishes the authorized period of admission and status. Used to verify current lawful status and authorized stay duration. Sensitive immigration PII.

attributes.name: lca_number
attributes.description: The Department of Labor (DOL)-assigned Labor Condition Application (LCA) case number associated with an H-1B or H-1B1 visa. The LCA certifies that the employer will pay the prevailing wage and maintain required working conditions. Required for H-1B compliance tracking and DOL audit readiness.

attributes.name: opt_stem_extension
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) STEM Extension Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is on a 24-month STEM OPT extension (applicable to F-1 students with STEM degrees). True = STEM extension applies, extending OPT authorization by 24 months beyond standard 12-month OPT. Relevant only when authorization_type = OPT. Drives extended placement eligibility windows.

attributes.name: opt_stem_extension_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) STEM Extension End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the 24-month STEM OPT extension period. Null if opt_stem_extension is False or not applicable. Used to track the outer boundary of OPT-based work authorization for STEM candidates and to trigger timely H-1B sponsorship or transition planning.

attributes.name: passport_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country that issued the candidates passport (e.g., IND, CHN, MEX, CAN). Used for immigration compliance, co-employment risk assessment, and OFCCP reporting. Distinct from country_of_authorization.

attributes.name: passport_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the candidates passport as presented during work authorization verification. Used to ensure the underlying identity document remains valid throughout the placement period. Triggers renewal alerts when approaching expiry.

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The candidates passport number as presented during work authorization verification. Used as a supporting identity document for I-9 compliance and immigration record-keeping. Sensitive government-issued PII — access restricted to authorized compliance personnel.

attributes.name: placement_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidates work authorization imposes restrictions on placement (e.g., H-1B candidates restricted to the petitioning employers worksite, TN candidates restricted to specific occupations). True = placement restrictions apply; False = no restrictions. Triggers compliance review before assignment to a new client or location.

attributes.name: placement_restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of any specific placement restrictions associated with the work authorization (e.g., H-1B restricted to client XYZ worksite in Chicago, IL per LCA, TN restricted to Software Engineer occupation only). Null if placement_restriction_flag is False. Used by recruiters and compliance teams during placement eligibility review.

attributes.name: portability_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is eligible for H-1B portability under AC21 (American Competitiveness in the 21st Century Act), allowing them to change employers while an I-140 petition is pending. True = portability applies; False = not eligible. Critical for assessing whether a candidate can be placed with a new client without a new H-1B petition.

attributes.name: reverification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the candidates work authorization must be re-verified to maintain placement eligibility. Typically set to the authorized_end_date or a configurable number of days prior. Null if reverification_required is False. Drives proactive expiration alerts and compliance workflows.

attributes.name: reverification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidates work authorization requires re-verification before or upon expiration (e.g., EAD renewals, OPT extensions, TN renewals). True = re-verification is required; False = no re-verification needed (e.g., US Citizens). Drives automated renewal workflow triggers in the credentialing system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this work authorization record was sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Bullhorn ATS/CRM, SAP SuccessFactors, and manual compliance entry workflows.

attributes.name: sponsoring_employer
attributes.description: The legal name of the employer currently sponsoring the candidates work visa or authorization (e.g., the H-1B petitioner or PERM sponsor). May be Staffing Hr itself (as Employer of Record) or a client company. Null if no sponsorship is required. Critical for co-employment risk management and portability analysis.

attributes.name: sponsoring_employer_ein
attributes.description: The IRS-assigned Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the sponsoring employer. Used to verify the legal entity responsible for the sponsorship obligation and to support DOL Labor Condition Application (LCA) compliance. Format: XX-XXXXXXX. Confidential business financial identifier.

attributes.name: sponsorship_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate requires employer sponsorship (e.g., H-1B petition, PERM labor certification) to maintain or obtain work authorization. True = sponsorship required; False = no sponsorship needed. Critical for client placement eligibility screening — many clients explicitly exclude candidates requiring sponsorship.

attributes.name: staffing_vertical
attributes.description: The industry vertical for which this work authorization record is primarily relevant. Different verticals have distinct credentialing and authorization requirements (e.g., healthcare requires additional license verification; government may require security clearance alignment). Supports vertical-specific compliance reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work authorization record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale records, support incremental data loads in the Databricks Silver layer, and maintain audit trail integrity for immigration compliance reviews. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: uscis_case_number
attributes.description: The official case number assigned by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) for the candidates immigration petition or application (e.g., I-129 H-1B petition receipt number). Format: three-letter service center code followed by 10 digits (e.g., EAC2312345678). Used to track petition status and employer sponsorship obligations.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the work authorization documents were verified by the staffing firm. Used to establish the verification timeline for I-9 compliance audits and to calculate re-verification due dates for time-limited authorizations.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the candidates work authorization documents. document_review = physical or digital document inspection; e_verify = electronic verification via DHS E-Verify system; manual = manual internal review; third_party_vendor = verification performed by a credentialing vendor such as Sterling. Supports audit trail and FCRA compliance.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or user identifier of the Staffing Hr compliance officer, recruiter, or authorized representative who performed the work authorization verification. Supports audit trail requirements and accountability for I-9 and immigration compliance.

attributes.name: visa_category
attributes.description: The specific visa category or classification code as issued by the relevant immigration authority (e.g., H-1B, L-1A, L-1B, O-1A, O-1B, TN-1, TN-2, F-1 OPT, J-1). More granular than authorization_type and maps directly to the visa stamp classification. Used for precise immigration compliance reporting.

attributes.name: visa_number
attributes.description: The official visa number or foil number as printed on the candidates visa stamp or entry document. Uniquely identifies the specific visa issuance. Required for immigration compliance tracking and USCIS case management. Sensitive PII — access restricted to authorized compliance personnel.

products.name: credential_document
products.description: Master record for physical or digital documents submitted by a candidate to support credentialing verification — diplomas, transcripts, license copies, certification cards, immunization records, professional references, and government-issued IDs. Captures document type, document title, issuing institution or authority, issue date, expiration date, document storage reference (DocuSign CLM or document vault URI), verification status, and the credential or verification record it supports. Provides the document audit trail required for FCRA, HIPAA, and client audit purposes.

attributes.name: credential_document_id
attributes.description: Primary key for credential_document

attributes.name: bgc_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Background Check (BGC) order in Sterling Background Check that this document supports or was collected as part of. Nullable when the document is not associated with a BGC order.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that mandated this document as part of their credentialing requirements. Nullable when the document is a general credentialing requirement not tied to a specific client.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Link the document to the master credential definition it supports (e.g., RN License document supports RN License credential). This allows standardizing credential types across all documents. Removing

attributes.name: ic_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.ic_agreement. Business justification: IC agreements require specific documentation from contractors (certificates, licenses, insurance). Linking credential_document to ic_agreement enables IC agreement compliance audits — verifying all re

attributes.name: license_verification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the license verification record this document supports. Links the physical or digital license copy to the corresponding verification record in the credentialing domain.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (Req/Requisition) for which this document was collected as part of the candidate credentialing process. Nullable when the document is collected independently of a specific job order.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate who submitted this credential document. Links the document to the candidate profile in Bullhorn ATS/CRM for credentialing and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_credential_document_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer credential document record that replaced this one. Enables document version lineage tracking and audit trail for FCRA and client audit compliance.

attributes.name: candidate_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has provided explicit written consent for the collection, storage, and use of this document for credentialing and background screening purposes. Required under FCRA, GDPR, and CCPA.

attributes.name: client_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document was required by a specific client as part of their onboarding or credentialing program. When true, the document must be verified before the candidate can be placed with that client.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate provided consent for the collection and use of this document. Required for FCRA, GDPR, and CCPA audit trails.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential document record was first created in the Staffing Hr credentialing system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for the master resource lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or reference number assigned to the document by the issuing authority or institution (e.g., license number on a license copy, diploma serial number, passport number). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this master resource.

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the document itself, independent of its verification status. Tracks whether the document is currently valid, expired, revoked by the issuing authority, or superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the document as it appears on the physical or digital artifact (e.g., Registered Nurse License, Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, CPR Certification Card). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this master resource.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the credential document type submitted by the candidate. Drives downstream routing, verification workflows, and compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: license|certification|diploma|transcript|government_id|immunization_record|drug_screen_result|reference_letter|background_check_consent|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the document is considered active and valid for credentialing purposes. May differ from issue_date for documents with a delayed activation period (e.g., renewed licenses effective on a future date).

attributes.name: expiration_alert_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expiration alert notification was sent for this document. Used to track notification compliance and follow-up cadence for credential renewal.

attributes.name: expiration_alert_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated expiration alert notification has been sent to the candidate and/or credentialing team for this document. Supports proactive renewal management and assignment continuity.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document expires and is no longer valid for credentialing or placement purposes. Drives automated expiration alerts, renewal workflows, and assignment eligibility checks. Null for documents with no expiration.

attributes.name: fcra_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collection, storage, and use of this document complies with Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) requirements, including candidate consent and permissible purpose. Critical for background check document types.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: File format of the stored digital document (e.g., PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF). Used for document rendering, archival compliance, and integration with document management systems.

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the stored document file in kilobytes. Used for storage management, upload validation, and document vault capacity planning.

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document contains Protected Health Information (PHI) subject to HIPAA regulations (e.g., immunization records, drug screen results, medical clearance letters). Drives PHI handling, access controls, and retention policies.

attributes.name: is_primary_document
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is the primary or most current version of a given document type for the candidate. When false, the document may be a historical or superseded version retained for audit purposes.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the issuing authority originally issued or granted the document. Used to determine document age, validity windows, and renewal eligibility.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the institution, government body, or organization that issued the document (e.g., California Board of Registered Nursing, CompTIA, U.S. Department of Homeland Security). Critical for verification routing and source validation.

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the nation that issued the document. Required for I-9 employment eligibility verification and international credential validation.

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code of the authority that issued the document. Applicable for state-issued licenses, certifications, and government IDs. Null for federally or internationally issued documents.

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: The calculated or manually set date by which the candidate must renew this document to maintain credentialing compliance. Drives scheduling of renewal outreach and placement hold triggers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing specialists to record observations, exceptions, follow-up actions, or contextual information about the document that is not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the document was rejected during the verification review process (e.g., expired, illegible, mismatched name, suspected fraud). Populated only when verification_status is rejected.

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_days
attributes.description: The number of days between required renewals for this document type. Used to calculate the next renewal due date and schedule proactive outreach to the candidate.

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document requires periodic renewal to maintain its validity for credentialing and placement eligibility. Drives renewal workflow triggers and expiration tracking.

attributes.name: staffing_vertical
attributes.description: The staffing industry vertical for which this document is required or relevant. Drives vertical-specific credentialing rules (e.g., healthcare requires immunization records; government requires security clearance documents). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|skilled_trades|finance|government|general_staffing|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: storage_uri
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) pointing to the physical or digital document stored in DocuSign CLM or the enterprise document vault. Enables retrieval for audits, client requests, and FCRA/HIPAA compliance reviews. Access is governed by role-based security controls.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate submitted this document to the staffing organization for credentialing review. Serves as the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP at day granularity) for the document intake lifecycle.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential document record was last modified in the Staffing Hr credentialing system. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data pipeline processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the authenticity and validity of the document (e.g., primary source verification with issuing authority, third-party vendor such as Sterling, manual review, E-Verify for employment eligibility).

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the documents verification process. Drives credentialing workflow actions, placement eligibility, and compliance holds. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this master resource.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or system identifier of the credentialing specialist or automated system that performed the document verification. Supports audit trail requirements under FCRA and client audit programs.

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was confirmed as authentic and valid by the credentialing team or automated verification system. Null until verification is completed.

products.name: package_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the requirement relationship between credential_package and credential. It captures the specific rules and constraints that govern how each credential must be satisfied within the context of a specific credentialing package. Each record links one credential_package to one credential with attributes that define whether the credential is mandatory, verification requirements, expiry windows, renewal policies, and waiver rules for that specific package-credential combination.. Existence Justification: In staffing and recruitment operations, credential packages are reusable bundles that combine multiple credentials with package-specific rules. A single package (e.g., Healthcare Travel Nurse Package) requires multiple credentials (RN license, BLS, immunizations, background check), and a single credential (e.g., RN license) is required by multiple packages across different clients and verticals. Compliance teams actively configure and manage these package-credential relationships, setting mandatory/optional flags, verification levels, expiry windows, and waiver policies for each combination.

attributes.name: package_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for this package requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the credential that is required by this package

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the credential package that contains this requirement

attributes.name: acceptable_expiry_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days before credential expiration that the credential is still considered acceptable for placement under this package. Allows package-specific tolerance (e.g., client may accept credential expiring within 30 days for short-term assignments).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package requirement record was created.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying this credential requirement within the package checklist presented to candidates and recruiters.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential requirement becomes effective for this package. Supports phased rollout of new requirements.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential requirement is no longer applicable for this package. Supports time-bound requirements (e.g., COVID-19 vaccination required only during pandemic period).

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after credential expiration during which the credential is still considered acceptable for this package. Package-specific override of the credentials default grace_period_days.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is mandatory for the package (true) or optional/preferred (false). Drives candidate readiness evaluation logic.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package requirement record was last modified.

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before credential expiration that the renewal process must be initiated for this package. Drives proactive renewal notifications.

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate must renew this credential if it expires during the assignment period covered by this package.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this requirement within the package. Allows individual requirements to be deprecated without removing the entire package.

attributes.name: verification_level
attributes.description: The level of verification rigor required for this credential within this package context. May differ from the credentials default verification_method based on client or program requirements.

attributes.name: waiver_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential requirement can be waived for this package under exceptional circumstances (e.g., pending license transfer, temporary assignment).

attributes.name: waiver_approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational approval level required to grant a waiver for this credential requirement within this package context.

products.name: credential_type
products.description: Master reference table for credential_type. Referenced by credential_type_id.

attributes.name: credential_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for credential_type

attributes.name: parent_credential_type_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on credential_type (parent_credential_type_id)

attributes.name: allowed_document_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of acceptable document file types or formats for this credential type (e.g., PDF, JPG, PNG). Null if document upload is not required or any type is accepted.

attributes.name: background_check_scope
attributes.description: For background check credential types, specifies the scope or type of background check (e.g., criminal, employment verification, education verification). Null for non-BGC credential types.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory or compliance framework that mandates or governs this credential type (e.g., Joint Commission, OSHA, state licensing board). Null if not tied to a specific framework.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_usd
attributes.description: Estimated average cost in USD for obtaining or renewing this credential type, including application fees, exam fees, and verification costs. Null if cost is not tracked or highly variable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential type record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credential_type_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the credential type into major groupings for reporting and filtering.

attributes.name: credential_type_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the credential type (e.g., RN_LIC, CPR_CERT, BGC_BASIC). Used as a business key for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: credential_type_description
