attributes.description: Reference to the Vendor Management System (VMS) client program under which this rate agreement is executed.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor supplier party that is a signatory to this rate agreement.

attributes.name: tier_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.tier_classification. Business justification: Rate agreements in MSP/VMS programs are tier-specific — different vendor tiers receive different markup rates and terms. The rate_agreement table carries vendor_tier (STRING) as a denormalized referen

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: Rate agreements operate within the contractual framework established by vendor agreements. The vendor_agreement defines markup caps, fee schedules, and governing terms that constrain rate_agreement pa

attributes.name: vendor_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_rate_card. Business justification: A rate agreement formally executes and governs the rates defined in a vendor rate card. The rate_agreement captures the negotiated markup percentages and terms, while vendor_rate_card defines the unde

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the rate agreement, typically including vendor name, client program, and engagement period (e.g., Acme Staffing — TechCorp IT Program FY2025).

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this executed rate agreement, used for cross-system reconciliation between Beeline VMS, DocuSign CLM, and Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate agreement. Controls whether rates under this agreement may be applied to active placements and job orders.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate agreement by engagement model. Determines applicable rate structures and compliance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msp_vendor|sow_vendor|ic_supplier|direct_placement|temp_to_perm|rpo_vendor — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate agreement automatically renews upon expiration unless either party provides written notice of termination within the notice period.

attributes.name: burden_rate_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer burden rate (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation, benefits) is embedded within the agreed markup percentage or billed separately as a pass-through cost.

attributes.name: clm_document_reference
attributes.description: The internal DocuSign CLM document reference number or URL for the executed rate agreement, used for contract audit trail and legal record retention.

attributes.name: conversion_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The agreed conversion fee percentage charged when a contingent worker placed under this agreement is converted to a permanent (FTE) hire by the client (Temp-to-Perm or Contract-to-Hire conversion).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate agreement record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this rate agreement (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency MSP programs.

attributes.name: dt_markup_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated markup percentage applied to double time (DT) hours billed under this agreement, applicable in states or contracts requiring double-time pay.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the negotiated rates and terms of this agreement become binding and applicable to placements and job orders.

attributes.name: escalation_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate agreement contains a rate escalation clause permitting periodic rate adjustments (e.g., annual CPI-linked increases) after the rate lock period expires.

attributes.name: escalation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which rate escalations may be applied under the escalation clause. Null if escalation_clause is False.

attributes.name: escalation_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum allowable rate escalation percentage per escalation period as defined in the escalation clause. Null if escalation_clause is False. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 = 3%).

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required signatories completed execution of the rate agreement, making it legally binding. Captured from DocuSign CLM completion event.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate agreement expires and rates are no longer binding. Null indicates an open-ended agreement. Triggers renewal workflow when approaching.

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code indicating the jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of this rate agreement.

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The agreed markup percentage applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate for contingent workers placed under this agreement. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4500 = 45%). Core financial term in staffing: Markup % = (Bill Rate - Pay Rate) / Pay Rate.

attributes.name: max_exception_markup_pct
attributes.description: The maximum markup percentage permitted for approved rate exceptions under this agreement. Null if rate_exception_allowed is False.

attributes.name: msp_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The MSP program management fee percentage charged to the vendor supplier under this agreement, deducted from the bill rate or invoiced separately depending on program structure.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing special terms, negotiation context, approved exceptions, or operational notes associated with this rate agreement that are not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: ot_markup_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated markup percentage applied to overtime (OT) hours billed under this agreement. May differ from the standard markup percentage per FLSA overtime billing conventions.

attributes.name: per_diem_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether per diem allowances for travel, lodging, and meals are included within the rate structure of this agreement or handled as separate expense reimbursements.

attributes.name: program_scope
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational scope of this rate agreement — whether rates apply nationally, regionally, to a specific site, or globally across the clients enterprise.

attributes.name: rate_exception_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether approved rate exceptions above the negotiated rate card are permitted under this agreement for specialized skill sets or market-driven rate adjustments.

attributes.name: rate_lock_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the rate lock period. After this date, rates may be renegotiated per the escalation clause terms defined in this agreement.

attributes.name: rate_lock_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the rate lock period during which negotiated bill rates and pay rates cannot be unilaterally modified by either party.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to expiration that written notice must be provided to prevent auto-renewal or to initiate renegotiation of terms.

attributes.name: spread_ceiling_amount
attributes.description: The maximum dollar spread (Bill Rate minus Pay Rate) permitted under this agreement, capping the MSP/staffing firms margin to protect vendor competitiveness. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: spread_floor_amount
attributes.description: The minimum dollar spread (Bill Rate minus Pay Rate) guaranteed under this agreement, ensuring the MSP/staffing firm retains a minimum gross margin regardless of pay rate fluctuations. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate this rate agreement prior to its expiration date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate agreement record was most recently modified, supporting change tracking and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: vendor_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized signatory representing the vendor supplier who executed this rate agreement.

attributes.name: vms_fee_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Technology Fee Percentage
attributes.description: The VMS technology platform fee percentage (e.g., Beeline transaction fee) applicable to placements under this agreement, distinct from the MSP management fee.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: The worker classification type covered by this rate agreement. Determines tax treatment, co-employment risk, and applicable compliance obligations (W-2, 1099 IC, Corp-to-Corp, or Employer of Record).

products.name: sow_agreement
products.description: Manages Statement of Work (SOW) agreements executed with vendors for project-based or deliverable-based engagements within the vendor program. Captures SOW number, vendor ID, client ID, project title, scope of work description, deliverables list, fixed price or T&M structure, total contract value, milestone schedule, start date, end date, amendment history, SOW status (draft, executed, active, closed, terminated), DocuSign CLM reference, and co-employment risk classification. Supports SOW vendor program management distinct from staff augmentation. Note: This product owns the vendor-side SOW relationship and program enrollment aspects; the contract domain owns the commercial contract lifecycle and legal terms of the SOW.

attributes.name: sow_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a Statement of Work (SOW) agreement record within the vendor program. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: beeline_sow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to this SOW agreement within the Beeline Vendor Management System (VMS). Enables reconciliation between the vendor domain data product and the operational VMS platform.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for whom the SOW project or deliverable is being executed. Links to the client account master record.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_contact. Business justification: SOW execution requires a named client signatory/approver who is a client contact. Staffing operations track which client contact authorized each SOW for contract governance, audit trails, and DocuSign

attributes.name: contract_msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: SOWs in staffing are governed by MSAs. Business needs to validate SOW terms (liability, payment, termination) against parent MSA provisions and ensure SOW doesnt contradict MSA terms during legal rev

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_package. Business justification: SOW agreements for project-based work specify required credentialing packages for worker eligibility. Essential for SOW compliance requirements, worker eligibility determination, and project onboardin

attributes.name: rate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.rate_agreement. Business justification: A Statement of Work agreement for project-based vendor engagements operates under a master rate agreement that governs the pricing framework. The sow_agreement has its own pricing_structure and not_to

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sla. Business justification: SOWs may have attached SLAs (delivery timelines, quality metrics). Business needs to link SOW to its governing SLA for performance measurement, breach determination, and validating SOW deliverables ag

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (staffing supplier or subcontractor) who is party to this SOW agreement. Links to the vendor master record in the vendor domain.

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: SOW agreements are executed under the governing vendor agreement framework. The vendor_agreement defines the supplier relationship terms within which SOW project work is authorized. This link enables

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Beeline VMS contingent workforce program under which this SOW agreement is managed and tracked.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Running count of formal amendments executed against this SOW agreement. Tracks the number of change orders or modifications to scope, value, or timeline since original execution.

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOW agreement contains an automatic renewal clause that extends the agreement beyond the original end date without requiring a new execution. Triggers renewal notification workflows.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the vendor submits invoices for work performed under this SOW. Determines the invoicing cadence in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: co_employment_risk_classification
attributes.description: Assessment of co-employment risk associated with this SOW engagement. High-risk SOWs may involve workers who could be deemed joint employees of the client, triggering FLSA, EEOC, or IRS worker classification concerns. Supports compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOW agreement record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation event for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this SOW agreement (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency vendor programs.

attributes.name: deliverables_summary
attributes.description: Summarized list or description of the specific outputs, work products, or outcomes the vendor is contractually obligated to deliver under this SOW. Supports deliverable-based program management.

attributes.name: docusign_clm_reference
attributes.description: Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) reference number or document ID assigned by DocuSign CLM for the executed SOW agreement. Used for legal document retrieval and audit trail.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed date on which the SOW engagement concludes and all deliverables must be completed. Represents the effective-until date of the agreement. Nullable for open-ended engagements.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SOW agreement was formally signed and executed by all parties via DocuSign CLM. Marks the transition from draft to executed status.

attributes.name: ic_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Independent Contractor (IC) compliance review has been completed for this SOW engagement, confirming the vendors workers meet IRS and state-level IC classification criteria.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is required to provide a certificate of insurance (COI) as a condition of this SOW. Typically required for general liability, workers compensation, and professional liability coverage.

attributes.name: insurance_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendors certificate of insurance was verified and confirmed as meeting the requirements specified in this SOW. Null if insurance verification is not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: latest_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal amendment executed against this SOW agreement. Null if no amendments have been executed. Supports amendment history tracking.

attributes.name: milestone_count
attributes.description: Total number of payment or delivery milestones defined in the SOW milestone schedule. Used for milestone-based pricing structures and progress tracking.

attributes.name: nda_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is required as a condition of this SOW engagement. When true, the NDA must be executed before work commences.

attributes.name: non_compete_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a non-compete clause or agreement is required for workers engaged under this SOW. Relevant for sensitive client engagements involving proprietary processes or competitive intelligence.

attributes.name: not_to_exceed_amount
attributes.description: Maximum authorized spend ceiling for T&M or NTE-structured SOW agreements. Vendor billings may not exceed this threshold without a formal amendment. Null for fixed-price SOWs.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms governing when the client must remit payment to the vendor following invoice submission. Drives accounts payable scheduling in Oracle NetSuite ERP.

attributes.name: pricing_structure
attributes.description: Defines the commercial pricing model for the SOW engagement. Fixed Price (FP) means a set total cost regardless of effort; Time and Materials (T&M) means billing based on hours and expenses; Milestone-Based ties payments to deliverable completion; Not-to-Exceed (NTE) caps total spend.

attributes.name: project_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the project or engagement described in this Statement of Work. Used in reporting, dashboards, and client communications.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to the SOW end date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew, if auto-renewal is enabled. Drives contract expiry alerting.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the project scope, objectives, and work to be performed under this SOW. Captures the high-level summary of deliverables and responsibilities as defined in the executed agreement.

attributes.name: sow_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the SOW agreement as referenced in DocuSign CLM, Beeline VMS, and client-facing communications. Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: sow_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SOW agreement. Tracks progression from initial drafting through execution, active delivery, and final closure or early termination.

attributes.name: sow_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SOW engagement type. Project-Based SOWs have defined scope and timeline; Deliverable-Based SOWs are tied to specific outputs; Managed Service SOWs involve ongoing operational management; Consulting SOWs cover advisory services; Staffing SOWs are distinct from staff augmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: project_based|deliverable_based|managed_service|consulting|staffing_sow — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed date on which the SOW engagement commences and the vendor begins work or deliverable execution. Represents the effective-from date of the agreement.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SOW agreement was early-terminated by either party prior to the contractual end date. Null if the SOW was not terminated early. Triggers final billing and closeout procedures.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the SOW agreement was terminated prior to its scheduled end date. Used for vendor performance analysis and program management reporting.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the SOW agreement as executed, representing the maximum authorized spend or fixed price for the full scope of work. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this SOW agreement record. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance requirements.

attributes.name: vendor_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized representative from the vendor organization who executed this SOW agreement. Required for contract validity and legal enforceability.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Tax and employment classification of workers engaged under this SOW. W-2 indicates employees on payroll; 1099 IC indicates Independent Contractors; Corp-to-Corp indicates vendor entity engagement; EOR indicates Employer of Record arrangement. Critical for IRS compliance and co-employment risk management.

products.name: performance_scorecard
products.description: Periodic vendor performance scorecard capturing quantitative and qualitative KPIs for each supplier within an MSP/VMS program. Tracks evaluation period, overall score, TTF (Time to Fill) score, QoS (Quality of Submission) score, submittal-to-interview ratio, interview-to-offer ratio, offer-to-start ratio, fall-off rate, assignment completion rate, compliance rate, NPS score, client satisfaction rating, redeployment rate, and scorecard status (draft, published, disputed, finalized). Drives tier reclassification and program allocation decisions.
products.reference: Vendor Performance Scorecard / Supplier KPI Report

attributes.name: performance_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Primary key for performance_scorecard

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which this vendor performance is being evaluated. Enables client-specific vendor scorecarding within multi-client MSP programs.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_contact. Business justification: Supplier performance scorecards in MSP programs are reviewed and signed off by a specific client contact (program manager or procurement lead) during QBRs. Tracking the evaluating client contact enabl

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Vendor Management System (VMS) Program ID
attributes.description: Reference to the MSP/VMS contingent workforce program under which this vendor is being evaluated. Supports multi-program vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sla. Business justification: Scorecards measure SLA compliance (time-to-fill, submittal quality, fill rate). Business needs to link scorecard metrics to the SLA definitions they measure against for breach determination, penalty c

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing supplier or subcontractor being evaluated in this scorecard. Links to the vendor master record in the Beeline VMS vendor registry.

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: Scorecards measure vendor performance against SLAs and terms defined in vendor agreements. Business needs this link for breach determination, penalty calculation, tier classification changes, and agre

attributes.name: active_assignment_count
attributes.description: Number of active worker assignments managed by this vendor at the end of the evaluation period. Reflects the vendors current headcount contribution to the program.

attributes.name: assignment_completion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of assignments placed by this vendor that were completed through the scheduled end date during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9200 = 92%). Complement of the fall-off rate.

attributes.name: client_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Average client satisfaction rating for this vendor during the evaluation period, collected via structured client feedback surveys. Expressed on a 1.00–5.00 scale. Distinct from NPS — captures direct satisfaction rather than likelihood to recommend.

attributes.name: compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of vendor-placed workers who met all required compliance and credentialing requirements (I-9, background checks, drug screens, certifications) on time during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this scorecard record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field supporting data lineage and SOC 2 Type II compliance requirements.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the vendors stated reason for disputing the scorecard findings. Populated when scorecard_status is disputed. Supports the formal dispute resolution process.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the scorecard dispute was formally resolved and the scorecard status was updated to finalized or re-published. Supports dispute lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: dispute_submitted_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the vendor formally submitted a dispute against this scorecard. Populated when scorecard_status is disputed. Used to track dispute resolution SLA compliance.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the performance measurement window covered by this scorecard. Defines the inclusive end boundary for all KPI calculations.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the performance measurement window covered by this scorecard. Defines the inclusive start boundary for all KPI calculations.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency cadence of the scorecard evaluation cycle. Determines how often vendor KPIs are formally assessed and published within the MSP/VMS program.

attributes.name: evaluator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative commentary entered by the MSP program manager or evaluator summarizing vendor performance highlights, concerns, and context for the evaluation period. Supports narrative reporting alongside quantitative KPIs.

attributes.name: fall_off_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of placements made by this vendor that ended prematurely (before the scheduled assignment end date) during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%). A key indicator of placement quality and candidate fit.

attributes.name: finalized_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the scorecard was finalized and locked, either after the dispute window expired without challenge or after dispute resolution was completed. Marks the record as immutable for historical reporting.

attributes.name: improvement_plan_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the vendor must submit their Performance Improvement Plan in response to a below-threshold scorecard. Populated when improvement_plan_required is True.

attributes.name: improvement_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scorecard evaluation has triggered a requirement for the vendor to submit a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP). True when overall score falls below the program-defined minimum threshold.

attributes.name: interview_to_offer_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of candidate interviews that resulted in a job offer during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Indicates vendor effectiveness in presenting placeable candidates.

attributes.name: job_order_fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of job orders assigned to this vendor that were successfully filled during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). Measures vendor responsiveness and capacity to fulfill requisitions.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score reflecting client satisfaction with this vendors performance during the evaluation period. Ranges from -100 to +100. Derived from client survey responses collected through the MSP program.

attributes.name: offer_to_start_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of job offers extended that resulted in a candidate starting the assignment during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Measures vendor reliability in converting offers to active placements.

attributes.name: on_time_submittal_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of candidate submittals delivered by this vendor within the program-defined SLA submittal window during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal. Measures adherence to program SLA timelines.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Composite weighted performance score for the vendor across all KPI dimensions for the evaluation period. Expressed as a numeric value on a 0–100 scale. Drives tier reclassification and program allocation decisions.

attributes.name: overall_score_grade
attributes.description: Letter grade derived from the overall performance score, providing a simplified qualitative summary for executive reporting and vendor communications. A=Excellent, B=Good, C=Satisfactory, D=Below Standard, F=Failing.

attributes.name: program_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total program job order volume allocated to this vendor during the evaluation period. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 = 25%). Used to assess vendor share-of-wallet and inform future allocation decisions.

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the scorecard was formally published and made available to the vendor. Marks the transition from draft to published status and starts the vendor review/dispute window.

attributes.name: qos_score
attributes.description: KPI score measuring the quality of candidate submittals from this vendor — assessing how well submitted candidates match job order requirements. Scored on a 0–100 scale. A core MSP/VMS program metric.

attributes.name: recommended_tier
attributes.description: The vendor tier classification recommended as a result of this scorecard evaluation. Populated only when tier_change_recommended is True. Subject to program manager approval before taking effect. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|preferred|approved|probation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: redeployment_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of workers placed by this vendor who were successfully redeployed to a new assignment upon completion of their prior assignment during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal. Measures vendors ability to retain and redeploy talent.

attributes.name: scorecard_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the scorecard, used in vendor communications, dispute resolution, and program reporting. Format: SC-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor performance scorecard. Draft: under preparation; Published: shared with vendor; Disputed: vendor has raised a formal challenge; Finalized: accepted and locked; Archived: historical record.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_score
attributes.description: Composite score measuring the vendors overall adherence to all program-defined SLA requirements during the evaluation period. Scored on a 0–100 scale. Encompasses submittal timeliness, onboarding compliance, and reporting obligations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this scorecard data originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Beeline VMS is the primary source for MSP/VMS program scorecards.

attributes.name: submittal_count
attributes.description: Total number of candidate submittals made by this vendor during the evaluation period. Denominator for submittal-to-interview and QoS ratio calculations.

attributes.name: submittal_to_interview_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of candidate submittals that resulted in a client interview during the evaluation period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4000 = 40%). Measures the relevance and quality of vendor submissions.

attributes.name: tier_change_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scorecard evaluation has triggered a recommendation to reclassify the vendors tier designation. True if the overall score warrants a tier upgrade or downgrade per program thresholds.

attributes.name: ttf_avg_days
attributes.description: Average number of calendar days from job order receipt to first qualified submittal by this vendor during the evaluation period. Raw metric underlying the TTF score.

attributes.name: ttf_score
attributes.description: KPI score measuring the vendors performance on Time to Fill — the elapsed time from job order receipt to candidate submittal or placement confirmation. Scored on a 0–100 scale relative to program SLA benchmarks.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this scorecard record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: vendor_tier
attributes.description: Vendor tier designation at the time of this scorecard evaluation. Captures the tier in effect during the evaluation period and may trigger reclassification upon finalization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|preferred|approved|probation — promote to reference product]

products.name: vendor_contact
products.description: Master record for individual contacts associated with a vendor/supplier organization. Captures contact full name, job title, role type (account manager, recruiter, compliance officer, billing contact, executive sponsor), email, phone, mobile, preferred communication method, contact status (active, inactive), primary contact flag, and the vendor organization they represent. Supports relationship management and communication routing for MSP program operations.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the vendor contact record. Primary key for the vendor_contact data product.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: On-site MSP programs assign vendor contacts (on-site coordinators) to specific client locations. Staffing operations track which client site each vendor representative is stationed at for workforce ma

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor/supplier organization this contact represents. Links the contact to the parent vendor record in the vendor domain.

attributes.name: vms_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vms_enrollment. Business justification: A vendor contact who is a VMS portal user (is_vms_portal_user = TRUE, vms_portal_username populated) is associated with a specific VMS enrollment record. Adding vms_enrollment_id links the contact to

attributes.name: communication_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor contact has opted out of non-essential communications such as marketing, newsletters, or program announcements. Mandatory for GDPR/CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: contact_source
attributes.description: Originating system or method through which this vendor contact record was created. Used for data lineage tracking and source system reconciliation.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact record. Drives whether the contact is included in active communication routing and program operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record age analytics.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or business unit within the vendor organization where this contact works (e.g., Recruiting, Operations, Finance, Compliance). Supports organizational mapping and routing.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the vendor contact. Used for MSP program communications, submittal notifications, compliance alerts, and billing correspondence.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this vendor contacts relationship with the MSP/VMS program was terminated or deactivated. Null for currently active contacts. Used for offboarding tracking and access revocation.

attributes.name: external_contact_code
attributes.description: Identifier for this vendor contact as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., Beeline VMS contact ID, Bullhorn contact ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data integration.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first (given) name of the vendor contact individual. Used for personalized communication and formal correspondence.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full display name of the vendor contact (first + last name). Used in UI displays, reports, and communication templates within MSP program operations.

attributes.name: is_billing_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated to receive billing-related communications including invoices, payment remittances, and billing dispute notifications.

attributes.name: is_compliance_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated to receive compliance-related communications including I-9 verification notices, credentialing alerts, and regulatory audit requests.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this individual is the designated primary contact for the vendor organization within the MSP/VMS program. Only one contact per vendor should be flagged as primary at any given time.

attributes.name: is_vms_portal_user
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Portal User Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor contact has an active user account in the Beeline VMS portal for submitting candidates, managing timesheets, and accessing program data.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the vendor contact at their organization (e.g., Account Manager, Director of Staffing, VP of Operations). Used for relationship management and escalation routing.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the MSP program team had a documented interaction with this vendor contact. Used for relationship health monitoring and engagement cadence management.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last (family/surname) name of the vendor contact individual. Used for formal identification and correspondence.

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn professional profile URL for the vendor contact. Used for professional verification, relationship management, and talent acquisition partnership activities.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number for the vendor contact. Used for urgent communications, SMS notifications, and after-hours contact in time-sensitive staffing situations.

attributes.name: nda_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is on file for this vendor contact. Required for contacts who have access to client confidential information or candidate data.

attributes.name: nda_signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor contact executed the Non-Disclosure Agreement. Used for compliance tracking and NDA renewal management.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_contact_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next scheduled outreach or business review with this vendor contact. Supports proactive relationship management and QBR (Quarterly Business Review) scheduling.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for MSP program team notes about the vendor contact, including relationship context, communication preferences, escalation history, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: office_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the vendor contacts office location. Used for formal correspondence, site visit coordination, and geographic program mapping.

attributes.name: office_city
attributes.description: City of the vendor contacts office location. Supports geographic segmentation and regional program management.

attributes.name: office_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the vendor contacts office location (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international MSP program operations and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: office_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP/postal code of the vendor contacts office location. Used for geographic routing and regional program management.

attributes.name: office_state
attributes.description: U.S. state or territory code (2-letter USPS abbreviation) of the vendor contacts office location. Used for regional program assignment and compliance jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary office/desk phone number for the vendor contact. Used for direct business communication within MSP program operations.

attributes.name: phone_extension
attributes.description: Office phone extension number for the vendor contact. Required when the vendor organization uses a PBX system and direct dial is not available.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The vendor contacts preferred channel for receiving communications from the MSP program team. Drives automated notification routing and outreach strategy.

attributes.name: program_access_level
attributes.description: Level of access granted to this vendor contact within the Beeline VMS program portal. Controls what program data, rate cards, and candidate submissions the contact can view or manage.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Functional role classification of the vendor contact within the MSP/VMS program relationship. Determines communication routing and program responsibilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: account_manager|recruiter|compliance_officer|billing_contact|executive_sponsor|operations_manager|technical_contact|onboarding_coordinator — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this vendor contact became active in the MSP/VMS program relationship. Used for relationship tenure tracking and program onboarding analytics.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the vendor contacts primary work location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago). Used to schedule communications and meetings at appropriate local times.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor contact record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: vms_portal_username
attributes.description: Username assigned to the vendor contact for accessing the Beeline VMS supplier portal. Used for portal access tracking and account management.

products.name: program_allocation
products.description: Defines the requisition fill-rate allocation and submission quota assigned to each vendor within a specific client VMS program and job category. Captures program ID, vendor ID, job category, tier classification reference, allocation percentage, maximum concurrent submissions allowed, priority rank within tier, allocation effective date, expiration date, and allocation status (active, suspended, exhausted). Governs how job orders are distributed across the vendor supply chain in Beeline VMS to ensure preferred suppliers receive first-look access per MSP program rules. Updated periodically based on scorecard results and tier reclassification decisions.

attributes.description: The requisition fill-rate allocation percentage assigned to this vendor for the specified job category within the VMS program. Represents the share of job orders this vendor is expected to fill relative to total program volume. Sum of all active vendor allocations per program and job category should equal 100%.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this vendor program allocation. Active: vendor is receiving job order distributions. Suspended: temporarily halted due to compliance or performance issues. Exhausted: submission quota has been fully consumed. Pending: awaiting activation. Expired: past expiration date. Terminated: permanently removed from program.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the MSP program manager or client stakeholder who approved this allocation assignment. Provides an audit trail for allocation governance and change management.

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: auto_distribute
attributes.description: Indicates whether job orders matching this allocations job category are automatically distributed to this vendor by Beeline VMS without manual MSP intervention. When True, the VMS auto-routes requisitions based on tier and allocation percentage. When False, manual distribution is required.

attributes.name: compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has completed all required compliance verifications (insurance certificates, E-Verify enrollment, background check program agreement, OFCCP compliance attestation) to be active under this program allocation.

attributes.name: compliance_verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendors compliance credentials were last verified and confirmed as meeting program requirements. Used to track compliance currency and trigger re-verification workflows.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this program allocation record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and SOC 2 compliance.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor program allocation becomes active and the vendor is eligible to receive job order distributions under the specified terms. Aligns with MSP program cycle start or tier reclassification decision date.

attributes.name: exclusive_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor holds exclusive rights to fill requisitions in the specified job category within this VMS program. When True, no other vendor may receive job order distributions for this category. Typically reserved for niche or specialized labor categories.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor program allocation expires and the vendor is no longer eligible to receive job order distributions under the specified terms. Nullable for open-ended allocations. Typically aligned with program review cycles or scorecard-driven reclassification events.

attributes.name: first_look_days
attributes.description: The number of business days this vendor has exclusive or priority access to a new requisition before it is released to lower-tier vendors. Enforces preferred supplier first-look access per MSP program rules. Applicable only to Tier 1 and Preferred vendors.

attributes.name: ic_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is authorized to supply Independent Contractors (ICs) under this program allocation. When True, the vendor may submit 1099 or Corp-to-Corp workers. Requires additional IC compliance validation per IRS worker classification rules.

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: The labor category or job family for which this allocation applies within the VMS program (e.g., IT, Engineering, Administrative, Light Industrial, Healthcare). Governs which requisition types the vendor is authorized to fill under this allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IT|Engineering|Administrative|Light Industrial|Healthcare|Finance|Legal|Creative|Operations|Scientific — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation was last reviewed by the MSP program manager, typically as part of a periodic scorecard-driven tier reclassification cycle. Supports governance audit trails and ensures allocations are not stale.

attributes.name: max_bill_rate
attributes.description: The maximum hourly bill rate the vendor is authorized to charge the client for placements made under this allocation and job category. Enforced by Beeline VMS rate card controls. Expressed in the programs operating currency (USD).

attributes.name: max_concurrent_submissions
attributes.description: The maximum number of candidate submittals this vendor is permitted to have active simultaneously for a single requisition within this program and job category. Controls submission quota per Beeline VMS program configuration to enforce Quality of Submission (QoS) standards.

attributes.name: max_markup_pct
attributes.description: The maximum markup percentage (bill rate minus pay rate, divided by pay rate) the vendor is permitted to apply for placements under this allocation. Enforces MSP program margin controls and prevents rate gouging. Expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: max_pay_rate
attributes.description: The maximum hourly pay rate the vendor is authorized to pay workers placed under this allocation and job category. Used to enforce spread and markup controls within the MSP program. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: min_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The minimum requisition fill rate percentage the vendor is contractually required to achieve for this job category within the program period. Used as a performance threshold in scorecard evaluations and tier reclassification decisions. Expressed as a percentage of assigned requisitions successfully filled.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation is next scheduled for review and potential reclassification based on vendor scorecard results. Drives MSP program management workflows and ensures timely tier adjustments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for MSP program managers to capture contextual notes about this allocation, such as rationale for tier assignment, special client instructions, or conditions attached to the allocation. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the standard bill rate for overtime hours billed by the vendor under this allocation. Typically 1.5x for OT and 2.0x for double time (DT). Governs how overtime billing is calculated for workers placed under this program.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank of this vendor within its assigned tier for the job category. Lower values indicate higher priority for job order distribution when multiple vendors share the same tier. Used by Beeline VMS to sequence first-look access among same-tier suppliers.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workforce program under which this allocation operates. MSP: Managed Service Provider program. VMS: Vendor Management System-only program. RPO: Recruitment Process Outsourcing. SOW: Statement of Work-based engagement. IC: Independent Contractor supplier program. Direct: direct client-managed program.

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: The frequency at which this vendor program allocation is reviewed and potentially updated based on scorecard performance and tier reclassification decisions. Governs the cadence of MSP program management activities.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for why this allocation was suspended, if applicable. Populated when allocation_status is suspended. Supports MSP program governance and vendor remediation tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: performance|compliance|rate_violation|contract_breach|client_request|audit_hold|other — promote to reference product if additional values needed]

attributes.name: target_time_to_fill_days
attributes.description: The target number of business days within which the vendor is expected to submit qualified candidates for a requisition under this allocation. Represents the Time to Fill (TTF) SLA commitment for this vendor-program-job category combination.

attributes.name: target_time_to_start_days
attributes.description: The target number of calendar days from requisition approval to worker start date for placements made under this allocation. Represents the Time to Start (TTS) SLA commitment for this vendor-program-job category combination.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this program allocation record was most recently modified. Tracks the last change event for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: vms_allocation_ref
attributes.description: The native allocation or supplier program enrollment reference number assigned by Beeline VMS for this vendor-program-job category combination. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the Beeline VMS operational system.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: The worker classification type this allocation governs. W-2: temporary employee on agency payroll. 1099: independent contractor. Corp-to-Corp: vendor-supplied contractor via their own entity. EOR: Employer of Record arrangement. SOW: Statement of Work-based resource. Impacts tax treatment, co-employment risk, and IRS worker classification compliance.

products.name: vendor_compliance
products.description: Tracks vendor-level compliance status, regulatory obligation fulfillment, and insurance certificate records for each supplier in the MSP/VMS program. Captures compliance category (insurance, E-Verify, EEOC, OFCCP, OSHA, FCRA, I-9 audit, workers comp, FUTA/SUTA registration, non-compete policy, data security SOC 2), compliance item description, required document, document expiration date, compliance status (compliant, non-compliant, pending review, waived), last audit date, next review date, remediation notes, and compliance officer assigned. For insurance-category records, additionally captures certificate number, insurance type (general liability, professional liability/E&O, workers compensation, cyber liability, umbrella), carrier name, policy number, coverage limit, certificate holder (MSP/client), additional insured status, auto-renewal flag, and COI document reference. Triggers compliance alerts when documents or certificates approach expiration. Distinct from the credentialing domain which tracks worker-level credentials.

attributes.name: alert_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days before document expiration at which a compliance alert is triggered and sent to the assigned compliance officer and vendor. Enables proactive renewal management to prevent lapses in coverage or certification.

attributes.name: alert_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a compliance expiration alert has been triggered for this record based on the configured alert threshold. True when the current date is within alert_threshold_days of document_expiration_date.

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance policy is set to auto-renew upon expiration. When True, the compliance team may rely on automatic renewal; when False, proactive renewal tracking is required to prevent coverage lapses. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the insurance carrier or underwriter that issued the policy documented in this compliance record. Used to verify carrier financial strength ratings and validate certificate authenticity. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: certificate_holder
attributes.description: Name of the entity listed as the certificate holder on the COI — typically the MSP, the end client, or both. The certificate holder is notified by the carrier in the event of policy cancellation or material change. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: certificate_number

attributes.name: coi_document_reference

attributes.name: compliance_category

Covers insurance certificates, E-Verify enrollment, EEOC/OFCCP obligations, OSHA safety programs, FCRA background check policies, I-9 audit readiness, workers compensation registration, FUTA/SUTA tax registration, non-compete policy, and data security (SOC 2). attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance disposition for this obligation. compliant indicates all requirements are met; non_compliant indicates a deficiency exists; pending_review indicates documents have been submitted and are under evaluation; waived indicates the MSP or client has formally waived this requirement for the vendor.

attributes.name: coverage_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of coverage provided under the insurance policy per occurrence or in aggregate, as stated on the Certificate of Insurance (COI). Expressed in USD. Used to verify that vendor coverage meets MSP/client minimum requirements. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: coverage_limit_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the coverage_limit_amount represents a per-occurrence limit, an aggregate annual limit, or a per-claim limit. Critical for accurately assessing whether vendor coverage meets program requirements. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor compliance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: document_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the submitted compliance document or certificate becomes effective and valid. For insurance certificates, this is the policy inception date. For regulatory filings, this is the filing effective date.

attributes.name: document_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance document or certificate expires and must be renewed. Triggers automated compliance alerts when the expiration date is within the configured alert threshold. Critical for insurance COIs, SOC 2 reports, and E-Verify MOUs.

attributes.name: everify_employer_number
attributes.description: The E-Verify employer identification number assigned by USCIS to the vendor upon enrollment in the E-Verify program. Required for vendors operating under federal contracts subject to FAR E-Verify clause. Applicable for compliance_category = e_verify.

attributes.name: everify_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor enrolled in the E-Verify program with USCIS. Used to verify continuous enrollment and compliance with federal contractor E-Verify requirements. Applicable for compliance_category = e_verify.

attributes.name: insurance_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage documented in this compliance record. Covers the five standard insurance types required in MSP/VMS programs: general liability, professional liability (Errors & Omissions/E&O), workers compensation, cyber liability, and umbrella/excess liability. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: is_insurance_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance record is an insurance-category record requiring additional insurance-specific fields (certificate number, carrier, policy number, coverage limit, etc.). When True, all insurance sub-fields must be populated.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the compliance obligation, regulatory basis, and what the vendor must demonstrate to satisfy the requirement. Provides context for compliance officers and auditors reviewing the record.

attributes.name: item_name
attributes.description: Short, human-readable name of the specific compliance item or obligation (e.g., General Liability Insurance Certificate, E-Verify Employer Enrollment, OSHA 300 Log Submission, SOC 2 Type II Report). Used as the display label in compliance dashboards and audit reports.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent compliance audit or review was conducted for this compliance item. Used to track audit cadence and identify overdue reviews.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit of this item. Drives compliance calendar and workload planning for compliance officers. May be set automatically based on document expiration or audit frequency rules.

attributes.name: non_compete_policy_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has a documented non-compete or non-solicitation policy on file with the MSP program, as required by the Master Service Agreement (MSA). Prevents vendors from directly soliciting placed workers or end clients.

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance policy becomes effective, as stated on the Certificate of Insurance. May differ from document_effective_date if the COI was issued after the policy inception date. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance policy expires, as stated on the Certificate of Insurance. Used as the primary expiration trigger for insurance-category compliance alerts. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Unique policy number assigned by the insurance carrier for the coverage documented in this compliance record. Used to verify coverage with the carrier and cross-reference against the COI. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.

attributes.name: remediation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the remediation plan, corrective actions taken, or outstanding steps required to bring a non-compliant vendor into compliance. Captured by the assigned compliance officer and visible in audit trails.

attributes.name: required_document_type
attributes.description: Type of document the vendor must submit to satisfy this compliance item (e.g., Certificate of Insurance (COI), E-Verify MOU, OSHA 300 Log, SOC 2 Report, W-9, I-9 Audit Report). Drives document collection workflows in the VMS program.

attributes.name: soc2_report_type

Type II is the standard requirement for MSP/VMS data security compliance. Applicable for compliance_category = data_security.

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Beeline VMS compliance record ID, DocuSign envelope ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and deduplication in the Silver Layer.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this compliance record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration in the Silver Layer. Primary source is Beeline VMS; manual entries and DocuSign CLM are secondary sources.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor compliance record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale records and support incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized individual (compliance director, MSP program manager, or client representative) who approved the waiver of this compliance requirement.

attributes.name: waiver_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which an approved compliance waiver expires and the vendor must re-demonstrate compliance or obtain a new waiver. Prevents indefinite waivers from masking persistent compliance gaps.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented business justification for waiving a compliance requirement for this vendor. Required when compliance_status is waived. Must be approved by an authorized compliance officer or program director.

products.name: preferred_supplier_list

Captures client program ID, vendor ID, job category, PSL status (preferred, approved, conditional, excluded), inclusion date, exclusion date, PSL version, approval authority, and client-specific notes. Governs which vendors are visible and eligible to receive requisitions in the VMS for each client engagement.

Adding tier_classification_id normalizes psl

attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendors required insurance certificates (general liability, workers compensation, professional liability) have been verified and are current for this PSL entry. A prerequisite for PSL active status in most client programs.

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: The labor category or skill classification for which this PSL entry governs vendor eligibility (e.g., IT, Engineering, Administrative, Clinical, Light Industrial). Determines which requisition types the vendor is authorized to fulfill within the client program.

attributes.name: job_category_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the job category within the VMS or client program. Used for system-level routing of requisitions to eligible vendors and for cross-program reporting.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PSL entry was most recently reviewed by the approval authority or program governance team. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify stale PSL entries.

attributes.name: nda_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) has been executed between the vendor and the client for this program. Required for vendors accessing sensitive client information as part of the staffing engagement.

attributes.name: non_compete_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a non-compete or non-solicitation agreement has been executed with the vendor for this client program. Protects the clients workforce and candidate pipeline from direct solicitation by the vendor.

attributes.name: psl_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this PSL entry, used in VMS communications, audit trails, and client-facing documentation. Follows the format PSL-{alphanumeric code}.

attributes.name: psl_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor on this PSL entry. preferred = top-tier vendor with priority routing; approved = eligible to receive requisitions; conditional = eligible with restrictions or conditions; excluded = blocked from receiving requisitions; suspended = temporarily ineligible pending review.

attributes.name: psl_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the PSL under which this entry was created or last revised (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports PSL versioning and audit trails when the client program updates its approved vendor roster.

attributes.name: requisition_visibility
attributes.description: Controls whether the vendor can see and respond to open requisitions in the VMS for this client program and job category. visible = vendor sees all eligible reqs; hidden = vendor is on PSL but not shown reqs; restricted = vendor sees only specific reqs per conditional rules.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this vendors PSL status for the client program and job category. Supports governance cadence for PSL maintenance and vendor performance evaluation cycles.

attributes.name: right_to_represent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must obtain a Right to Represent (RTR) confirmation from the candidate before submitting to this client program. When true, the VMS enforces RTR capture prior to submittal acceptance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this PSL entry originated or was last synchronized. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse and reconciliation between VMS and ATS records.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Beeline VMS PSL record ID). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer lakehouse record back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: sow_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is authorized to deliver Statement of Work (SOW) engagements under this PSL entry, in addition to or instead of contingent staffing. Governs SOW requisition routing in the VMS.

attributes.name: submission_cap
attributes.description: Maximum number of candidate submittals the vendor is permitted to make per requisition for this client program and job category. Enforced by the VMS to manage submittal volume and ensure quality of submission (QoS).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSL entry record was most recently modified. Tracks the last change event for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data loading in the Silver Layer lakehouse pipeline.

products.name: diversity_certification
products.description: Tracks vendor diversity certifications required for OFCCP compliance, client diversity spend reporting, and supplier diversity program participation. Captures certification type (MBE, WBE, SDVOB, HUBZone, 8(a), LGBTBE, VOSB), certifying body (NMSDC, WBENC, SBA, USVBA), certification number, issue date, expiration date, certification status (active, expired, pending renewal, revoked), and supporting document reference. Enables diversity spend analytics and OFCCP supplier diversity reporting.
products.reference: Vendor Diversity Certification / Supplier Diversity Record

attributes.name: previous_certification_diversity_certification_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the prior certification record that this record supersedes or renews. Enables certification history chain tracking for audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (staffing supplier, subcontractor, or service provider) that holds this diversity certification. Links to the vendor master record in the vendor domain.

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
